Game Description Hytale is a sandbox role-playing game with a procedurally generated world that invites gamers to explore and create. Travelers will find the Orbis global universe, consisting of many unique climatic zones with their characteristic flora and fauna. The planet’s landscape is represented not only by vast plains, but also by high mountain peaks and deep gorges. In the depths of this world hide dangerous dungeons, inhabited by hostile creatures and guarded by powerful bosses. Each adventure promises valuable rewards and reveals pieces of local history through the artifacts they discover.
In addition to exploring the environment, Hytale provides powerful tools for creativity. Enthusiasts have at their disposal not only the means for block-by-block construction of monumental structures, but also systems for creating their own objects and full-fledged scenarios. Navigating vertically oriented locations is made easier by having a glider. There are several main formats for gamers to interact with the world, access to which is available through the central hub of the Capital:
immersion in a story campaign with base building and dialogues with NPCs. free survival with an emphasis on crafting in randomly generated locations. unlimited construction with endless resources to realize your creative ideas. participation in competitive mini-games on specialized servers.

Game Description Journey Through the Undead is an uncompromising first-person shooter where the sole goal is to survive in a world twisted by the consequences of a catastrophic scientific miscalculation. The confrontation will unfold in the gloomy scenery of abandoned cities and deadly swamps, where grotesque mutants wait around every corner. The main character, who finds himself at the epicenter of events, is deprived of memories of the causes of the tragedy. His progress is subject to a strict linear sequence of missions leading through a series of dangerous zones. The project is an ideological rethinking of its predecessor called Aftertime, offering improved mechanics and redesigned level designs.
The gameplay is built on the contrast between moments of ominous silence and sudden, chaotic clashes with hordes of the living dead. Successful completion of Journey Through the Undead will require constant adaptation to changing conditions. A wide selection of weapons, from melee weapons to firearms, is offset by a limited amount of ammunition, which forces you to carefully plan every action. To stay alive you must:
competently manage found ammunition and medicines. use grenades to eliminate clusters of enemies. Use interactive environmental elements such as exploding barrels to gain a tactical advantage.

Game Description Kin and Quarry is an incremental adventure in which gamers will have to organize large-scale excavations in the bowels of the earth. The player is entrusted with the role of the guardian of the lands, managing the tiny relatives in their difficult mission. The process requires constant monitoring, as the evil Geomancer tirelessly monitors the progress of work. When night falls, the antagonist seals the passage to the mine, suspending all activity until the next day. The success of the enterprise depends entirely on the timely support of wards, whose actions can be accelerated with the help of clicks and swipes.
The main task is to restore the sacred Eternal Tree to its former glory, whose magical substance was stolen and hidden underground. Completing Kin and Quarry opens up access to valuable resources and unique relics. Discovering over 150 rare artifacts helps attract new allies, and mining over 20 types of ore increases the overall efficiency of excavations.
Excavation management and resource extraction:
Hiring teammates with different specializations. Assignment of miners for manual extraction of ore. Using demolitionists to remove hard rocks. Use of a drilling rig for rapid descent to depth. Modernization of tools to improve work efficiency. Collecting a collection of more than 150 unique artifacts. Attract new followers with the help of found relics. Extraction of more than 20 types of valuable ores and minerals. Confronting a Geomancer blocking a mine at night.

Game Description DeadCore Redux is a re-release of a hybrid platformer in which the main goal is to quickly climb to the top of a colossal Tower floating in the void. The protagonist, deprived of memories, finds himself at the foot of this grandiose structure, where each stage is a dense interweaving of traps and zones patrolled by enemies. The process of overcoming levels is built around the use of a special SwitchGun device. With its help, the environment is controlled: moving platforms, gravitational fields and hostile mechanisms are activated and deactivated. Successful advancement depends on the accuracy of jumps and timely interaction with elements of locations.
The updated version of the project offers not only improved graphics and a redesigned interface, but also a new story level that precedes the true ending. DeadCore Redux encourages exploration with plenty of secret passages, and a new ranking system that awards badges for efficiency. To completely immerse yourself in the world and reveal all its secrets, you need to collect various items:
Find Sparks to access additional bonus stages. look for diaries from previous explorers that reveal the background. collect musical compositions for use in speedrun mode.

The main tool for interacting with the world is the protagonist’s gaze, with the help of which the environment is transformed: from discovering hidden clues and turning on lights to activating secret passages. The project is a unique combination of comedic elements and scary moments, where the atmosphere of horror is achieved largely through the sound design.

Game Description One Turn Kill is a PvE card strategy where the only condition for survival is eliminating your opponent within one single turn. Any mistake or miscalculation results in inevitable defeat from the enemy’s counterattack, creating a unique and intense experience. Events unfold in a pixelated setting of devastated lands, where the protagonist will have to face the strongest enemies. The key to success is careful deck construction limited to 20 cards. It is the competent combination of various skills and cards that allows you to create powerful combinations that are more effective than their individual uses.
Combat system and deck building:
Destroying the enemy in one turn is the only condition for victory. Direct attacks serve as the main means of dealing damage. Support cards are used to strengthen other active cards. Combinations are created by sequentially playing skills. Obtaining new cards from the deck requires the expenditure of a special resource. Deck size is strictly limited to twenty cards to increase tactical depth.
An extraordinary feature of the project is the mechanics of drawing cards from a deck. Each draw consumes a special resource, so you must constantly maintain a balance between creating repeatable combos and the risk of being left without available actions. Fast-paced and intense fights in One Turn Kill require the gamer to quickly react and accurately calculate. The visual component is supported by high-quality character animation, synchronized with the drawing of cards. The atmosphere is complemented by energetic musical accompaniment, matching the high tempo of what is happening on the screen and creating the effect of complete immersion.

The basis of all gameplay is the career mode, built on the principles of classic racing projects. The path to the top begins with the purchase of a used car, and the money earned in racing becomes a source for its subsequent modernization or the purchase of faster models.

Game Description The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon is a role-playing adventure that unfolds along three intertwining narrative paths. At the center of the events are Van Arkride, the ashen Chevalier Rin Schwarzer and Father Kevin Graham, whose fates intersect due to a mysterious offer from Marduk to take part in high-tech exercises. The combat system has been enriched with new capabilities, providing unprecedented tactical scope both in field and team battles. The Awakening mechanic allows characters like Ven to unleash hidden power by transforming into Grendel on the battlefield. Shard and S-boost commands provide a variety of benefits, and the Z.O.C. Gives control over time, slowing down opponents for fast attacks.
Events unfold on the continent of Zemuria, which is facing a predicted apocalypse, while humanity prepares for its first trip into space. The process of exploring the detailed territories of the Calvard Republic is closely connected with the strengthening of ties between allies, which is an integral part of the narrative. The main task is to gather allies from all over the world to counter the machinations of Ouroboros in the Gloomy Garden. It is in The Legend of Heroes that you will uncover the secrets that lie at the very core of the universe and determine what awaits everyone beyond the horizon.

Game Description UNFOLLOW will plunge gamers into the depths of the dark side of social networks. In this first-person horror adventure, you’ll meet Anna, who wakes up in an empty house with no memory of how she got there. The only familiar face is Akidearest, a famous YouTuber who helped the heroine cope with the darkest moments of her life. The plot will not leave you indifferent, because you will have to explore the rooms of the house and uncover the most terrible secrets of the protagonist’s past. However, you will not be alone - at every step you will be pursued by a terrible creature that will not give you peace. Can you help Anna get out of this nightmare?
UNFOLLOW is not only a fun game, but also an exploration of the dark side of social media. You can learn more about the influence of social networks on our lives and discover the secrets that are hidden behind each account. Additionally, you can choose either Game Mode or Broadcast Mode if you want to share your gameplay with others. The game is available in two versions - international and Italian, each of which is represented by different Internet personalities, including Knite, Kin Ryan and Elisa True Crime.

Game Description Air Hares is a mission to save the land of Winrose Warren, which has been reduced to a lifeless wasteland after a mysterious dust storm known as the Black Flame. Under the control of a brave pilot, Captain Rabbo Sunskipper, you will have to confront not only the consequences of the cataclysm, but also aggressive feathered opponents from the Gail gang. The main goal is not military superiority, but the revival of agriculture to ensure the survival of an entire settlement on the brink of famine. The protagonist needs to lead a small squad and organize work to cultivate fields in order to turn barren lands into a prosperous community. With each successful mission, the area will gradually transform, proving that even in the harshest conditions, prosperity can be achieved.
The project offers an unconventional take on the genre, where the main task is not to destroy opponents, but to ensure food security. Together with your faithful partner Dirk Doggo or in co-op mode, Air Hares gameplay requires gamers to complete a number of tasks. Gradually, the abandoned settlement is transformed into a thriving metropolis, which attracts new recruits. The levels increase in difficulty, and each of the four stages ends with a battle with one of the main antagonist’s henchmen.
Winrose Warren restoration process:
Sowing carrot fields from the air using special equipment. Confront aggressor birds using evasions and ramming attacks. Attracting new volunteers to the ranks of air defenders. The final battle with the powerful boss Twin Horn for the fate of the entire settlement.

Game Description CASSETTE BOY is an isometric puzzle game with action role-playing elements, the world of which obeys a fundamental law: everything that disappears from sight immediately ceases to exist. The seemingly 2D pixelated environment is actually a fully 3D structure, and changing the viewing angle allows the gamer to directly manipulate reality. It is this ability that becomes the main tool in the quest to find the missing moon, the disappearance of which led to the gradual destruction of the world. During this journey you will meet many mysterious characters, whose stories and dialogues add additional depth and charm to the adventure.
The process of passing is a combination of exploring locations, battles and solving logical problems. CASSETTE BOY’s combat system requires the use of a sword and bow to face a variety of monsters and powerful bosses. Discovering new weapons and equipment significantly expands your tactical options both in combat and when exploring the world. Successful advancement directly depends on mastering unique mechanics, which will require:
remove interfering obstacles from the screen, making them disappear; discover secret routes with a simple turn of perspective; use the environment to gain an advantage over opponents; find non-standard solutions to spatial puzzles.

Game Description Kejora begins with the main character noticing a time anomaly affecting her village, unknowingly living the same day in a continuous loop. She and her companions begin to investigate the source of this curse. Beneath the quiet surface of the settlement lies a secret completely unknown to the residents as they continue to go about their daily business. The player’s goal is to break the time loop by revealing the cause of this phenomenon.
Kejora’s gameplay is based on a party system, where the main character is joined by 2 friends. Each companion has a unique set of skills needed to navigate the world and overcome challenges. These special abilities are used to remove various obstacles and solve puzzles along the way. Sharing skills is the basis for progressing through the story and discovering new locations.
Exploration of the world takes place in hand-drawn locations containing certain riddles and obstacles. The team works together, finding useful items and using shared skills to interact with the environment and unravel mechanisms. This cooperative approach extends to encounters with opponents. The entire game is built on the strategic use of each character’s abilities, allowing you to remove obstacles and reveal the secrets of this world.

Game Description Kotama and Academy Citadel is a 3D Metroidvania set within the walls of the futuristic Carmel Academy. In this isolated world, preparing to celebrate its 100th anniversary, there is one immutable law that rules: the survival of the fittest. The main prize in the fierce struggle for supremacy is the honorary title Star of Carmel, which every student dreams of winning. It is for this prestigious award that a mysterious exchange student named Kotama arrives at the school. Her appearance sets off a chain of events related to an age-old conspiracy and a brewing crisis, calling into question the true goals of the girl herself.
Battles play a central role. The combat system in Kotama and Academy Citadel requires sharp reflexes and tactical thinking, eliminating mindless button mashing. Confrontations with numerous rivals and outlandish opponents require mastering a whole arsenal of techniques:
using the special ability Liquid Detonation to turn the tide of the battle. Activating mental acceleration to exploit the enemy’s brief moments of vulnerability. timely dodges followed by the destruction of special detonation points on opponents.
Exploring the world is not limited to duels. The protagonist will have to navigate a huge and confusing campus, where science fiction intertwines with surrealism. Classrooms here become battlefields, and corridors form time loops. Interactions with other elite students, who act as both rivals and allies, directly affect the development of the plot. The decisions made determine not only the ending of the story of Kotama herself, but also the future fate of the entire academy, revealing the secrets of a century-old conspiracy hidden behind the impeccable facade of the educational institution.

The main task is to investigate the mystery of the Void - an otherworldly force that gradually absorbs all living things. The story begins when an adventurer from another planet crash lands on these lands, finding himself drawn into events of incredible proportions. The project combines nostalgic style with a dynamic combat system that requires honed skills in real time. Exploring the world involves solving puzzles and finding treasures.
The journey begins by choosing one of four archetypes: Berserker, Ranger, Chronomage or Assassin. Each direction of development has its own skill tree, and further specialization is achieved through equipment modifiers and powerful loot dropped by monsters. Philna Fantasy’s deep crafting system allows you to influence your progress yourself. To survive and uncover the secrets of the world, the protagonist will have to:
Explore 9 handcrafted dungeons filled with traps and secrets. collect resources to create weapons, improve armor and brew potions. hunt for magic cards and rare artifacts to receive bonuses. find and raise faithful pets to help you in your travels and battles.

summary: Game Description SHE WAS 98 is a depressing psychological horror with a first-person view, forcing you to face the horrors of a fading consciousness within the walls of a dilapidated apartment. The space, once filled with coziness, is now an oppressive labyrinth of old things, faded photographs and painful memories. The main character arrives in this place with a noble goal - to provide care for his almost hundred-year-old grandmother. Abandoned by other relatives, the elderly woman is completely dependent on her grandson for help.
title: SHE WAS 98

Game Description Streetdog BMX is an arcade extreme cycling simulator where the main goal is to perform spectacular tricks and create long combinations. The space for demonstrating skills is 6 vast locations, including city streets, skate parks and even the roofs of high-rise buildings. Exploration of the environment is encouraged by the presence of many secret areas and the discovery of alternative routes to travel. The core of the gameplay is to combine spins, slides and jumps into continuous series to score the maximum number of points. The project provides ample opportunities for self-expression, allowing you to fine-tune the appearance of the character and his vehicle.
Customization of appearance and bike:
Clothing and accessories that allow you to create a unique style. Hairstyles and tattoos for a detailed look. Wide selection of bicycle components, from frame to chain. A varied palette for painting equipment and vehicles.
There are over 270 challenges to test your skills, including time trials, record-breaking tasks and particularly difficult stunts. The arsenal of available techniques in Streetdog BMX is very extensive and includes both basic elements, like barspin or backflip, and technical grinds. The project does not impose a certain style of passage. You can focus on reaching the top of the leaderboard or just ride for fun, honing your technique and finding new lines to ride.

Game Description Tiny Robots: Portal Escape is a 3D puzzle game whose plot begins with the kidnapping of the protagonist’s grandfather. A young and smart robot named Telly witnesses this incident on his way to his relative’s house. On the spot, he discovers only a devastated workshop, broken inventions, and the only link connecting him with the kidnapped man - a working radio station. The protagonist will have to find out who is behind this crime and what are the motives of the attackers. The investigation will take him through many unusual worlds filled with complex mysteries and powerful opponents.
The journey to save grandfather unfolds over 60 levels, each of which is a colorful location full of secrets. Successful completion of Tiny Robots: Portal Escape requires gamers to pay attention to detail and use logical thinking to interact with the environment. To overcome all obstacles and get closer to solving the mystery, you need to perform a number of actions. To successfully advance through the story, the gamer will have to:
carefully examine locations in search of evidence and hidden objects; solve a variety of mechanical puzzles to advance; collect fragments to later create useful artifacts.
In addition to the main adventure, the project offers a large number of mini-games, as well as the ability to change the appearance of the protagonist, combining hundreds of parts, even installing a shark head or a jet engine instead of legs. Artifacts collected according to the drawings will become an indispensable aid in the confrontation with enemies, which will culminate in battles with epic bosses at the end of each chapter. It is the victory over these powerful opponents that will allow the robot Telly to move step by step closer to saving his grandfather and revealing all the secrets.

Game Description Varmint is an atmospheric anthology platformer set in a harsh world of mechanical horror. Here, organic creatures are relegated to the lowest rung of the food chain, and power belongs to giant metal deities. Players take on the role of fragile pests forced to fight for existence in this depressing setting. The narrative is told without a single word, revealing the tragedy of this world through destroyed locations and silent scenes. Every corner is imbued with a feeling of hostility, as if the environment itself is watching every wrong step of the protagonist.
Unique world protagonists:
The first pest is the personification of speed and constant movement, rewarding quick reactions. The second character is the embodiment of a balanced approach, focused on measured and systematic progress. The third hero is the slowest, but his special adaptations open up ways to solve problems that are inaccessible to others.
The core of Varmint’s gameplay is precision acrobatics, requiring sharp reflexes and memorization of patterns. All enemy attacks and dangers in the levels are clearly marked, which eliminates the element of chance and makes the difficulty fair to the gamer. The mechanics don’t penalize mistakes, offering instant respawns at nearby checkpoints so you can get back into the action without delay. The controls are highly responsive, and the seemingly simple movement mechanics open up significant scope for demonstrating skill. Each of the three acts culminates in massive boss battles that create intense tests of reflexes and tactical thinking.

Game Description Magic Forge Tycoon is a satirical simulator in which the fate of entire kingdoms depends on the decisions of one master weaponsmith. The action takes place in an absurd fantasy world, torn apart by civil strife and political intrigue. The astral forge, hovering over the lands of Corendor, comes under the control of the gamer, where the production of legendary weapons will be established. Every commercial transaction has the potential to spark conflict, but the wise allocation of resources can create lasting peace. Fulfilling orders for warring factions directly changes the balance of power on the global map, and denial of supplies can lead to the fall of an entire nation.
The central element is deep management of production and political processes. The gameplay in Magic Forge Tycoon requires strategic thinking and the ability to foresee the consequences of your actions. To succeed and become the most famous blacksmith, you need to master many interrelated mechanics.
Forge management mechanics:
Forging weapons - selecting optimal blueprints, fine-tuning parameters and casting magic spells to create unique items. Workshop Upgrade - Invest in new technologies to speed up production cycles and unlock advanced crafting techniques. Trading operations are speculation of resources in a market where prices are formed under the influence of military operations and shortages of materials. Political influence - accumulating reputation points to gain access to lucrative contracts and receive exclusive bonuses from various kingdoms.

Game Description Dream of Corpse Lady is a card strategy game in which the story is told from the perspective of the antagonist. Awakened from a long sleep, the Lady of Corpses intends to turn the whole world into her personal collection, using an army of puppets to do this. The main resource for expanding influence and strengthening troops are wandering souls, which must be constantly absorbed. The storyline unfolds over 5 distinctive campaigns and 10 test levels, the complexity of which gradually increases. Mortal heroes who dare to challenge become useless artifacts in the protagonist’s treasury after defeat, allowing access to new cosmetic items and victory illustrations.
The process of strengthening the protagonist and her subordinates is multifaceted. In Dream of Corpse Lady, achieving global dominance requires you to tackle a whole range of tasks.
Strengthening the army of puppets:
Recruit 28 unique followers with a set of special talents. Absorbing wandering souls to strengthen your own troops. Increasing the base characteristics of allies through the blessing system. Use more than 100 magical artifacts to support you in battle. Using Dark Tablets to gain power at the cost of a curse. Instant resurrection of fallen puppets right during the battle. Transforming defeated heroes into exhibits of your treasury. Unlock new cosmetic items for defeating enemies.

Game Description Gamer Stop Simulator - turn a run-down retail outlet into a thriving business, where every item on the shelf has its own story. Having started his journey in an abandoned building with minimal start-up capital and a modest set of old video games, the entrepreneur will have to build a real gaming empire. Success here depends not only on the ability to sell, but also on technical skills, because mastering the intricacies of diagnosing and repairing faulty equipment is a key element for increasing profits. Interaction with visitors, who include both ordinary buyers and experienced collectors, requires honing the art of bargaining. It is successful negotiations that make it possible to acquire rare specimens and valuable artifacts into the collection.
The gradual development of business in Gamer Stop Simulator opens up access to the expansion of retail space and the arrangement of specialized areas, for example, a workshop or a station for testing devices. Attracting a larger flow of customers is directly related to the establishment’s reputation, which is formed from many factors. Effective administration involves performing a number of tasks:
purchasing consoles and cartridges from the population; thorough testing of the performance of goods; replenishment of the assortment with rare collector’s editions; maintaining financial records and controlling expenses.

Game Description Quarantine Zone: The Last Check is a simulator of a quarantine post employee, where the player is responsible for making fateful decisions in a zombie apocalypse. The screening process for arriving refugees requires meticulousness to look for warning signs, from coughs and suspicious wounds to abnormal pulses and greenish tints to the skin. Based on the diagnosis, a verdict is made: allow the survivor into the camp, isolate for observation, or immediately liquidate. Each choice has fatal consequences, since a mistake can cost the life of the entire shelter. In addition to working at the checkpoint, you will have to manage the camp’s resources, distributing food, medicine and electricity. As darkness falls, routine duties are replaced by the need to defend the perimeter from attacks by the infected.
Responsibilities of the checkpoint officer:
Diagnosis of arrivals - use of x-ray, reflex hammer and methiascope to identify signs of infection. Camp management - control the distribution of food, medicine, energy and places to accommodate survivors. Perimeter defense - repelling night attacks of the infected using stationary weapons, drones and automatic turrets. Research activity - studying freshly turned zombies in a special cage to obtain samples and develop improvements.
Attacks from the infected become more intense over time, and opponents demonstrate new tactics, including attacks from rooftops. Survival in Quarantine Zone: The Last Check is complicated not only by external threats, but also by internal problems, because resources are strictly limited. Gradually, the narrative reveals hints of a government conspiracy involving secret experiments and rigged evacuations. The project poses a complex moral question for gamers about preserving humanity when bureaucratic instructions become a tool that determines life and death.

Game Description Pathologic 3 is about a desperate race against time and an exploration of human nature in conditions of total collapse. In the role of the capital’s doctor Daniil Dankovsky, who arrived in a remote steppe city in search of immortality, the gamer finds himself in the midst of a mysterious epidemic. Only 12 days are allotted to save the doomed settlement. Survival requires ruthless decisions as each patient presents a unique medical mystery where lies and ulterior motives interfere with an accurate diagnosis. Exploring isolated areas with their impossible architecture and interacting with unreliable characters plunges you into an atmosphere of psychological horror, where self-control becomes the main resource against the backdrop of general destruction.
Survival in the world of Pestilence 3 requires not only medical knowledge, but also the skillful use of unique tools to control chaos. The central mechanic is the ability to rewrite the past, returning to key moments to correct fatal mistakes. This ability is accompanied by the need to collect the rare resource Amalgam, obtained for completing critical tasks or destroying mirrors. In addition, to counter the plague, the protagonist can introduce citywide decrees, establishing quarantines or curfews, which directly shapes the future of the city, even if its inhabitants come to hate their savior.
Toolkit for surviving an epidemic:
A mind map is a mental diagram for tracking events and storylines. A medical journal is a tool for recording symptoms and making correct diagnoses. The emotional state is a scale between apathy and mania, the extremes of which lead to death. Manipulating time is an opportunity to go back and correct mistakes.

Game Description Set in a dark tale of power, addiction and ruin, Kingdoms And Slaves offers a journey into the ruins of a fallen civilization. The combat system is built on constant pressure and an aggressive fighting style, rewarding quick reactions. The player needs to exploit enemy vulnerabilities that arise after their unsuccessful attacks. The creation of effective combinations is achieved by interweaving strikes with bladed weapons with magic spells and special skills. A key role in survival is played by competent positioning and timely evasion of enemy attacks, turning every collision into a dangerous dance on the verge of defeat.
The protagonist is created from scratch, which allows you to create a unique style of passage. The development process in Kingdoms And Slaves is closely related to the exploration of the destroyed world. Exploring optional locations and hidden areas is rewarded with valuable upgrades for the character and his equipment. One of the central mechanics is the rescue of representatives of the Greenin race, enslaved by the fallen king. Each rescued ally returns to base, providing long-term benefits and opening access to the creation of new weapons or strengthening of existing abilities.
Events take place in the ruins of the once great Kingdom of Fire, whose prosperity was based on living crystals. These shining stones turned out to be a curse that plunged the inhabitants into madness and caused the catastrophic collapse of civilization. You can go through this dark path either alone or in cooperative mode to overcome difficulties together. For those who appreciate the competitive aspect, there are battles in the player versus player format, where the outcome depends solely on skill and tactical calculation.

Game Description BULT: Hunting simulator is a waterfowl hunting simulator in which the result is determined not by reaction speed, but by methodical planning. The protagonist finds himself in open spaces inspired by the harsh nature of Yakutia. The atmosphere is formed by misty swamps, wide lakes and quiet shores, where any mistake is instantly noticed. Success depends on the ability to read the landscape, understand bird habits, and quickly respond to changing conditions. Each fishing trip becomes a lesson in attentiveness and control, turning a well-aimed shot into a valuable achievement.
The behavior of birds is subject to complex algorithms: they have natural instincts, flock together and are sensitive to human actions. The ballistic model in BULT: Hunting simulator is highly developed, taking into account air resistance, the weight of the shot and its spread. The process of luring prey requires a strategic approach. Careful placement of decoys and timely use of decoys help direct the flock to the desired area, while excessive activity or careless noise can undo minutes of careful preparation.
One of the gameplay components is the ethical fishing system. The local ecosystem contains rare species listed in the Red Book, and their shooting entails game fines. This aspect encourages thoughtful actions and respectful attitude towards fauna. The project is aimed at connoisseurs of a thoughtful process, where patience is rewarded much more generously than reflexes. There is no place for arcade rush, and each trophy becomes a natural result of the demonstrated endurance and composure.

The work on display ranges in scale from compact 50x50 sketches to impressive 500x500 panels, including one particularly large final commission. Game Description Raiders of Blackveil is a hybrid action role-playing game, the gameplay of which is based on tactical battles and team interaction in a group of up to 3 people. The combat system requires gamers not to use skills chaotically, but to accurately position and competently manage abilities with recovery time. The process of clearing locations is reminiscent of competitive arenas, where success depends on a combination of attacks and the timely use of skills. The depth of the passage is given by a system of perks, numbering over 300 modifiers, allowing you to create unique builds for each character. The protagonists will have to penetrate industrial facilities, destroy robots and security forces, and steal enemy technology.
Available class archetypes:
The Warrior is a fighter who is effective in the thick of battle and can withstand significant damage. The Guardian is a tank that specializes in crowd control and protecting allies. The Assassin is a stealthy character with high explosive damage, focused on surprise attacks. A mage is a specialist in eliminating large groups of enemies using spells. The Priest is a support hero who buffs and heals other party members. The Monk is a mobile fighter who uses martial arts to evade and deal damage. The Druid is a summoner who relies on the forces of nature and creatures to fight. A warlock is a sorcerer who sacrifices his own health to gain power.
The events take place in a dark industrial world where anthropomorphic animals fight against the oppressive Blackvale Corporation. Each mission in Raiders of Blackveil involves a raid on procedurally generated factories followed by an evacuation. Successful completion of the mission allows you to keep all the loot, which is used for improvements on the mobile base called the Liberator. If a character dies, only temporary equipment found during the raid is lost, while the main currency and meta-progression are retained.

summary: Game Description Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a side-scrolling action game, the gameplay of which is based on constant switching between two forms of the main character. In her vampire form, the protagonist becomes a deadly weapon, armed with a huge scythe. However, staying in this form is associated with a constant loss of health, which forces you to look for balance in battle. Replenishment of vitality occurs only after returning to human form, where the heroine is much more vulnerable and uses the staff to weaken opponents, rather than destroy them.
title: Vampiress: Eternal Duet

Game Description Alchemy Factory is a large-scale project that turns the mystical art of alchemy into a well-functioning production mechanism. A novice adept of magical sciences comes under the control of the gamer, who will have to go from a modest shop owner to the head of an entire industrial empire. The company specializes in the creation of potions, metal processing and jewelry making. The main goal is to transform manual labor into a completely self-sufficient system, operating with virtually no intervention, where all processes from grinding herbs to transmuting ore into the Philosopher’s Stone are performed automatically.
The process of building production chains is based on the use of a variety of logistics tools. There are conveyor belts for moving ingredients and finished goods, as well as a network of magical pipelines for liquid reagents. Alchemy Factory also features a high-capacity rail system that allows you to personally travel around the complex by train. In the middle of the passage, access to portals opens up, radically simplifying logistics. The construction of all structures takes place in a first-person view, and the voxel construction system ensures convenient and accurate placement of objects.
Profit generation is organized through trade in finished products. Sales of goods, like production, can be automated through the introduction of self-service checkouts and special mechanisms for replenishing the assortment on the shelves. To optimize complex production lines, the possibility of joint passage is provided. In co-op mode, you can invite other alchemists to help design and set up your workshop. The visual execution of the project is made in the low-poly style, which emphasizes the cubic basis of the building elements and gives the world a special charm.

Game Description Everdream Village is an adventure simulator where the main goal is not only farming, but also exploring the magical world. Daytime worries about arranging and restoring the estate are replaced by magical night dreams, which allow you to inhabit various animals and look at the surrounding reality from a completely new perspective. The process of transforming an abandoned property into a thriving summer paradise requires attention to detail, whether it’s cultivating a variety of fruits and vegetables or caring for numerous pets that need protection, nutrition and entertainment.
The center of everything becomes a settlement, which is not just a collection of buildings, but a living community. Interaction with its inhabitants and the development of relationships directly affects their willingness to help in economic matters, including harvesting or logging. Beyond the comforts of home in Everdream Village there is an entire archipelago accessible for sea travel. Each island has a unique ecosystem, treasures and resources necessary for the further prosperity and expansion of the village.
The project provides ample opportunities to change the landscape: from creating hills and rivers to digging deep dungeons in search of hidden artifacts. In addition, there is a system for breeding animals with heritable traits, as well as many side activities such as fishing, cooking and running errands. This project is a development of the ideas of the previous part, offering deeper mechanics and an expanded world for exploration both in single mode and in co-op for 4 people.

Arrangement of furniture, including sofas, tables, chairs and cabinets. Free movement and rotation of every object in the room. Selection of textures and materials for flooring and walls. Game Description Military Logistics Simulator is a first-person simulator dedicated to managing the complex support mechanisms of modern armies. The project proposes to concentrate not on front-line battles, but on rear operations, on which the outcome of any armed conflict depends. Players will have to go through professional growth from an ordinary supply chain to an experienced quartermaster, taking full responsibility for organizing and protecting supply chains in hostile territory. The main goal is not the destruction of the enemy, but the systematic restoration of the war-torn region, including the rescue of the surviving population and the revival of critical infrastructure.
The process of passing involves the constant development of our own operating base and vehicle fleet. Completing high-paying contracts opens up access to financing, allowing you to purchase new buildings and more advanced equipment. In Military Logistics Simulator it is necessary not only to deliver valuable cargo, but also to repel sabotage or drone attacks. Fulfilling the assigned tasks requires an integrated approach, because the gamer will have to:
evacuate surviving civilians. use the German Shepherd to detect explosives. transport and deploy air defense systems. drive reconnaissance trucks and heavy transporters.

Game Description Terminator 2D: NO FATE is an arcade action game, the plot of which is based on the events of the cult sci-fi action film, offering to relive iconic episodes in a 2D side-scroller format. Gamers take control of characters such as Sarah Connor and T-800, who will have to thwart the plans of Skynet’s artificial intelligence. The main enemy is the invulnerable T-1000, and the main task is to prevent the total destruction of humanity in the coming war.
The project is not limited to one genre, combining several game mechanics. Beat ‘em up-style battles give way to stealth episodes, as well as intense run-and-gun shootouts. In addition to re-enacting classic scenes from the film, Terminator 2D: NO FATE allows you to lead the Resistance in the future by taking on the role of John Connor. These War Against the Machine missions contain original scenarios that expand on the original universe.
Visual execution in the style of hand-crafted pixel graphics recreates the atmosphere of classic arcade games of the nineties. The non-linearity of the narrative with several ending options and the scoring system with a table of records encourage repeated playthroughs. The presence of several modes allows you to take a different look at the gameplay, be it sequential exploration of the story or battles with bosses. The outcome of the battle for the future depends entirely on the player’s actions.

Game Description CorgiSpace is an anthology that brings together under one cover more than a dozen independent projects made in a recognizable eight-bit style. This compilation offers a fast-paced dive into a variety of genres, from arcade and puzzle to adventure and action. The key concept is to provide a concentrated experience: each individual piece is designed to be completed in short sessions and does not take more than an hour to complete. Thus, gamers have the opportunity to get acquainted with many original ideas and unusual mechanics in one sitting, constantly switching between completely different virtual worlds and tasks.
Each element of the collection represents a complete concept with its own rules and goals. Some of the mini-games featured in CorgiSpace even have a progress save feature, allowing you to return to your favorite challenges. The kaleidoscope of available scenarios includes both logical tasks and dynamic confrontations.
Examples of game concepts:
Rat Dreams is an action game in the spirit of souls-like, where the protagonist’s movement is limited exclusively to rolls. Dino Sort is a puzzle game that requires you to place dinosaurs in the correct order based on their food preferences. Cave of Cards is a miniature rogue-like about clearing dungeons of killer mushrooms using explosives. Kuiper Cargo - cargo delivery, where success depends on the competent selection of improvements and increasing the guild rank.

Game Description Drifter Star: Evolution is a unique experience of cosmic evolution, where the path from stardust to galactic ruler depends solely on the ability to absorb everything in its path. The process of climbing the cosmic food chain begins with controlling an unnoticed fragment floating defenselessly in the void. Each collision with smaller objects increases mass and opens up new forms of existence, from planets and stars to powerful black holes. The gradual transformation is accompanied by a change in the scale of the environment: what seemed like an endless space eventually becomes cramped and filled with potential goals.
Progression is not automatic. At key stages of development, Drifter Star: Evolution proposes to determine the further specialization of the celestial body, shaping its strengths and weaknesses. You can turn your site into an impregnable ice fortress, a balanced cradle of life, or an aggressive military planet focused on rapid expansion. This choice directly affects the survival style and is associated with a constant assessment of risks, because in space there are always larger bodies, a collision with which can instantly interrupt many hours of development.
Gameplay combines meditative exploration with sudden bursts of tension. The initial stages force you to act carefully, looking for safe sources of matter, but as the scale grows, the situation changes dramatically. The former object of the hunt itself turns into a gravitational threat, attracting and absorbing weaker neighbors in the star cluster. The visual transformation, from humble stone to dazzling star, is the ultimate reward for thoughtful action and patience on the path to absolute dominance.

Game Description I Sell Lemonade is a story about a 1980s summer spent on the sidewalk with a pitcher of soft drink. At the center of the story is a 10-year-old child who, after his father sells his gaming console, is forced to look for something to do on the street. An activity initially conceived as a way to pass the time gradually turns into an extended journey through childhood experiences, friendships and character formation. The project immerses you in the nostalgic atmosphere of an era where summer days were spent in the open air, and the visual style and musical accompaniment create a feeling of warmth. This is not just a business simulator, but a story about seemingly insignificant events that lead to serious internal changes.
The process of managing your own small business includes inventory control and setting prices for goods, which allows you to master the basics of economics and communication with neighbors. However, commercial success is not the only goal in I Sell Lemonade, as the narrative focuses on personal growth. Every day confronts the protagonist with new choices that influence his development. He will have to solve many life problems:
stand up to the local basketball kingpin for respect and a boombox; earn the right to participate in underground races on radio-controlled cars; find a way to start a conversation with the neighbor girl; learn to build a dialogue with your own father.

Game Description Anxiety Puppy is an interactive story that focuses on coming to terms with your inner state. At the center of the plot is an unusual metaphor, where anxiety takes on a physical embodiment in the form of a small puppy. This approach turns a complex psychological topic into a touching fairy tale for adults. The project is made in the original style of an illustrated book, and the entire visual range is made by hand. Warm color palette and expressive animation create a calm and peaceful atmosphere. The focus is on emotional response and self-discovery rather than overcoming difficult challenges, allowing for a deeper dive into the story of finding harmony.
The story introduces a young girl whose measured life in the metropolis hides growing internal tension. Her days seem to be an endless repetition of the routine of school and work. On one of the sleepless nights, the heroine of Anxiety Puppy is transported to a surreal world, which has become a reflection of her experiences. The gameplay is based on delicate interaction with the environment and does not require honed skills. To establish contact with your alter ego, you need to take a few simple steps:
explore the history of a mysterious creature. find traces of him in a strange dimension. try to establish peaceful coexistence with him.

Game Description Bits and Bops is a collection of original rhythm challenges, with each challenge featuring its own soundtrack and unique characters. The gameplay involves hammering nails to the beat, capturing a photo of a rare sea creature, or synchronizing jumping on a handcar as mole miners to keep it moving. Other tasks include pairs skating on ice, where you have to match your partner’s movements to avoid falling, or hitting coins thrown by a monkey to aim them accurately at a suitcase. In total, more than 20 similar scenarios are presented, each of which requires concentration and a sense of rhythm.
Examples of rhythmic tests:
Hammering nails in exact accordance with the rhythm of the music. Photographing a sea creature at the brief moment of its appearance. Controlling a trolley using synchronized jumps of characters. Repeating your partner’s dance movements while skating on ice. Deflecting flying coins to redirect them into the suitcase. Using original melodies as a guide for action. Interaction with unique characters in each task.
Success in each test is directly dependent on the ability to accurately respond to auditory and visual cues. Gorgeous hand-crafted 2D animations and haunting original tunes serve as the player’s main reference points. It is these elements in Bits and Bops that determine the right moments to perform an action, and mastering simple controls does not cause difficulties. In all adventures, the gamer is constantly accompanied by a charming character named Bop, who is a hybrid of a dog and a bear.

Game Description Boxing Simulator is a complex project that combines elements of a sports manager and a fighting game. The basis of the gameplay is the creation and development of your own training room, which includes the purchase of a variety of equipment, from boxing rings to weight training equipment. Management also involves recruiting new athletes every day, each with a unique set of characteristics such as health, strength and speed. The gamer has a dual role: he can personally enter the ring or focus on coaching. Choosing opponents for fights requires a balanced approach, since battles with strong opponents bring great rewards, but are associated with a high risk of defeat.
The central element is a unique control system, where mouse movements are directly translated into body turns and punches of the virtual athlete. Boxing Simulator does not have the usual list of combinations or a parry system, and success depends entirely on the accuracy of your actions. Intuitive controls let you throw uppercuts, jabs and hooks without having to learn complicated button sequences. To achieve success, it is necessary to constantly improve fighters, for which various training activities are provided:
working on boxing bags to hone punching power; sparring in the ring to increase endurance and defense; exercise on treadmills to improve speed; strength exercises with iron to build muscle mass.

Game Description Dead Format is an experimental survival horror game that immerses you in nightmarish worlds inspired by various eras of cinema. The project offers a unique combination of gameplay and live action scenes recorded on videotape, which effectively blurs the line between fiction and reality. The protagonist will have to explore the contents of mysterious GHL format cassettes, each of which opens a portal to a separate universe with its own rules and dangers. The events take place in Scotland in the 90s, where the main character begins a desperate search for his brother, who disappeared after becoming fascinated by mysterious recordings. The situation is aggravated by rumors of a government ban on these films, known as Video Nasties.
The only safe place is the character’s apartment, which serves as a center for analyzing evidence and preparing for attacks. This is where the TV for playing tapes is located, and only in this shelter is the function of saving progress available. Inside each world, you need to search for supplies for survival and solve puzzles in order to unlock further progress. The Dead Format arsenal consists of weapons and tools that are stylistically appropriate to the cinematic era in which the hero finds himself. Each universe is filled with unique enemies, challenges and powerful bosses.
Inspiration for worlds:
The cinema of the silent era is silent horror and distorted reality. Italian giallo are tense thrillers with intricate plots. Body horror of the 80s - frightening bodily transformations and mutations. Found film - the effect of presence and fear of the unknown.

Diving into a mysterious rift is fraught with enormous risk, as the process of drilling into ever deeper layers of rock inexorably affects the minds of the dwarves. The growing insanity serves as a kind of beacon for monsters hiding in the impenetrable darkness of the dungeons, turning every foray into a deadly undertaking. Having started an expedition with only four workers and a minimal set of supplies, the player immediately feels the fragility of his position, where any mistake could be the last.
All outpost activities are built around the competent distribution of scarce supplies and timely modernization of equipment. Every decision made in Drill Rift has long-term consequences for the entire mission. A special layer of gameplay is the incident system, which requires workers to be sent to resolve them, where success depends on the characteristics of the selected gnome, which influence the outcome of the dice roll. To ensure the viability of the colony it is necessary to constantly:
engage in the construction and improvement of key mechanisms. exercise strict control over limited stocks. carefully assign gnomes to tasks, protecting their health and sanity. improve the qualifications and level of their students.

Game Description Dunjungle is a 2D game where gamers take on the role of a monkey tasked with protecting the jungle from a corrupting force. The gameplay is a mixture of exploration, combat and survival. Each dungeon that users encounter transforms with each playthrough, creating a unique experience every time. Such a dynamic environment forces gamers to be on alert. One moment you might be faced with a swarm of unusual enemies, and the next you might find yourself walking through treacherous traps.
In Dunjungle, variety is the name of the game. There are many types of weapons and relics available to gamers. These items can be combined in different ways to achieve different effects. This element of experimentation gives the combat system depth. Instead of relying solely on brute force, users can combine their arsenal and find strategies that suit them. This encourages a trial-and-error approach, where success comes from learning and adapting rather than learning patterns.
The main gameplay is based on the need to build a strategy. As users delve deeper into the jungle, they encounter various problems. The design ensures that neither of the two experiences are mirror images of each other. The unpredictability of each run enhances the sense of adventure. Gamers may think they have the situation figured out, but an unexpected enemy or new dungeon layout may throw a surprise at them. This unpredictability draws players into the process, forcing them to think about their actions.

Game Description Express No 6 is an intense psychological horror where the main task is survival in the confined space of a moving train. Events take place on New Year’s Eve, and only 30 minutes of real time are allotted for rescue. The protagonist, being an ordinary passenger, finds himself in the midst of terrible incidents. His main mission is to urgently stop the train and save his own life. An unusual camera becomes a key tool for understanding what is happening. It is his lens that is capable of revealing the hidden essence of things and showing the truth inaccessible to the naked eye.
Gameplay and conditions:
Strict time limit of 30 real minutes to complete. The main goal is an emergency stop of a moving train. Using a camera to detect hidden phenomena and evidence. Procedural generation of events with each new playthrough. The direct impact of the player’s actions on the final ending of the story. Exploring confined spaces of carriages to find clues.
Each new playthrough generates a unique sequence of events and discoveries, which ensures high replayability. The process in Express No 6 requires the gamer to have maximum concentration and the ability to quickly respond to a changing situation. Strategic depth is enhanced by special relics that unlock powerful synergistic effects and significantly increase combat potential. Each new playthrough in From The Top offers a unique path, as the level structure and available paths are randomly generated. A thoughtful choice of the further path allows you to optimally prepare for the final clash, where you will have to defeat the main boss of the adventure.

Game Description The Temple of Elemental Evil opens up a world where a resurgent darkness gathers around the ruins of a destroyed cultist stronghold near the village of Hommlet. Many years ago, the spontaneous cult of the demoness was defeated, and its citadel was destroyed by the Circle of Eight detachment. Now the local roads are overrun by bandits, and ominous gatherings are taking place within the walls of the fallen fortress. A group of adventurers will have to investigate these incidents, reveal the identities of the mysterious figures and fight the source of the growing chaos that threatens to engulf all the surrounding lands.
Taking control of a squad of five created heroes, the gamer can hire three more companions in The Temple of Elemental Evil. Each character develops through a selection of skills, talents, and spells based on the Dungeons & Dragons system. The project supports any worldview, allowing you to solve problems from good, neutral or evil positions. The choice you make directly affects your communication with non-player characters inhabiting various locations in the world of Greyhawk.
Battles in this game take place in a turn-based tactical mode, requiring competent positioning and coordinated actions of the squad against a variety of monsters. The narrative branches based on the player’s decisions, creating many separate story paths and shaping a unique adventure. The choices made directly lead to different outcomes and multiple endings, reflecting the consequences of the group’s actions. The entire game gradually evolves from an investigation into a local mystery into a direct confrontation with an ancient evil that threatens the entire region.

Game Description Death Howl is a tactical card roguelike with soulslike elements, where battles with otherworldly entities take place in arenas divided into square cells. Each move requires informed decisions, because the outcome of the fight depends on the correct use of cards with attacking and defensive skills. You will have to confront not only ordinary spirits, but also powerful bosses, defeating which will require a deep understanding of their behavior. Defeat here does not mean the end, but serves only as the next stage of learning, forcing you to reconsider your strategy and deck composition.
At the center of the story is a hunter named Ro, who refuses to accept the loss of her son and goes to the spirit world to save him. The process of exploring the gloomy world, made in the style of the Scandinavian Stone Age, is directly related to the gameplay. In Death Howl, each new area, be it the Forest of Howling Shadows or the Meadows of Delusion, unlocks unique maps. This allows gamers to collect ingredients and create new elements for their deck, gradually increasing their combat potential.
The deck customization options go beyond simply creating cards. A special role is played by shamanic totems - artifacts that give the deck additional passive and active properties, which adds even greater tactical variety. As the story progresses, pieces of Ro’s personal story are revealed, touching on themes of grief, healing, and resilience. Thus, each defeated opponent not only brings the heroine closer to her goal, but also becomes part of her metaphorical path to accepting loss.

Game Description Keep the Heroes Out is an asymmetrical cooperative strategy game, an adaptation of the board game of the same name for 1-4 people. The entire gameplay is based on protecting the dungeon from the attacks of self-proclaimed heroes seeking to plunder the treasury. Participants will take control of monsters, each of which has a unique set of abilities and a starting deck of cards. Effective interaction and clever combination of monster skills, performing roles from crowd control to support, becomes the key to success in solving constantly changing tactical puzzles. Progress is expressed in the ability to create new cards, thereby improving and personalizing your deck for a more effective confrontation.
The main task is to protect treasures from invaders over several waves. After the player’s turn ends, the attack phase begins, when bands of adventurers enter the catacombs. Losing all the valuables from the vault in Keep the Heroes Out means immediate defeat for the entire team. The death of an individual monster does not lead to elimination from the session, since it can always be returned to service. Numerous levels with unique dungeon layouts and special rules add variety to the experience, from collecting frogs for the witch Olga to participating in a music competition. Controlling your own creatures involves performing a number of tactical maneuvers:
activating unique skills to gain an advantage; distribution of available actions among several units; timely replenishment of the hand to five cards at the end of the turn.

Game Description RuneQuest: Warlords is a turn-based strategy game set in the mythical world of Glorantha, inspired not by medieval clichés but by the mysticism and tribal cultures of the Bronze Age. The basis of everything here are the divine Runes, which determine not only magical abilities, but also the very identity of the warriors. Belonging to certain Runes directly affects the available skills and cultural aspects of the controlled factions. The confrontation takes place on maps divided into cells, where tactical positioning and terrain play a decisive role in the outcome of battles.
The 18-mission story campaign places commanders at the center of a brutal conflict. Take control of Halgrim, champion of the Biling tribe, forced to unite his allies to repel the Chaos invasion from Dorastor. Throughout the story, RuneQuest: Warlords introduces such iconic figures to the universe as Ketil White-Eyes and the Lord of Chaos Ralzakark. Players will face three main forces: the tribal warriors of Talastar, the mutated monsters of Chaos, and the disciplined legions of the Lunar Empire.
Combat squads are made up of multiple models, each with their own health pool, making resource depletion a significant factor on the battlefield. Spending action points on movement, attacks, and special abilities forms the core of tactical planning, with heroic units having an expanded pool of points to perform more complex maneuvers. Each unit creates a zone of control around itself, making it difficult for enemy forces to retreat. In addition to the main story, the project offers separate scenarios in the format of skirmishes with artificial intelligence, as well as multiplayer arenas for competitive matches.

The plot follows a girl named Beat and her companions as they navigate a repressive society where live concerts are an act of defiance. Clashes with law enforcement occupy a central place in the story, often escalating into direct skirmishes that force the heroes to flee. The situation is complicated by encounters with mysterious monsters and alliances with other individuals wanted by the authorities.
The gameplay in UNBEATABLE is divided into two components. In the arcade rhythm segments, the player will perform musical numbers using a simple two-button system for pressing up and down. The second half of the gameplay is devoted to exploring the world, freely moving around locations and communicating with various characters. This adventure segment contains branching dialogue and choices that influence the development of the plot and lead to large-scale staged scenes that combine both mechanics.
In addition to the main story, the project has an arcade mode, which is a separate game with its own development system and online elements. It offers modifiers and a challenge board with many challenges of varying difficulty levels. The mode contains an extensive library of original compositions, also presented in the form of acoustic versions and remixes. Completing tasks unlocks items for customizing your personal profile, which adds content independent of the main adventure.

Pricing - analysis of the market and demand to set the optimal cost of goods. Warehouse logistics - organizing the storage of products and timely expansion of space. Game Description Angeline Era is a 3D adventure in which former soldier Tetsu Kinoshta must find the truth in a chaotic world. Together with the angel Arcas Gemini, he must break through the storm hiding the angels' mothership, the Throne, to uncover its secrets and determine the future. The gameplay of Angeline Era offers a non-linear exploration of the world, where you can freely move around the global map in search of hidden levels and secrets. Confronting enemies requires not only combat skills, but also attentiveness to the environment, because various obstacles constantly arise along the way:
moving walls that change the geometry of locations; deadly volleyballs flying along an unpredictable trajectory; animated hammers chasing the protagonist.
The narrative plunges into a dark mythology woven from Irish folklore and esoteric Christian motifs. In addition to the story campaign, for fans of classic challenges there is an arcade mode aimed at achieving the maximum score in battles with waves of enemies. The flexibility of the passage is ensured by the weapon and armor improvement system, which allows you to adapt your fighting style to your preferences. For those looking for a more accessible experience, there are varying difficulty levels, and for genre veterans, nightmarish challenges that test your skill to the limit.

Game Description Yakuza 0 Directors Cut is an extended edition of the crime drama that explores the backstory of two of the franchise’s iconic characters. Set against the backdrop of Japan’s economic euphoria in 1988, the story takes place in the neon lights of fictional Tokyo and Osaka. The narrative focuses on two characters: a young member of the Tojo clan, Kazuma Kiryu, is falsely accused of murder, and cabaret manager Goro Majima is ordered to eliminate a defenseless girl, but decides to protect her. The fates of both protagonists are intertwined around a fierce struggle for a small plot of land known as the Empty Lot. This version of the project is supplemented with previously unseen scenes and the Red Light Raid multiplayer mode, where you can fight waves of opponents.
The Yakuza 0 Directors Cut experience not only offers an intense story to follow, but also a deep dive into asset management. In addition to street fights, much of his time is devoted to developing side businesses: Kiryu is buying up real estate in the Kamurocho area, and Majima runs his own cabaret club in Sotenbori. The combat system offers variety by switching between three unique styles for each hero. Kiryu’s arsenal of moves includes balanced, power and speed styles, while Majima relies on unpredictable techniques, including using a baseball bat. All ability upgrades are purchased with money earned in battles or from business activities.
Exploring detailed city locations offers plenty of ways to take your mind off the crime spree. The open world is filled with secondary tasks and various mini-entertainments that allow you to feel the atmosphere of the era.
Activities of neon megacities:
Visiting discos with dance competitions. Participate in races with customizable Pocket Circuit car models. Walkthrough of classic arcade machines from SEGA. Competitions in bowling, darts and other salon entertainment.

Game Description Light Up The Town is a cozy project, the main goal of which is to create a festive atmosphere in a small town on the eve of winter celebrations. The process of transforming the settlement provides complete freedom to realize creative ideas. Placement of multi-colored garlands is carried out with a simple mouse click, and for each decorative element detailed settings of dimensions and rotation angle are available. The protagonist is a young ferret named Bean. Exploring the snowy streets is rewarded with hidden coins. This in-game currency can be exchanged for even more colorful and varied decorations, expanding the arsenal of available decorative tools. In addition, Bean delivers gifts to other residents of the town.
The plot takes you to the fictional settlement of Bellflower, located in Colorado. The entire story of Light Up The Town revolves around the sudden illness of local electrician Chuck. Due to illness, he is unable to prepare the city for the annual Winter Festival. All responsibility for decorating the streets and saving the holiday from the approaching snowstorm falls on the shoulders of his daughter. Placement of festive garlands and decorations on more than 10 levels. Find and collect hidden coins to unlock new content. Delivery of gifts to residents to enhance the festive mood.

Exploration of this large-scale facility, consisting of 26 separate compartments, requires extreme caution, as any area contains lethal threats and hidden secrets. The chances of survival are determined by careful management of supplies and careful tactics in confrontations with the monstrous creatures generated by the complex. Further passage requires finding solutions to logical problems integrated into the environment, as well as the ability to remain unnoticed by creatures that react to light sources and movement. Reconstruction of the picture of the tragedy that occurred is carried out through the analysis of discovered diaries, video archives and the remains of station employees.
Major Axel Wex, an experienced employee of the special squad for working with alien incidents, sent to check the emergency beacon from the Tsengon facility, comes under control. What initially seemed like an ordinary task quickly turns into a struggle for one’s own existence. In HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach, the character will have to confront a mysterious organic entity that has the ability to control physical objects and consciousness. The adaptive mechanism for instilling fear reacts to the style of passage and the steps taken by the character.
The feeling of constant anxiety is formed through a combination of psychological pressure and direct biological threat. Successful overcoming of difficulties is impossible without meticulous management of limited supplies. The atmosphere is complemented by elaborate sound design, which not only enhances the suspense, but also serves as a tool for navigation in space. The narrative part is revealed through environmental elements: found recordings and video materials allow us to reconstruct the chronology of the tragic events in parts.

Game Description ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL is an atmospheric survival adventure set in a surreal world reminiscent of a frozen limbo. The protagonist wakes up in a secluded hut in the middle of a silent taiga, deprived of any memories of his past. The surrounding reality, known as the Wasteland, is subject to a strict cycle of day and night. Daylight hours provide an opportunity to prepare and gather resources, while as darkness falls, the icy desert becomes filled with hostile entities. The feeling of constant threat and isolation forces you to carefully plan every action in order to survive one more day and get closer to solving the mystery of your own origin.
The process of exploring the world is built on elements of roguelite, where each failure is not a final defeat, but becomes a lesson. Death opens up access to new knowledge and craft recipes, allowing you to move further with each new attempt. The narrative in ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL unfolds through quests that gradually shed light on the mysterious past of this place. To counter the dangers, you will need to master a number of vital activities.
Wasteland Survival Basics:
Crafting tools and weapons is vital for defense and food production. Hunting and fishing are the main ways to replenish food supplies in harsh conditions. Upgrading equipment and skills is the only way to adapt in the face of increasing threats. Exploring a variety of biomes is the key to unlocking secrets and finding valuable resources.

Game Description Blood: Refreshed Supply is the definitive edition of the iconic first-person shooter, combining a dark Lovecraftian aesthetic with extreme levels of brutality. The passage unfolds over 42 levels filled with an ominous atmosphere, where the player will have to face hordes of bloodthirsty creatures. Confronting sinister cult fanatics, gargoyles, zombies and hellhounds forms the basis of the entire process. To exterminate enemies, there is an extensive arsenal, including both standard firearms and more exotic means of destruction, such as a flare pistol or voodoo dolls.
The central figure of the story is a rifleman named Caleb, who has risen from the dead. He was once one of the chosen commanders of the powerful Cabal order, serving the dark deity Chernobog, but for unknown reasons he was betrayed and killed by his patron. Now, having returned from the grave, the protagonist is driven solely by a thirst for revenge. His main goal in Blood: Refreshed Supply is to find and destroy not only Chernobog himself, but also all his minions responsible for the betrayal.
This updated edition offers all the content of the original project, including the classic additions Plasma Pak and Cryptic Passage. In addition, it is expanded with two completely new story scenarios - Marrow and Death Wish. Technical improvements include multiplayer mode, which now supports up to 8 participants in cooperative and competitive formats, including split-screen. Expanded support for custom modifications has also been implemented, opening up space for community creativity.

Game Description Forgot is a psychological horror game where the only way to get out of a trap is to be extremely attentive to the details of the environment. The whole process comes down to careful observation of a familiar environment in search of the slightest deviations from the norm. The detection or absence of oddities directly affects the critical decision: whether to eat the offered cake. If anomalies are noticed in the room, the dessert will be poisoned and should be discarded immediately. If everything looks familiar, the treat is safe. The path to freedom will open only after a series of 12 error-free verdicts in a row, which will allow you to break the time loop and wait for the morning.
Game loop elements:
Monitoring the room to look for anomalous phenomena. Making a decision to eat the offered cake. Refusal to eat if any oddities are detected. The need to perform 12 error-free actions in a row. Moving around a house with a looping architecture of rooms. The main task is to wait until morning and break the loop.
The protagonist is a boy who finds himself a prisoner in his own house along with his grandparents. However, the reality of these relatives and the home itself is highly questioned. Attempts to leave the building turn out to be failures, since all exits lead to the same rooms, creating the feeling of an endless labyrinth. Time in Forgot freezes at midnight, and the grandmother persistently convinces her grandson to stay, constantly offering him treats and sending him back to his room. Only a correct assessment of the situation will help you wait for dawn and finally gain the long-awaited freedom.

Game Description In Pawn Planet you will plunge headlong into the crazy world of an interstellar pawn shop. Forget dusty earthly stores; it’s a galaxy filled with strange clients and even stranger objects. Here you will have to test your customer service skills by dealing with grumpy Glurgs and outrageous Zilarians who are eager to make a sale or a profitable deal. But in “Planet of Pawns” you need to do more than just bargain. You’ll need a keen eye to spot a good deal, the savvy to buy low and sell high, and the know-how to distinguish a fake from a real space shuttle engine.
Auctions become your hunting ground, where rare artifacts and forgotten treasures await the discerning pawnbroker. The game doesn’t hold your hand. You’ll have to get your hands dirty by scrounging for parts, fixing broken devices to maximize profits, and keep a close eye on the sticky fingers of space pirates. Every decision has weight. Should you invest in risky repairs or play it safe? The choice is yours, but one wrong move could leave you deep in debt with a galactic ransomman on your tail. As your reputation grows, so does your store.
Updates are unlocked to allow you to display a wider range of products and attract even more eccentric customers. But the adventure doesn’t end at your store door. The galaxy beckons! Explore unfamiliar planets, find hidden treasures, and maybe even pull off a daring heist or two. The universe is your pawnshop, and the possibilities are endless. Pawn Planet is a breath of fresh air in the simulation genre. It’s a quirky, challenging and ultimately rewarding experience that will keep you glued to the screen as you strategize, wheel and haggle your way to galactic pawn shop supremacy.

Direct confrontation with opponents is often not the optimal solution, as it is much more effective to act unnoticed, moving in the shadows or using ventilation shafts for surprise attacks.
