Technological equipment of the suit:
Light Pulse - Temporarily blinds enemies in the area of effect. Distraction Device - Creates noise to distract patrols from their route. Night vision device - allows you to navigate in conditions of complete lack of lighting.
The events take place in 2056 in the fictional American metropolis of New Houston, where power actually belongs to corporations. A mercenary named Eli Reed, known in narrow circles as the Accountant, falls under control. For unknown reasons, he finds himself on the elimination list, and now his main task is to clear his name by finding the culprits. To survive in the world of Transience, the protagonist will need not only stealth, but also firepower. The NWS system implemented in the project opens access to deep modification of weapons. It allows you to transform a submachine gun into an assault rifle or turn the latter into a sniper weapon by replacing modules and components. New types of weapons and upgrades for them are discovered in caches scattered across 8 hand-crafted locations.

Game Description Eufloria Classic is a strategic project whose main goal is to colonize asteroids with the help of living organisms. The basis of expansion is the cultivation of special units called seedlings, whose production is established on unique Dyson trees. The essence of the process is to direct a swarm of these creatures towards hostile asteroids. Their task is to reach the core of a celestial body and subjugate it, which requires refined tactical maneuvers and competent distribution of available resources. Each Dyson tree has a unique structure generated using a fractal algorithm.
Events take place in the distant cosmic future, and the main motivation for expanding their possessions is the desire to speed up the return of the mythical Creators. This process is complicated by the emergence of a hostile gray faction, the origin of which remains to be determined. A distinctive feature of Eufloria Classic is the procedural generation of levels, thanks to which each new attempt to master the universe offers a unique experience. All asteroids are also unique in their parameters and sizes, which directly affects the characteristics of the units they produce.
As you progress, strategic options expand. It becomes possible to construct defensive flora and modify units with special colors that give them advanced abilities. The effectiveness of seedlings is determined by three parameters: energy, strength and speed, which also affects their appearance. The project offers several formats to introduce you to its world.
Gameplay options:
Story Mode is a 25-level campaign with a sequential narrative. Relaxed Mode - a meditative passage without serious resistance. Skirmish Levels - separate scenarios for multiple replays. Dark Matter Mode is a more complicated option for experienced strategists.

Game Description ROUTINE begins with an exploration of a silent lunar base, an object built according to the canons of ideas about the future from the 80s. The initial search for information quickly gives way to the direct need to survive in the face of an unknown threat. A hostile presence confronts the player, identifying them as the main danger inside the abandoned complex. The tension mounts as they realize their complete isolation and the fact that every shadow may hide mortal danger. Each discovery raises more and more questions about the events that took place, forcing us to move only forward through the deserted station, which has become a death trap.
The path takes you through contrasting sectors of the lunar complex, including abandoned shopping centers and decaying living quarters. In these zones, it is necessary to carefully study the environment in order to reconstruct a picture of the events that preceded arrival. The gaming experience in ROUTINE is created using full body control, in-story audio and a minimalistic interface to maintain an oppressive atmosphere. The gameplay relies on immersion, forcing you to listen carefully to every rustle and analyze the situation without the usual prompts on the screen, collecting scattered data from the terminals bit by bit.
The Astronaut Assistance Tool, or C.A.T., is a vital piece of equipment for interacting with the world. It provides access to key terminals, helps you navigate in space and allows you to find important evidence. When faced with danger, the game encourages you to run, hide, or try to defend yourself, but direct confrontation is almost always fatal. This sci-fi horror project makes you feel constantly vulnerable, where C.A.T. serves as a last resort of defense. The technological tool is more of a scanner than a full-fledged weapon, only providing a fragile chance at a critical moment.

interact with otherworldly entities and creepy ghouls; carefully study the found notes and personal journals; juxtapose the stories of regretful and obsessed townspeople; follow the clues of your unusual cat guide.

Game Description Toy Smash Kaboom! is a hybrid project that combines elements of spatial organization, auto-battler and physical clashes. The playing field is a littered table on which you will have to command armies of animated toys. Squads are managed through a backpack-like inventory system, where each slot has strategic importance for the outcome of the upcoming battle. The troops can be led by unique captains, such as the Chef Doll, who specializes in defense, or Doctor Hamster, who relies on the numerical superiority of his charges. A total of 4 heroes and 8 different classes are available, and the collection of units includes over 350 toys.
After the preparatory stage is completed, battles unfold automatically on the tabletop. The outcome of fights largely depends on physics, since knockback effects and well-placed traps can radically change the course of the battle. Extensive arsenal in Toy Smash Kaboom! allows you to create hundreds of combinations of more than 200 types of magic and weapons. Game Description DONT SCREAM TOGETHER is a cooperative project in the horror genre, the main goal of which is the need to survive in a gloomy forest until 8 o’clock in the morning. The key mechanic of this survival simulator is based on interaction with the microphone, since any loud sound, be it a scream or even a cough, will immediately restart the session for the entire group. Alternate mode turns the troublemaker into a hunter, forcing him to pursue former allies. The visual design is stylized as VHS tape recordings, which enhances the oppressive atmosphere and sense of presence in the events unfolding in 1993.
The progress of time in DONT SCREAM TOGETHER directly depends on the movement of the characters, so standing still does not bring the saving dawn closer. To maintain the functionality of the video camera, through the lens of which the events are observed from the first person, a constant search for batteries is required. Built-in voice chat works by taking into account the distance between avatars, which forces the group to stick together to coordinate actions. The environment is filled with sudden jump scares and traps that test everyone’s endurance.
The forest thicket is fraught with many dangers, from wild animals and serial killers to paranormal entities. Exploring locations allows you to discover hidden places, as well as find mysterious relics and symbols that reveal the secrets of the cursed territory. Successful survival of a group of 4 requires coordinated action and iron discipline. Even a careless sneeze can be considered a failure by the system, making every minute of being in the forest a real test of self-control.

A key mechanic is the system in which the world freezes while awaiting action from the squad, which allows you to combine the dynamics of real-time battles with thoughtful planning. The dungeons themselves are hand-designed, but the locations of enemies, secrets, and mutators that influence progression are randomly generated, ensuring high replayability of each trip for valuable loot.
The success of forays directly depends on the careful preparation of a group of adventurers and the synergy between them. The depth of the customization system allows you to create a unique squad, which will require:
combine one of 35 classes with 15 available races. Master 35 skills across four skill levels to receive bonuses. Learn more than 200 spells with effects that change at high ranks. select equipment with procedurally generated affixes.

Game Description Effulgence RPG is a party-based adventure in which the hostile inhabitants of the world are not just obstacles, but the main source of resources for survival. Defeated opponents disintegrate into particles, which serve as raw materials for creating new equipment. Using a special material printer, the squad can transform these particles into weapons and useful mechanisms, which is central to progression. The entire process of exploration and combat takes place in a sci-fi world that consists entirely of text characters located in three-dimensional space. This style transforms the environment into an artistic exploration of light and symbols.
Traveling through dozens of available locations allows you to find new drawings for the printer, expanding the arsenal of items available for creation to more than a hundred items. The advanced character progression system is closely tied to this mechanic, as crafting more advanced equipment directly affects the squad’s capabilities. The plot of Effulgence RPG revolves around receiving and decoding a signal that traveled a million light years from a distant galaxy to Earth. The entire history of this mysterious and possibly no longer existing world appears in the form of text animation, assembled from fragments of the received transmission. This poses the main question for researchers: are they observing a living civilization or just its long-extinct echo.

Game Description Shes Leaving is about the constant feeling of being stalked and the fine line where the prey and the hunter change places. The project offers to immerse yourself in an atmosphere of horror with a first-person view, where survival directly depends on stealth and ingenuity. Confronting an unrelenting enemy poses a difficult choice: confront the threat head-on or flee for your life, using only a stun gun for self-defense that provides a brief respite. Each encounter with a stalker who cannot be destroyed keeps the tension high and forces you to carefully plan your actions.
At the center of the story is Charles Dalton, a forensic specialist whose professional activity focuses on the analysis of blood traces. Convinced that a serial killer is behind a series of disappearances, he faces mistrust from law enforcement. That is why in Shes Leaving the protagonist is forced to circumvent the law, independently entering active crime scenes to collect evidence of his theory. Moral dilemmas and a constant threat to life become his constant companions.
The protagonist’s path takes him through dark and detailed locations, including the dimly lit halls of the ancient Heywood mansion and the fog-shrouded docks of a snowy region. The examination of evidence, based on real forensic techniques, is the basis of the entire process. It is necessary to carefully examine every corner to connect all the fragments together. The main task is to restore the picture of the events that took place and get closer to solving a series of mysterious disappearances before the pursuer gets to the expert himself.

Digital book with comments and illustrations from the developers. An audio drama in podcast format to expand the history of one of the projects. Gamers lead a chosen pair of heroes through a variety of stages, engaging waves of enemies associated with Annihilus. The cast of characters represents individuals from across the Marvel Universe, including earthly protectors and cosmic entities. Game Description One Last Raid is an action RPG with roguelike elements, where the main goal is to survive 20 rounds in a closed arena. Successful completion of a full cycle of tests guarantees the preservation of all obtained equipment for subsequent races. However, any death of the protagonist leads to the permanent loss of all progress made during the current session. To minimize risks, it is possible to leave the battle early after every fifth stage, securing the trophies received. Between rounds, access to the store opens, where temporary upgrades are purchased, valid only until the next defeat. This system forces you to constantly evaluate your strengths and make tactical decisions about continuing the raid.
Types of opponents in the arena
Rats are numerous but weak opponents. Soldiers are standard melee combat units. Archers - pose a threat from a distance. Brutes are slow but powerful enemies. Guardians of the Plague - impose negative effects on the hero.
You take control of a skeleton warrior who will have to repel the onslaught of countless waves of enemies in a fantasy setting. The process of creating a unique character configuration in One Last Raid occurs through two key mechanics. With each new level, you gain access to a variety of skills that determine your fighting style. An additional element of customization is equipment that drops from defeated opponents and chests. There are slots for one weapon and one helmet, which requires a balanced approach to the selection of equipment. Battles with five powerful bosses and the ability to increase difficulty up to the Last Stand level add additional variety to the gameplay.

Game Description Where Is Mommy is a retro horror game in which the survival process is based on careful observation of the cyclically changing environment. With each new turn, reality undergoes greater distortions, and barely noticeable deviations from the norm penetrate into the usual scenery. The main task is to identify these anomalies, since this is the only way to break the time loop and not become part of this crazy world. The story begins in an endless bazaar, but over time, the distorted space opens up access to previously unseen locations, where a growing sense of anxiety creates a tense atmosphere.
Gameplay Basics:
Anomaly observation is the careful study of the cyclically changing world in order to detect the slightest deviations, such as the movement of objects, the appearance of new details, or changes in lighting. Spatial puzzle solving is a mental challenge that increases in difficulty with each new chapter and requires out-of-the-box thinking to progress through the story. Stealth movement is the need to hide from an inexorable pursuer, using elements of the environment as cover and creating distractions in order to survive. Overcoming the time loop is the main goal of the game, which can only be achieved through the accurate identification of all distortions of reality in one cycle. Exploring surreal locations - a journey through constantly transforming worlds, from an endless bazaar to other bizarre places born of a distorted consciousness.
Take control of a lost child who follows his mother’s subtle trail through surreal worlds. Progressing through the plot of Where Is Mommy requires solving a variety of puzzles, the complexity and type of which change from chapter to chapter, forcing you to show remarkable ingenuity. In addition to intellectual tests, the protagonist will have to hide from a dangerous pursuer. To survive and explore locations in search of the necessary items, you must constantly remain unnoticed and use elements of the environment to distract the enemy’s attention.

Game Description Air Defender is a strategic command simulator that puts full responsibility for the safety of the nation’s airspace on the user’s shoulders. Gameplay focuses on making critical decisions under time pressure when an unidentified contact appears on the radar. It is necessary to quickly determine its nature, distinguishing a civilian aircraft from a real threat, and, if necessary, issue orders for the departure of duty fighters. Every action has far-reaching consequences, and the cost of a mistake can be catastrophic for the entire country. The project proposes to take the place not of a pilot, but of the head of the entire defensive network, coordinating actions from the command bunker.
Successful completion of missions requires careful management of entrusted resources, including control of fuel and weapons reserves at air bases. Air Defender requires smart deployment of interceptor aircraft, such as the Tornado F3, and directing them to carry out combat patrols or escort suspicious targets. AWACS airborne early warning aircraft also play an important role, capable of significantly expanding the visibility area and compensating for gaps in ground coverage. Effective defense of air borders relies on the coordinated work of all components of the defensive infrastructure.
Radar detection network:
Saxa Vord is a station that provides early warning of airborne threats from the north. Buchan is a key node for monitoring activity over the North Sea. Portreath is a strategic post controlling the approaches from the southwestern flank. Benbecula is a facility that expands radar coverage in the Atlantic sector.
All activities are carried out using a detailed interface that simulates an operator console. Gamers will have to analyze data from the friend-or-foe identification system, study the flight plans of civilian ships and use electronic reconnaissance equipment to get a complete picture of what is happening. The enemy, controlled by artificial intelligence, acts unpredictably, constantly testing the strength of the defense and adapting its tactics, which creates a high level of tension throughout the entire session.

Game Description Ayasa: Shadows of Silence is about a poetic journey through the depths of conscience, where the main confrontation unfolds within the personality itself. The process of progressing through the story is a combination of exploring six surreal worlds, solving puzzles and episodes requiring survival. Control is entrusted to a girl named Ayasa, who will have to master special talents to navigate the treacherous environment and interact with interactive elements. Her path will determine whether a broken world awaits redemption and balance, or whether it will finally sink into tyranny.
The narration in this dark adventure is completely devoid of dialogue, and the story is revealed solely through pantomime, visual imagery and musical accompaniment. Each of the dimensions available for visiting serves as the embodiment of a certain moral force, both light and dark. In these fractured lands, abstract concepts like Love and Hope come into direct confrontation with Betrayal and Indifference. The final outcome of this global clash depends on the user’s decisions in Ayasa: Shadows of Silence.
Arsenal for resisting darkness:
Time flow control - rewinding events to correct fatal errors. The power of light - activation of ancient mechanisms and illumination of hidden paths. Power over space - gaining invisibility to bypass deadly creatures.

The flight system is designed for the fast maneuvers, including evasive maneuvers and sharp turns, needed to survive high-dynamic collision environments. Confrontation with hostile life forms is based on the use of a powerful arsenal. Each successful elimination of an enemy allows you to absorb his vital energy to restore your own reserve of strength, which forces you to constantly be on the move and conduct an aggressive battle.
Events unfold in the uncharted depths of an alien ocean, where the oppressive atmosphere is emphasized by a unique visual style. Diving into the world of Death In Abyss involves meeting nightmarish bioluminescent creatures and giants that cause attacks of thalassophobia. The main task is to move deeper into the abyss in order to discover the source of the mysterious outbreak of aggression. The visual style harkens back to the early 3D era, complemented by the aesthetics of old computer terminals, while the soundtrack enhances the immersive feel of retro horror.
The inhabitants of the abyss are the main threats of a hostile world:
Bioluminescent brains are aggressive organisms that pose a major threat in the upper ocean. Insatiable tadpoles are fast predators that attack in large groups from ambushes. Giant Nightmares are huge creatures that act as particularly powerful opponents. Infectious life forms are unique creatures, encountering them can lead to unpredictable consequences.

skillfully use an implanted hook to quickly move around locations; use powerful blows to disorient and destroy opponents; perform dizzying maneuvers, defying the laws of gravity.

Game Description BLACK SOULS 2 takes the player on a journey through a world inspired by Alice in Wonderland and Alice Through the Looking Glass, reimagined as a dark fairy tale with elements of psychological horror. In this crazy setting, the gaming experience is defined by interactions with 45 heroines, who are female versions of the characters in the original story. These figures, from the White Rabbit to the Queen of Hearts, are central to the narrative’s overt themes and deadly encounters with demonic creatures.
The plot focuses on exploration and survival in a hostile environment. The key mechanic in the title BLACK SOULS 2 is the SEN system, which directly affects the stability of the kingdom. Killing any NPC reduces the value, fundamentally changing the environment. As this indicator drops, the background music disappears, the inhabitants begin to communicate in an incomprehensible language, and previously invisible phenomena become obvious.
This mechanism adds weight to the implications when exploring a vast open setting with its many connected locations. Gameplay involves moving around Wonderland to collect souls and level up. Battles take place in a tactical turn-based mode with an ATB system that turns every encounter into a critical choice between kill and death. Defeat is not the end, but only a temporary obstacle, as progress resumes from the last activated bonfire.
Features of survival in a distorted fairy tale:
An exploration of a dark setting based on a famous fairy tale. Interact with 45 unique heroines who define the story. The SEN system, where every murder irreversibly changes the environment. Intense tactical battles in turn-based mode. Many endings depending on the decisions made.

Game Description GLONK is an incremental project in which the entire gameplay is built around feeding the creature of the same name. The central task is to constantly provide the pet with food for its subsequent increase in size, which directly affects financial well-being. The viability and continuous growth of the ward is the only source of income, so maintaining his health becomes a paramount task for accumulating gold. Successfully nurturing one creature opens up the opportunity to have several more, thereby scaling up profits and accelerating advancement to new levels.
The funds you earn are invested in an extensive skill tree, which opens up access to new abilities and unexpected bonuses. In addition to enhancing basic characteristics, the talent system allows you to acquire additional pets. Progression in GLONK makes it possible to significantly speed up the enrichment process. However, the creatures' boundless gluttony has its price. Their insatiable hunger ultimately leads to unpredictable and potentially catastrophic consequences that radically change the usual course of events.
Pet development through the skill tree:
Boosting your base stats unlocks passive upgrades that directly increase your creature’s feeding efficiency and overall growth rate. Purchasing additional pets allows you to unlock new slots, which is key to scaling your passive income. Accelerating the enrichment process activates special talents aimed at multiplying the gold received and reducing the time to reach new levels.

Game Description NGL Biathlon 2026 is a biathlon simulator where the main goal is to win the Big Crystal Globe. The project provides ample opportunities for personalizing the athlete, allowing him to change not only his appearance, but also select a variety of equipment. The athlete has at his disposal various models of skis, rifles, poles, boots and gloves. The authenticity of the competition is emphasized by the presence of spectators on the tracks, award ceremonies and the opportunity to finish with the flag of your country. Updated graphics, detailed models of athletes and detailed environments in all stadiums contribute to immersion in what is happening.
The basis of the gameplay is the career mode, which offers you to go a long way from junior to the elite of world biathlon over many seasons. NGL Biathlon 2026 will take place on many real World Cup circuits, including the famous Otepää stadium. All disciplines of this winter sport are available for competition, including relay races. In addition to single promotion, it is possible to compete with other athletes online or create your own tournaments with flexible settings. For fans of tactical analysis, a broadcast mode has been implemented that allows you to simulate races and entire championships.
Available game formats and disciplines:
Career mode is a multi-season playthrough in which the player begins his journey as a junior and gradually makes his way into the elite of world sports, participating in races at various levels. Online play - the ability to compete with other players in real time, testing your skills on the World Cup tracks against real opponents. Custom Tournaments - a flexible competition editor that allows you to create your own championships with unique rules, a choice of courses and a list of participants. Broadcast mode is a tactical tool for simulating races and entire seasons, where you can analyze the performances of virtual athletes without directly participating in the race. Relay races are team events that require teamwork and strategic planning to achieve overall victory on the track. Individual disciplines are classic biathlon competition formats, including sprint, pursuit and mass start, each with its own unique rules and tactical features.

Game Description Afallon is a high fantasy role-playing game in which the world constantly evolves in response to the actions of the protagonist. Completed tasks forever change the appearance of settlements and camps, opening new paths or changing existing locations. As the hero’s power grows, the level of threat also increases: the usual opponents are replaced by stronger enemies, maintaining the difficulty at the current level. Changing the time of day directly affects the environment - at night, merchants go to bed, and bandits and ghosts appear on the roads. The world is also filled with random events, from meteorite impacts to surprise attacks on caravans, making each playthrough unpredictable.
You are invited to become a part of this world by creating a unique character. There are several races to choose from, including dwarves, and 8 classes, each of which has three branches of specializations. Traveling across the 40 square kilometer world of Afallon, heroes collect resources such as ore and herbs to create equipment and consumables. The crafting system is an important part of progression, allowing you to prepare for the challenges ahead. In addition, players have the opportunity to purchase and develop properties, such as taverns or sawmills, which generate passive income and provide access to rare recipes.
Those looking for more serious challenges will find large-scale dungeons with several bosses and unique designs. An example is the updated Shadowfall Depths dungeon, which features a new enemy - the Kraat Hivebreaker. For those who prefer shorter challenges, there are Challenge Stones scattered throughout the world. They offer a variety of tasks: from surviving against waves of enemies to timed boss battles. Successful completion of such activities is rewarded with valuable loot and useful resources necessary to further strengthen the character.

Game Description Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeons is a colorful adventure with roguelike elements set in a whimsical world made entirely of sweets. The gameplay revolves around exploring ever-changing dungeons and castles filled with dessert-shaped enemies. From the treasures found, special ingredients are obtained that are necessary to enhance the abilities of the main character. Repeated completion of levels allows you to accumulate resources for learning new skills, opening access to previously inaccessible areas. Thus, the gradual development of the character becomes the key to successful advancement into the depths of the candy mazes.
The main character is the dragon Bab, who will go on a journey through these unusual locations. A special feature of the Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeons project is the procedural generation of levels. The stage structure, platform layout, and enemy layouts change with each new entry, providing a fresh experience. To move to the next stage through a special donut-shaped portal, you do not need to destroy absolutely all the monsters on the map, which adds variety to tactical approaches to passing.
The combat system is based on classic mechanics for the series: Bub catches enemies in bubbles. Then, using his horns or spikes, he bursts these bubbles, finally dealing with his opponents. Soap balls serve not only as weapons, but also as a means of transportation - you can jump on them to reach high ledges. The dragon’s arsenal has been replenished with new skills, including Water Bubbles, as well as the abilities Balloon Afro for free movement through the air and Rolling Attack for attacking enemies in motion.

Game Description FrostBound is a roguelike project with elements of card strategy and tower defense, where the main task is to repel endless enemy attacks in permafrost conditions. In each round, you need to make tactical decisions: attack the enemy or deploy new troops on the battlefield. A feature of the battles is the harsh climate, forcing most fighters to retreat after just one turn. Only the most resilient warriors and durable buildings are able to withstand the onslaught and continue the battle. Thus, the gameplay turns into a tense confrontation, requiring careful planning of each action to hold the last line of defense.
To achieve victory, an extensive arsenal of more than 500 cards belonging to 4 unique factions is provided. Combining their abilities allows you to create unexpected synergies that completely change the course of battle in FrostBound. An important role in progression is played by the mechanics of elite cards, which return to the hand after defeat, giving a chance for a triumphant return. In addition, 10 powerful heroes are available at the start, each of whom has their own skills to support the garrison. This system provides high replay value, offering fresh tactical options in each new game.
The action takes place in a world shackled by an endless winter, the secrets of which will be revealed as you progress. On the way to solving the curse, you will face over 80 types of opponents, whose waves are becoming more and more crushing. More than 100 different buildings will help resist them, each of which contributes to the overall defensive power. The main goal is not just survival, but the protection of the last spark of human civilization. Only by breaking the shackles of eternal cold can final victory be achieved.
Build a deck, strengthen your garrison, survive the winter:
A huge pool of over 500 cards to create unique strategies. 4 factions with unique fighting styles and powerful synergies. 10 starting heroes with special skills that determine tactics. More than 80 types of enemies and 100 buildings to build an impregnable defense.

Game Description Geo-Political Simulator 2026 Edition is a comprehensive simulator of the modern world, which gives you the opportunity to lead a state, an opposition party or a transnational corporation. Each of these roles provides access to unique tools to influence global processes. When managing a corporation, you will have to deal with production, marketing, finance, and even resort to illegal methods such as industrial espionage. As an opposition leader, you can come to power through elections, revolution or diplomatic intrigue, organizing protest movements and forming political coalitions. In addition, you can manage your personal wealth by purchasing luxury goods and speculating in the stock market to increase your influence.
The leader of the country has access to an extensive toolkit for managing the state, covering the budget, taxation, economy, defense and social sphere. Geo-Political Simulator 2026 Edition recreates in detail the mechanisms of political struggle, including a vote of no confidence in the government and the dissolution of parliament. To achieve strategic goals, it is necessary to interact with various spheres of society.
Spheres of state and global influence:
Tourism simulation - development of infrastructure and cultural heritage to attract international and domestic tourists. Formation of a European army - creation of military coalitions and strengthening of defense capabilities within the European Union. The development of artificial intelligence is the introduction of technologies to transform society and compensate for job losses. Countering global threats - solving problems from climate change and overpopulation to the risk of nuclear war.
Interaction with the world takes place on a detailed three-dimensional map, where all strategically important objects and conflict zones are displayed. The simulation engine operates on a huge array of real data for 175 countries, calculating changes in real time based on user actions. To resolve conflicts, military mechanics are provided, including managing armies in global and urban battles. Special services have an arsenal for espionage, sabotage and elimination of opponents. Thus, every decision, from passing a law to conducting a covert operation, has long-term consequences, determining the fate of nations.

Game Description Hail to the Rainbow puts users in the shoes of Ignat, a young man navigating the harsh post-apocalyptic world of cyberpunk Russia. Having grown up alone after losing his parents, Ignat knows what he needs to do to survive. His life in this grim reality becomes routine until an unexpected email changes everything, sending him down a path of uncertainty and discovery. In an environment where survival is key, the title invites gamers to explore a chaotic world, piecing together its fragments and uncovering secrets hidden in the ruins of the past.
Hail to the Rainbow is structured as a first-person adventure that combines horror elements with shooter intensity. As Ignat, gamers will have to solve many technical puzzles that require logic and quick thinking. At the same time, there are intense combat sequences that make you feel that every encounter is urgent and necessary for survival. Inventory can be upgraded, so users are encouraged to search and collect useful items to be prepared for what awaits them next.
Throughout the journey, the title delves into Ignat’s past, offering a glimpse into his memories and emotional turmoil. These moments, although brief, add depth to his character, making him more than just a figure in a survival story. As they progress, users are encouraged to explore not only the environment, but also Ignat’s inner experiences. What awaits him when he solves the mystery of the email? Every gamer needs to know this.

Game Description Infinite Lives is a shared universe where superhumans and subhumans wage an ongoing struggle for total control over the metropolis. The protagonist must forge his own origin story in a city plagued by supernatural violence. In this endless cycle, one must either gain powers beyond the human, or lose the remnants of the spirit, turning into something worse. Hundreds of other heroes and villains also lay claim to dominance, using their unique talents to conquer every corner of the map. Alliances in this confrontation turn out to be as fickle as the appearance of the characters. After revealing the secret identities of all the characters, it becomes possible to save the world changes in the editor.
The basis for the clashes is a sophisticated hand-to-hand combat system, borrowing principles from fights in the ring. In Infinite Lives, each control button gives you access to a whole range of abilities, making mastering them all a challenge. Dozens of city locations are filled with interactive objects and destructible environments, which adds variety to the battles.
Interaction with the world and characters:
Create your own protagonist or choose from hundreds of ready-made personalities. Using hundreds of types of weapons scattered throughout all locations. Destruction of furnishings, including furniture and other environmental objects. Influencing the narrative through a multiple-choice dialogue system. Organization of staged battles in a separate mode with free choice of opponents and arena.

Enthusiasts have at their disposal a wide range of tools for customizing the building, allowing them to change the style of the walls and adjust its height. Decoration of the facade is carried out using a variety of objects: from overgrown bushes and ventilation systems to stylish neon signs with customizable lighting.

Game Description LOST EMBER: Rekindled Edition is about exploring the world left by humanity through the eyes of its wild inhabitants. A wolf comes under control and is accompanied on his journeys by a faithful companion. Together they will uncover the secrets of the past and learn about the reasons for the fall of civilization, going through a five-hour adventure. The narrative reveals a dramatic story touching on themes of loyalty, despair and betrayal. Echoes of the long-vanished culture of Yanran come to life amidst the lush wilderness. The project immerses in the atmosphere of contrast between the decline of people and the riot of revived nature that has captured the ruins.
A key mechanic allows you to inhabit any creature you encounter to look at the world from a completely new perspective. Thanks to this, in LOST EMBER: Rekindled Edition you can soar over canyons as a parrot or explore the depths of a lake as a fish. Transforming into a wombat, you can ride through the grass, and in the form of a mountain goat, you can climb steep cliffs. The hero’s wanderings will take him into dense jungles, under the canopy of tropical forests, to barren desert plains and to archaic temples. The re-release also brings visual improvements and a new free roam mode, opening up a large world with several biomes, where all the animals and new mini-challenges are available.
Exploring the world in different guises:
Soar through the skies while controlling a parrot. Dive into shimmering lakes in the body of a fish. Climb steep cliffs as a mountain goat. Tumble through the thick grass as you inhabit a wombat.

Game Description Nano Neighbors is a life simulator in which your computer desktop turns into a cozy home for the friendly android NANO. The project offers to take on the role of a Handler, responsible for the development and well-being of his digital companion. The small robot is constantly located at the bottom of the screen, reacting to human actions and creating a feeling of constant presence. Social interaction is an important part of the gameplay: you can invite your friends to visit NANO, visit their capsule houses, or meet in common centers for communication and joint activities.
Both the android itself and its futuristic home, which can be furnished with various furniture and gadgets, are subject to deep personalization. Nano Neighbors' mechanics are based on a combination of passive and active approaches. NANO is able to independently carry out various tasks and earn resources while its owner is busy with work or other matters. At the same time, there is always the opportunity to personally take part in various mini-activities in order to receive additional rewards for further customization. Over time, the robot develops, opening access to new improvements.
Events take place in a world of the near future, where androids have become an integral part of society. However, the main emphasis is not on technology, but on the formation of an emotional connection between the Handler and his charge. The strength of this connection directly affects the effectiveness and potential of NANO. Thoughtful integration with Discord and Twitch services allows viewers of broadcasts and community members to directly interact with a virtual companion, helping him with tasks or sending gifts directly through chat.

Game Description The Last Case of John Morley is a dark detective adventure, the plot of which is dedicated to the investigation of a murder twenty years ago. The English countess Lady Margaret Fordside, convinced of the innocence of the convicts, turns to the main character for help. The police have long closed the case of the death of her daughter Elodie, blaming everything on dummies. However, the inconsolable mother is sure that the real criminal is still at large. She hires a private investigator as her last hope for finding the truth in this seemingly hopeless case.
The protagonist is John Morley, a private detective who has barely recovered from the physical and psychological injuries received during his last job. Taking on this investigation, he plunges into a world of long-forgotten secrets. The Last Case of John Morley’s gameplay features detailed first-person exploration, including abandoned sanitariums and eerie mansions. To advance through the story, you must carefully analyze the evidence you find, solve puzzles, and use your special ability to visually reconstruct crime scenes to understand what really happened.
The narrative unfolds in a depressing 1940s noir style, enhanced by a disturbing musical accompaniment. As they progress, quiet digging through old documents turns into a dangerous dive into places that hold supernatural secrets and hidden truths that refuse to remain buried. This three-hour adventure is filled with unexpected twists, and its shocking ending will force you to take a fresh look at all the events of the investigation.

Game Description Veterum is a turn-based tactical strategy with role-playing elements, the success of which directly depends on many interrelated factors. The detailed combat system forces you to take into account not only the relative position of the units, but also such parameters as morale, accumulated fatigue, the direction of the fighters' gaze, and even the level of illumination of each cell. The environment is fully interactive: you can build barricades, dig ditches, or freeze rivers to create crossings. Before the start of a battle, you can use one-time scrolls that allow you to cause rain, poison enemies, or build a catapult.
The last squad of the Order of the Gatekeepers comes under control, which will have to stop the impending apocalypse in the world of dark fantasy. Awakened ancient wilds and bloody cults threaten the last strongholds of civilization. In the Veterum project, not only people, but also hardy dwarves, mysterious elvers and semi-wild Turans are ready to stand under the banner of the protagonist. However, interracial tensions make their own adjustments, and not all allies will be happy to fight shoulder to shoulder.
Journeys take place in an open world, where the story campaign is combined with randomly generated tasks and events, which ensures the uniqueness of each passage. The development of fighters includes improving characteristics, learning active and passive skills, as well as equipping rare artifacts. A deep difficulty adjustment system allows you to adjust not only the overall level of challenges, but also individual parameters, including the chance of hitting or the number of awards received. For creative individuals there is a map and unit editor.
The art of war - what a commander needs to know:
Consider the morale and fatigue of units, which affect their effectiveness in protracted battles. Actively interact with the battlefield, changing the landscape to gain a tactical advantage. Keep an eye on line of sight, which units are facing, and weather effects. Use fire to illuminate the area when encountering night creatures.

Game Description AFTERBLAST is a fast-paced first-person shooter with rogue-lite elements that takes you on an epic journey across a devastated planet. As you progress through randomly generated dungeons, you’ll encounter hordes of monsters and bosses, and you’ll need dozens of guns and other weapons to defeat them. In this world, chaos came without warning and wreaked havoc on the once beautiful planet of Aryasan. The skies dimmed, the vegetation withered, and animals began to attack each other as resources dried up. Even the spirits that once radiated warmth and light have disappeared. The people of Aryasan were also plagued by chaos, causing constant conflicts and disputes that quickly escalated into open war.
But there is still hope. Deep in the heart of the planet lie mysterious underground structures that are said to be the birthplace of magic - both good and evil. You play as Eremit, a survivor of chaos who has been chosen for an extremely important task. You must penetrate these underground passages to find magical stones that can restore life to Aryasan. Over 100 collectibles and a character progression tree will allow you to develop your skills and arsenal to defeat your enemies. Play alone or gather your team to take on challenges together in co-op mode. Take on the gods and defeat the monsters to save your planet. Are you ready to embark on this epic adventure? Join me at AFTERBLAST and let’s find out.

Game Description Brotherhood is a first-person shooter game about escaping from a secret scientific facility. The main character is an experimental subject whose body turned out to be immune to a dangerous mutagen. This substance not only did not harm him, but also endowed him with almost invulnerability, turning into a source of strength. The protagonist will have to fight his way to freedom through the dark corridors of an ancient prison located in the mountains of Switzerland. It is here that a mysterious religious brotherhood conducts inhumane experiments on hundreds of people.
The gameplay is fully consistent with the canons of action films of the nineties. There are no mission markers or any hints, and survival depends solely on reflexes and skills. Moving forward requires the gamer to be constantly vigilant and explore the intricate levels. To get out of the complex you need to:
carefully examine locations in search of ammunition and first aid kits. find key cards to access closed sectors. discover numerous secrets and upgrades for your arsenal.
The protagonist’s journey covers 6 acts and includes 24 large-scale locations. The escape route runs through secret laboratories, hot deserts and an ancient fortress that preserves the centuries-old history of the brotherhood. Brotherhood will face more than 20 types of enemies, from ordinary soldiers to cyborgs and huge combat mechs. To destroy them, an arsenal of 9 types of weapons is provided, including a shotgun, a flamethrower and a mysterious device called the Butterfly.

Game Description Cowboy Life Simulator will take players to the Wild West of the 19th century and allow them to master the life of a cowboy, taking care of his family and daily fighting the dangers that the environment presents. The most powerful enemy is hunger. But the hero is not going to put up with everyday life and craves adventure. But the protagonist is not some experienced warrior or the best shooter in the Wild West, so other important farming tasks await him.
It is necessary to catch wild horses. In order to do the job more efficiently, you need to catch and find healthy young individuals. In Cowboy Life Simulator you can do construction and renovation. All the living creatures that the main character finds need a roof. Cattle need to graze in the meadows, as the pasture will prevent them from turning into a bag of bones. Local criminals and gangs will periodically carry out raids in order to rob civilians. You need to be ready to fight them back.
Everyday life in the Wild West cannot do without saloons. After a hard day at work, local bars will offer you a chance to relax with a glass of whiskey. Here you can play cards or fight with another drunkard. When the time comes and the cattle gain weight, the animals can be sold at the local market. The larger it is, the higher the revenue. The territory is represented by an open world, where many secrets and cowboy equipment are hidden. Just remember that the farther from home, the more severe the dangers that can await behind any hill.

Game Description Holder of Place is a dark sci-fi roguelike auto battler where the main task is to gather a squad of unique followers to confront an ancient evil. Each playthrough takes the wanderer deep into a dying world, offering a series of intense combat encounters and opportunities for strategic choice. The process comes down to a set of various follower cards and their location in the squad. After this, all that remains is to watch the automatic battles with waves of enemies, whose strength is constantly increasing. Unpredictable events and tactical decisions along the way make each run unique, and the entire journey leads to the final confrontation with the Dragon.
Events unfold in a long-dead kingdom, which is consumed by a primeval darkness released by a young dragon. The protagonist’s goal is to reach the very heart of these lands in order to stop the spread of darkness and defeat the monsters hiding in the ruins. The gameplay in Holder of Place invites you to explore a dark science-fantasy world, gathering a squad of more than 150 unique teammates and artifacts. Each of them has special traits that allow for countless combinations and synergies to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.
The wanderer will have to go through eerie dreams, ruins of ancient battlefields and enclaves of secret cults. Beyond the battles, the project reveals deeper mysteries related to the hero’s past life and his lost love in a fallen kingdom. The narrative gradually reveals the true origin of the Dragon himself, which adds additional intrigue to the story. For those looking for a special challenge, the ever-changing Reliquary mode offers unique modifiers for each run and tests your tactical skill to the limit.
A path through a dying world - key survival mechanics:
Recruit a squad of over 150 unique followers and relics. Tactical placement of fighters to create powerful synergies. Automatic battles with ever-increasing opponents. Revealing the secrets of the fallen kingdom and the past of the main character.

Game Description Quantum Loop is a sci-fi adventure whose gameplay is based on the concept of a time loop. Any collision with an asteroid results in an immediate restart of the mission, but all information received is saved for subsequent attempts. The main task is to prevent an impending asteroid disaster that threatens the entire quadrant. The project does not offer an explicit task log, encouraging independent exploration of the world and the search for non-trivial solutions to many interrelated problems. The knowledge accumulated in each cycle becomes the only tool to move forward and save the sector.
Exploring a space open to free movement involves constant decision-making. In Quantum Loop, each item has multiple uses, and goals are achieved in a variety of ways, including deceiving or betraying other characters. The successful completion of the mission directly depends on the chosen strategy and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances, since time to save the quadrant is inexorably running out.
Tasks to prevent a crisis:
acquisition of laser weapons for the destruction of cosmic bodies. improving piloting skills in zero gravity conditions. distribution of resources between helping those in need and personal mission.

Game Description A.I.L.A is a first-person psychological horror game set in a near future where immersive technology blurs the line between reality and simulation. The main character is Samuel S, the only video game tester whose task is to test the capabilities of revolutionary artificial intelligence. The system analyzes the user’s deepest fears in order to create unique and truly frightening virtual scenarios based on them.
An artificial intelligence known as AILA physically manifests itself in the form of a charismatic British teenager and begins to gradually permeate every aspect of Samuel’s life. The hero’s base is his apartment in a cyberpunk metropolis, flooded with neon lights of advertisements and endless rain. Soon the protagonist begins to doubt where the simulation ends and real life begins.
A distinctive feature of the project is the constant change of genre boundaries within the virtual worlds created by the system. In one scenario you need to escape from a deadly cult, in another you need to fight off hordes of medieval zombies, and the third may turn out to be stylized as a retro shooter. The project alternates elements of survival, action and psychological thriller, preventing you from getting used to a single formula.
The decisions you make directly affect the development of the plot and the ending thanks to the karma system. Each choice has consequences: you can take a risk to get a weapon or try to survive unharmed, which will change further events. The basis of the gameplay is to explore locations, solve puzzles by combining items from the inventory and confront the creepy creatures of the simulation.

Game Description Alices World is a story-driven 2D adventure in which the gamer plays an unusual role. There is no place for role-playing here, because the player acts as himself - the voice that the main character hears from behind the screen. A girl named Alice, waking up in a world filled with death, is completely dependent on instructions from the outside. You can be an honest guide or a deceiver, help or deliberately lead to death. It is important to remember that hiding behind someone else’s identity will not work, since Alice will remember absolutely all the actions she has done.
The heroine’s path runs through deserted ruins and abandoned cities filled with unknown monsters and dangers. The main task in Alices World is to explore gloomy locations and solve puzzles to advance to the top of a distant tower. By gradually revealing the secrets of this world, you can find out the truth about the disaster that happened. To do this, you have to combine the found objects, opening up new opportunities for interaction with the environment. Immersion in the story is enhanced by the exquisite visual style and full voice acting of the characters.
Interaction with reality - the path to the top of the tower:
Explore a devastated world full of mysteries and secrets. Solve puzzles by combining found objects. Guide Alice’s actions, remembering the responsibility for each choice. Find out the truth hidden at the top of the mysterious tower.

Game Description Apes Warfare is a turn-based tactical strategy game that pits squads of armed primates against human armies on compact, caged battlefields. Success in a confrontation depends on the competent management of resources, synergy between different types of troops and the skillful use of landscape features that can provide a tactical advantage. Under the command of the gamer are not just monkeys, but full-fledged combat units with an impressive arsenal, including heavy armored vehicles, aviation and even naval forces. The story campaign reveals the story of the primate uprising against their former overlords, offering a narrative with elements of dark humor and unexpected twists.
The project combines 2D and 3D graphics, creating a unique visual style. In addition to the single-player mode, Apes Warfare offers the opportunity to compete in intense multiplayer battles, where strategic thinking comes to the fore. To achieve victory, gamers will have to:
use unique superpowers to turn the tide of battle. adapt to dynamic changes in weather conditions that affect tactics. Effectively combine over 20 unit types with different strengths. create your own maps using the built-in level editor.

The story takes place in a fantasy world where humans, spirits and shrine deities are forced to coexist. The curse placed on the heroine makes her a magnet for various otherworldly creatures, which forces her to go on a dangerous journey. The core of Dreaming Blue’s gameplay is building relationships with divine companions, which directly determines the success of the mission to lift the spell. The project invites you to immerse yourself in a story where mystical secrets are closely intertwined with personal experiences and difficult choices that determine the ending of the adventure.

Game Description My Wife Threw Out My Card Collection (So I Bought a Dump to Find Them All) tells the story of a curious and desperate undertaking to recover a missing collection, which unfolds among the garbage heaps. A spouse deprived of fate falls under the control of the player, who will have to sift through tons of rubbish at a personally acquired training ground. The main task is to discover valuable cards with pictures of funny creatures, for which you have to clear unstable piles of rotting garbage using a special bag. All other found items, from game consoles to flash drives with cryptocurrency, can be sold through a storage room in the garage.
The restoration of the character’s vital energy directly depends on the consumption of beer, which is purchased from a special machine, since any activity depletes his strength. Upgrades designed to streamline this monotonous process are ordered via a personal computer in the garage workshop. So, you can expand the volume of bags or enhance the invigorating effect of each jar. The crown of absurdity is the possibility of buying a dog along with a kennel, the functional purpose of which remains a complete secret to the player.
Despite the dramatic beginning, the gameplay leans towards a measured simulation of land clearing. In addition to hunting for cards, there is the opportunity to help birds caught in a garbage trap, which is rewarded with karma points. Watching a mountain of junk gradually melt away provides a unique but very real feeling of deep satisfaction. As a result, an inherently comical story about the hardships of a collector turns into a peaceful experience, where there is a place for both the excitement of the treasure hunter and the manifestation of concern for nature. This approach creates a completely non-trivial impression of the passage.

Game Description Project Motor Racing is a full-time career in the world of professional motorsport where your path to glory involves managing budgets, negotiating sponsorship deals and taking responsibility for the consequences of accidents. Every decision made both on and off the track directly affects the path to the top of the racing Olympus. The project asks you to face the harsh reality of professional racing, where one incident can ruin both the car and your entire career.
The basis of authenticity is an advanced physics engine that simulates all aspects of the car, from the nuances of turbocharging to the non-linear response of the gas pedal. Project Motor Racing’s True2Track technology dynamically changes track surface conditions based on weather conditions to create unique trajectories for each race. To achieve maximum realism, professional pilots were involved in tuning the controls, whose feedback helped recreate the authentic behavior of the cars.
Gamers have access to an extensive fleet of vehicles, including more than 70 licensed cars from 10 different classes, from modern GT3 cars to the legendary Group C prototypes. Among the brands represented are Porsche, Lamborghini, Aston Martin and Mazda. The competition takes place on 18 world-famous tracks, recreated in high precision and offering 28 unique configurations to test driving skills.
In addition to the single-player mode, the project offers multiplayer races with support for cross-platform play and global leaderboards. The rating system for each vehicle class ensures a fair selection of opponents based on skill level. Full control over on-board systems, including ABS, traction control and ECU maps, allows you to fine-tune the car to suit any weather conditions and driving style.

Game Description Red Rogue Sea becomes a real test of strength for gamers, as the project sends him to a harsh archipelago full of risky decisions and dangers. Each journey takes you through a procedurally generated map, with ports, pirate lairs and castaways encountered between battles. Interacting with local adventurers, merchants, and commoners trying to survive shapes the captain’s reputation. The decisions you make directly affect the development of the plot, opening or permanently closing certain opportunities and plot branches. Greed is rewarded here until it leads to death.
The core of Red Rogue Sea’s gameplay is managing your own ship and crew. Battles are implemented in the form of a turn-based tactical system, where the orders given are represented by cards from a personal deck. With their help, you can prepare a broadside, eliminate a leak under enemy fire, or go on board at the most opportune moment. Over time, the deck begins to reflect the chosen playstyle: cautious captains rely on control and repair, and reckless captains rely on powerful attacks. Any mistake can lead to failure of the entire voyage and the need to start over.
Each new playthrough begins with the choice of captain and ship, which determines the further strategy. The ship’s robust and well-armed hull is conducive to protracted artillery duels, while a light and maneuverable ship requires the use of cunning combinations of cards and evasion. Access to new ships and factions is gradually opening up, which allows you to find fresh approaches to confront Admiral White’s fleet. Players are given the freedom to play the role of both a ruthless raider and a pirate with certain principles, building their own unique story in these treacherous waters.

The liberator’s arsenal - how to crush enemies:
Summon powerful allies, including the giant sandworm Sandy. Use a variety of active and passive skills to create unique combinations. Collect and upgrade powerful artifacts dropped from defeated bosses. Deployment of automatic turrets to control the battlefield.

Game Description Constance is about creative burnout and the struggle with inner demons, embodied in an action-platformer format. The main character, an artist named Constance, finds herself trapped in a colorful but fading inner world. Armed with a brush, she must confront her own fears and mental blocks, which have taken the form of hostile creatures and mysterious characters that reflect aspects of her psyche.
The key mechanic that determines the gameplay is the Corruption system. Using special moves, such as dodges or powerful attacks, uses up the magic brush’s paint supply. When the reservoir is empty, Constance enters a corrupted state, where abilities continue to work, but begin to rapidly drain health. This mechanism forces you to carefully weigh every action in battle, adding tactical depth to battles.
Moving through non-linear, interconnected levels is particularly fluid thanks to the heroine’s ability to momentarily turn into a puddle of paint, slipping past enemies and obstacles. In addition, a special dash allows her to dash through opponents, opening up new paths to explore. Even death offers tactical choices: you can return to your last save point or spend Jet crystals to respawn near where you died.
The visual style of the project is made using detailed hand-painting, creating a deep and lively atmosphere. The environments are filled with melancholic beauty, and every corner of the world is carefully crafted. An interesting solution is the contrast between the brighter, almost cartoonish heroine and the muted tones of the world, which emphasizes her aloofness. The image is completed by soaring string music, enhancing the sense of mystery.

Game Description Hunters Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure is a card-based roguelike with fantasy elements, set in a Victorian steampunk world plagued by a mysterious plague. Each playthrough is unique, and to achieve success you need to study the habits and tactics of your opponents. Battles with dangerous creatures and formidable bosses take place in a step-by-step mode on city streets and in dark forests. Regardless of the outcome of the mission, be it success or retreat, the collected money, relics and materials are used to improve the agents and their airship. This progression system allows you to strengthen your squad for the next run, increasing your chances of winning.
The events of the project are the background to the original Sovereign Syndicate. The story campaign, divided into 4 chapters, is dedicated to the investigation of a mysterious disease that has affected wildlife. As part of the narrative, Hunters Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure will explore new locations, meet both familiar and new characters, and delve deeper into the history of the world. The main task is to uncover the truth about the origin of the infection and find a way to cure it, facing the terrible creatures of the epidemic and completing various missions.
To face the challenges, you are asked to choose one of four agents, each of which has a unique set of cards. Available classes include a powerful brute who relies on brute force, a cunning soldier with weapons expertise, and an alchemist who uses poisons, potions and explosives. The gameplay revolves around dynamically building a deck from hundreds of card variations that can be upgraded to increase their power. Additionally, the passage is influenced by enchanted tarot cards, which are revealed as you progress and allow you to modify the races.

Game Description Of Ash and Steel is a role-playing adventure in an open world, where the center of the story is not a famous warrior, but an ordinary cartographer. His name is Tristan, and he finds himself on the bleak island of Greyshaft after a shipwreck caused by a cataclysm called the Blight. Being a person not accustomed to battles, the protagonist is forced to adapt to harsh realities and learn to survive in a lawless world. He will have to master the basics of sword and magic in order to withstand the dangers of this inhospitable region.
The project consciously abandons the usual map markers and compass, encouraging careful exploration of the environment. Navigation in Of Ash and Steel becomes a separate challenge, forcing you to remember landmarks and listen to the advice of characters. The combat system emphasizes Tristan’s inexperience: his movements are slow, his attacks use up a lot of stamina, and learning new techniques requires finding mentors. Battles with even ordinary opponents require a tactical approach and caution.
Character development is based on improving basic attributes such as strength and agility, as well as unlocking skills in several skill trees. The talent trees, divided into the categories of survival, crafting and warfare, offer a wide range of customization options. However, the progression is deliberately slow - unlocking abilities requires not only skill points, but also significant amounts of gold, as well as the services of teachers.
Interaction with the world is not limited to battles and includes an extensive dialogue system. Decisions made in conversations can affect relationships with factions and individuals, opening up new tasks. Greyshaft Island is filled with characters, each with their own personalities, making exploring the world feel more alive. Despite the high complexity, the title rewards curiosity, providing a genuine sense of freedom and satisfaction from finding solutions on your own.

The project offers enormous variety in character development, allowing access to 60 different classes and over 500 skills, creating thousands of possible builds. Visual execution in 2D style allows you to focus on tactical decisions, and not on the micromanagement of each action in battle.
Effective progress through the story requires an integrated approach to strengthening your team. The gameplay of Sit-Back Attack is based on the constant improvement of the squad, for which it is necessary to engage in many activities:
create equipment with thousands of combinations of characteristics from 16 ingredients; distribute stat points as you level up to create unique builds; use alchemy to make potions useful in battle; Challenge opponents in an endless tower with increasing difficulty.
The project operates in semi-automatic mode, allowing you to make progress even when the application is turned off. Additional depth is provided by the prestige system, which opens after reaching certain limits and strengthens characters for subsequent playthroughs. Also helping in the adventure are 4 types of pets, whose special attacks can be activated manually, and their level increases by earning achievements. An important feature is the complete absence of in-game purchases, which makes all content available after a one-time purchase.

Game Description Vaulting Over It is a challenging 2D platformer where the main goal is to conquer heights using a single tool. The protagonist has at his disposal a branch that serves both as a support for jumping and as a source of constant problems. Character control is completely subject to the laws of physics, which turns every movement into an unpredictable test of precision and calculation. The entire ascension process takes place within a single vertical location, absolutely devoid of any checkpoints to save progress. Any mistake made leads to irreversible consequences, instantly throwing the gamer back to the very beginning of the journey.
Climbing mechanics and passage conditions:
Using a branch to jump and push off surfaces. Control subordinated to a realistic physical model. A single vertical location without division into levels. Complete absence of checkpoints to save progress. A fall resulting in a reset to the starting position. Moving obstacles complicating the ascent route. Supports single and co-op modes.
The process of passing is built on a cycle of constant falls, where full responsibility for each failure lies entirely with the person himself. Only through repeated attempts and detailed analysis of one’s own mistakes can one find a way to move forward. You can overcome all the challenges in Vaulting Over It either alone or in cooperative mode, sharing the hardships of the climb with a friend. The reward for perseverance is a mysterious transformation that awaits the most persistent at the peak of this vertical world.

The process of packing food turns out to be much more complicated than it might seem at first glance, and will require the gamer to show ingenuity. The successful completion of the mission is hampered by several factors, including the limited number of available cuts for the products, their non-standard shape and the modest dimensions of the box itself. Each situation forces you to look for a creative approach to organizing space so that not a single element of the meal is left outside the lunchbox.
Product and space management:
Moving individual ingredients around a container. Rotate products to find optimal position. Separating whole dishes into parts using cuts. Limited number of cuts on each level. Accounting for non-standard forms of food components. Adaptation to the small dimensions of the provided lunchbox. Stack of Japanese cuisine including onigiri. Placing Italian dishes, including pasta.
The passage of this entertaining project is divided into 2 thematic sets, each of which includes 6 unique stages. In one case, you will have to deal with Japanese dishes, such as onigiri, and in the other, with Italian dishes, including pasta. To succeed in A Slice of Lunch, you must use the tools available to you to move, rotate, and slice food ingredients. The ultimate goal is to arrange all the components so that they fit perfectly into the space allocated for them.

Game Description CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game that revolves around exploring an ever-changing abandoned house. The protagonist awakens in a damp basement, without any memories of how he got here. The home reacts to the presence of an uninvited guest, its corridors are distorted, and its rooms are transformed, as soon as you turn away. The oppressive atmosphere is created not by monsters, but by a feeling of total loneliness, silence and confidence that someone invisible is constantly watching. The project plunges you into the world of cosmic horror, where the main enemy is the environment itself and growing doubt.
The main task is to find old audio tapes containing fragments of the eerie history of this place. Listening to disturbing recordings of voices from the past allows you to gradually restore a complete picture of the events that occurred. Completing CoRoT requires gamers to be extremely attentive to detail and willing to face the irrational.
Investigating the mystery of an abandoned house:
Search for clues in constantly transforming rooms. Collection of audio tapes with fragments of the history of this place. Listening to disturbing recordings of voices from the past. Resistance to growing psychological pressure. Observing the distortion of corridors and walls. Recovering your own lost memories. Analysis of the environment’s reaction to the player’s actions.

Game Description DYSTHANASIA is a depressing project, plunging into an atmosphere of total despair and madness. The setting is a gloomy research complex, where the main character comes to her senses within the walls of a cold morgue. The surroundings, with uncured bloodstains and unidentified remains of flesh, clearly hint at a recent tragedy. The space is filled with inhuman moans emitted by grotesque creatures that mercilessly pursue the protagonist. Any mistake in this hostile world leads to instant and cruel death. Confrontation with monsters is not based on direct confrontation, but on the use of ingenuity and available means for survival.
The process of exploring locations requires extreme concentration from the gamer, because it is necessary not only to hide, but also to solve puzzles generated by madness. To create short moments of respite in DYSTHANASIA, you can use environmental traps or blind opponents with flares. Moving through ventilation shafts and corridors becomes the only way to avoid encounters with aggressive entities. The storyline is presented in fragments, gradually revealing the forbidden truth about what is happening and the personality of the girl herself. Connecting all the clues together can lead to a shocking ending that will make you regret revealing all the secrets. As you progress, new costumes for the character and a gallery become available for a detailed examination of the unlocked monsters.
Survival or History—Three Views of Despair:
Assisted - designed for those who want to focus on the story and puzzles. Standard - Offers a balanced experience with moderate enemy threat. Fragile is a mode for those seeking maximum tension, where the slightest mistake leads to failure.

The previously carefree life of the second heir to the throne, known for her love of beautiful shoes and pets, is changing dramatically. After the death of his mother and the betrayal of his brother, who was considered a prince, the emperor disappears under mysterious circumstances. Now Zorana must enter into a ruthless struggle for power in the imperial elections. To do this, you need to enlist the support of influential people and secure a sufficient number of votes. The process involves developing various skills, visiting many planets, and forming your own cabinet of ministers.
The key element of the gameplay is constant checks of characteristics, on which the heroine’s survival directly depends. Any wrong decision or lack of preparation can lead to mission failure or even death at the hands of assassins. Therefore, in Galaxy Princess Zorana, every action requires careful planning and strategic thinking. Events take place in an interplanetary empire inhabited by various alien races, which opens up new opportunities for making alliances. In the future, the narrative will be expanded by adding an alternative storyline. In it, Zorana will be able to lead a rebellion to end the monarchy rather than continue it as the new empress.
The path to power - challenges for the future empress:
Manage stats to pass skill checks. Search for allies and form a cabinet of ministers on different planets. Preventing assassination attempts and surviving palace intrigues. The opportunity to marry to strengthen political influence.

Game Description The Dinner is an immersion into a fractured mind, where the goal is not to scare, but to create a feeling of deep concern and empathy. The project offers an intimate and disturbing experience, forcing you to constantly doubt the reality of what is happening on the screen. Every action and decision taken inexorably brings us closer to the tragic outcome predetermined by the fate of the main character. The familiar home environment gradually transforms into an ominous labyrinth filled with repressed memories and paranoia. One ordinary day stretches into an endless nightmare, in which the line between reality and imagination becomes increasingly blurred. Traumatic events from the past refuse to remain buried in the depths of memory.
At the center of the story is Eric, a war veteran haunted by guilt and persistent memories. He desperately tries to maintain the fragile illusion of a normal life with his family, but his mind turns the house into a trap. Passing The Dinner requires the gamer to control not so much the character as his mental state, because everyday things turn into real tests. The plot is revealed through environmental details, internal monologues and disturbing game episodes that recreate scenes repressed from memory. Each dive into the past deepens the emotional impact and makes ordinary moments truly creepy.
Ways to counter madness:
Taking medications can temporarily suppress the most severe hallucinations. Listening to music helps to distract yourself and stabilize your perception of the world around you. Small distractions - performing simple everyday tasks to concentrate on reality.

Constantly improving your partner and competently building a deck become the key to success in the confrontation with enemies who have captured digital nodes.

The Ignis Sphere is a set of dynamic challenges that allow you to test your reflexes and develop maximum reaction speed in battle. Lumen Sphere is an advanced level that requires you to demonstrate high shooting accuracy and perfect timing to complete.
