Gamers are given the opportunity to throw opponents into the air and then perform long aerial combinations, which allows them to accumulate a special scale. Filling this meter will activate temporary buffs that can change the outcome of the battle. In addition, the arsenal of techniques includes parries and attacks from behind, which open up access to devastating charged strikes. The process of character development is tied to collecting devilish fragments that fall from defeated enemies. Confrontations with bosses with unique sets of attacks require maximum concentration from the gamer to avoid powerful attacks.
The events take place in a rural area called Grimthorn. It is here, in the world of Dead Wells: The Devil Fragment, that the protagonist will have to search for a mysterious artifact. These lands are in the grip of corruption, which awakens the dead and turns living beings into possessed devils. The cause of the disaster was the fall of an unholy comet, which split into many parts upon entering the atmosphere. One of these fragments, known as the Devil Fragment, became the epicenter of the infection. The places where these fragments fell received the ominous name Dead Wells. Every death in this harsh world is not the end, but an opportunity to study the habits of the enemy and develop new tactics for the next encounter.

Game Description Heartspell: Horizon Academy is a visual novel with match-3 puzzle elements, in which building deep connections with characters is closely intertwined with the practice of magic. The basis of the gameplay is interaction with 11 unique protagonists, including sirens, werewolves and fairies. Strengthening friendships or romantic bonds with them opens up access to new spells. These spells, in turn, are used to solve puzzles that represent the process of creating magic.
Events unfold within the walls of the Horizon Academy of Witchcraft, an eclectic educational institution located in the world of spirits. The plot of Heartspell: Horizon Academy revolves around the mysterious disappearance of the director, after which the students are left to maintain order on their own. The main character, as a newcomer, will not only have to master magic, but also reveal secrets that threaten the very existence of the academy.
The match-3 mechanics receive a unique development thanks to the individual characteristics of the characters, which influence the conditions for solving problems. For example, scenes with the warlike Typhon add dangerous stones with a timer to the field, and only combinations of four or more elements count for Amara’s impression. For successful completion, experience is awarded, which can be spent on improving skills or gaining additional moves for future challenges.
The project offers significant freedom of choice, allowing you to develop relationships in a platonic or romantic way without any restrictions or content blocking. The decisions made shape the destinies of those around you, and the overall narrative lasts more than 20 hours. For those who prefer to focus solely on the plot, there is a special mode that completely disables the puzzles.

This narrative, based on real events, offers to follow the fate of the protagonist, whose new refuge becomes the space under the bridge. His main occupation is street musical performances, during which he encounters unexpected acquaintances. The whole story is presented in a restrained and honest manner, reminiscent in style of a short musical film. The main questions remain the motives for the escape and what awaits the hero at the end of his journey.

A visual novel is the basis of a narrative, revealing the plot through dialogue and interaction with characters. Rhythm arcade is a street performance mechanic in which you need to press the keys in time to the beat of the music. Adventure elements - exploring locations and searching for objects that influence the development of the story. Musical puzzles are tasks related to selecting melodies and composing your own compositions.
The special atmosphere of the project is created by the original soundtrack, consisting of acoustic compositions. Each tune, from the protagonist’s songs to the hits performed on a makeshift stage, is directly related to the unfolding events, creating a holistic perception.

Game Description Kriophobia is a psychological survival horror game in which a scientific expedition to the remote island of Zhokhov turns into a nightmare after encountering anomalous magnetic fields. Instead of scientific discoveries, the team finds themselves in a death trap at a long-forgotten Soviet military base, hidden under the thickness of permafrost. The main character, a young geophysicist named Anna, will have to fight alone for life in the icy corridors of the complex. She is haunted not only by grotesque creatures, but also by surreal visions associated with her foggy past, as if this place itself is trying to pull her into its depths. The search for a way out of the trap forces the girl to plunge deeper into the secrets of this cursed place.
The project returns to the canons of the genre, offering exploration of locations from fixed camera angles, which enhances the cinematic nature of what is happening. Kriophobia’s gameplay revolves around solving intuitive but challenging puzzles and surviving in the face of extreme resource shortages. Encounters here are extremely tense, and often the best choice is flight rather than open confrontation. The deadly cold acts as a separate threat, forcing her to constantly monitor the heroine’s condition and look for any sources of heat. Every decision has weight, and a wrong step can lead to quick death.
A distinctive feature of the title is its unique visual language, where deliberately rough shading in the spirit of comics is combined with picturesque textures of the environment. This artistic technique creates a dark and oppressive atmosphere, reminiscent of graphic novels from the 80s and 90s. The immersion into the world of icy loneliness and horror is enhanced by a soundtrack with pronounced Slavic motifs. Anna’s every step is accompanied by disturbing sounds, revealing fragments of her distorted history and the dark secrets of the Soviet complex.

The range extends from tanks, aircraft and even nuclear warheads to simple cartridges, hand-made in the initial stages. Gameplay in Military Incremental Complex requires constant optimization of production processes. Over 120 improvements to the research tree are aimed at making production cheaper and faster, while full control over the supply chain, from mines to factories, ensures a smooth flow of resources and automation of all operations.
The special mechanics of global fear allow you to directly influence demand and prices, broadcasting special signals throughout the world. The higher the level of fear in society, the more expensive each unit of production can be sold. Additional income comes from rare gold versions of weapons, the temporary increase in value of which allows you to conclude especially profitable deals. The combination of these systems with smart investment and political influence opens the way to market monopolization and the accumulation of untold wealth, turning the economy into a well-oiled money-making machine.

Game Description SIDE EFFECTS is a brutal pharmaceutical experiment turned into a deadly survival game. Participants play the role of test subjects caught in the middle of a failed clinical trial. They will have to plunge into the oppressive atmosphere of psychological horror, where hallucinations are indistinguishable from reality. The only goal is to outlast your opponent by taking one dose after another.
The basis of the gameplay is turn-based roulette with tablets. Before each round, a set of drugs with unknown properties appears on the table: some can help, others cause harm, and others lead to instant death. The gameplay of SIDE EFFECTS requires participants not only to luck, but also to think strategically. The key parameter for survival is the resistance scale, the zeroing of which means inevitable loss. Between rounds you can use experimental items that can change the balance of power.
Up against another patient who will stop at nothing to survive. The opponent actively bluffs, adapts to the situation and uses all available arsenal to achieve victory. Various means are used, from vaccines to mouth clamps, which forces us to constantly analyze the risks. Every action requires a balanced decision, because the price of a mistake is your own life.
The project offers both a single-player mode for confrontation with artificial intelligence, and multiplayer sessions. From 2 to 4 people can take part in online matches, which turns each game into a unique test of nerves and tactical calculations. Only the one who can best manage randomness and calculate the moves of his opponents will survive.

Game Description Speed ​​Demons 2 is an arcade road racing game that focuses on explosive action and all-out destruction. The project offers hundreds of races, distributed across numerous chapters. A total of 10 modes are available, ranging from classic competitions with rivals to missions where the main goal is to destroy as many vehicles as possible within the allotted time. The narrative suggests taking one of two sides of the conflict. You can join a gang of chaotic racers known as Demons, or become part of a group of vigilantes called Enforcers whose goal is to stop them at any cost. Depending on your choices, the objectives in Speed ​​Demons 2 change dramatically, offering both aggressive and defensive scenarios. In addition to destructive tasks, there are also tests of skill, for example, the Rush Hour mode, where you need to overtake the maximum number of cars in traffic, or Scratchless, which requires you to reach the finish line with minimal damage.
The stylized graphics give a special atmosphere to what is happening: cars and environmental objects are made using cel-shading technology. The action is presented from 3 angles, including an overhead view and two pursuit cameras from different angles, enhancing the sense of speed. The controls are deliberately focused not on steering, but on overall motion control. Instead of turning the steering wheel, an analog stick or mouse is used to move the car vertically along the track, while separate buttons are responsible for the gas, brakes and activating abilities.

Game Description ZAKO NO AHIRU is a 2D platformer of increased difficulty, the main goal of which is to conquer an inaccessible peak to the accompaniment of caustic comments. Every action is tirelessly watched by a girl named Sugaki Mary, who lives next door. She’s ready to make a caustic remark or an inappropriate joke at any time, using an arsenal of more than 800 fully voiced lines. The reward for your patience and skill will be one of 7 endings, each of which represents a unique surreal situation, reminiscent of a dream. You can choose the order in which they open.

Navigating cartoonish-looking but treacherous obstacles like giant fruits and trampolines requires sharp skills and extreme concentration. Any mistake can lead to a fall and the need to start climbing from earlier sections, which will inevitably cause a new portion of ridicule from Mary. The project challenges not only reflexes, but also the psychological stability of the gamer, creating a tense atmosphere.
Despite its apparent simplicity, the mechanics of movement have significant depth. To jump, the duck uses a stream of water, using up a limited resource. It becomes possible to make up to 5 jumps in a row, which opens up scope for searching for short routes and high-speed passage. For those who are completely desperate, there is a special help button, but using it will negate all personal achievements. Thus, success directly depends on the ability to calculate one’s strengths and maintain composure.

Game Description Cleared Hot is an arcade helicopter shooter in which the laws of physics become the main weapon in the hands of the pilot. Having received an old helicopter at his disposal, he returns to the sky again, where he will face numerous opponents. The combat vehicle is equipped not only with machine guns and missiles, but also with a unique cable and magnet system that allows you to interact with the environment.
The gameplay offers dynamic aerial battles with enemy soldiers and gangs in armed pickup trucks. Missions in Cleared Hot are not limited to just destroying targets, requiring the player to master piloting. Tasks range from carefully transporting fragile cargo, such as boilers or even live chickens, to aggressive attacks on enemy fortifications. Using a cable, you can throw stones, cars, and even intercept incoming missiles at your opponents, turning any object on the battlefield into a deadly projectile.
In addition to arcade shooting, the project contains an element of tactics, implemented through the control of ground troops. It is possible to land soldiers to capture enemy territories or organize the defense of their own bases. To perform increasingly complex tasks, it is possible to purchase and upgrade helicopters, which allows you to create individual weapon configurations for specific combat conditions and style of play.
The action takes place in three different biomes, including desert canyons, dense jungles and arctic wastelands. Missions are carried out both during the day and at night, when night vision devices must be used to detect targets. The visual style features sophisticated design and warm colors, while professional voice acting with a distinctive Texas accent and a high-quality soundtrack enhance the atmosphere of the intense action movie.

Game Description Dangerous Galaxy is a side-scrolling action roguelite whose gameplay revolves around exploring procedurally generated star clusters and saving the galaxy from a powerful evil. Battles are based on physical interactions: any object on the screen, including the protagonist’s ship, can be thrown away, destroyed, or used to collide. Active abilities, such as launching rockets, cause explosions and create gravity-altering anomalies. The entire route is divided into 4 global stages, each of which represents a unique star system. As you move across the map, the difficulty and level of danger steadily increases, forcing you to constantly adapt your tactics. During your journey, special events occur that offer a choice of three upgrades or the opportunity to discover lost cargo containers.
The central element is a deep system for improving the starship, which allows you to create a unique combat vehicle. All upgrades are placed on a special 5x5 mounting grid and must be directly connected to the ship’s core. Dangerous Galaxy provides the ability to install up to 4 active abilities at the same time, as well as leveling up each individual module. Experience gained after completing a flight is converted into points to permanently enhance the basic characteristics of the ship. Fulfilling certain conditions opens up access to new types of main weapons, which significantly changes the style of play.
Starship constructor and its components:
More than 35 unique passive and active modules with various effects depending on their level. Placing improvements on the mounting grid with a mandatory connection to the central core of the ship. Possibility of combining two identical upgrades to increase their efficiency and power. Choosing the main weapon before each new mission to fundamentally change combat tactics.

Game Description Demeo x Dungeons and Dragons Battlemarked, a full-fledged crossover of two famous franchises, offers an immersive tactical adventure in virtual reality. Events take place in the Forgotten Realms, where a military conflict brewing in the North threatens the entire Sword Coast. A group of heroes must join forces to expose a sinister conspiracy and prevent the impending chaos. The project is designed to be played together by a team of up to 4 people, although there is also a single player mode for those who prefer to act independently. All mechanics are built on a system without a Dungeon Master, which shifts the emphasis from roleplaying to joint discussion and strategic decision-making.
The gameplay is based on a turn-based combat system, where success depends on proper planning and the use of unique abilities presented in the form of cards. Each game in Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked forces you to adapt your tactics to the ever-changing conditions on the battlefield. Two full-fledged story campaigns are available from the very beginning, Embers of Chaos and Crown of Frost, within which you will explore such iconic places as Neverwinter Forest and Cragmo Castle. In the future, the world will expand with downloadable add-ons that offer new challenges.
To confront the dark forces, you can assemble a squad of colorful characters representing classic D&D classes. Available heroes include the dragonborn paladin Boltrax, the halfling sorcerer Tibby, and the human ranger Jessix. They are accompanied by the tiefling rogue Ash, the gnome warrior Tarok, and the elven bard Lyria. Each of them has their own set of skills, the combination of which becomes the key to victory in battles with monsters. Effective joint use of their skills allows you not only to control the battlefield, but also to successfully overcome traps on the way to legendary treasures.

Game Description Infinity Islets is a relaxing fantasy sandbox that challenges players to explore interdimensional archaeology. The plot begins in a mysterious and empty museum, whose mysterious director asks for help in restoring it after a catastrophic interdimensional collision has destroyed all the exhibits. To complete this mission, the protagonist receives a magic shovel that can dig up the sands of endless islands. Relics found, which can be anything from robots to bananas, must be returned safely to storage. Thus, empty halls are filled with life again, and the museum regains its former greatness, becoming a canvas for creativity.
Travel takes place on procedurally generated floating islands, between which you can freely plan. Creativity is at the core of Infinity Islets' gameplay, as found objects are used to create unique displays limited only by the imagination. Players can independently edit the descriptions for each artifact in any language, giving them their own story. The atmosphere of the exhibitions is complemented by special relics that reproduce music of various genres and environmental sounds. In addition, the world offers special tasks, for example, helping a wandering clot of light. As part of seasonal events, exclusive items become available for search.
Museum as a reflection of the creator - create your own story:
Dig through the sands in search of lost interdimensional relics. Create incredible exhibitions by filling empty rooms with unique exhibits. Share save files so friends can visit your personal museum.

Game Description IT Specialist Simulator is a simulator where players will have to go from a beginner to a high-level administrator or IT project manager. Professional development directly depends on the decisions made, allowing you to specialize in both servicing computer equipment and organizing e-sports events. Each completed task and resolved malfunction contributes to career advancement in the corporate world of information technology, opening up new career prospects.
The basis of the gameplay is managing IT infrastructure and solving real technical problems. Players must diagnose network and system failures, repair a variety of equipment, and prioritize tasks based on strict service level agreements (SLAs). The IT Specialist Simulator project requires not only technical skills, but also the ability to tactically distribute workload to avoid critical failures and downtime in the corporate network.
For immersive workflows, interactive interaction with the virtual environment is provided, including the use of system commands such as NCPA.cpl to configure network addresses. The specialist has at his disposal a variety of equipment, from SD-WAN routers and switches to access control systems (RCP), the parameters of which can be changed. The project also offers a training mode, where devices are disassembled into components to learn their internal workings and practice repair procedures.
The authenticity of what is happening is maintained through sudden breakdowns, system failures and even hacker attacks that require an immediate response. For personalization, you can select an avatar that will represent the specialist throughout the entire passage. You can track your progress on a special statistics tab, which records achievements in various areas, from working with office equipment to network administration.

Game Description Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road means constantly fighting, strengthening and collecting resources on a desperate journey to the saving Arch. The basis of all gameplay is the defense of a constantly moving fortified city, which represents the last stronghold of civilization. On his way, merciless hordes of monsters stand in their way, seeking to wipe out this mobile shelter from the face of the earth. Survival directly depends on the ability to repel attacks from both small monsters and giant bosses that threaten the integrity of the tower. Every decision made in this chaotic world could be the last, determining the difference between salvation and complete destruction.
The project is an unusual combination of the tower-survivor and roguelite genres, put on wheels. For successful progress in Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road requires constant collection of valuable materials such as wood, stone and gold. The resulting assets are invested in strengthening defensive structures, unlocking new abilities and generally improving the combat potential of the mobile base. The path to the final goal runs through a variety of biomes, each of which presents its own unique challenges and requires adapting strategic approaches to move forward.
The main tasks on the path to salvation:
Organizing the collection of vital resources for development. Construction and modernization of protective structures on a moving platform. Destroy endless waves of enemies of all sizes. Successfully reaching the final goal of the journey - the legendary Arch.

Exploring the dark underground corridors involves solving numerous puzzles and confronting anomalous phenomena. The space around is constantly changing, turning into intricate labyrinths and distorting the usual perception. Survival will require stealthy movement, competent management of resources and the use of various types of weapons for self-defense from monsters.

Game Description Neon Inferno is a hybrid side-scroller whose gameplay is an explosive combination of 2D run-and-gun and gallery shooter. The basis of the combat system is the ability to fire at opponents who are simultaneously in the foreground and in the background. Tactical depth is provided by the Bullet Time mechanic, which allows you to deflect enemy projectiles, as well as the ability to hijack vehicles to pursue targets.
At the center of the story are two hitmen - Angelo Morano and Mariana Vitti. Acting on the side of a crime syndicate known as the Family, they carry out missions to eliminate competitors. The Neon Inferno project sets them the task of establishing complete control over the capital’s battlefield. The heroes have many upgrades and different types of weapons in their arsenal to shift the balance of power in their favor.
The setting is dystopian New York in 2055, mired in lawlessness and internecine wars between various factions. The cityscapes, made in the style of pixel art, represent a neon cyberpunk metropolis. The atmosphere of decline and constant conflict is complemented by carefully selected musical accompaniment, emphasizing the tension of what is happening.
Each mission culminates in a unique boss encounter with multiple phases and a variety of attacks, putting your skills to the test. For those who want to share this experience with a friend, a cooperative mode is provided. The most hardcore challenge will be the arcade format, which requires you to complete the entire journey on one credit.

Game Description Princess of the Water Lilies is a 2D puzzle platformer inspired by the golden age of classic animation. Each location is a hand-painted canvas, and the narrative unfolds to the accompaniment of a full-fledged symphony orchestra. The story in this adventure is virtually devoid of dialogue, and its meaning is conveyed through universal icons and beautifully illustrated scenes that are understandable without words.
The basis of the gameplay is the exploration of picturesque levels filled with both secrets and numerous dangers. Despite its cozy atmosphere, the project poses a serious challenge: any mistake leads to instant failure, requiring the player to have precise movements and precise control. To overcome obstacles in Princess of the Water Lilies, the heroine uses a whole arsenal of movements: she can not only run and jump, but also swim underwater, climb mossy ledges and cling to hanging vines.
The main character is an inquisitive cat named Princess, raised in a family of frogs. On her neck there is a magic collar that, when she purrs, releases magical energy. The power activated by this unique ability allows you to transform your environment, growing plant bridges and opening previously inaccessible paths to solve numerous mysteries.
The Princess’s main mission is to save her adoptive family and restore the natural balance in her native lands. Her journey takes her through 6 unique biomes, each with its own unique atmosphere, unique challenges and hidden paths. At the end of each chapter, she will encounter bosses, defeating which will require mastery of all available skills.

Game Description Prologue: Go Wayback! is a brutal survival simulator in which players will have to guide a heroine named Lucy through tens of kilometers of wilderness. The main objective is to reach a remote weather tower located on the opposite end of the map. The path is complicated not only by changeable weather conditions, but also by the need to navigate in space without modern navigation aids.
The action takes place over a vast area of ​​64 square kilometers, generated for each new playthrough using machine learning technology. Thanks to this approach, every journey in Prologue: Go Wayback! offers unique terrain and new challenges. The world appears absolutely lifeless: there are no animals or other people here, which reinforces the oppressive feeling of complete loneliness in the middle of pristine nature.
Survival requires constant monitoring of hunger, thirst and, most importantly, body temperature. A complex system for starting a fire has been implemented, requiring the collection of tinder and fuel, and any suitable objects from the environment can be used as fuel. Abandoned forest houses serve as temporary shelter from bad weather, which, however, do not guarantee complete safety without proper preparation.
Weather events, including rain, snow, and strong winds, directly affect the character’s condition and the environment, such as making objects wet and making them more difficult to ignite. Navigation is carried out exclusively with the help of a map and compass, forcing you to carefully study the terrain and landmarks to plot your route. Overcoming slippery slopes and snowy plains becomes a real test of strength in this merciless world.

Game Description Retrace the Light is a 2.5D action-adventure gameplay based on the unique Dimensional Return mechanic. This ability allows you to instantly teleport to previously visited points, which opens up wide tactical possibilities. Using this power becomes the key not only to outflanking opponents or launching surprise attacks, but also to finding creative solutions to complex puzzles built into the environment.
The events take place back in 3323, where humanity, together with the superintelligent artificial intelligence Primus, launched the Meta-Mirror project to heal people’s emotional traumas. The main character is Enforcer Decem, an agent whose task is to penetrate the Mirror Labyrinths generated by human consciousness. In the world of Retrace the Light, the protagonist, amnesiac after being seriously injured, must relearn his skills and uncover the mysteries surrounding his ambitious project.
In the depths of the mental worlds, Decem will have to face powerful Mirror Nightmares - entities born from obsessions. Enemies range from colossal mechs that wreak havoc to cunning enemies that can change shape or hide from sight. Defeating each of them requires careful analysis of behavior and well-timed use of abilities to exploit their vulnerabilities, turning battles into an intense challenge.
The combat style can be flexibly customized thanks to the Module system, opening up new approaches to combat. By defeating bosses, gamers gain access to 7 main Modules and their variations, and by exploring locations - to more than 20 minor ones. Living on the Motherboard with allies and engaging in dialogues with them, Decem influences the development of the plot with his decisions, which ultimately leads to one of several possible endings to the story.

Game Description SEMI – Side Effects May Include is a cooperative action game for 1-4 players, in which the main goal is to escape from a special hospital. Experimental drugs are the main tool for survival and at the same time a source of chaos. After taking the pill, the patient gains superpowers, but along with them, completely unpredictable side effects. Well-coordinated teamwork becomes the key to success, because at any moment the situation can get out of control. To coordinate actions and organize sabotage, voice chat is provided, which helps you navigate rooms and fight opponents.
Escape is complicated by the random generation of levels consisting of rooms with changing gravity, traps and moving walls. The gameplay in SEMI – Side Effects May Include forces you to constantly adapt to new conditions. For example, Alice syndrome can turn a character into a giant or a tiny person, and bipolar disorder can turn a character into an invulnerable monster who becomes helpless moments later. The overall madness scale threatens to take away control of the avatar at any moment, turning the ally into an uncontrollable threat to the entire group.
Each escape attempt, regardless of its outcome, ends with the issuance of a personal medical report. It contains a unique diagnosis, such as hyperactivity, reflecting the passing style. Successfully completing challenges unlocks new costumes and decorations, allowing you to make your next race more stylish. In this project, abilities are a real lottery, and the most dangerous opponent is often on their own team, which requires the participants to have maximum concentration and readiness for any surprises.

Game Description Sliding Hero, a dark, top-down Metroidvania puzzle game, takes you into the mysterious atmosphere of an 18th-century Venetian villa. The main character is Luca Sicomoro, a fleet captain who, after a shipwreck, comes to his senses on a mysterious island. He will have to explore an ominous estate to uncover the secret of his imprisonment and find a way to salvation.
The world of the project is imbued with carnival aesthetics, and the character designs are inspired by the masks of the Italian commedia dell’arte. Sliding Hero’s visual style features hand-drawn pixel art and suspenseful animations that create a unique atmosphere. The exploration of this world is accompanied by an original soundtrack in the spirit of Italian Baroque, which enhances the feeling of mystery and grotesqueness.
The villa is a tangled labyrinth of interconnected rooms and secret passages. In keeping with Metroidvania conventions, progression will require finding new tools that will open up access to previously inaccessible areas. Along the way, you’ll interact with the estate’s eccentric inhabitants and solve puzzles to find hidden passages and piece together all the pieces of the mysterious story.
The basis of the gameplay is the sliding mechanics, in which the character moves in one direction until colliding with an obstacle. This system turns every movement into a strategic task requiring precise calculation. Combat encounters are implemented through ramming enemies, where the outcome depends on the characteristics of the weapon, as well as through the use of traps and environmental hazards to eliminate opponents.

Game Description TerraForge invites you into a world where mining and blacksmithing are not just a profession, but a way of life. As the heir to a family of blacksmiths, your goal is clear: forge the perfect weapon and leave a legacy behind. To do this, you will have to plunge into the mysterious Abyss - a kingdom underground, filled with rare and powerful resources. Along the way, you’ll manage loot, sell crafted items, and upgrade your tools to delve deeper into the mysteries of the land.
In TerraForge, your journey begins with managing a mining operation. You’ll collect materials from different locations, use different tools, and even buy mining licenses to unlock new areas. Each new layer you discover holds the potential for rarer and more valuable resources, advancing you towards your final goal. As you progress, you’ll be able to upgrade your tools, unlock blueprints to craft more valuable items, and increase your shop’s reputation.
The game combines resource management and crafting. With each material you mine, you get the opportunity to create new items, which you can then sell in your store. Trading with buyers and strategic pricing will be the key to your success. Over time, you will discover ancient relics that will give you abilities that increase your efficiency and help you advance.

Game Description Typhon: Bot vs Bot is a sci-fi tactical strategy game where you need to masterfully write Python scripts to defeat your opponents. Autonomous mechs are controlled through the creation of unique behavior algorithms that determine all actions of combat vehicles. It is the program code that becomes the main weapon responsible for navigation, combat and the execution of complex missions in real time. The main goal is to outwit your opponent by developing better and more adaptive logic for your mechanized forces on the battlefield.
Events unfold on the surface of the hostile moon AEGIS IVb in the Typhoon system, where humanity reached by 2387. Conditions uninhabitable for humans, filled with dangerous anomalies and temporary distortions, make direct human presence impossible. That is why in Typhon: Bot vs Bot exclusively autonomous machines are used to explore and control territories. The landscape of this world is littered with ancient ruins, abandoned outposts, and areas with unstable physics, forcing bots to adapt to ever-changing threats.
The basis of tactical planning is the deep customization of combat vehicles. The design of each ‘Mech is modular, allowing the chassis, weapons, sensor systems and power cores to be tailored to specific missions. The choice between heavy armor or speed, long-range weapons or close combat systems depends directly on the terrain and type of mission. Thus, success on the battlefield is determined not only by the quality of the code, but also by the ability to design a machine that is perfectly adapted to a hostile environment.

Game Description WAR RATS: The Rat em Up depicts the Great Rat War, plunging gamers into conflict with armies of TechnoRats. In this world inhabited exclusively by rats, the TechnoRat entity, a unified consciousness of cyborg rodents, seeks to consume all organic matter and turn it into metal structures. The gameplay features side-scrolling combat where you must fight alongside hired troops to reclaim the land of Ratopia. The task is to push back enemy forces and seize a bridgehead at the enemy base.
The gameplay of WAR RATS: The Rat em Up combines run-and-gun shooter mechanics with tower defense and base building aspects. The gamer manages resources, purchases various weapons and equipment for credits (CHz), and tactically places fighters in battles. Success requires coordinating attacks with the placement of defensive structures such as turrets, walls, and resource generators. The fights feature blood and brutality that matches the claimed influence of some 90s titles.
The passage is built on the roguelike principle: the player has one life to overcome the areas on the way to the headquarters of the TechnoRat. Failure resets the progress of the race, but the CHz collected is spent on permanent performance upgrades for future attempts. The optional Iron Rat mode increases the difficulty, requiring you to start at level 1 after death, but allowing you to retain earned upgrades. In addition, Skirmish mode allows you to participate in battles on selected maps outside of the main campaign of this game, using a visual style hand-crafted by artist wootusart.

Game Description Xenopurge puts you in the role of a Commander, controlling an elite squad from a remote command center. The main task is to eliminate aliens through indirect orders through the interfaces of several monitors. You will plan routes for fighters, set their priorities and determine tactics before they enter the combat zone. The team’s survival depends on this strategy and preparation, as you will have few direct ways to influence events once the operation begins.
Within each race in Xenopurge, the gamer will have the opportunity to recruit new fighters, each with their own initial tactical settings. You also equip your team with improved equipment, tailoring the unit to suit your leadership style. Missions take place on procedurally generated maps with different layouts of rooms and enemies, which ensures that each mission is unique. Each game session is designed to be completed in approximately 60 minutes and focuses on solving complex problems that require tactics.
The consequence of failure will be the final death of the members of your unit as part of the current mission. Whether the foray ends in success or complete failure, your command profile gains experience, unlocking new abilities and recruiting options for future operations. Your units operate in a dark, retro-futuristic setting, tracking down targets in closed corridors and facility rooms. The key challenge of this project is the need to be proactive rather than react to threats in real time.

Game Description Asbury Pines is a narrative incremental title where, in order to solve the mystery of a brutal murder, it is necessary to build production cycles that span the entire history of the town. The gameplay is based on the synthesis of the efforts of more than 50 unique creatures, artifacts and even plants. The union of the labor of such dissimilar personalities as the caveman Hrokk and the temporal physicist Moharan makes it possible to create and modify a complex mechanism for extracting resources. The effectiveness of this system directly affects the speed of gaining access to new fragments of the narrative, which gradually shed light on the dark mystery. The development of automated production loops between the past and the future becomes the main tool in the hands of a time-traveling detective.
The plot centers on a brutal crime that shakes a small town to its very core. The investigation at Asbury Pines goes beyond the usual detective genre, as the mystery stretches back into the distant past and into the distant future. Events unfold over 12 different eras, starting with the late Stone Age. It is necessary to collect evidence and information bit by bit in order to ultimately piece together a complete picture of what happened and understand the motives behind this mysterious crime. Each era adds new details and characters, making it more complex and at the same time bringing us closer to the solution.
The world of the project is inhabited by residents known as Pini, who move the investigation forward with their personal stories and memories. Their experiences and observations are presented in more than 350 short stories. These disparate fragments, obtained from documents, conversations and even the thoughts of animals, are gradually woven into a single fabric. Thus, the development of production chains is inextricably linked with the revelation of secrets and a deep dive into the rich history of this unusual place, where each resident may be the key to understanding the tragedy.

Game Description BIRDCAGE is a fast-paced bullet hell shooter where gameplay focuses on unique sword mechanics to fend off attacks and destroy enemies. The project takes inspiration from the arcade classics of the 90s, offering a polished combat system and stylized graphics. The pilot is required not only to dodge hundreds of projectiles, but also to actively use the blade to break through enemy squadrons. The title requires high concentration and sharp reflexes to survive in the chaos of battles.
The plot takes place in the year 2342, when humanity is divided into two factions: SELENE, which controls the Earth, and RADON, which controls the space colony CAGE. The latter, under the leadership of Mother ROENTGEN, creates a superweapon WORLD-EGG, capable of giving birth to a new universe at the cost of destroying the old one. At the epicenter of the BIRDCAGE conflict is a pilot who has awakened in the experimental ship HALCYON. A mysterious voice in his mind gives the only order - to destroy the created threat.
The pilot has two unique ships at his disposal. The HALCYON is a fast and maneuverable fighter equipped with a sword that can be used for both close combat and as a projectile. An alternative is the CEYX, which is slower but armed with homing missiles and the GRAZE system, which fires salvos when approaching enemy bullets. Both vessels have switchable firing modes between wide spread and focused beam, and can also activate Hyperblade mode.
The adventure unfolds over 6 stages where you will face dozens of bosses, including enemies such as THESIS and ARCHE. In addition to the story campaign, there is an arcade mode and a Score Attack competition. For a deeper immersion into the history of the world, the DRYAD database is intended, where records about characters, technologies and events of the universe are opened for the in-game currency NEURO.

Game Description Brush Burial: Gutter World is a dark, immersive simulator that revolves around completing missions across four carefully crafted and interconnected locations. The narrative structure offers one Great Contract and three Minor Contracts, encouraging repeated exploration of levels to experiment with tactics to eliminate opponents. Successfully completing challenges and progressing unlocks access to dozens of unique cosmetic items, including unique outfits for the main character, which significantly increases the replayability of the project.
The story takes place in a harsh, desolate world where a demonic creature named Fennel survives. This demon, expelled from his native lands, who is also a swamp creature, is forced to make his way on the outskirts of the colonial frontier. The main leitmotif of the Brush Burial: Gutter World project is enrichment through the suffering of others. The surrounding reality is saturated with despondency and decline: occult locations look as if they were compressed into bizarre shapes, creating an atmosphere of improvised and at the same time thoughtful chaos.
Mastering a unique set of combat and acrobatic techniques, the protagonist actively uses his forked tail. With its help, you can not only climb to dizzying heights, but also tie up enemies, performing spectacular techniques in the style of koppojutsu. Despite its apparent simplicity, the combat system is highly dynamic and allows you to use both stolen weapons and environmental objects to eliminate threats. Moreover, any confrontation can be avoided, and the crimes committed do not receive a moral assessment, leaving the choice between mercy and cruelty to the gamer.

All interaction with the system occurs under the supervision of a virtual assistant named Inky from the INKorp corporation. Over the course of one week, the operator will have to analyze encrypted messages and find keys to decrypt them using specialized software. Rewards are promised for conscientious performance of duties, while sabotage and disobedience entail punishment. The ultimate goal of the entire operation is to uncover the reason why this project is critical to saving humanity.
Completing daily tasks is rewarded with a special currency, INKredits, which can be spent on unlocking new applications or personalizing the InkOS operating system. These tools also provide access to paid news articles that expand your understanding of the world of the DECRYPTO Project. However, the system imposes strict restrictions on the operator’s activities, requiring him to avoid the following actions:
deliberate failure of assigned tasks; coming into contact with individuals pursuing hostile goals; exploitation of detected vulnerabilities of the InkOS operating system.

Demonschool isn’t just about spells and tutorials. It interweaves the supernatural with strategic depth, all wrapped in a cloak of academic intrigue. The title beckons you to explore her world, uncover hidden truths, and become a master of movement-based tactics. The title stands out from the crowd with its innovative approach to tactical role-playing adventure games. It promises to be a fun game with unique gameplay and an exciting setting.
Prepare to be immersed in challenging experiences and discover what lies beneath the surface of the mundane. Now the big question is: are you ready to handle the pressure? Tactical role-playing games are not easy. You’ll have to think, anticipate your opponent’s moves, and maybe even rewind time (or ten) to achieve victory. But that’s part of the fun, right? Mastering a complex system and overcoming difficult challenges is an incomparable feeling.

Game Description Duskpunk is a dark steampunk RPG where a former soldier must survive on the streets of Dredgeport. The main character, mistakenly declared dead, miraculously avoids being processed into fuel for a military machine. Finding himself in the heart of a metropolis, torn apart by corruption and gang power, he is left face to face with the harsh reality. He has only his own life and sanity at his disposal, the preservation of which becomes a paramount task in a world where even the dead serve in war.
The basis of gameplay is dice rolls that determine the outcome of skill checks. The player needs to carefully monitor 3 key indicators: health, energy and stress level, the accumulation of which imposes negative effects on the character. Each day in Duskpunk offers a limited number of actions, forcing you to wisely distribute your time between earning money, exploring dark neighborhoods and finding allies. Movement around the city is limited by checkpoints, creating a feeling of enclosed space.
The storyline offers significant freedom of choice, allowing you to join the existing order or lead a revolution against the fascist regime. The characters you meet along the way, like the priest Brother Reichek, have ambiguous motivations and can either help or pursue their own goals. The protagonist will have to make connections, look for fake documents to evade recruiters, and even participate in political debates. Not only the fate of the hero, but also the future of the entire Dredgeport depends on the decisions made.

Game Description Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault challenges the player to explore procedurally generated dimensions to collect valuable relics while confronting hostile creatures. Once in the village of Tresna, the gamer alternates forays into dungeons with commerce. Such trips present a balance of risk and reward: deep exploration of locations promises more treasures, but also carries the risk of losing all the collected goods. Survival requires overcoming these dangers to return with a backpack full of artifacts to sell.
After each expedition, the focus shifts to running the store. The resulting loot is displayed in a personal establishment, requiring the gamer to negotiate and strategically set prices to secure profitable deals. Profit from trading is the main driver of progress in Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault. The proceeds can be used to purchase improved weapons and armor, or reinvested in the businesses of other citizens, which is necessary to revitalize the local community.
Investing in local Tresna businesses, such as the blacksmith’s shop or the witch’s shop, directly contributes to the development of the city. A thriving community attracts new residents and, as a result, more potential buyers. The Infinite Vault itself is an artifact that represents the central challenge of this project, testing commercial acumen through highly profitable trading sessions. Overcoming his challenges brings significant improvements to the city, creating a system where business success fuels the development of the settlement and opens up new gaming opportunities.

Game Description Winter Survival Simulator is a hardcore first-person survival game that offers you to experience the severity of the winter climate. Finding yourself in the snow-capped mountains, there is nowhere to wait for help. You need to rely only on your own strength. Try to survive. Find shelter and wait for rescuers. The action takes place in the mountains of Washington State.
With only limited supplies on hand, battle the cold in the wild. Try to find your way to the abandoned hunter station to try to call for help from there. Hope dies last. At the beginning of the game, the hero loses his backpack and almost all his supplies, including equipment. Move through the snowstorm, try to find food and rest as much as possible.
Set traps to catch game. Beware of wild animals that are always trying to attack. The area is inhabited by wolves and bears. They pose a serious danger. Place traps and explore the area to make sure it is safe. After catching the rabbit, build a fire and fry the meat. There are 4 main factors in Winter Survival Simulator: cold, thirst, hunger and exhaustion.
Keep track of the hero’s indicators and try not to drop the value to zero. You may suffer injuries that affect game play and movement. There is a dynamic weather system, so adapt to the conditions. Once upon a time, people lived in these mountains. Explore locations for useful things. The hunting lodge can be renovated and turned into a real refuge. Fight the terrible weather and wait for the rescue helicopter. Unfortunately, there is no point in waiting for help until the weather clears.

Game Description Wretch: Divine Ascent is a tactical 1v1 auto battler where the main goal is to achieve a 10 win streak to gain access to the global leaderboard. The path to the top begins with choosing one of the available fighters, including Knight, Ronin and Assassin. Each of them has a unique fighting style, which directly affects their preferred strategies and equipment selection in battles.
The foundation for triumph in Wretch: Divine Ascent is meticulous inventory management. By purchasing a variety of gear, accessories, and moves from the store, gamers must strategically place them in their backpack to create powerful combos. Moreover, items can be fused with each other, obtaining unique artifacts that are not available for purchase. Careful planning is necessary as some attacks can neutralize the enemy’s actions.
After completing the preparation stage, the battle unfolds automatically, allowing you to observe the effectiveness of the created assembly. Fights take place in an asynchronous format against avatars of real opponents, which eliminates the need to wait for an opponent online. The main task in battle is to break through the enemy’s defenses and carry out a series of quick attacks using prepared combinations of techniques.
All duels take place in the scenery of a harsh and gloomy medieval fantasy. The oppressive atmosphere of this world is emphasized by both the dark visuals and character designs, creating a feeling of hopelessness. The project offers deep customization and tactical battles within its unique concept, where the outcome of the battle is decided not by reaction speed, but by forethought.

Game Description Fatal Claw is a dark 2D metroidvania that asks you to take control of a mysterious cat named Keesha, resurrected after death. The protagonist will have to master a combat system based on the use of mystical claws to confront the terrible creatures that have infested the underground world. As you progress, new mutant abilities are unlocked, allowing you to climb walls, make rapid dashes, and even soar in the air. A variety of engraved skills, charged from attacks, help you adapt to different opponents and overcome challenges.
The action takes place in a world known as the Dark Bestopia, where the ruins of the ancient civilization of Elord and modern science-fiction complexes are intricately intertwined. The hero begins his journey in Fatal Claw in an isolated laboratory, not remembering anything about his past. His main task is to stop the spread of the destructive curse, saving the few survivors and gradually restoring the lost memories of the events that led to the decline of this world. The multifunctional support system Karox helps him with this.
At the center of the story is a powerful artifact of the fallen kingdom - the Record Stones, capable of restoring matter, knowledge and even life itself. However, their limitless power gave birth to distorted creatures, which led to disaster and the death of the ancient civilization. Centuries later, the megacorporation Origin, which excavated the ruins, unknowingly awakened an ancient evil again, releasing it and dooming the remnants of the world to slowly fade away.
The world structure encourages non-linear exploration of a variety of distinctive regions, from Mossy Cave and Aurora Village serving as a safe haven to the abandoned Castle Elorde. The decisions made during the journey directly affect the development of the plot and lead to one of several endings. Even after the end of the story, the world continues to exist in a changed form, allowing you to continue the adventure and try to differently influence the fate of the underworld.

Game Description Kingdoms of the Dump is a pixelated RPG adventure that follows an unjustly accused squire named Dustin Binsley. After the ruler of the kingdom of Garbagia is kidnapped, it is Dustin, the Garbage Can Knight, who falls under suspicion. Now he must go on a dangerous journey to restore his reputation, save the monarch and uncover a sinister organization that threatens the entire world. His main goal is to prevent a full-scale war and return peace to his native lands.
The hero will have to confront not only false accusations, but also an entire army of Toxic Grimlins, seeking to plunge everything into chaos. The journey in Kingdoms of the Dump takes place in a world called the Lands of the Dump, consisting of five and a half unique kingdoms. Each location, from cities with houses made of tin cans to dungeons littered with trash, is imbued with a unique atmosphere of garbage fantasy, emphasizing the unusual setting of the project.
Dustin Binsley is not alone in his journey. He is joined by his faithful friend Ratavia, the librarian Walker Jacket, the bard Lute, the laundress Cerulean and the master of disguise Musk. Switch between 6 characters to use their unique abilities to overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. The world exploration, which includes platforming elements, takes place on a vast Mode 7-style map, which can eventually be navigated by airship.
Enemy battles are not random - enemies are visible on the map, allowing you to engage in combat at your discretion. The combat system, implemented on a 3x3 grid, requires tactical squad placement to evade spells, traps and deal maximum damage. In addition, the mechanics of well-timed taps used during attacks add an element of interactivity to turn-based fights and require extreme concentration from the gamer.

Game Description LexiRogue is an educational project that combines roguelite mechanics with science-based techniques for memorizing foreign vocabulary. It is based on a 21-day cycle designed to effectively consolidate the material studied. The learning process is based on regular tests, where it is necessary to accurately reproduce words according to given prompts. Any inaccuracy results in the word being marked as unlearned, and the testing phase begins again. In parallel to this, there is a mode with roguelite elements, offering the passage of levels with various combinations of enhancing bonuses for a more exciting learning experience.
An extensive system of achievements serves as an incentive for systematic improvement of skills. In addition, you can compare your own successes with the results of others thanks to multi-level leaderboards. Before starting a session in LexiRogue, you must complete a preliminary action. First, the required vocabulary base is loaded, which will become the basis for all subsequent tests. The project provides several formats for interacting with content, allowing:
pre-study words in a special training mode; take daily dictations to consolidate knowledge; Track your personal progress after completing each cycle.

Game Description Little Aviary is a meditative collecting simulator where the main goal is to create the perfect aviary for dozens of bird species. The process of replenishing the collection involves breeding over 40 species of birds, each of which has many unique color variations. The project is conceived as a background companion for the desktop, allowing you to observe the life of your pets without being distracted from other tasks. The game window is easily customizable: it can be moved around the entire screen and scaled so that it does not create clutter. Feathered friends fly independently within the visible area and can land on the upper borders of active windows of other programs. Each discovered individual is accompanied by interesting facts from real life.
The economic model is based on breeding the most valuable individuals in order to obtain maximum profit from their subsequent sale. Little Aviary uses proceeds to purchase new eggs for incubation and a variety of decorative items, including trees and birdhouses. These items serve not only as decoration, but also as a place for birds to gather and rest. Gradual development opens up access to new themed areas, such as the beach, which provide bonuses for certain types of birds. The egg incubation process continues even when the application is turned off. To effectively manage a virtual poultry house, a gamer needs to:
engage in the selection of the best birds to increase income. arrange the space of the enclosure with the help of decorative items. open new areas to gain species benefits.

Game Description Long Drive North: Co-Op RV Simulator is a brutal survival test where an old RV becomes the only refuge in the world after an unknown disaster. This vehicle requires constant attention, forcing gamers to personally repair it, search for spare parts in abandoned buildings and refuel the tank to continue driving. Every bolt found and engine fixed gives a temporary sense of security in the middle of the deserted American wilderness. There are no usual amenities here, and the only companions are silence and the noise of the engine.
The endless journey north takes you through deserts, forests and areas prone to sudden storms, where the main opponents are not monsters, but nature itself. In Long Drive North: Co-Op RV Simulator you need to carefully monitor your hunger, thirst and fatigue indicators so as not to die in harsh conditions. For food, you can hunt together with your faithful canine companion, and the found ingredients can be turned into full-fledged dishes according to various recipes. This methodical adventure tests resourcefulness and endurance.
You can complete this difficult route either alone or in co-op mode for up to four people, where each person drives their own van. The project offers unhurried and meditative gameplay, in which the joy of fixing an engine or contemplating the dawn after a cold night is valued above dynamic battles. This is a story of resilience, skill and the quiet beauty of the open road, rewarding patience and curiosity.

Game Description Morsels is a roguelite action game with elements of creature collecting, offering dynamic battles from a top-down view. The basis of the gameplay is the use of mystical cards that allow you to take on the appearance of creatures of the same name. Players have access to a deck of 3 cards, which they can switch between at any time to tactically adapt to the situation. Each creature has a unique set of attacks, dodges, and special abilities, adding variety to the combat system.
The main character is a hungry mouse who descends into the labyrinths of the sewers in search of food. His goal is to repel the evil cats who have seized power and become the Card Barons. Making his way through the winding floors of the world of Morsels, the protagonist collects cheese and finds new cards to strengthen his arsenal. The adventure begins by choosing one of two starting creatures, such as the sunflower-like Windsel or Gomsel.
The structure of each race is unique, which forces you to constantly look for new approaches to passing. An unusual mechanic results in the death of a creature after its second level up in one session, encouraging active searching and card rotation. As you explore, you can discover secret passages leading to mini-games with valuable rewards. This keeps meta-progression to a minimum, focusing on the skills within the current attempt.
The visual style of the project is distinguished by deliberate negligence and pixel graphics with the effect of an old CRT monitor. The gloomy and dirty atmosphere of the sewer is emphasized by a bright but specific color palette. The atmosphere is complemented by memorable musical accompaniment from composer Sam Webster. All elements together create a holistic and memorable image of a world full of dangers and hidden opportunities.

Starting with one of 10 starting decks, each offering a different style, players gradually earn experience. This experience is used to unlock new cards and sets, expanding tactical options and increasing replayability of the project, offering both relaxed sessions and intense challenges.

Game Description Sektori is an intense twin-stick shooter whose gameplay is inextricably linked to the aggressive rhythms of techno music and requires extreme concentration from the player. The project immerses you in a state of flow, where kaleidoscopic visuals, soundtrack and gameplay merge into one. The main task is to destroy a myriad of opponents in a constantly transforming arena. The battlefield dynamically changes its shape, expanding, contracting or even splitting into several parts, which forces you to constantly adapt battle tactics and does not allow you to rely on memorized patterns.
Under control is a maneuverable ship, protected not by traditional lives, but by energy shields. Destroyed enemies leave behind gold, which is necessary to purchase upgrades from a special deck. Modifications for the ship, such as increasing armor or missiles, are acquired sequentially from the proposed queue, and not by free choice. Sektori’s special tactic is the ability to use the ship itself as a powerful projectile, which allows you to inflict enormous damage, but carries the enormous risk of being defenseless in the midst of enemies.
Structurally, the title offers a campaign consisting of five unique worlds with epic bosses at the end of each level. Each playthrough becomes unique due to the procedural generation of waves of opponents and the random selection of final opponents from the available pool. Additional variety is provided by alternative ship types and customizable upgrade decks, allowing you to create your own playstyle. In addition, there are six alternative modes and several difficulty levels, including the maximum called Revolution, to test your skills.

Game Description The events of SpaceBourne 2 begin from the end of the first part, only now the player needs to build his own space empire and develop it in all directions. However, there is no need to rush with this global task. The game world is completely open to exploration of each solar system, where the user can first become famous or, on the contrary, become an enemy, and then make it easier for themselves to establish diplomatic relations.
The main character is a space traveler who is free to do whatever he wants. True, for this he needs funds to maintain and improve the ship, which means he will still have to carry out various missions and assignments. But he doesn’t need to navigate the expanses of the universe alone, because due to the size of the ship, he couldn’t do it without a crew. Each member has their own needs and tasks that can be assigned to them. Features of the protagonist of SpaceBourne 2:
Mining - minerals are valued everywhere, because they are the main resource for construction, fuel and other export goods, so in order to effectively develop the economy it is worth purchasing and launching several mines on asteroids and satellites Trade - space is full of abandoned or destroyed ships, but you can collect many valuable items from them and then sell them on the market at a good price, you can also engage in piracy, but this is not a safe business Hunting - rebels is a big problem for some states and in order to suppress the riots they are ready to pay a tidy sum for the head of the rebel leader or the conviction of his death Wormholes are portals that lead to random places in the universe or even dimensions, an excellent and convenient way to travel, as well as search for unique items
After the protagonist has accumulated enough strength and money through tasks, he can begin to create his own state on the territory of abandoned planets. Diplomatic agreements will become the basis of the country’s existence, since with their help you can exchange goods and expand your capabilities. The most enterprising managers will even be able to finance invasions of entire regions of space, receiving monthly rewards for each successful operation and changing the balance of power in the Nusa system, which is slowly recovering from a devastating war.
The basis for the establishment’s prosperity is well-structured management and culinary skills. Gameplay in The Diner at the End of the Galaxy requires mastering over 50 alien recipes using over 13 basic ingredients and 3 different cooking methods. You will have to hire staff consisting of cooks, gardeners and waiters, as well as organize expeditions to distant planets to search for rare crops. Creating a menu that suits the varied tastes of an intergalactic clientele is achieved through trial and error.
All the activity takes place on a desert planet, where the task is to transform an abandoned trading outpost into a thriving center of gravity for the entire galaxy. The establishment will become a haven for mercenaries, smugglers, adventurers and even influential aristocrats. The doors are open to everyone who is able to pay in the local currency - gobards. Starting with clearing the area of ​​industrial waste, it is necessary to gradually build dining halls, equip kitchens and lay out gardens for growing exotic plants, creating a unique enterprise from scratch.

Game Description Dungeons and Kingdoms is a hybrid project that combines the features of a kingdom management simulator and role-playing action game with dungeon exploration. The advancement of technology and the overall prosperity of the settlement directly depend on bold forays into dangerous locations. Adventurers will have to descend into ancient ruins and temples filled with ferocious monsters. Battles with opponents, including powerful bosses, take place in third-person action format. Victory over enemies is rewarded with valuable resources necessary for the technological development of the entire kingdom, as well as for protecting roads from bandits.
Trophies obtained in battles become the basis for the construction and improvement of unique buildings. Builders have at their disposal a modular system with over 500 elements, allowing them to create buildings from scratch or use editable drawings. Beyond the architectural challenges, Dungeons & Kingdoms offers deep citizen management. Each settler has their own needs and skills, and the community’s survival requires hunting, farming, and resource gathering. The surrounding landscape can be changed: leveling areas for fields, digging ditches or creating hills for buildings.
The story begins with managing a small group of refugees forced to leave their native lands in search of a new home. The primary task becomes basic survival, which includes obtaining food and creating simple tools and shelters. Adaptation to difficulties is forced by realistic cycles of day and night, as well as changing seasons, which affect the availability of resources. Thus, the path from a handful of exiles to the rulers of a prosperous state is entirely in the hands of the gamer.

Game Description Forestrike is a tactical kung fu fighting game with a supernatural element, built on the unique ability to predict the outcome of a battle. The project proposes to hone your skills in mental duels before entering into a real fight. Using the gift of Foresight, the hero can repeatedly play out various battle scenarios in his mind, finding the only correct sequence of movements for victory. However, in a real conflict, any mistake is fatal, because defeat means having to start the whole journey from the very beginning. Each battle is presented in the form of a puzzle, where success requires not only the strength of your fists, but also a sharp mind.
At the center of the story is a martial artist named Yu, who goes on a long journey across the country. His goal is to free the Emperor, who has fallen under the corrupting influence of the evil Admiral. Opponents are always outnumbered, so you can’t do without a special meditative technique. Every encounter in Forestrike forces you to adapt and improvise, as randomly generated runs and encounters make every playthrough unique. As Yu progresses towards the capital, he becomes stronger, learning techniques from five unique masters and receiving constant upgrades to his skills.
The art of victory is to hone every step to perfection:
Experiment with tactics in mental rehearsals without any consequences. Learn new techniques from five eccentric mentors to gain permanent improvements. Adapt to unique encounters in a procedurally generated world. Knock out crowds of brutal enemies using the entire available environment.
The journey takes you through a visually detailed fantasy world populated by colorful characters and dangerous opponents. Detailed pixelated landscapes provide an atmospheric backdrop for hand-crafted animation, highlighting the intensity of each fight.

Game Description Have You Seen This Man? is a first-person psychological horror, the plot of which takes you into the atmosphere of Texas in 1975. The gameplay is based on a methodical exploration of the streets of Emsdorf County, where you will have to knock on doors and communicate with local residents. Each encounter is unique: from conversations with eccentric conspiracy theorists to clashes with aggressive hermits with shotguns at the ready. Some of them will help in the investigation, while others will deliberately lead on the wrong trail. All these interactions are designed to immerse you deeper into the unsettling atmosphere of a place full of omissions and dark secrets. Gradually revealing the secrets of the district, the protagonist gets closer to the solution.
The main character is Weldon McCall, a former homicide detective from Dallas who now holds the post of sheriff in the quiet county of Emsdorf. His quiet life is shattered when violent crimes resume in the city, reminiscent of an old unsolved case. A ruthless killer who preys exclusively on parents and leaves children alive is on the trail again. This nightmare from the past, which Weldon thought was long forgotten, now threatens his own family. In the project Have You Seen This Man? The sheriff has to find the maniac before he himself becomes his next victim. This desperate investigation becomes the hero’s only chance to close the bloody chapter of his life.
Combing the streets of Emsdorf County:
Communicate with each resident to collect evidence and rumors. Thorough research of locations and crime scenes. Confronting hostile characters. Finding the serial killer before he strikes again.

Local employees begin to patrol the endless trading floors and warehouses - creepy entities obsessed with the idea of ​​​​providing their last service to lost souls. Their obsessive desire to help turns into a ruthless hunt, forcing survivors to seek cover and move with extreme caution, because every squeak could be the last.
Daylight hours become a short respite intended for active actions. Groups of up to three people need to work together to explore the labyrinths of shelves, looking for useful items, tools and encrypted notes that can point the way to salvation. Teamwork is the key to success in Storebound, as solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles requires teamwork. Communication is maintained using walkie-talkies and voice chat, but any extra noise can attract unwanted attention from the nocturnal inhabitants of this damned place.
What the endless shelves hide:
Finding fuses to restore lighting and gain a temporary advantage. Using cover, ventilation shafts and shadows to move unnoticed. Solving spatial puzzles that open new passages to the treasured exit. Game Description Stuck Together is a co-op challenge filled with 1990s nostalgia. The space is filled with recognizable items from the era, including videotapes and furniture with distinctive tacky patterns. However, this retro world is actually a house of horrors from which you have to make a daring escape. Five full-scale rooms, including the Kitchen and Bedroom, conceal numerous dangers, traps and mutilated toys, creating an oppressive and tense environment for a bold ascent to freedom.
The plot centers on two children’s toys, mercilessly glued together by their tyrannical teenage owner. Their only goal is to break free, but the path to it is constantly complicated by the intervention of a malicious antagonistic hand. This little tormentor is ready to knock down the characters at any moment with one slap, throwing them far back and resetting the progress made. Successfully completing Stuck Together becomes a real test of both skills and friendships, requiring extreme concentration and patience from your partners.
The project offers a cooperative climb that requires two people to flawlessly coordinate either locally or online. The controls are physics-based, requiring all four limbs to work together to swing, grapple, and climb through levels. Any mistake is fraught with fall, and many threats await you on the path to salvation.
What’s hiding in the cursed house:
Boiling kettles and hot fireplaces, turning everyday life into a deadly obstacle course. Headless dolls and other mutilated inhabitants of the children’s room. Falling debris and treacherously designed sections of levels. The constant threat of being knocked down from a height by the sudden appearance of a tormenting hand.

A powerful laser blaster is used to mine other materials, such as human debris, mushrooms or crystals. All mined resources in Shelldiver can be sold in your own store, and in between swims you can walk around the island, which distinguishes the project from titles where all interaction occurs through the menu.
The profit received from the sale of jellyfish is invested back into the business. This allows you to improve the submarine, working tools and increase the supply of oxygen necessary for deeper dives. Progressive development and expansion of capabilities are at the core of incremental mechanics. The ultimate goal is not only personal enrichment, but also the prosperity of the local community, whose residents are the main clients and connoisseurs of the exotic jellyfish sold in the small shop of the enterprising turtle.

Game Description Village of the Curse is a depressing first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of a journalist investigating the dark secrets of an isolated settlement. The hero will have to survive in an atmosphere of constant fear, because unpredictable and ruthless creatures are hiding in the shadows. Every meeting with these distorted entities becomes a test of strength. Exploring eerie locations, including an abandoned church, a witch’s house and a haunted cemetery, is fraught with mortal danger. Every corner of this cursed place is filled not only with secrets, but also with horror, ready to engulf any unwary adventurer.

The strategic distribution of mined materials allows the mothership to be transformed into a veritable asteroid-killing machine, capable of withstanding the most intense encounters.
The path from prospector to destroyer of worlds:
Extraction of resources through the total destruction of asteroid fields. Gradual strengthening of the ship through an incremental progression system. Exploring a branching tree of improvements to customize features. Survival in intense battles with bullet hell elements.

Game Description Beyond R: Rule Ripper is a visual novel that places ten strangers in a ruthless game of survival. Finding themselves locked in the mysterious Golden Jack bar, they learn from the mysterious Boss that they have been poisoned. The only chance of salvation lies in following the rules or breaking them completely, setting the stage for a tense psychological thriller.
The ultimate goal for each of the captives is to survive until there are three or fewer people left alive. What makes Beyond R: Rule Ripper unique in its gameplay is that each of the ten characters secretly represents one of the rules. Violation of one’s own rule remains unpunished, but disobedience to someone else’s instructions leads to inevitable death, after which the corresponding rule disappears forever, narrowing the circle of suspicion.
Key moments unfold during the so-called Councils - intense discussions where the group decides its future fate. These debates are visualized like a game of pool, requiring the protagonist to be able to influence opinions and steer the conversation in a safe direction. Success depends on understanding the personalities of your opponents, including the hot-tempered Poker, the eccentric Lime, as well as the gloomy Vodka and the cold-blooded Coffee.
The intimate atmosphere of the Golden Jack bar is enhanced by a stylish jazz soundtrack of over 40 tracks. The project offers high replayability due to more than 25 different endings leading to one True Ending. Every decision made has weight, forcing you to carefully analyze the consequences of your actions to achieve the desired outcome.
