The exploration of the world takes place in the vast post-apocalyptic wasteland, fraught with many dangers. The locations are filled not only with hordes of aliens and zombies, but also with hostile survivors, as well as the results of sinister military experiments. The world of Shatterland keeps the secrets of the past in the ruins of secret facilities and the remains of military bases, where you can find files that shed light on the disaster and the stolen powers of the hero.
Survival requires players to constantly collect resources needed to craft weapons and equipment. The most important element of the gameplay is the construction of shelters and barricades, allowing you to create safe zones anywhere. Strengthening your own base becomes a key task to counter threats that intensify with the onset of night in conditions of dynamic changes in weather and time of day.
The project supports both single play and co-op mode, where you can team up with friends to share resources and build more powerful defensive structures. Vehicles are provided to move around the large-scale map. The gameplay is built on constant tension: the world does not stop even for a moment, and the inventory is tied to a specific session, which forces you to adapt to new conditions every time you connect to a foreign world.

Game Description CLAWPUNK, a 2D action-platformer with roglite elements, takes you to a dystopian city overrun by hostile factions and street gangs. The main goal is to recapture the metropolis from a tyrant named Mister Fluffy, a former ally who betrayed his relatives and expelled all the cats. The liberation mission falls on the shoulders of a squad of 9 unique cat heroes with a total of 9 lives per playthrough.
Unusual mechanics encourage an aggressive style of play: trying to avoid battles and sneak past security cameras unnoticed only increases the level of anxiety, attracting elite opponents to the level - hellhounds. CLAWPUNK’s gameplay allows you to freely switch between available characters, but the death of any of them is final within the current run, which adds tactical depth to what is happening.
The team composition is distinguished by a variety of fighting styles and approaches to movement. The squad includes the agile and swift Dash, the slow but devastating tank Buck with a huge hammer, and Candy, whose whip can reach enemies even through walls. Other fighters are even more eccentric: Larry moves around the arena on a springy pogo stick, and Jinx uses a flying hoverboard for maneuvers.
Procedurally generated levels are organized into 9 distinct zones that offer different challenges. Deep customization of character abilities is implemented through a collectible card system that allows you to equip up to 3 modifiers for each cat. This system, combined with a completely destructible environment, makes it possible to create your own route to the end of each stage.

Game Description Driving Life is a detailed simulator that offers you to master more than 40 types of transport in the setting of rural America. Players will explore a vast open world of 16 km², where they can not only complete work tasks, but also buy and sell 16 unique houses. Of particular interest is the mechanics of restoring 6 project cars, parts for which are scattered throughout the island. In addition to managing finances, it is necessary to constantly monitor the basic needs of the character: hunger, thirst, sleep and even boredom, which significantly increases the level of immersion in what is happening.
The basis of the gameplay is economic survival, built on completing various tasks. To earn money, there are 24 types of work, including transporting tourists, delivering goods, removing garbage and replenishing vending machines. Successful completion of Driving Life contracts is directly dependent on your ability to drive manual transmission cars, vans and trucks. Every dollar counts because poor financial decisions, whether it’s not buying fuel on time or missing rent, can quickly lead to bankruptcy and the end of the passage.
The project focuses on realism, offering a complex simulation rather than arcade racing. Advancement up the career ladder is determined by a system of licenses and reputation, and innovations have added a well-developed system of damage to vehicles during collisions to the title. Numerous signs and signs have been added to make road navigation easier, and some tasks now require physically interacting with objects and manually loading them into a vehicle. All of this creates a complex and skill-demanding experience where success depends on patience and strategic planning.

You control four heroines, each of whom has a unique fighting style: archer Haneul, kendo master Sumi, chemist Arin and athlete Mirae. Their shared shamanic power allows them to use special talismans in battle. The project’s combat system is based on launching projectiles that ricochet off walls and other objects to hit placed amulets and drive out enemies blocking the path.
Midnight Study takes place in the prestigious Yeongcheon High School, which, after one careless ritual, has turned into a deadly labyrinth. Driven by curiosity, four students awakened ancient spirits long locked within the walls of the occult club. Now the endless corridors, dark classrooms and sealed rooms of the school have become home to creatures straight out of the pages of Korean school horror stories and traditional folklore. Every encounter with them is a meeting with a legend that has become reality.
The main goal is to survive the prolonged midnight self-preparation and clear the school of otherworldly presence. After each successfully completed battle, you are rewarded with forbidden talismans and mysterious relics that can be combined to create a cursed deck. Since the structure of the school constantly changes with each new playthrough, and the strength of the enemies only increases over time, survival directly depends on the tactical decisions made and the ability to adapt your strategy to unpredictable conditions.

This powerful antagonist uses portals to instantly move and drain energy, and battles with him take place in several intense stages. Throughout the battle, he is able to call upon the echoes of fallen worlds, making the confrontation more difficult. The warrior’s ultimate mission is to prevent the collapse of the energy core, for which it is necessary to penetrate desecrated dimensions and destroy ominous altars that drain life forces.
To complete this task, there is a choice of several characters, who are presented not as traditional classes, but as variables in a system on the verge of collapse. Each of them is a unique force capable of bending the laws of reality. Progression in Fracturefront is driven by two mechanics. By collecting fragments of energy cores from different worlds, you can create powerful new equipment. In addition, by harnessing the shrapnel power of destroyed altars, the protagonist creates loyal allies to support him in battle, which adds strategic depth.
Traveling through rifts takes the hero to diverse and dangerous dimensions, where each foray is a risky battle for survival. Among the locations available for exploration are scorched deserts, gloomy forests, abandoned ruins and a cruel mechanical metropolis. You will have to confront constantly evolving opponents and colossal giant bosses. Enemies range from dancing zombies and a music-obsessed fat man to a fierce biker chick and a variety of other bizarre but deadly monsters.

Game Description Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends and the Secret Fairy DX offers an expanded version of the adventure, allowing you to take control of Empel and Leela in their own storyline. The events of this expanded edition take place 3 years after the finale of the first part, when the matured Raizalin Shtout goes to the capital city of Ashra-am-Berd. At the request of a friend, she takes on the task of investigating a mysterious stone, which soon turns out to be an egg. A mysterious creature, named Phi, hatches from it, which becomes the starting point for a new series of discoveries and dangers associated with ancient ruins.
The basis of the passage remains alchemical synthesis, necessary to create items and equipment. The combat system, combining turn-based elements and real-time combat, has been improved. In the capital, Ryza reunites with old friends, including Tao, Lent and Claudia, and also meets new companions, including Patricia, Clifford and Serri. While exploring the ruins in Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX, the team uncovers the secrets of the past and searches for a way to help their new pet, whose origins are closely tied to these ancient places and the other world.
It turns out that Phi is a creature from the Underworld that requires a huge amount of mana to survive. By absorbing energy from the magical crystals in the ruins, the creature unwittingly weakens the ancient seal. This leads to the opening of a gate to another world and the appearance of powerful monsters led by the Legendary Monarch. The heroes must not only repel the invasion, but also make difficult decisions about the fate of Phi in order to restore balance and protect the kingdom from the impending threat, completing their summer adventure.

A voice in her head guides Reiza to create mysterious keys that open up not only new possibilities in the synthesis of objects, but also access to previously unseen areas for exploration. On her travels, Reiza is accompanied by a team of 11 loyal companions, including old friends Tao Mongarten, Lent Marslink and Claudia Valenz, as well as new faces. Exploration of the world of Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX takes place on the expanses of a single seamless map that unites several regions without additional downloads. Traveling around this world is necessary to collect rare ingredients from defeated monsters and in secluded corners of nature. Collected materials are used in a complex system of alchemical synthesis to create powerful equipment and useful items needed to advance the story and complete quests. Game Description Goodnight Universe puts at the center of the story a six-month-old baby named Isaac, who has not only a developed intellect, but also mysterious psychic abilities. His main desire is to receive the love and recognition of his family, whose members are emotionally distant from each other. However, the gifted child is already being hunted by a shadowy technology corporation pursuing its own goals. In an attempt to improve his relationships with his loved ones and keep his secret, Isaac secretly uses telekinesis and telepathy to solve their problems and ease their mental suffering, while remaining an ordinary baby in their eyes.
Interaction with the world in this first-person adventure is implemented in an unusual way. The Goodnight Universe project proposes using a webcam to track eye movements and facial expressions, turning them into a tool for interacting with the environment. This way you can move objects from a distance or even change channels on your TV with just a blink. While a traditional controller is also available, it’s the facial gestures that allow you to immerse yourself deeper into the role of a child creating real magic. You have to solve puzzles and explore a world full of both comical situations and touching moments.
Secret ways to change a baby’s world:
Unnoticeable interference in family life using telekinesis. Reading the thoughts of relatives to understand their hidden experiences. Making decisions that create a ripple effect and influence the development of events. Solving creative problems and puzzles in the style of non-linear quests.

Game Description Hymer 2000 plunges into a melancholy and philosophical story, where a mundane task of disposing of an outdated artificial intelligence module turns into a deep investigation for technician Frank. He is sent to a mysterious residential complex called Hope Residence with the goal of carrying out a complete shutdown of the system named Hymer. However, upon arrival, he is confronted with digital fragments of other people’s memories, mysterious images and long-buried secrets. What begins as a routine task quickly turns into an introspective journey in which the boundaries between human perception and machine logic become extremely blurred.
All interaction with the world occurs through an interface that completely imitates the operating system. Instead of choosing from ready-made lines, free text input is used to communicate with artificial intelligence and advance through the plot. The gameplay of Hymer 2000 is based on an open search function that allows you to analyze any found correspondence logs using keywords. Thus, gradually collecting digital evidence and clues, the gamer uncovers a complex narrative hidden in the depths of the system archives and dialogues that Hymer had with previous users.
Adding coherence to the story are 80 unique illustrations depicting pareidolic faces—ambiguous images found in random objects. They symbolize the instability of reality and the subjectivity of perception. The built-in algorithmic mini-problems, including Particle and Note, add variety to the research process. Each detail serves one purpose - to reveal the main secret that Hymer keeps before his final shutdown, and to understand the nature of his digital consciousness.

Terrain becomes a full-fledged weapon, allowing you to separate enemy forces and lure bosses into traps. Success depends on the right combination of character skills, such as Qili’s positional combinations, Diego’s counterattack ambushes, or Daniel’s explosions that spread negative effects. A deep build system allows you to combine 112 tactical components to achieve maximum effectiveness in battle.
The plot continues the saga begun in Indies’ Lie, where warriors from different eras, awakened by the Mistress of Death, must challenge the divine tyranny on the continent of Meka. Under the yoke of the evil god Indys, factions fight in procedurally generated battles. In Indies' Lies 2: Fire Seed, each expedition is unique with random maps, enemies and events, from surprise ambushes to mysterious altars. Forming a squad of mechanically diverse characters opens up endless tactical possibilities, while hundreds of combinations of equipment and Ignite abilities allow for devastating synergies.
Components of victory over divine tyranny:
Create unique builds like Blink Crit or Toxin Overload from a variety of relics and equipment. Adapt to unpredictable challenges, including random events and ambushes from elite enemies. Leverage the synergy of skills and terrain for tactical dominance on the battlefield.

Game Description MORSE is a strategy simulation game where the main goal is to fend off a naval attack using Morse code. The fire control process is implemented with only two control elements. To aim at a target, you must enter combinations of dots and dashes that correspond to coordinates on a grid of letters and numbers. Successful completion of this task allows for precise strikes on the Kaiser’s fleet, methodically destroying enemy ships. Every battle requires not only reaction speed, but also tactical thinking to efficiently use ammunition.
One of the tactical components is reconnaissance. Artillery bursts briefly illuminate enemy ships hidden in the darkness, and a direct hit near a target reveals its position permanently. After each repelled attack, you are given the opportunity to improve your arsenal or strengthen your defenses. MORSE gameplay also involves deploying sea mines to create defensive lines. These barriers serve as the last chance to intercept ships that have broken through the line of fire.
With each new wave of the enemy, the difficulty increases: the grid on the battlefield expands, and more and more powerful German ships appear from the dark waters. The main task is to hold out until dawn. To hone your telegraphy skills, there are various modes, including a story campaign and free battles. A total of 40 characters are available to explore, and for complete immersion, you can connect a real telegraph key, which provides an authentic interaction experience.

His career starts in a modest home garage, where he will prepare his first car for races in the ARCA Menards series. Gradually moving up the racing hierarchy, it will be possible to conquer the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, Xfinity Series championships and, finally, fight for the main cup. Success depends not only on skill on the track, but also on strategic decisions: hiring personnel, finding sponsors and developing new parts for the car, building its reputation through results and communication with the press.

Download, and driver ratings based on Racing Insights data reflect their real strengths on different track types.
Tools for creating a champion:
More than 150 licensed pilots from four national series. Deep customization of the car, helmet, overalls and transporter. Network races with support for up to 40 riders simultaneously. Over 400 color options to create a unique style.

Game Description Schematic Void is a meta-adventure that asks you to take on an unusual mission to complete someone else’s half-finished project. Here the fourth wall is completely broken, and the creator’s unfinished notes are turned into tools for advancement. Interface elements become part of the puzzles, and the rules are constantly rewritten as you progress. Solutions require not so much technical knowledge as ingenuity and innovative thinking, because the logic of the world is subject to its own, very bizarre laws. The goal is to bring someone else’s creation to life, using the most unexpected methods.
Taking on the role of a developer, gamers will have to solve puzzles centered around electrical circuits. However, the fundamental principle of Schematic Void is to be as close to a real electrical circuit as possible. Circuit boards and wires serve only as a playground for puzzles that encourage curiosity and trickery. Instead of following strict instructions, you need to experiment and find non-obvious connections between objects. The world is filled not only with technical elements, but also with completely unexpected characters, including pets, princesses and even a unicorn.
The project is distinguished by its stylish minimalistic visuals, where two-dimensional graphics at times create the illusion of three-dimensional space. The art, done in a warm palette, creates a feeling of comfort and handicraft, and expressive animation emphasizes the mood of each scene. The atmosphere is complemented by a soundtrack that evokes a wide range of emotions - from melancholy to inspiration. The non-linear structure allows you to return to previously completed levels in order to use new tools and capabilities that are discovered as you progress.

Game Description Highway 11 is a psychological horror game in which the only way to break out of an endless loop is extreme concentration. The story begins at a deserted crossroads, from where all paths inevitably lead to the starting point. The vehicle moves autonomously, leaving the protagonist the role of a passive observer. The main task is to carefully study the environment for the slightest deviations from the usual route. Any change, be it a displaced road sign or an unusual sound, is a clue.
At each intersection, a fateful decision must be made: whether something anomalous was noticed. The mechanics of Highway 11 require you to accurately determine the presence or absence of deviations. A sequence of 11 correct conclusions allows you to finally leave the ominous highway. However, even a single mistake completely resets the progress made and returns you to the beginning of the loop. To facilitate the observation process, it is possible to control the passage of time, slowing it down for detailed analysis or speeding it up in familiar areas.
The project does not rely on sudden frightening moments, but on creating an oppressive feeling of anxious discomfort. The visual style emphasizes the atmosphere of liminal spaces, where familiar landscapes cause irrational anxiety. The absence of direct threats or scenes of violence shifts the focus to internal experiences. All the horror is concentrated not in graphic effects, but in the mind, forced to constantly doubt its own perception of reality. The soundtrack only enhances this feeling, using subtle changes in background noise.

Game Description Lumines Arise is a reimagining of the classic puzzle game from the studio Enhance, known for the Tetris Effect: Connected project. Temporarily stopping field clearing with the new Burst mechanic opens up tactical depth, allowing you to build huge formations for record-breaking scores. This approach turns each playthrough into a unique audiovisual experience, where actions directly affect the environment and soundtrack. The concept of synesthesia, laid down by the developers, is felt in every element, linking together light, sound and interaction.
The gameplay is based on the simple task of making squares from falling blocks of two colors. The time line scanning the field to the beat of the music erases ready-made figures, launching chains of combos. In Lumines Arise, every action is synchronized with the soundtrack, creating a completely immersive experience. The solo journey will take you through more than 35 unique stages, from the neon streets of Tokyo and dense jungles to lost spaces in space, each with its own mood and theme song.
Symphony of light and sound:
The single-player mode offers a journey through various worlds, where each level is a separate audiovisual composition. Online confrontation Burst Battle forces you to use new mechanics to attack your opponent, filling his field with blocks. The electronic soundtrack from composers Hydelic and Takako Ishida immerses you in a state of flow, and the playlist function allows you to customize the musical accompaniment.

Game Description Million Depth offers a unique tactical experience where survival is directly dependent on the ability to manage time. The main character, Moma, has a device known as a biotope jammer, which allows her to completely freeze a moment while she herself remains motionless. This mechanic becomes the basis of the combat system: dangerous creatures hiding in the shadows of dungeons make their move only after the actions of the protagonist. Battles become an intense puzzle that requires careful planning of every move, especially when equipment wears out and breaks, leaving the girl defenseless in the face of the threat.
Moma’s journey is a descent into an abyss a million stories deep on a fallen Earth. Her goal is to find her friend, following barely noticeable traces of a former civilization. However, the world of Million Depth is constantly changing, subject to the laws of parallel realities and time loops. The story takes place in three different eras, covering the present, events a hundred years ago and the distant future a thousand years from now. Decisions made in the past irreversibly shape future events, creating new branches of the narrative and changing the fate of the heroine herself.
Creativity becomes the main weapon in this unpredictable world. The gameplay allows you to create your own equipment, combining various blocks to construct both long-range weapons and durable shields. The economic system is also different from the usual one: instead of money, barter flourishes here. You’ll have to bargain with local shopkeepers, taking into account their mood and the constantly fluctuating cost of a strange resource called stockinum, in order to make profitable deals. Each playthrough reveals new pieces of the global mystery, turning exploration of the depths into a large-scale adventure.

Game Description Possessor(s) tells the grim story of a forced symbiosis that emerged amid the ruins of a flooded city. At the center of the story is Luka, a student who was mortally wounded as a result of an interdimensional cataclysm. To survive, she makes a deal with an otherworldly entity named Rem, who restores her body. Now this couple, who do not trust each other, must learn to coexist. Their joint survival becomes the only chance to escape from the destroyed metropolis, consumed by surreal horrors and anomalies that have distorted reality.
The destroyed city is a huge quarantine zone, where collapsed skyscrapers coexist with abandoned aquariums. Exploring the world of Possessor(s) reveals the truth behind the disaster: behind it is a corrupt corporation whose experiments with demonic energy were the root cause of the disaster. Traveling through this dangerous world, the heroes meet other survivors, each of whom has their own tragic story. Navigating through locations requires precision, and unlockable abilities such as running on walls or using a whip to cross chasms allow you to penetrate previously inaccessible areas.
The combat system is based on fast and precise attacks, inspired by platform fighting games. The gameplay forces you to combine ground and air attacks, throwing opponents into the air for long series of attacks. The most unexpected objects appear in the heroine’s arsenal, from a guitar to a computer mouse, which turn into deadly weapons against demonic opponents. Mastering all combat and acrobatic techniques is the key to victory over powerful bosses guarding the secrets of this dying world.

Thanks to the efforts of the SparklingBit studio, the project received not just graphical improvements, but also a significant reworking of key mechanics, which made it possible to preserve the spirit of the original, making it accessible to modern audiences. At the center of the escalating turmoil are six unique heroes, each of whom will have to go their own way. Exploring vast territories, they will complete hundreds of tasks, fight monsters in dangerous dungeons and uncover ancient secrets. Completing Sacred 2 Remaster is closely tied to deep character customization through collecting loot, leveling up, and mastering unique martial arts. The fate of an entire continent depends on the decisions made in this massive adventure, where every choice shapes a legend.
Ancaria’s heritage in a new guise:
The combat system has become more responsive, ensuring smooth battles. Full support for controllers and a modern interface guarantee comfortable control. The visual component has been improved due to redesigned textures and lighting effects. The edition includes all previously released additions and updates in a single package. Numerous fixes based on community feedback have improved overall stability.

Game Description Swords and Sandals 3 Redux plunges fighters into a world of merciless combat, where cutting off limbs does not mean inevitable defeat, but only strengthens the will to win. Turn-based battles in the Gladiae Ultratus arena, taking place both one-on-one and in teams of two, set the goal for the gladiator to defeat 24 legendary champions of the Brandor universe. The path to glory runs through seven deadly locations, from the eerie depths of the Bone Pit to the dizzying heights of the Tower of Vertigo. To achieve triumph, any means are used: you can throw your own weapon at the enemy or even throw a discarded bottle of healing potion at him.
Creating a warrior begins with detailed customization of appearance, height, weight, and even hometown. In addition to people, powerful automaton constructs - robotic overlords with a unique development system - can participate in battles. The gameplay of Swords and Sandals 3 Redux allows you to master a variety of talents and skills, turning your fighter into a real killing machine. Characters rain down molten death from the skies or perform earth-shaking guitar solos, showcasing the versatility of the combat system.
The world of Brandor is populated by colorful characters, among whom there are both old familiar merchants and formidable opponents. Among them are the cartoonish Pig-skinned Merchant Pigsus in a sombrero and the Dread Prisoner waiting for his magical weapon. For connoisseurs of the classics, it is possible to switch to the original sprites of gladiators and merchants at any time, as well as use the classic design of the city. All mechanics feel faster and more polished, offering a concentrated gladiatorial combat experience without unnecessary elements, where champions can be called to duel at any time.

Game Description The Single-Eye Nightmare is a frightening dive into the depths of a long-abandoned underground temple, where the oppressive silence is broken only by the echo of your own footsteps. Instead of treasures and ancient artifacts, winding corridors and dark tunnels conceal a deadly threat, forcing you to constantly be on alert. A monstrous creature is constantly following on the heels - a cyclops, a meeting with which does not bode well, because his only eye sees in the darkness. The main task is not exploration, but survival, which requires the gamer to be extremely careful and ingenious to overcome all challenges.
To find a way to the surface, you will have to overcome many deadly traps, cunningly placed by the unknown builders of this gloomy place. Solving a variety of environmental puzzles is the only way to move deeper into the catacombs and open locked passages. The entire gameplay of The Single-Eye Nightmare is built on constant tension, since it is necessary not only to solve riddles, but also to constantly hide from the only inhabitant of the temple. A monster’s vision is its main weapon, so remaining undetected in this first-person horror game becomes a primary goal for survival.
What the temple corridors hide:
Deadly mechanisms of ancient civilization. Intricate puzzles integrated into architecture. The vigilant gaze of the one-eyed guard. The only path to salvation that needs to be found.

Game Description Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature invites you to immerse yourself in a world where the weather and nature itself directly depend on the emotions of a stone golem. This magically reborn creature embarks on a journey of self-discovery, seeking not only to find his purpose, but also to restore harmony. The surrounding world is a single organism, where the emotional state of the protagonist in real time shapes the weather and influences the behavior of animals. Progress in this mission is visually reflected by bright flowers blooming on the hero’s back, symbolizing the return of life to the dying lands.
The golem is not alone on his journey, because a curious fox becomes his faithful companion and assistant. As the story unfolds, these disparate characters develop a deep and meaningful bond in Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature, highlighting themes of friendship and loss. Their adventure runs through vast and gradually flowing locations, from the mysterious Cave of Awakening to the picturesque Green Forest. The ruins of a long-vanished civilization contain secrets that can help rejuvenate the world, and it is up to the unusual duo to uncover them.
The protagonists will encounter a variety of adorable creatures, including peacocks, armadillos and sand cats. Solving environmental puzzles becomes the main tool of interaction. Using the golem’s abilities, you can creatively change the landscape, opening previously inaccessible paths and revealing secrets. The orchestral soundtrack enhances the atmosphere of a peaceful and thoughtful adventure, making every moment in this amazing project truly memorable. The entire story is a moving tale of finding your place in a reborn world and the power of friendship to heal nature.

Game Description Wall World 2 continues the exploration of the vertical world. Players will control a complex spider robot as they delve into procedurally generated mines to mine resources and search for lost artifacts. The machine and its pilot will have to fight hostile organisms inhabiting the dark depths of the structure. Each expedition aims to discover forgotten technologies and uncover the fundamental secrets hidden within this massive structure. The entire experience is focused on survival, managing supplies, and battling the horrors that lurk in the darkness.
What awaits daredevils in Wall World 2:
Extraction of resources to improve equipment. Battles with hostile creatures. Research of generated mines and biomes. Upgrading the robotic spider and the pilot’s exosuit. Uncovering the secrets buried in the depths of the Wall.
The gameplay in this project involves a constant calculation of risk and reward. Monsters pose a constant threat, attacking the robotic spider on the surface of the Wall and ambushing inside the dug tunnels. Collected materials are used to upgrade the player’s mobile battle station and personal exosuit between missions. These upgrades provide access to more remote and dangerous areas of the environment, and characters in the city-sphere offer more options for customizing equipment.
The Wall itself is a dynamic environment, changing and presenting new challenges with each approach. Moving through different biomes reveals environmental anomalies that can either help or hinder the gamer’s journey. The central point of interest is the mysterious Hole - a location that promises answers, but also poses significant threats. The goal of this game is to navigate your way deeper into this world, surviving its dangers to discover what lies in the uncharted depths.

Game Description Wartorn follows the journey of sisters Yara and Elani, who have been exiled from their home and must traverse a world riven by conflict. They lead a caravan through the Talaura Islands, seeking safety in their ancestral fortress, Beinun. The expedition involves controlling a squad of fantastic creatures in numerous battles in real time. Along the way, they must also find lost relatives to piece together their story. The player’s actions determine the survival of this group in a hostile environment.
The combat system in Wartorn is based on the interaction of the elements: fire, water, resin, plants and lightning with the environment and fighters. Water extinguishes fire but also conducts electricity to wet targets, while resin can be ignited to intensify the flame. She can also heal creatures of plant origin. Players build their forces by recruiting squads of goblins, elves and demons, each of which opens up new tactical options with unique abilities.
The combination of these warriors, their placement on the battlefield and the skillful application of their skills determine the outcome of each battle. Each playthrough offers new variables thanks to unpredictable situations and random story events on the world map. Branching paths force you to make choices that could lead to helping the caravan or its destruction. The player needs to manage critical resources such as food and hope - an indicator that decreases with losses in battle. If the spirit of the party fades, the journey will end. Finding family members grants heirlooms that unlock permanent benefits for all future runs.

Game Description Ambrosia Sky plunges into the atmosphere of a deserted colony near the rings of Saturn, where an alien fungal infection has turned human habitation into a disaster zone. After 15 years of absence, Dalia returns here, a disaster response specialist and a member of the Scarab caste - space caretakers who see off the dead on their final journey. Her task is not only to clean up the area, but also to conduct a bioremediation ritual over the bodies of the dead, such as her old friend Gerald Parker. This procedure allows the remains to be transformed into a new form of life, paying tribute to the victims of the tragedy.
The whole process takes place from the first person, and the main tool of the heroine is a multifunctional sprayer. It can be used to wash away growths, burn out dangerous spores, or apply a special foam that can conduct electricity to activate consoles and restore power supply. Ambrosia Sky combines exploring damaged corridors and reading notes with the need to solve environmental puzzles. For example, turning off gravity opens up new routes for moving around the station, and a grappling hook helps you overcome chasms and destroyed passages.
Arsenal of a bioremediation specialist:
Cleaning surfaces of fungal colonies with a powerful jet of water. Burning out particularly dangerous spores using the fire mode. Creation of conductive foam to restore power to de-energized systems. Study the behavior of different strains to create equipment improvements.
The alien fungus is not a passive contamination, but a living and aggressive threat, capable of consuming entire rooms in seconds and attacking Dahlia. Some of its species release electrical discharges, while others try to trap them. Despite the melancholy theme, the clearing experience feels intense and kinetic, requiring gamers to adapt and inventively survive.

Game Description Below the Crown takes you on a retro adventure where a deep secret lurks behind the façade of a treasure hunt. Periodic glitches on the screen interrupt the process, prompting you to take psychological tests. The answers to these questions gradually reveal the true background of the events, in the center of which is a powerful wizard, forced to go down into the dungeons. His main mission is to mine gold for the Emperor using unusual tactical skills. The project combines elements of turn-based strategy and exploration of procedurally generated locations, creating a tense atmosphere with hints of 80s science fiction.
The basis of the gameplay is a radical rethinking of chess, freed from protracted games and the need to memorize openings. The journey begins with just one piece - the mage, who, as he progresses, assembles a squad of other creatures, such as Rooks and Archers. Below the Crown makes every mission unique with ever-changing levels. The group’s combat power is enhanced by found spell cards and special abilities, for example, those that grant a shield on dark squares of the field. Successful survival and capture of enemy pieces requires both thoughtful maneuvers and the competent use of magic.
Dungeon mysteries and the will of the Emperor:
Create and share your own dungeon maps. Asynchronous challenges to compete with other strategists. Watch replays of your best playthroughs to learn tactics. Collect mysterious runes to change the difficulty of future races.

The path to the top of the financial world lies through smart investments in stocks, buying and selling entire businesses, as well as speculation in the real estate market. Every strategic decision directly affects capital growth and brings you closer to billionaire status.

In addition, in Business Simulator 2026 you need to take care of self-development, getting education for career growth and improving skills. Managing a taxi business in different cities around the world, owning restaurants and clothing stores are all part of a larger strategy. You can travel, work out at the gym, and earn passive income from bank deposits or sponsorships on social networks.
It all starts small: with only a modest start-up capital, you need to make the first and most important choice - to determine the industry for your business. This simulator offers you to go through the full cycle from renting your first apartment to owning a diversified portfolio of assets. Opening the first store, hiring employees and competent production management become the foundation for future prosperity. Timely automation of processes allows you to turn a small enterprise into a continuous source of income, laying the foundation for further expansion and transformation from a poor man to a tycoon.

Game Description Die For The Lich is a dark journey whose ultimate goal is the throne of the powerful Lich. The path to it is blocked by mythical monsters that came straight from classical folklore, among which there are Strigoi and Vetals. Each attempt to break through the darkness becomes a unique test, since death here is not the end, but only the beginning of a new, unique journey. The hero will have to rise from defeat over and over again, adapting his strategy and becoming stronger with each new cycle.
At the heart of this roguelike adventure is not a deck of cards, but a clever combination of dice with a variety of equipment. The rolls on the dice must be correctly combined with weapons and amulets in order to defeat your opponents. The arsenal ranges from rusty shovels and coffin-lid shields to ghostly sabers and durable tower shields. The Die for the Lich project offers a deep improvement system that allows you to develop your character and unlock new abilities that change battle tactics.
To manage chaos and luck, special mechanics are provided that allow you to tip the scales in your favor. For example, you can find a Lucky Die to get the desired result, or use the Fusion Table to create custom dice. The Eyepatch ability allows you to re-roll units, and the activation of the Blood Moon makes battles more difficult, but increases the reward. This combination of randomness and strategic planning turns each playthrough into a tense tactical puzzle where every roll matters.

In Donna: The Canine Quest, players take control of this particular character to fight back against the forces of evil. Armed with the family blade and awakened magical powers, she must rally the other dogs to fight the ensuing chaos. Her path runs through enchanted forests, eerie cemeteries, forgotten crypts and the fiery depths of the underworld, where danger awaits at every turn.
The source of all disasters was a once noble bull terrier named Rocco Hell’s Messenger. Succumbing to the influence of a forbidden force, he opened a portal to the other world, releasing hordes of aggressive creatures. This event plunged the peaceful settlements and ancient ruins of Barkhaven into danger, turning them into battlefields. Donna’s main goal is to confront this fallen hero and restore the broken balance, which will require her to uncover the lost secrets of her family and battle mythical monsters.

Game Description HoloSeeker is a card roguelike with RPG elements, the main goal of which is to conquer the adventure map with the help of a well-built deck. Players will have to choose one of four available characters, each of which has its own fighting style. Initially, only Usada Pekora is available, using the Carrot accumulation mechanic to gain an advantage. As you progress, other talents are unlocked: Nekomata Okayu, who relies on high evasion with low defense, Takanashi Kiara, who is able to revive after death thanks to Phoenix Feathers, as well as the FuwaMoco duo, which accumulates the Mischief Stock resource to play powerful cards.
HoloSeeker’s strategic depth is revealed through a deck-building system and randomized events that make each playthrough unique. The combat system is based on more than 100 maps, inspired by memorable scenes and quotes from virtual idol broadcasts. They feature not only cute illustrations, but also a variety of effects that allow you to create countless combinations. New cards to strengthen your deck can be purchased in the store using a special currency, HoloCoins, earned during adventures. Success directly depends on the synergy between the abilities of the selected hero and the effects of the cards.
The key to victory is the synergy of talents and cards:

Game Description In King of Bones, the main goal is to dominate prehistoric arenas in battles with realistic physics. The combat system conveys the weight and power of every encounter as all bites and strikes interact with physically simulated bodies in real time. Gamers dash, stomp and headbutt in fast-paced battles where creatures fight to the last. An attacking Triceratops can throw an enemy into the air, and small raptors can grab onto larger opponents right during a fight.
The Path to Arena Domination in King of Bones:
Physically authentic encounters that reflect the weight and strength of ancient lizards. Fight with 27 types of dinosaurs, each with their own fighting style. Several game modes, including free battles and survival. An interactive environment that can be used to your advantage.
The gameplay offers several unique modes. King of the Hill is a free-for-all deathmatch, and Ascension takes you from hatching from an egg to giant size, constantly fighting for survival. Onslaught challenges you with endless waves of enemies whose numbers are constantly growing. With 27 species, you can adapt to different fighting styles, from the tail swings of an Ankylosaurus to the powerful attacks of a Pachycephalosaurus, ensuring tactical variety.
The environment itself becomes part of the battle, allowing you to use a nearby log or bone as an improvised weapon. Hidden geysers can throw creatures into the air, changing the course of the fight. The project includes an elaborate mutilation system: flesh is torn into pieces, and bodies can be completely dismembered. For fans of observation, there is a spectator mode that allows you to set up battles between dinosaurs under AI control and follow the action while controlling the time.

Game Description Nitroglycerine! is a test where the main task is to transport a deadly substance along difficult routes. The process of controlling a heavy tractor is subject to the laws of realistic physics, and the vehicle itself is completely unsuitable for overcoming obstacles along the way. Any mistake in piloting, sharp turn or collision can lead to the detonation of nitroglycerin and instant failure of the mission. Even climbing moderately steep slopes requires precise timing, and putting too much pressure on the engine via turbocharging risks stalling the engine.
Set in a world full of despair, where every short but intense session becomes a test of strength, and successful delivery of the cargo is the only ticket to freedom. Navigation in Nitroglycerine! is carried out using a primitive map, and only 3 attempts are given for the entire journey, where gas stations act as control points.
Obstacles and dangers along the way:
Driving on dilapidated wooden bridges with the risk of collapse. Passing narrow mountain serpentines on the edge of an abyss. Maneuvering between boulders blocking the passage. Driving along cliffs crumbling under the wheels with an unstable surface. Response to sudden landslides that change the landscape. Overcoming steep slopes with the need to accurately calculate traction. Monitoring engine temperature when using turbocharging. Crossing water obstacles taking into account the inertia of heavy transport.

Game Description Surviving Mars: Relaunched invites players to lead not just a survival mission, but the process of establishing an entire civilization on a hostile planet. The key task is to form an independent Martian society, free from terrestrial influence. Through a new system called the Martian Assembly, political factions within the colony will be managed. Settlers will make their own demands and adhere to certain ideologies, which will force them to make laws and develop long-term development strategies, balancing between different interest groups. The ultimate goal of this complex social and political process is to proclaim the complete sovereignty of Mars.
Before achieving political autonomy, it is necessary to lay a solid foundation for the colony, providing it with everything necessary for existence. This complex simulation from Haemimont Games forces you to carefully plan every step, from building the first domes and setting up life support systems to exploring the secrets of the planet, including the mysterious black cubes. Managing resources such as oxygen and water is the basis of survival in the world of Surviving Mars: Relaunched. Continuous expansion of infrastructure and scientific breakthroughs are opening up new opportunities for settlement growth and stability on the Red Planet.
Stages of formation of Martian civilization:
Developing a gastronomic culture to improve the comfort and sanity of the colonists through the creation of complex dishes from new ingredients. Full automation of production using powerful machines and colossal excavators, replacing human labor at all stages. Creation of an extensive transport network using trains to transport heavy goods and personnel between remote sites. Transformation of the planetary climate and subsequent settlement of Mars by animals to create a self-sufficient biosphere.

Game Description Verho - Curse of Faces offers a brutal challenge in a world ravaged by an ancient curse. The journey begins with the choice of one of the masks, which determines the initial characteristics and sets the vector of character development. However, this class system is flexible, allowing you to invest points into any stats over time, be it Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence, creating a unique warrior. The combat system requires careful attention: each weapon, from the fast rapier to the heavy axe, has its own fighting style. Studying the habits of your opponents and using your arsenal wisely becomes the key to survival in dark dungeons filled with deadly creatures.
The action takes place in the cursed lands of Yariv, which became the source of the disaster known as the Age of Solitude. According to legend, anyone who sees someone else’s face is doomed to instant death along with what they saw. That is why masks have become not just an accessory, but the only way to survive. The Verho - Curse of Faces project is deliberately devoid of modern conveniences: there is no world map or quest log. To progress through the plot, you need to carefully listen to the few characters, memorize the routes and independently explore every corner in search of hidden passages and valuable artifacts.
The main goal of traveling around Yariv is to uncover the secret of the Curse of Faces. The hero faces a difficult choice: try to rid the world of this scourge or subjugate its dark power to his own will. The decisions made during the passage influence the fates of the characters encountered and the outcome of the entire story. Success depends on the player’s ability to piece together pieces of information found in item descriptions and ancient ruins, gradually reconstructing the full picture of the disaster that occurred and finding his own answer to the main question of this world.

The main character is a raven who is destined to become a guide to lost souls, helping them find their way to a new world. Starting his journey as a chick, he gradually turns into a mythical creature from ancient legends. Now the feathered protagonist will have to not only fulfill his destiny, but also confront the darkness that threatens all existence, and also take care of his own family.
The basis of the adventure is the exploration of a small open world, created under the influence of Scandinavian mythology. Cozy and picturesque landscapes can hide both hidden secrets and serious challenges. The VORON: Raven’s Story project implements an interesting system for learning the Language of Souls: at first, the characters' speech is incomprehensible, but as you interact with them and find stone tablets with the legends of the world, the protagonist begins to understand their stories and requests, fulfilling the last wishes of the deceased.
Laws of flight and service to souls:
Freedom in the sky is achieved through a unique control system that allows you to independently decide when to flap your wings or fold them for a dive. Collisions do not lead to death, because the raven does not have a health bar - it is always ready to rise and continue on its way. Careful exploration of the environment is rewarded by the discovery of secret places and artifacts that shed light on the history of the world. For complete immersion in the role, there is a separate button responsible for the characteristic crow cry.

Game Description Yes, My Queen is a tactical strategy game where magic and absurd tricks break the canonical rules of chess. To break free from captivity, you will have to defeat a chain of opponents in a series of fights, whose power is constantly increasing, which will require both a sharp mind and a willingness to disregard the foundations. There are over forty different cards at your disposal, the use of which can radically change the situation on the board. For example, it is allowed to initiate the launch of an intercontinental ballistic missile, organize an invasion of the dead when resurrected fighters attack everyone, or build defensive barriers to cover important sectors.
Initially, only a handful of fighters are under command, but after each victory, there is a chance to replenish your ranks, gradually amassing an impressive army. The mechanics are based on a system of continuous progression. Mana collected from attempts is spent on purchasing new cards and units, serving as permanent upgrades for future sessions. Some of the boosts received are permanently fixed and help in further progress towards the final, while the rest are canceled. This gives each new start a unique character. The final triumph will depend on the chosen approach: defeat enemies through superior intelligence or crush them with brute power.
The main task is to crush all enemy Queens who block the road to deliverance. Players will face over ten complex chess puzzles, as well as confrontation with three powerful leaders. An interesting mechanic allows you to build relationships with defeated opponents after a victory, even to the point of establishing friendly or even romantic relationships with them. As a result, each battle takes on the features of a non-linear narrative, where campaigning to attract enemy pawns to your side sometimes brings more benefits than the traditional checkmate.

The collected resources are used to strengthen the egg and improve your own abilities, allowing access to deeper and riskier areas of the dungeons, where the most valuable materials and greatest threats lie hidden.
The passage process is built on cycles of immersion and return to the surface. Drilling through the thickness of the earth, the character finds not only ore, but also hidden treasures. The resulting materials allow you to improve the drill, increase your health and load capacity. Monster encounters are small puzzles that require cleverness to overcome rather than brute force. This repeating cycle of worrying about the future and surviving in the present forms the basis of the entire adventure, making it rich and memorable.

Game Description Inn Tycoon offers relaxation. Forget about the hustle and bustle of modern life. This adventure game will take you back to simpler times, where running an inn is the main event. No stress, no deadlines, just you and your virtual business. The gameplay is focused on managing the inn. You hire staff, decorate rooms and serve clients. It’s a simple concept done with a soft touch. No complex systems or mind-blowing tasks. This adventure is for relaxation, not frustration.
Upgrades and expansions are part of the journey. As your inn grows, so does your reputation. You open new rooms, hire additional staff, and discover new ways to delight your guests. It is a gradual development that rewards patience and constant effort. Seasonal events bring life to the gameplay. These time-limited challenges offer new rewards and goals. Think of them as small bursts of excitement in the midst of normal calm. While they are not essential to the core experience, they add depth and variety. Microtransactions exist, but they are optional.
You can purchase in-game currency to speed up your progress or unlock exclusive items. However, the project remains enjoyable and without spending. It’s a matter of personal preference. Inn Tycoon is designed for a specific audience. If you’re craving fast-paced action or intense competition, look elsewhere. This adventure game is for those looking for a relaxing holiday, a digital refuge where time slows down. The charm lies in its simplicity. Watching your inn grow gives you one satisfaction after another. It’s a tranquil experience, perfect for unwinding after a long day.

Game Description Kentum is a sci-fi adventure where the death of the protagonist is only a temporary setback thanks to cloning technology. The main task is to revive civilization, relying solely on automation and our own strength. The basis for survival is the creation of a self-regulating environment, where automated mechanisms and conveyor belts turn the shelter into a full-fledged production complex. Here, coal is produced from bones and wood, and ingots are smelted from scrap metal, gradually building a complex system to provide themselves with everything they need in a world devoid of people.
It all begins with the awakening of a space scientist named Kent after 7,000 years of suspended animation. A shipwreck on a distant future Earth makes him the last of humanity. His only companion is the sarcastic AI assistant ORB, whose sharp tongue accompanies the hero on his odyssey. Together they will explore the world of Kentum, uncovering the secrets of the abandoned planet and using advanced technology to survive. Every new discovery and created object becomes a step towards restoring the lost heritage of the human race.
The post-apocalyptic Earth of the year 10,000 greets the traveler with an ever-changing climate and dangerous biomes, from mountains of garbage to jungle-overgrown ruins. Using a hoverboard and grappling hook, Kent scans unknown flora and fauna to discover new crafting recipes. Fighting evolved predators and gathering resources in harsh environments is necessary to expand your base. Improved equipment opens up access to previously inaccessible locations where even more valuable materials lurk, closing the cycle of exploration, survival and creation.

Game Description Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a tactical tennis simulator in which the outcome of the match is decided not by the speed of reaction, but by the depth of strategic planning. The gameplay is based on a turn-based system that encourages you to focus on analyzing your opponent’s playing style to gain a decisive advantage. A key mechanic is the ability to line up the perfect shot and pre-simulate its outcome before committing to the action on the court. This approach turns every play into a tense intellectual duel, where every move is calculated and the opponent’s actions are anticipated.
Victory in this project is achieved not through reflexes, but through informed decisions and the ability to read the court. You have to constantly choose between attacking into the open area and taking risky shots along the lines, which reflects the complexity of real-life sports. It is in Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics that the intellectual component of tennis is revealed, forcing you to think several moves ahead. The depth of the mechanics is manifested in many nuances that allow you to control every aspect of the fight.
Tactical superiority is the key to a winning rally:
Calculating the actions of a computer opponent who independently makes decisions about letting the ball pass. Effective use of twisted blows to neutralize the enemy’s high-speed attacks. Fine-tune the strike zone to perform technically challenging moves, including volleys.

The cause of the disaster was a mythical creature known as the Spiritual Beast, tearing their civilization apart. At the center of events is the ancestor of Greencup, who is destined to fulfill an ancient prophecy. He will become Hiertan, a cultural leader capable of uniting disparate clans to jointly confront a common threat. The hero’s path runs through a huge world full of secrets and long-gone mysteries, waiting in the wings to be revealed.
The gameplay offers a flexible combat system inspired by classic action games. Armed with a whip with the ability to attack in 8 directions, as well as a variety of auxiliary weapons, the character fights with numerous opponents. Navigating the environments in Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores requires refined platforming skills that combine precise controls with encouraging curiosity to explore. The non-linear structure of the world allows you to find hidden passages and discover new abilities that expand access to previously inaccessible areas.
The visual execution of the project is made in a nostalgic 16-bit style, creating a bright and soulful atmosphere. This is not a gloomy Metroidvania, but an adventure full of charm, with an emphasis on discovery and wonder. In addition to the main plot, for challenge lovers there are 40 optional parkour levels hidden behind special portals. These segments offer a serious test of dexterity, rewarding the most persistent.

Game Description My Little Spider invites you to fill out Bugopedia, an extensive catalog of over 50 species of insects. To find everything from the common blue blowfly to the beautiful monarch, you’ll have to keep a close eye on the in-game clock, as many species only appear at certain times. This difficult task is performed by a charming pet spider, who has taken up residence right on your desktop. He independently weaves a web and catches beetles flying by while the gamer goes about his business. However, to catch particularly rare specimens, intervention will be required, since the spider will signal for help upon noticing valuable prey.
A successful hunt is rewarded with entomological coins, which serve as local currency. The money earned is spent in the store on all kinds of improvements and decorative items. The My Little Spider project allows you to purchase fun hats, new colors, and unique web decorations such as Halloween trinkets for your companion. In addition to visual changes, practical upgrades are also available that increase the catching speed or the chance of encountering rare species of insects. An additional source of income is a variety of tasks that require you to find creatures of a certain type or size.
New areas are gradually opening up for exploration; in total, more than 5 unique travel locations are available. Each of them has its own set of inhabitants and creates a peaceful atmosphere conducive to the meditative process. This simulator is an unobtrusive adventure where the main emphasis is on collecting and quietly observing the life of a little virtual friend, who sometimes even takes breaks for a short nap, adding even more charm to what is happening.

Game Description Only Up: BRAINROT TOGETHER offers a surreal and chaotic adventure where the main goal is to climb to unimaginable heights. In this psychedelic world, the protagonist Tung Tung Sahur and his friends must reach the top, but their venture is constantly under threat. Every ledge and platform is haunted by bizarre creatures, including Bombardino Cocodrilo and Spijuniro Golubiro. These opponents turn every step into a test of strength, testing not only the coordination, but also the mental stability of the daredevils who decide to climb.
You can overcome crazy levels either alone or in a company of up to 8 people, which turns the passage into a source of collective insanity. Precision and timing are the key to success, but teamwork in Only Up: BRAINROT TOGETHER is constantly accompanied by the opportunity to push a friend into the abyss for the sake of laughter. A unique save mechanic is tied to victories over enemies: by discarding a monster from the map, you can create an “anchor point” for teleportation, securing your progress. This approach forces you to constantly balance between risk and caution.
Each jump requires careful actions, and any mistake threatens to fall back to the very beginning, causing either a fit of despair or an outburst of laughter. The atmosphere of absurdity is supported by a visual style that immerses you in acidic worlds where logic gives way to pure madness. Survival in this vertical journey depends on the ability to act coherently and readiness for the most unexpected traps placed on the path to the cherished goal.

Game Description Paracom is a tactical horror role-playing game in which managing a task force is complicated not only by encounters with monsters, but also by psychological tension within the squad. Each soldier has his own point of view and may question the commander’s orders if he considers them illogical or irrational. The anomalous zone itself is a living mind that changes its behavior in response to the actions of the players. Aggressive clearing of an area provokes hostility, while passive surveillance creates other, equally serious consequences for the mission.
Under the command of the gamer is the mobile task force Gamma Fireteam from the Seven-Headed Dragon division. The main task is to investigate a mysterious incident and search for the missing squad in a place where reality is constantly distorted. Paracom’s combat system requires a balanced approach, offering, instead of mindless shooting, pinpoint targeting at vulnerable parts of the exomorphs' body to slow them down or immobilize them. At the same time, ammunition and equipment are extremely limited, and there is no opportunity to replenish supplies, which forces you to carefully plan each shot.
Exploring locations involves solving puzzles that allow for several options, including the use of brute force, typical of special forces. Deviation from the main route is rewarded by discovering secret bosses, hidden types of enemies and additional information about the world of the project. Every decision made, from how to solve a riddle to how to react to the behavior of your allies, affects the development of the plot. This nonlinearity opens up access to one of five endings, radically changing the perception of the events that occurred during repeated playthroughs.

Game Description Reentry - An Orbital Simulator will tell about the everyday life of real astronauts participating in space programs. The game presents models of real vehicles that have ever left our planet. Having created your astronaut, manage his career and each flight.
Each completed task will bring experience. Among these there will be both operations already written into history, and fictional ones that are designed to give the player a feel for themselves in unprecedented circumstances. During the work at the orbital station, you will have to deal with equipment maintenance, repairs, and accept shuttles and capsules with parcels from Earth for docking. Each type of activity is implemented with precision down to the smallest detail. Your vessel is the most complex distillation of the best engineering solutions of recent decades, so you will need to monitor dozens of systems, toggle switches and instrument panels.
In order to properly understand the operation of the equipment, the game itself offers training at a flight school. You will be taught the principles of operation, piloting and research in airless space.
The project helps to experience an area previously inaccessible to most people. Knowing so much about humanity’s missions beyond the stratosphere, not everyone has an accurate idea of ​​what the volunteer heroes have to go through. Feel your heart skip a beat a second before liftoff at the top of the 100-meter-tall skyscraper-shaped shuttle. Witness the exit to escape speed 1 with the roar of engines carrying thousands of tons of metal skyward. Try to keep your cool in a dangerous situation where you have to interact with a huge dashboard to resolve it.

Game Description Session Notes: Route 404, a first-person psychological survival horror game, follows the story of a former bus steward. His attempt to return to normal life turns into a nightmare journey, where the line between reality and illusion is erased forever. The protagonist will have to fulfill his direct responsibilities: serve passengers, solve their problems and monitor the condition of transport. However, every action takes place under the yoke of the past, because the trauma experienced constantly distorts the perception of the world around us, turning an ordinary trip into a surreal thriller with several possible endings.
At the center of the story is a man striving to recover from a terrible accident that has changed him forever. The decision to hit the trail again was a chance for him to start over and find peace. But it is this trip in Session Notes: Route 404 that becomes a trap for his consciousness. Instead of the long-awaited healing, the hero faces inner demons and dark memories that take on physical embodiment. The atmosphere of oppressive tension is enhanced by mysterious events and oppressive soundtrack, forcing you to doubt what is happening.
Signs of impending madness:
Sudden shutdown of lighting in the bus interior for no apparent reason. An overly intent and anxious gaze from one of the passengers. Strange sounds from the luggage compartment, awakening forgotten memories. A constant feeling of an invisible presence that can appear anywhere.

The only island of relative safety in a city engulfed in chaos is the DOM bus. This mobile base not only serves as a means of navigating dangerous streets, but also as a workshop for upgrading your equipment. Inside it, you can modify your character and save valuable loot collected during forays. DOM is key to survival in a world where every shadow lurks a threat from the mutated monsters that infest the ruins.

Each foray into Skopje ‘83 represents an attempt to move forward in the investigation of the mysterious conspiracy that has shrouded the city. After each death, the world is transformed: enemies appear in new places, and the location of resources changes. This forces you to constantly adapt tactics and explore altered routes, leading to different challenges and new pieces of the intricate story.
Confronting hordes of grotesque mutants combines intense first-person shooting and close combat. Collecting resources allows you to create and improve weapons using blueprints that are saved between attempts. The narrative unfolds through the environment, gradually plunging into a world of retro-futuristic science and occult deals. Teaming up with other survivors not only increases your chances of success, but also opens up new depths to the unfolding chaos and main story.

Game Description Tiny Auto Knights is a deep tactical challenge where the main goal is to survive for as many rounds as possible. The key to success is the ability to assemble a combat-ready team, wisely combining the unique effects of more than 50 available characters. The key mechanic is the merging of identical fighters, which allows you to raise them to level 3 and mark them with a gold star. Such a boost radically changes the balance of power on the battlefield, opening up access to new synergies and strategic opportunities to defeat opponents in automatic battles.
All confrontations take place in an asynchronous format, pitting assembled squads against teams previously created by other strategists. Effective management of gold as the main resource is necessary for the timely replenishment of the army with new warriors. The variety of tactics in Tiny Auto Knights is provided by a variety of classes, including elven healers, gnome warriors, wizards and even lizard spies. It is the thoughtful combination of these diverse units that determines the winner in intense battles, where every decision has long-term consequences for the entire campaign.
What decides the outcome of an asynchronous battle:
Timely unification of warriors to achieve maximum power level 3. Rational distribution of gold for the acquisition and renewal of fighters in the squad. Finding the most effective synergies between characters of different classes. Placing units on the field based on their unique skills and roles.

Game Description Bloodgrounds is a tactical roguelike where every battle in the arena could be the gladiator’s last. Turn-based battles take place on a grid map, requiring the commander to wisely spend action points on movement and attacks. Using class abilities, setting traps, and using consumable items such as potions or scrolls becomes the key to survival. After defeating an enemy fighter, you have to make a choice: show mercy by adding a new warrior to your squad, or execute him for the amusement of a bloodthirsty public, receiving more generous rewards in return.
All this cruelty serves one purpose - revenge. The main character, a wealthy patron, is obsessed with the desire to punish Emperor Dammas II, who is responsible for the death of his father and the loss of his youth. Each victory on the sands of the arena brings him closer to the capital, where the tyrant has settled down. In the Bloodgrounds project, progress through the plot is inextricably linked to the expansion of the team of gladiators with physical, magical or shooting talents. The path to justice lies through a series of brutal tournaments, where the defeat of one fighter means his irrevocable loss.
Outside of the arena, gameplay centers on managing the coastal town of Marevento. Between battles, you need to invest the gold you earn in the construction and improvement of buildings. The infirmary allows you to restore the wounded, the market allows you to trade equipment, and special buildings provide access to new mechanics. You can make deals with crime lords to sabotage your opponents or make offerings to the gods, hoping for their divine intervention in future battles. The preparation of the squad, including training and equipment, is a key element on the path to overthrowing the emperor.

The reason for the cordon is the search for a mysterious secret object, turning gray everyday life into an intense struggle for survival. The mournful wail of a siren and the hermetically sealed doors of residential cells now foreshadow not just another shift, but an unknown filled with total control and suspicion. Each event calls into question the inviolability of the established order.
Before this incident, the life of the protagonist, a simple resident of a giant concrete structure, proceeded according to a strict schedule. Seven shifts at the machine in exchange for a bowl of concentrate and the imaginary approval of the party constituted the whole raison d’être of his existence. The narrative in Choice of Life: Samosbor suggests finding a way out of this vicious circle, where every decision made can lead to unpredictable consequences. The branched plot forces you to constantly make choices that determine the future fate of not only the main character, but also those around him in this dystopian world.

Any action irreversibly affects the development of a nonlinear story. The unique universe of Gigakhrushchevka lives by its own harsh rules. Descent into the mysterious mines will require courage and a faithful sword, because not only treasures await there, but also various challenges. It is in such forays that one can discover rare materials necessary to create unique items that can transform a personal farmstead and attract the attention of amazing creatures to it. Interaction with local inhabitants allows you to reveal the secrets of this world.
The main task at the alien ranch is to create ideal conditions for bizarre creatures known as Critterlings. To attract them to Cosmic Coop, you will have to decorate your property by placing buildings, ornaments and special objects that will interest curious creatures. Each species has unique needs, and only after those needs are met will the creature decide to stay. However, not all creatures get along with each other, which requires careful planning of their placement to maintain harmony. Among them are Flufflets - charming fluffy and jumping creatures that spend most of their time eating.
The foundation for the prosperity of the alien farm is the cultivation of exotic plants. The harvested crop becomes a versatile resource: it can be eaten, sold at the local market, or used as food for the Critterlings. The proceeds are reinvested in the purchase of new seeds and improvement of tools, which opens up access to further development of the farm and crafting. The first steps in this matter are helped by Fenna, who on the very first day gives the initial task of planting ten seedlings, introducing the basics of agriculture.

The storyline, spanning a prologue and several epilogues, challenges gamers to survive under harsh corporate oppression. The main gameplay comes down to the exploration of asteroid fields, where not only courage is required, but also extreme caution to successfully extract resources. Every decision made directly affects the further development of events and the ability to secure a decent future for oneself. You will have to either follow the strict rules of the company, or take fate into your own hands by challenging the system. Success depends on competent management of the ship and its equipment.
The project offers extensive opportunities to upgrade your vessel and select the best tools for the task at hand. It’s important to remember that in the world of Deep Space Exploitation, everything has a price, and every upgrade requires a balanced approach. The gameplay is based on two-dimensional physics with a completely destructible environment, which makes collisions and explosions especially spectacular. The visual style is made in deliberately rough pixel graphics, emphasizing the harsh atmosphere of what is happening. All interaction with finances, equipment and tasks is carried out through a single terminal, simplifying management between flights.
The harsh everyday life of a space miner:
Carefully extract valuable resources from dangerous asteroid fields. Upgrade the ship and select the optimal equipment for each mission. Making difficult decisions that determine the relationship with the corporation and the ending of the story.

Game Description Dinocop is a detective adventure that takes you deep into the investigation of a dinosaur rights convention held at the Cretaceous Hotel. An anonymous denunciation was received about serving illegal human flesh to guests, and now the first lizard policeman in history will have to get to the bottom of the truth. Armed with a magnifying glass to search for clues and relying on the dinosaur’s keen senses, the protagonist interviews witnesses and explores the environment. You’ll even have to knock over a trash can to examine its contents and find out that one of the suspects is only feasting on mammoth meat. The real culprit is still hiding somewhere in the building and needs to be found.
What awaits history’s first raptor detective:
Conducting interrogations of colorful hotel guests. Thorough inspection of locations in search of important clues. Exposing a conspiracy involving the serving of prohibited meat. Confronting prejudices in the world of intelligent lizards and people. Making decisions that influence the further course of the investigation.
Events take place in a world where humans coexist with intelligent dinosaurs, which gives rise to many social conflicts. It was under such conditions that a specially designed raptor detective was created, because no other lizard wanted to become an officer. While solving the case of the mysterious meat in the Dinocop project, the hero and his human partner named Mark are faced with manifestations of racism and class inequality. The narrative with elements of black comedy allows you to look at serious problems from an absurd angle, offering to determine the course of the investigation through the choice of questions and promising leads.
