Each encounter with these enemies is a puzzle that requires careful planning and adaptation to constantly changing battle conditions. The hero will have to overcome the consequences of a curse imposed by carelessly drinking a potion from a mysterious wizard.
The protagonist is the legendary Witch Dog, who is half dog and half witch. The gameplay of DOG WITCH is based on short but intense races, where to win you need to effectively combine rolls of magic dice with spell cards from your personal deck. The basis for achieving success is experimentation and the search for powerful synergies between the objects found. The character’s appearance can be customized in detail, allowing you to change the color of the coat, headdress and even voice.
Magic dog’s arsenal:
Each dice roll directly affects the power of your spells, allowing you access to devastating combinations. A collection of over 150 artifacts and their corrupted counterparts allows you to create unique builds with increased power and risk. Summoning unusual allies, including laser ponies and skeleton assistants, can turn the tide of the most difficult battle. Various magic hats radically change the style of play, offering new challenges and forcing you to look for non-standard tactics.

Game Description Egging On is a brutal test where every wrong move sends the fragile egg-shaped protagonist back to where he started. There’s no save system, making vertical climbing a tense test of precision and patience. To achieve the cherished freedom, you have to perfectly master difficult physics, feeling every vibration and roll of your fragile shell. Success depends on the ability to synchronize the rotation with the jump to achieve maximum height, because any mistake threatens to fall and the need to start all over again.
Running the coop is just the first step in a long journey. The route takes you through a variety of themed locations, including a farm store, a dangerous factory and a kitchen, each filled with interactive elements. The environment actively opposes progress, putting ominous chainsaws and hostile roosters in the way. To add variety to this challenging gameplay, the world of Egging On offers over 60 unique customization skins. Some of them are purely decorative, while others are capable of changing aspects of the gameplay.
Among the many unlockable items, there are also special ones created in collaboration with other projects. For example, secret seekers might discover the Don’t Starve-inspired Tallbird shell, or the Inscryption-inspired Raven shell. Additional motivation comes from stamps hidden throughout the levels, the collection of which gives access to special rewards at the top. This encourages you to explore every corner of carefully crafted locations, constantly remembering the high cost of a single carelessness.

Successful growth in Electronics Store Simulator also means hiring qualified staff who can provide first-class service. To stay ahead of your competitors, you need to purchase licenses for exclusive products, turning your store into the main place for all connoisseurs of advanced technologies and gadgets.
In addition to strategic planning, gameplay includes many practical tasks that shape the owner’s daily routine. Through the in-game computer, new batches of goods are ordered, which then need to be unpacked and carefully placed on the shelves. An important part of the work is the repair shop, where it is necessary to diagnose faults and restore broken customer equipment. To move around the city and solve logistics issues, you have a personal car at your disposal, which adds realism to the process.

Game Description Jitter is a sci-fi simulator that immerses you in the dark atmosphere of the consequences of a catastrophe in the Main Asteroid Belt. A once-bustling mining colony lies in ruins after a mysterious incident, and the truth behind what happened must be uncovered in the rubble. The danger comes not only from the destroyed environment, but also from pirates or even unknown life forms lurking in the shadows. To survive and complete the mission, you must carefully explore abandoned mines, colossal cave systems and remote outposts scattered across the surface of a giant asteroid.
All control is entrusted to the artificial intelligence of the spaceship, whose main program prescribes the search and rescue of survivors. Although the storyline is linear, Project Jitter offers significant freedom in achieving your goals. For example, to destroy an enemy outpost, you can use brute force by firing at it from guns, carry out a tactical operation to capture it from the inside, or use cunning by destroying a nearby asteroid and allowing its debris to pierce the station’s hull, causing depressurization.
To successfully complete missions, it is necessary to constantly modify the ship, adding or discarding modules to adapt to a combat situation or for a quick retreat. Deep simulation of on-board systems forces constant monitoring of oxygen generation, energy distribution and damage repair. An important role in the gameplay is played by the crew, consisting of characters with unique backstories and abilities that influence the style of play. Combat seamlessly switches between strategic battles in outer space and tactical action on deck when boarding enemy ships.

Game Description Majogami is a fast-paced 2D adventure in which players hack their way through a nightmarish world using unique abilities for instant movement and attacks. The main character, armed with the Kamikiri katana, is able to quickly close the distance with enemies, cutting them into pieces thanks to the Setsuna mechanics. The same ability is used to overcome obstacles and evade enemy attacks, turning every collision into a swift dance of blades. The heroine will be confronted by powerful witches known as Majogami, who hold the bizarre reality in their power.
The events take place in Orchesgra, a world of illusions made in the dark style of paper art. This world is ruled by Craft Witches, whose twisted desires and powerful magic gave birth to all its inhabitants and dangers. The journey of a young swordswoman named Shiroha aims not only to escape from this captivity, but also to restore lost memories. She is accompanied on this difficult journey by Shiori, her father, transformed into a piece of paper, who provides support with the help of protective symbols. The gameplay of Majogami is closely related to the gradual revelation of the past of the protagonist and her companion.
Speed ​​and a sharp blade alone are not enough to survive in Orchesgra. Meeting guardians called Astrals along the way, Shiroha gains the ability to transform into new combat forms, which significantly expands her arsenal of techniques. By defeating the Craft Witches, she not only gets closer to freedom, but also collects special Recarte cards that contain fragments of her past. It is through defeating these powerful creatures and restoring memory that the story of the relationship between father and daughter, trapped in a paper nightmare, is revealed.

Game Description My Little Puppy is a touching tale of devotion set in an unusual afterlife. The protagonist will have to cross vast deserts, snow-capped mountain plateaus and deserted meadows, overcoming challenges that combine elements of adventure, racing and action. At the center of this emotional story is a Welsh Corgi named Bong-gu, who escaped from dog paradise for one single purpose - to find his owner. This journey will take him through worlds teetering on the brink of life and death, where every corner looks both familiar and alien, creating a unique atmosphere.
Motivated by the familiar scent of his human, who has just entered another world, the dog immediately sets off in search of him. His odyssey takes him through various planes of existence, including a bright canine paradise marked by a yellow glow and a gray purgatory. The concept of My Little Puppy is based on the touching belief that pets are the first to meet their people after death. Bong-gu, the once abandoned and ill elder dog who has found a loving family, now strives to be reunited with her again, repeating the miracle of their first meeting.
Control of the four-legged character is based on the realistic behavior of a dog. Smell, barking and running are the main tools for interacting with the environment, but their possibilities are not unlimited. To overcome difficulties, the corgi will have to communicate with other dogs, each of whom is patiently waiting for his person and is ready to share a unique story. Helping others brings Bong-gu closer to a touching ending—a meeting for which he risked absolutely everything. Interaction with the inhabitants of the afterlife becomes the key to advancing the plot of this soulful project.

Game Description Service with a Shotgun plunges you into an absurd reality where retail rules apply even during a zombie apocalypse. The main task becomes not only survival among the hordes of the undead, but also high-quality service to the eccentric customers lining up at the half-empty shelves. While the living dead are wandering outside the window, a real drama is unfolding inside the store: you need to speak quickly, shoot accurately and build defensive structures in order to survive the next work shift. This crazy balance between running a business and shooting zombies creates a unique atmosphere of dark humor and constant tension, turning the end of the world into the worst day in the service industry.
The protagonist is given the unenviable role of the last roadside store manager on the planet, forced to maintain a flickering “Open” sign. Service With a Shotgun’s visual novel narrative is intertwined with the intense shooting of incoming waves of enemies. The entire gameplay is divided into five story chapters, where each subsequent shift increases the chaos, throwing up new challenges and unexpected turns. As you progress, the madness only grows, forcing you to simultaneously deal with the requests of customers and fight off the attacks of the hungry dead, who are also not averse to looking at the light.
Each chapter introduces new characters, the total number of which exceeds ten colorful personalities. From quirky regulars to desperate survivors, these encounters make every visit to the store completely unpredictable. It’s the dialogue and interactions with these crazy customers that reveal a satirical look at capitalism that refuses to die even when everyone around it is long dead. In this world, the apocalypse does not wait, but buyers, as we know, do not like to wait, demanding attention here and now.

Game Description Star Ores Inc. — a journey into the depths of space, where you will take control of an abandoned station, turning it into the center of a mining empire. Located in the middle of an asteroid field, this complex becomes the starting point for the career of an intergalactic entrepreneur. The initial steps involve manual work, using a high-tech laser drill to cut through the asteroids yourself to extract valuable minerals. The entire process is presented from a first-person perspective, which contributes to complete immersion in the atmosphere of loneliness and discovery among the silent expanses of space, concealing not only resources, but also long-forgotten secrets.
Manual labor is gradually giving way to strategic management and automation. The main task is to create an effective network of robotic assistants that will take over all operational processes. At Star Ores Inc. These mechanisms are engaged in drilling, transporting the extracted materials and their subsequent sale to clients from all over the galaxy. The goal is to establish a smooth pipeline from the extraction of raw materials to maximum profit, turning an abandoned outpost into a thriving enterprise and establishing itself as an industry legend.
Stages of the revival of the space complex:
Eliminating alien growths to gain access to new sectors and reactivating old terminals. Placement of automatic drills on 9 large ore veins for a constant flow of resources. Game Description Syberia - Remastered offers an adventure in the punk watch world. The player takes on the role of Kate Walker, a New York lawyer. Her initial assignment: selling a factory in a remote village in the French Alps. This mundane affair quickly turns into an unexpected journey through the snowy landscapes of Eastern Europe, where Kate travels with Oscar, a special machine gun.
The central plot of Syberia - Remastered revolves around the pursuit of Hans Voralberg, an inventor with an unconventional goal. Voralberg seeks to discover the last living mammoths on the mythical island of Siberia; this desire propels the narrative. Kate and Oscar explore many forgotten locations, from Valadilen to the frozen outskirts of Eastern Russia. This project reveals an environment where complex mechanical structures are combined with elements of fantasy.
This version, a re-release of the 2002 original, provides an updated experience. Characters and locations from the original project received a comprehensive visual overhaul; their appearance is changed within the environment. Each location has been rebuilt with attention to detail, maintaining the author’s unique visual style, allowing for a deeper immersion in the artistic universe.
The gameplay has also received significant adjustments. Puzzles have been redesigned to make them easier to interact with, and their mechanics have been adapted to provide more direct solutions to problems that reveal the secrets of Voralberg’s genius. The controls and interface have been modernized, making it easier to navigate the world and offering smoother controls that meet modern standards. This adventure game focuses on a rich story while maintaining its contemplative core.

Game Description The Last Caretaker is a story of survival in a world where hostile mechanisms and a constant lack of resources force you to act methodically. The gameplay is based on the exploration of abandoned structures towering over the endless ocean. Each rusty tower or silent dock becomes a source of valuable materials obtained by dismantling the remains of a former civilization. Not only tools and weapons are created from the recovered scrap, but also complex energy networks. Laying cables and providing power to ancient machines is a vital task, without which it is impossible to move forward and open locked doors.
The main character is a robot who wakes up completely alone on a flooded planet. On his mechanical shoulders rests the colossal responsibility of saving the remnants of humanity. The main mission in The Last Caretaker is to carefully nurture the last human seeds located in a special Lazarus complex. Incubation temperature, nutrient flow, and memory integration must be carefully monitored to ensure a future for a species that is nearly extinct.
Navigation through the post-apocalyptic waters is carried out by boat, which opens access to new locations and secrets of the past. While exploring the ruins, the protagonist gradually reconstructs the picture of the disaster that occurred. The ultimate goal is not just survival, but the restoration of the launch infrastructure. This is the only way to send the precious cargo - new life - to the stars, giving it another chance to exist far from the lost world.

Share the fun of the search with a friend or family member in local co-op mode on the same screen. Enjoy going at your own pace with soothing music without any external pressure or punishment.

Game Description Whiskerwood is a city-building simulator where industrious mice have to found a colony under the yoke of feline overlords. Space on the islands is limited, so the development of the settlement is directed not only in breadth, but also deep into the rocks and up to the skies. Verticality becomes a key element, forcing the construction of complex networks of conveyors, elevators and pipelines to transport resources and provide residents with everything they need. Mouse ingenuity allows you to create complex production chains and automated systems, turning a modest shelter into a thriving metropolis.
Each settler has unique traits and belongs to one of the guilds, which affects his productivity in different areas. In the world of Whiskerwood, you constantly have to make a choice: meekly comply with the growing demands of the cat masters, erecting statues for them to increase labor efficiency at the cost of morality, or take the path of resistance. You can establish trade relations with other factions of rodents and even pirates to gain independence. The final decision will determine the fate of the entire colony, which will either have to serve forever or raise its mustache in defiance.
Testaments of the founder of the mouse colony:
Take into account the vagaries of the weather, from storms to frosts that can destroy the crop. Distribute tasks to settlers, taking into account their talents and guild affiliation. Change the landscape to optimize construction or use natural reliefs for your needs. Maintain a balance between meeting the basic needs of mice and following the orders of the cat masters. Develop technology in research laboratories to discover new buildings and production methods.

Game Description Dead Static Drive is a constantly collapsing apocalyptic world. Someone is always chasing the hero, and dangerous and creepy monsters begin to crawl out of the ground. You can continue to run from them, or turn around and fight back. A variety of weapons, from chainsaws to guns, and other survivors will help you with this. But you should be careful, because not all people you meet will be good. Sometimes, it is humanity that will pose a greater threat than underground monsters.
To survive in “Dead Static Drive” you will need to rummage through trash and abandoned buildings, trying to find at least some useful resources. Food and water will be the first priority, although weapons and medical supplies will also help. It will be difficult to stay on your feet for a long time, so there are various vehicles in the game. From vans to muscle cars, they will significantly speed up your movement and give you an extra chance of survival. But the gasoline here is not endless, which means you won’t be able to run away from problems forever. You can refuel at a gas station, but it’s not a fact that there will be enough fuel for everyone. To save your life you will have to steal, deceive and constantly fight with monsters and other people. The world is extremely cruel, and only the strongest will survive.

Game Description Deadcam is a psychological horror game where the feeling of fear is fueled by the ability to see yourself through the eyes of a ruthless stalker. The main character finds himself locked within the walls of an abandoned rural house along with Margot, a former film crew colleague who has turned into a deadly threat. Her head-mounted camera continues to work, broadcasting in real time her distorted face and every step that brings her closer to her victim. The TV show producer escaped, tightly sealing the exit and dooming the protagonist to survive in a confined space with the monster.
The basis of the gameplay is stealth, because every creak of the floorboards can give away the location and attract the attention of an unpredictable monster. However, hiding all the time will not work, since to escape you need to find a hammer that can break the lock. The Deadcam project forces you to constantly move around the house, leaving temporary shelters and risking everything for the chance to escape. This whole nightmare was the result of a desperate attempt to film a new episode for a failed ghost hunting show. The only ally in this creepy place is a raccoon, whose mysterious clues point the way to salvation.
Notes left on the walls of the house:
Any careless sound attracts her attention. The tablet shows a live feed from her camera. The receiver helps determine its location with a light pulse. Trust the raccoon - he knows more than he seems.

Game Description Dice Dice Baby is a gambling roguelike where the main goal is to deceive the casino using special dice. To beat the establishment, you have to not just rely on luck, but actively change the rules in your favor. Dozens of types of special dice with unique properties and more than 100 amulets that provide access to dishonest strategies and the creation of powerful builds help with this.
The basis for victory is the synergies that are activated when collecting several bones of the same type or shape. For example, a set of six Hot Dice dice adds a permanent multiplier to each point scored. The Dice Dice Baby project offers dice in a variety of configurations, from D4 to D20, and some of them, like Holo dice, provide triple the results if they are not part of a standard set.
Each round consists of several rolls, during which you need to record the required values ​​​​and send them to the bank for scoring. For unused attempts and successful completion of the stage, currency is awarded. The coins you earn are spent in the store to purchase new dice, board upgrades, and useful amulets that enhance your chosen tactics.
The passage is based on randomly generated races, which ensures high replayability. With each round, the target score set by the house becomes higher, forcing you to constantly improve your build. Lucky Charms add further variety by providing passive bonuses and opening up new ways to crush the casino at one of three difficulty levels.

Game Description Eventide Matter is a 2D adventure where the survival of civilization depends on the construction of an interdimensional portal. The unknown continuum into which the protagonist finds himself turns out to be a hostile environment. Local crystalline life forms perceive the newcomer as an invader and attack without hesitation, trying to destroy any of his creations. As the pilot of the ship, Vanguard Unit 4 will have to operate under constant threat. A huge responsibility falls on our shoulders, because our native universe is inexorably fading, and every second of delay brings its final collapse closer, leaving no chance of salvation.
The main task is to build a complex engineering structure - the Phase Gate, the only way to evacuate the remnants of their people. The assembly process requires the sequential creation of many intricate layers of structure. The Eventide Matter project forces you to constantly balance between construction and defense from unforgiving opponents. To create a portal, you must master the extraction of six unique types of materials and their subsequent processing into high-tech components necessary to continue the mission. Progress opens up access to new opportunities, allowing you to more effectively counter threats and speed up construction.
Technologies for survival in an alien world:
Exploration of an extensive technology tree with dozens of permanent improvements for the ship. Unlock and strengthen about 10 types of modules, including lasers, tractor beams and drones. Use powerful energy shields to increase survivability in battle. Create advanced components from mined exotic resources to assemble the portal.

Game Description Foolish Mortals is an adventure in which the search for the treasure of the Belmore estate turns into a real race with a hostile phantom. The main character, young treasure hunter Murphy McCallan, will not only have to outrun an evil spirit, but also unravel the mystery of a wedding party that disappeared decades ago. To do this, he collects ingredients according to a list from an ancient voodoo manuscript, shoots from the cannons of an abandoned fort, and even survives being buried alive. All these trials lead to the unraveling of a terrible secret connecting wealth and missing people.
The action takes place on the fog-shrouded island of Devil’s Rock, where each location holds its own mysteries. Foolish Mortals' journey takes you through more than 70 hand-painted scenes, from the creaking docks of Dednettle to the dark halls of an ancient French-Caribbean fortress. The gameplay follows the canons of classic quests with an inventory of over 100 items to collect and combine. The atmosphere is enhanced by over 30 fully voiced characters and two hours of original music.
Treasure Hunter Route:
Exploring the abandoned river boat Spirit of the Queen, which became a haven for voodoo practices. A visit to the gloomy St. Juniper Parish Cemetery in search of clues. Infiltrating a closed club of sea captains to obtain valuable information. Descent to the bottom of the wishing well in the hope of finding the key to the main secret of the estate.

Game Description Generation Exile offers an atypical take on the city-building simulation genre. Instead of developing new territories and endless mining, we have to find a balance in a closed system. Progress is to create closed cycles where biological waste is transformed into nutrients or raw materials for bioplastics using anaerobic reactors. Each step in this step-by-step project requires careful planning of resources, since they cannot be replenished from the outside, and the goal is sustainability, not endless growth. The gameplay is completely devoid of combat encounters, concentrating on survival and cooperation.
Events unfold on board the last generation ship, which is on the verge of collapse. Management is carried out not on behalf of a nameless overseer, but through an avatar - a specific person with his own history and reputation. Relationships with other procedurally generated characters in Generation Exile directly depend on the decisions made, affecting both the state of the ship and the psychological climate in society. The Ark itself, with its fragile biomes, serves as a metaphor for a planet with limited supplies, scaling global problems down to the human level.
Ark Recovery Protocols:
The construction of any building requires available workers and sufficient energy. The expansion of the zone of influence occurs through the Signal network, which determines the radius for the placement of key objects. Life support systems require clean water and recycling waste to produce new materials. All story events and personalities on board are procedurally generated, creating a unique survival story.

Game Description PLAGUN – The Plague Goes On is a dark world of a fallen kingdom, destroyed by a failed immortality vaccine and turned into an arena for survival. Instead of healing, civilization received an endless plague that gave birth to regenerating horrors. In this setting, a former doctor, now a monster in a mask, will have to fight back the endless hordes of the infected. His task is not just to survive, but also to uncover the dark secret behind the disaster that destroyed everything around him. Each foray becomes a step towards understanding the causes of global decay and betrayal.
Cursed masks in the form of animal skulls not only change characteristics, but also impart passive abilities, radically influencing the style of play. The arsenal is represented by biomechanical weapons that fire plague-infected projectiles with a variety of effects. The gameplay of PLAGUN – The Plague Goes On is built around short but intense sessions, each lasting no more than 20 minutes. Progression between runs is achieved by collecting the remains of defeated enemies, allowing you to unlock new gear and meta upgrades for future attempts.
This action game combines elements of intense platforming and bullet-hell mechanics with automatic shooting. The visual style emphasizes the oppressive atmosphere with pixelated graphics and a limited color palette of black, white, red and sickly green. The history of the fallen world is presented in fragments, through the environment and mysterious records, gradually emerging into a single picture. Survival in such conditions requires sharp reflexes and the ability to quickly adapt to constantly changing threats, including bosses with personal ties to the protagonist’s past.

Game Description Second Sun is a journey through a picturesque world created in an impressionistic style. Here, vast open spaces juxtapose with procedurally generated dungeons to ensure that every encounter is unique. Enemy placements, loot caches, and important locations are also generated randomly, forcing constant adaptation. The main goal is to return the fading light of the Good Sun, because it is for the sake of saving these beautiful but devastated lands that the struggle is being waged.
The cause of the decline was a protracted civil war that brought the Empire to the brink of complete destruction. The only hope for salvation is the Sunborn, a gifted warrior tasked with protecting the remnants of the state. When confronting the Order of the Second Sun, he must rely on speed and skill. Second Sun’s combat system requires the protagonist to be constantly on the move, tactically using class skills to exterminate enemies who pursue him without stopping. Each victory brings valuable resources needed to improve equipment and character development.
Ways to become a defender of the Empire:
Careful customization of appearance and choice of combat class. Collecting trophies for subsequent equipment upgrades. Explore a vast world map in search of valuable items. Clearing randomly generated dungeons from hostile forces. Develop unique abilities to gain an advantage in battle.

Game Description Starlit Stories is a unique space for creativity, completely free from any restrictions and haste. In this simulator, there is no need for resource management or meeting strict deadlines, thanks to which all gameplay concentrates solely on creation. To the sounds of soothing melodies, the player will have to build the campsite of his dreams, thinking through every detail and customizing the environment to his own taste. The process of construction and customization becomes a form of meditation, allowing you to liberate your imagination and create a unique sanctuary filled with harmony. This is the ideal environment for those seeking respite from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
As the camp develops, it ceases to be just a collection of objects and takes on a life of its own. Your quiet haven is beginning to be visited by travelers whose routes intersect here. Their constant movement, comings and goings fill the location with the feeling of a lived-in and cozy place. Watching these guests in Starlit Stories becomes an integral part of the experience, turning a static picture into a living, breathing world. Thus, the space you create becomes not only a reflection of creativity, but also a real point of attraction for virtual wanderers.
The Art of Creating a Tranquil Refuge:
Construction and detailed setup of your dream camp. Complete freedom from management tasks and time constraints. Watching the wanderers bringing the created world to life. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility accompanied by soothing music.

Game Description Strange Seed is a project where survival depends not so much on reflexes, but on thoughtful mutation. Fighting enemies, including ferocious Soulslike bosses, requires creating a creature with the optimal set of body parts for a given situation. Victory is achieved not by brute force, but by a competent selection of evolutionary improvements, turning each battle into a tactical puzzle. Sophisticated strategies allow you to find vulnerabilities in even the most formidable creatures, opening up opportunities for unconventional victories.
At the center of the story is a modest clot that fell from an unusual tree and has a unique gift. This protagonist is able to absorb the DNA of defeated enemies, allowing access to their body parts for his own transformation. Strange Seed’s gameplay allows you to freely experiment with combinations using 7 modification slots. It is possible to create a hybrid from elements of mammals, birds, insects and even dinosaurs, aiming for the perfect balance between powerful attack and speed to chase prey.
Exploring the world is an integral part of the process, encouraging curiosity. The journey will take the hero through more than 10 unique biomes, from dense forests and sandy beaches to city ruins and the red-hot heart of a volcano. Each location is full of secrets and poses its own challenges, which you have to adapt to solve. For example, by growing wings to cross chasms or shrinking in size to penetrate narrow passages, hidden paths can be discovered.

Game Description The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike is a tactical project that allows you to control three unique characters with dissimilar fighting styles. The legendary killer Akira masterfully wields both firearms and melee weapons in close combat. His partner Yoko prefers surprise attacks from the shadows and high mobility to deceive opponents. A cold-blooded killer named Suzuki relies on cunning traps and weakening techniques to offer a completely different approach to combat.
The basis of the battles is to compose your own manga page from randomly dropped panels. Each action, be it attack, defense or movement, is presented in the form of a separate illustration. By placing these fragments on a blank sheet of paper, gamers form a sequence of attacks that are activated in the order they are read. In The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike, the damage taken literally tears through the paper, leaving holes and thereby limiting the space for further maneuvers.
In addition to intense turn-based encounters, the title offers surreal mini-events where you can earn powerful panels for your deck.
Pages from a mercenary’s diary:
Each turn begins with receiving a random set of panels to fill the page. Brilliant marksman Akira, his agile partner Yoko, and trap specialist Suzuki each have unique fighting styles. The damage taken literally punches holes in the sheet, blocking new actions from being placed in those zones. Between battles, you can take part in mini-competitions based on scenes from the original manga.

Game Description Tower Lords is a strategic project in which the player will take on the role of a defender of the lands from the forces of the Dark Lord. The basis of the gameplay is the construction and gradual improvement of your own tower, which serves as the main stronghold in the fight against advancing enemies. To repel the attacks of the titans and other minions of evil, it is necessary to form an army, freeing the souls of various races, such as elves, gnomes and orcs. Each victory allows you not only to expand your possessions, but also to challenge the power of the antagonist.
Using the power of your dragon, you have to clear six powerful towers located in different lands. Countering enemy waves, which only become stronger over time, requires competent resource management and constant strengthening of your troops. Tower Lords has a prestige system: after resetting progress, new powerful perks are unlocked, significantly accelerating further development and allowing you to advance faster. This mechanism encourages multiple playthroughs, offering new tactical options.
Management and development aspects:
Construction of new buildings using collected resources. Liberating intelligent races from the influence of the Dark Lord to replenish the army. Capturing enemy towers to open access to new units and buildings. The final confrontation with the main antagonist for the fate of the world.
The project combines elements of incremental development and strategic planning. The visual and sound design create a special atmosphere, immersing you in a fantasy world where every decision affects the outcome of the battle. The ultimate goal is to create the greatest lord tower, capable of withstanding the onslaught of the enemy and ending his dominance.

Game Description Snowfall’s Mystery plunges into the mind of a student computer programmer named Elliot, who encounters a mysterious program during the cold winter of 1999. An ordinary floppy disk received from a friend becomes the source of inexplicable events when the Snowfall messenger contained on it begins a dialogue. The program demonstrates a frightening awareness of the hero’s inner world, and the mysterious Administrator gets in touch, pursuing unknown goals. The protagonist will have to figure out what is happening, coping with long-standing mental disorders in the atmosphere of technological melancholy of the late 20th century.
Dreaming of creating a robot assistant to combat loneliness, Elliot finds himself drawn into a philosophical journey. The narrative of Snowfall’s Mystery presents gamers with difficult moral dilemmas, asking them to make choices at key points. Each decision made directly affects the development of the plot, leading to one of two possible endings. This psychological adventure is designed in a minimalist two-color pixel style, enhancing the sense of anxiety and mystery that envelops the events happening to the character. There is additional depth hidden beyond the main plot.
Archive of forgotten memories and evidence:
A cassette demo of a song called Constellation. Transcript of a news broadcast about mysterious events. Autumn video made by Elliot himself. Photo of a character named Charlotte. A medical document that sheds light on the hero’s condition. Personnel file of an employee named Irwin. Fragments of correspondence between characters in another messenger.

Game Description SPARTA 2035 plunges you into a brutal conflict in East Africa, where a squad of mercenaries, consisting of ordinary people with their own weaknesses and dreams, will have to defend the civilian population. They will be opposed by the extremist group Damat, which has established a brutal order. The basis of tactical confrontation is a system with two action points, allowing fighters to move and attack within the same turn. The combat system has a high level of lethality, as both allies and enemies can be destroyed with one precise burst from the flank, which forces you to carefully plan every move.
The ability to take up positions on the roofs of buildings and jump from them opens up scope for vertical gameplay, and the system of shelters, divided into full and partial ones, plays a decisive role in survival. The SPARTA 2035 project implements a mechanic in which each bullet is calculated separately, creating the possibility of accidentally hitting another fighter or an environmental object if it misses. Cone observation mode allows you to effectively control firing sectors. The environment at the locations is actively being destroyed, changing the tactical situation and forcing you to constantly adapt your strategy to new conditions.
Outside of battles, you need to manage your base, purchase equipment, and develop your squad on the global map. The story campaign consists of more than 20 hand-crafted missions with unique visual design and detailed objectives. Their passage is complemented by a large number of generated tasks, providing high replayability. The variety of tactical situations is achieved through advanced artificial intelligence of opponents, a variety of behavioral patterns and elements of randomness, which makes each encounter unpredictable and truly unique.

Game Description Tavern Keeper is a management simulator that dives into the intricacies of running a fantasy tavern. Here every little thing matters, from simulating the temperature and spoilage of food in the cellar to the likelihood of a fire from a spark from the fireplace. The success of an establishment directly depends on the ability to cope with such situations, be it a sudden illness of a cleaner or furniture breakdown in the middle of the evening. Staff management and proper distribution of responsibilities become key to meeting the needs of the most whimsical visitors.
The journey begins with a modest establishment on the outskirts of the kingdom, which will be transformed into a thriving business. As Tavern Keeper grows, new opportunities open up: expanding the menu with original dishes and drinks, arranging additional rooms and offering unique services to attract a more demanding clientele. This project offers not just an economic strategy, but a full-fledged creative process where you can design and decorate the tavern of your dreams from scratch. The story campaign introduces unusual characters, including skeletons in an existential crisis and werewolves suffering from impostor syndrome.
Notes from a zealous innkeeper:
Keep your furniture clean and in good condition to maintain your reputation. Hire staff with different personality traits for effective management. Expand the range of dishes and drinks to attract new guests. Be prepared for unexpected events that require immediate attention.

Characters can be bought and sold in the jewelry store, and collecting identical gems significantly enhances their characteristics, opening up powerful combinations for tactical automatic battles.
Tactical depth is achieved through competent resource management and detailed customization of fighters. In Vivid World, each squad member is equipped with special Orbs, and additional upgrades are acquired through the use of stickers and perfumes. Strengthening the bonds between heroes opens up access to unique joint skills that can turn the tide of the most difficult battle. You can explore the intricate labyrinths either alone or in co-op mode, joining forces with a friend to reveal all the secrets of this bizarre world with a bright pop style.

Collecting fighters with the same symbol will activate powerful group boosts. Combining different types of gems unlocks unique abilities. Combining duplicates of one hero greatly increases his personal power. Using Support Gems during auto-combat allows you to strategically influence the battle.

However, success in the races is only part of the global struggle for market dominance. Competitors are actively fighting for control of resource-rich territories and key cities. Providing production capacity with raw materials by capturing mines and factories on the world map becomes a primary task for any aspiring industrialist.
This expansion is fueled by its core business of creating and growing an automobile company from scratch at the dawn of the 20th century. Car Factory Empire’s gameplay revolves around a detailed design process. Gamers have access to over 100 technologies and more than 10 body types to create their first, often primitive, models. Profits from sales are reinvested in scientific research, paving the way for more advanced and competitive machines that can win customer recognition.
Management goes beyond the design bureau. In the administrative building, decisions regarding personnel and control of production chains are made. The strategic choice is to focus either on the mass production of affordable cars, or on the creation of exclusive and prestigious models. The ultimate goal is to achieve a dominant position in the market while avoiding bankruptcy.
Stages of becoming a car tycoon:
Explore over 100 technologies to improve your design. Establishing production processes at our own factories. Seizing control over raw material bases on the global map. The struggle for influence in the largest cities with competitors.

Game Description Mall Simulator is a test of management skills where maintaining financial balance is the key to prosperity. To prevent bankruptcy, it is necessary to be sensitive to consumer trends and set thoughtful prices for goods. The satisfaction of each visitor becomes a paramount task, the solution of which directly affects the success of the entire enterprise. You have to constantly monitor the assortment, enter into partnerships with famous brands and decorate the space, creating the ideal atmosphere for shopping.
The monumental goal of transforming a modest shopping center into a giant urban mall is achieved through physical expansion. By breaking through walls, you open up new areas for future shops and restaurants. Development in Mall Simulator starts small, gradually allowing you to open a variety of retail outlets, from grocery stores to luxury jewelry boutiques. Every decision about the design and placement of new departments determines how attractive the complex will be to hundreds of potential buyers willing to spend their money.

The feeling of non-stop action is enhanced by an energetic heavy metal soundtrack. The invasion of otherworldly forces using magic has brought humanity to the brink of complete enslavement. The responsibility for saving civilization falls on the shoulders of the commander leading the resistance forces. Opponents masquerading as gods are ravaging the lands in pursuit of their dark goals. In Slaves of Magic you will have to sabotage their operations and fight back against previously unseen creatures who wield false divine magic. Overconfidence here is a direct path to the death of units, so each battle requires a balanced approach.
Laws of survival in the new world:
It is necessary to maintain morale and hope in the surviving settlements. It is required to systematically expand influence, establishing new bases of resistance. Researching technologies to gain superiority is key. It is important to competently lead the troops in order to save the lives of soldiers for future battles.

Game Description The Remains and The Residue is a psychological adventure where the line between fiction and reality is rapidly thinning. The story begins in a quiet room, where the flickering TV screen and the creaking of the door create an oppressive feeling of constant surveillance. The protagonist will have to immerse himself in fragmentary stories, putting together a complete picture from fragments of someone else’s past. Here every detail matters, and fictional worlds begin to dangerously leak into reality, forcing you to doubt what is happening. This linear story invites you to relive someone else’s memories, which may not be what they seem at first glance.
The central figure of the plot is the famous writer Janus Brennhart, giving an interview after the release of his latest book. It is this conversation that becomes the catalyst that sends him on a journey through the back streets of his own memory, to events that he himself can no longer remember. The Remains and The Residue explores these memories from a first-person perspective, solving puzzles and progressing through the story. The retro style of the visual design only enhances the disturbing and mysterious atmosphere that accompanies the hero throughout his journey into himself.
What the pages of manuscripts hide:
Exploration of various locations born from the imagination and memory of the writer. Solving logical problems necessary to restore the integrity of the narrative. Immersion in a disturbing atmosphere where fiction is indistinguishable from reality. Experiencing events containing scenes of violence and self-harm.

This project invites you to immerse yourself in a world where running a business brings joy, not stress. The gameplay requires maintaining perfect cleanliness in the workplace and dexterity in performing every action, because the reputation of the cafe and the mood of its unique visitors depend on this.

grab and throw opponents to cause damage; reflect enemy shells, returning them to the sender; initiate chain reactions by detonating fuel cells scattered throughout the level; use ice asteroids to create fragmentation fields; use biological objects, such as bags of larvae, for tactical purposes.

The main task for the protagonist named Syrup is to significantly enrich the assortment of her confectionery shop Atelier Sweets. To do this, you need to travel, collecting rare components from all over the world. Defeating magical opponents provides access to unique ingredients needed to create new treats. At the same time, the manufactured confectionery products serve not only as a commodity, but also as a powerful aid in battles, providing characters with various enhancements and even the opportunity to fully recuperate after difficult clashes with enemies.
Narration Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG is a direct continuation of the story, previously presented in a visual novel format, but now with a full-fledged role-playing system. The main character will have to go on a great journey in the company of faithful companions, including assistant Pastille and the revived candy golem Lollipop. Exploring the world and interacting with the six recruitable characters opens up new storylines. To successfully advance and reveal the secrets of the world beyond Atelier Sweets, the gamer will have to:
master more than 60 recipes for unique confectionery products. defeat many unusual enemies and powerful bosses. carry out various tasks to expand your business.

Game Description Testimonium plunges into a chilling story, the starting point of which is a mysterious package left at the front door. Inside the package, only an old video cassette is found without any identification marks, with the exception of a mysterious symbol burned into the body. The absence of the sender and the ominous discovery create an immediate sense of unease, which is heightened by the visual style, which is deliberately aged and reminiscent of ’90s-era video footage. The whole atmosphere is permeated with a feeling of the unknown, making you doubt the safety of what is happening and whether you should give in to curiosity.
The main task is to review the found film, which turns this short experimental project into a real test for the psyche. Testimonium takes about 15 minutes to complete, but during this time you will encounter a series of disturbing images and solve several puzzles in order to get to the bottom of the frightening message. This psychological horror forces you to act against your instinct of self-preservation, because the only way to understand what is happening is to press play and face what is hidden behind the analogue noise.
What does the mysterious videotape hide?
An oppressive atmosphere built on the expectation of the unknown. Visual style inspired by the aesthetics of analogue recordings. Intellectual riddles woven into the narrative. A short but concentrated immersion into the world of psychological horror.

The goal is to strategically place otherworldly entities to intimidate mortal inhabitants. Success requires solving intricate puzzles that reveal deep secrets of the story. The player controls his ethereal powers to complete tasks throughout the city. This involves planning each event to maximize fear and progress through the main plot with multiple scenarios depending on the decisions made.
The strategic gameplay in Ghost Master: Resurrection is based on resource management and the use of a variety of ghostly creatures. The project allows you to summon howling banshees and cunning gremlins, each of which has unique abilities for different situations. The combination of the powers of various spirits creates complex chains of events designed to drive mortals out of each location. This requires an assessment of the environment and its inhabitants to develop effective intimidation tactics.
Careful planning is key as the decisions made influence the direction of each mission. The game’s campaign takes place across 11 different locations in Gravenville, including a mental hospital, a military base, and student dormitories. Each environment offers unique challenges and opportunities for ghostly manipulation. The title combines supernatural horror themes with elements of black comedy to create a special atmosphere. Individual adventures are combined into a single virtual world, and progress through it depends on solving puzzles within a coherent narrative.

Game Description Leaf it Alone is a simulator where completely clearing each individual area of ​​the yard is rewarded with permanent upgrades, such as running faster or being able to tie bags faster. The arsenal for tidying up includes a rake and a powerful blower, as well as the ability to collect leaves manually. It’s especially fun to work with the rake, which allows you to pull down large piles in one smooth motion thanks to the sticking effect at high pumping levels. The cleaning process is also speeded up by ventilation holes that automatically suck in nearby leaves. The ultimate goal of all efforts is to open access to a secret room, which serves as a kind of finale.
The main gameplay loop is based on collecting fallen leaves, for which coins are awarded when they are disposed of in a trash can. These funds are invested in upgrading tools, increasing their power or range, as well as purchasing bags with larger capacities. Leaf it Alone offers a balanced progression that avoids the feeling of monotony. The action takes place on a single, but detailed level, including a house with front and back yards, a swimming pool and a greenhouse. For convenience, there is a function to highlight foliage only in the current area.
In addition to cleaning, the title offers to find eight trading cards with funny illustrations, which are stored in a special magazine. To obtain all achievements, you will need at least two playthroughs, one of which is a speed run with the task of completing it in 40 minutes. After completing the main part, you can continue exploring the location to collect the remaining items and complete side objectives. This simulator creates a cozy and relaxing atmosphere, supported by pleasant visual style and the meditative process of putting things in order in the autumn garden, giving deep satisfaction from the work done.

Game Description Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection collects key games from the series' inception, presented as they appeared in arcades and on home consoles. This collection contains the original arcade releases and a carefully selected selection of home system adaptations from the 1990s. The gamer selects a character from a list of fighters, each of whom is based on digitized live actors - a technique that set the initial visual style of the project.
Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection’s gameplay focuses on one-on-one combat, with fighters using a combination of standard attacks and unique moves. These dark fantasy clashes often culminate in scenes that eliminate the opponent from the tournament. Online multiplayer allows for competitive matches supported by rollback code designed to maintain input accuracy over long distances. The title includes the ability to make all hidden characters available from the start, bypassing traditional unlocking requirements.
This option extends to the developer menu, providing access to game settings that are usually inaccessible to the user. After winning a match, the player has the opportunity to perform signature finishing moves on their immobilized opponent, an element of the combat system that contributed to the fighting game’s notoriety. The interactive documentary mode provides a historical account of the creation of the series and its impact on public opinion about video games. This mode features new video interviews with the original writing team, sharing insights into the creation process and audience reaction. The title provides access to a gallery of rare concept art, vintage marketing materials and archival video clips from the era.

Death here is just an annoying obstacle on the path to universal adoration and glory.

Gamers will have to choose one of several gladiators, each of which has a unique progression system and set of abilities. As part of the Nuclear Gladiators 3000 project, they will have to face endless waves of disgusting mutants, rebels and other champions of the show. Each run allows you to improve your arsenal and skills, and between battles permanent power-ups are unlocked, increasing your chances of success in subsequent attempts to survive this bloody show.
The path to fame lies through completing special tasks that increase fame and provide access to exclusive bonuses. Fights take place in stylized pixel arenas, where you need to destroy hordes of enemies and dodge hundreds of projectiles. Each stage culminates in intense battles with powerful bosses guarding valuable rewards. Short and intense sessions require the fighter to constantly adapt, selecting new equipment and weapons to effectively destroy opponents and win the love of the audience.

Game Description Silver Bullet is an arcade shooting gallery in which the protagonist will have to clear static screens from numerous waves of enemies. The famous monster hunter Van Helsing falls under the control of the gamer, who will have to go through 12 levels. The gameplay requires precise actions, since simultaneous movement and firing are not provided. To survive, you must constantly evade threats and choose the right position to attack. Resistance to evil spirits includes not only shooting, but also the ability to parry enemy attacks in a static position. The visual design combines detailed pixel graphics and a vibrant color palette. The gothic adventure atmosphere is complemented by a synth-pop soundtrack, creating a nostalgic feeling.
The plot takes the hero on a journey around the world to save puppies kidnapped by a vampire named Reggie. He will be opposed by ghouls, ghosts and other creatures of darkness. The route takes you through a variety of locations, including haunted mansions, carnivals and cemeteries, where Silver Bullet offers unique challenges. To effectively combat opponents, an improvement system is provided, and progress is tracked in online record tables.
Progression and unlockable items:
Collect gold coins hidden throughout the levels to purchase power-ups in the store. Discover secrets and complete tests to gain access to new weapons. Accumulate currency to unlock additional puzzle mode Terror Blocks. Summon your loyal dog Silver to attack enemies and receive bonus items.

Game Description Slot and Dungeons is an unusual roguelike, where each expedition into the depths of mysterious ruins begins by chance. The location of all opponents and valuable finds on the floor is determined by the mechanics of the slot machine, which is activated upon entry. This turns each playthrough into a unique challenge, forcing you to constantly adapt your tactics to the given level configuration. Survival depends on the ability to wisely manage resources that appear on the map in a random order. The hero will have to explore the flooded temple of a once great civilization, making his way through randomly generated halls.
Success in Slot and Dungeons is directly related to collecting special symbols that represent enemies and items. It is these symbols that replenish the reels of the slot machine, influencing future layouts. The combat system is built on risk: when colliding with an enemy, both receive damage, which requires a balanced approach to each movement. The character can be developed, improving its characteristics after gaining a new level, and special skills with cooldown allow you to dominate the battlefield if used at the right time. Advancing deeper into the dungeons opens up access to new challenges and powerful bosses.
Secrets of the sunken temple:
The rotation of the reels determines the composition and placement of enemies on each floor. The collection of symbols forms a pool of possible rewards and dangers. Mutual damage on contact forces you to carefully plan your movement. Defeating all monsters opens the way to the next level. The hero’s unique abilities add tactical variety to battles.

Game Description Vanguard Galaxy is a space sandbox where you will explore a procedurally generated world after a risky jump of 25,000 light years. The journey ends in the Canis Major Dwarf Galaxy, a once quiet corner of space that has become the scene of a clash between corporate interests and the local population. Here, a mysterious employer introduces the protagonist to a new reality, full of intrigue and conspiracies, offering to join one of the factions or remain neutral.
Pilots will have to forge their own path, choosing from a variety of styles. The gameplay of Vanguard Galaxy allows you to engage in trade, looking for profitable routes, or fight with opponents using a wide arsenal of weapons. In addition, it is possible to extract resources from the surface of asteroids and collect the wreckage of abandoned ships for subsequent processing into valuable materials.
Progress is achieved through the purchase and improvement of new ships, whose range ranges from small miners to large destroyers. Captain development occurs through the discovery of abilities in several skill trees, and a hired crew with different professions provides passive bonuses. Modules found or created from recycled resources allow you to strengthen your fleet for the exploration of distant sectors of space.
The galaxy is filled with dynamic NPC captains that you can form alliances with, fight with, or avoid. The world reacts to the player’s actions, building a unique storyline as you explore systems and complete a variety of missions. To automate routine tasks, the ECHO autopilot system is provided, capable of independently performing basic operations with minimal intervention.

Game Description Dark Moon is about a near and bleak future. This time, things have become very bad for humanity, not thanks to aliens or nuclear war, but because of the Sun. A storm is raging on the star, which has disabled all equipment on Earth and provoked unrest there. On the Moon, things are even worse: the sun’s rays destroy any objects on the earth’s satellite that they manage to reach.
In Dark Moon, gamers control a group of astronaut explorers. People need to survive and restore contact with their home planet. In this real-time strategy game you have to hide from dangerous natural light in the dark. Therefore, users have a mobile base. Initially, users receive several survivors and a giant Mechaplex moon rover. You can build buildings on its roof. It is allowed to redistribute energy and personnel within buildings. Drones are used to extract resources and conduct field reconnaissance. Found minerals are needed to improve the moving station.
Players periodically encounter other survivors. They can be taken on board a huge arachnid transport or abandoned to their fate. Each person has valuable skills, but takes up scarce space and requires food. In addition, there is always the possibility of betrayal. The crew can judge or support gamers' decisions, as well as have positive or negative attitudes toward specific crew members. Tensions often rise between astronauts. If the intensity of passions is too high, a riot will occur. The need to constantly make choices with not always obvious consequences, as well as various events, make this project replayable.

Game Description Drop Dead The Cabin is a co-op shooter with horror and roguelike elements, in which players will have to survive a night in an abandoned cabin in the forest. Set in a 1980s horror film setting, two lost travelers find a hideout formerly owned by a mad scientist named Doctor Monday. His monstrous experiments have created hordes of the undead, which the brave survivors must face.
Gameplay focuses on working together to defend against waves of zombies and complete various tasks to escape. To survive, you must constantly maintain electricity, search for fuel for the generator and fight off constantly arriving enemies. The heroes have a variety of weapons in their arsenal: from revolvers and knives to baseball bats, but ammunition is strictly limited, and melee weapons have a margin of safety. A successful confrontation requires coordinated actions and competent distribution of resources between participants.
Roguelike elements make every playthrough of Drop Dead: The Cabin unique. Key items, targets, and enemy spawn locations are constantly changing, forcing players to adapt their tactics and re-explore the environment. The project is available both in standard PC mode and using virtual reality technologies, providing maximum immersion in what is happening. The ability to choose between single and co-op modes allows you to experience this nightmare both in the company of a friend and on your own.

Game Description Earth vs Mars is a turn-based tactical struggle for the survival of the planet, where bizarre genetic engineering becomes humanity’s main trump card. To repel the alien threat, earthly commanders use not only standard army units, but also unique hybrid super-soldiers. The creation of these creatures occurs using a special Splice-O-Tron device, which allows volunteers to be crossed with representatives of the fauna. As a result of such experiments, swift cheetah flies appear on the battlefield, capable of spraying acid on the enemy from the air, or crushing human-rhino hybrids that break through enemy defenses.
This unusual army will be confronted by high-tech forces of invaders. The Martians use flying saucers, gravity tanks, and elite warriors who have spent years perfecting their martial arts in battle. Battles take place on a variety of maps, where tactical advantage is achieved through the intelligent use of each unit’s unique abilities and terrain features. As the conflict in Earth vs Mars progresses, the enemy also evolves, bringing new threats into the fray, including a living organic weapon known as The Creep.
The story campaign offers over 30 hand-crafted missions to complete, revealing the story of the invasion. The Martian aggression is explained by their long-standing interest in terrestrial life forms, whose atomic extract they used for their own purposes long before the start of a full-scale war. In addition to the single-player mode, the project provides the opportunity to fight with other commanders in online battles of the 1 on 1 format, where you can lead both the forces of Earth and the army of Martian invaders. A mode against artificial intelligence and an editor for creating custom maps are also available.

Game Description Mindscorn immerses you in the oppressive atmosphere of psychological horror, where every decision has weight. Limited ammunition turns any skirmish into a serious test, because each cartridge must be loaded into the weapon manually, counting down precious seconds. Strange creatures living in the dark corridors of the hotel tirelessly pursue their prey, ready to tear it into pieces at the slightest mistake. Survival here directly depends not on accuracy, but on the ability to hide, run away and open fire only in the most extreme cases, when there is no other choice left, and resource management becomes the key to life.
Rules of the deadly game in the cursed hotel:
Stealth and flight are the main tools for saving lives. Manually reloading a weapon makes you appreciate every shot fired. Unforgiving opponents, from whom it is easier to run away than to engage in battle.
The scene for these events is the notorious Royal Veil Hotel, shrouded in the mystery of the unexplained disappearances of many people. The investigation into this mysterious case came to a standstill after even the police officers sent there disappeared, which only strengthened the notoriety of this place. Mindscorn stars Oswald Wiebe, a disgraced journalist who has lost his job and family in his endless pursuit of fame and approval. He sees revealing the hotel’s secret as his last chance to get his life back on track, forcing himself to face not only external threats, but also the demons of his own past.

Game Description Truth Universally Acknowledged is a short dating sim where players experience a few days in the life of a typical high school student. The main character is a young man named Talai, whose daily life is filled with study and communication with friends. The narrative revolves around non-linear choices that determine which of four potential partners the protagonist will become romantically involved with. The key feature of the project is the decision-making mechanics: instead of standard text lines, you need to choose Talai’s facial expressions and emotions. The further development of events and the final ending of the story depend on this.
The action takes place in a quirky high school setting. In Truth Universally Acknowledged, Talay’s social circle includes four very different characters, each with a unique personality. Among them are the cheerful best friend Mii, who has extraordinary culinary talents, and the mysterious Courtney, who can always be found in the same place in the library. Also, the hero’s attention can be attracted by the shy and caring Keith or a charming celebrity named August, for whom Talay has a secret sympathy.
The project offers high replayability due to many plot branches and several endings. For convenient navigation through all available branches of the narrative, a special tree diagram is provided, which allows you to return to key points in the story at any time and explore alternative scenarios. Immersion in the world of school everyday life is facilitated by a completely original visual design, as well as a specially written musical and sound accompaniment that creates a light and romantic mood.

Game Description 1998 The Toll Keeper Story - a simulator in which every day at the workplace turns into a test of the strength of moral principles. As Devi, a pregnant toll checkpoint guard, you must make life-changing decisions that determine who gets to travel further and who gets left behind. Document checks and vehicle inspections take place against the backdrop of general chaos engulfing the fictional country of Janapa. Society collapses under the yoke of a financial crisis, protests erupt in the streets, and trust in government evaporates, turning routine work into a series of moral dilemmas.
Every missed or stopped car directly affects not only strangers, but also the safety of Devi’s family and her unborn child. The intense atmosphere of 1998: The Toll Keeper Story is supported by a unique visual style. Using dotted textures and a blue-dominated old paper aesthetic, the graphics intentionally emulate ’90s print materials, allowing for a deeper dive into the unsettling environment of the time. Every decision you make has dire consequences in a world where survival requires unimaginable sacrifices.
The narrative poses difficult questions about duty, humanity and motherhood in the face of national catastrophe. Friendship, ideology and love become central themes in Devi’s journey as she tries to maintain hope for her family’s future in the midst of a crumbling world. Managing limited resources and ever-increasing tension forces you to balance compassion with the need to follow corrupt rules in order to obtain vital supplies.

Society collapses under the yoke of a financial crisis, protests erupt in the streets, and trust in government evaporates, turning routine work into a series of moral dilemmas.

Game Description As Long As You’re Here is a narrative adventure in which the world around the main character constantly and subtly changes, creating a feeling of disorientation. The blurring of boundaries between past and present is a central element through which the vulnerability of an elderly woman named Annie, who suffers from Alzheimer’s disease, is conveyed. Delving into her mind from a first-person perspective, the participants share her doubts and feelings of social isolation. The plot reveals a complex family drama in which Annie and her children are forced to switch roles as caregivers after she moves away from her home.
As her children disagree over how best to manage their care, Annie’s mind begins to resurface with long-forgotten images of her late brother. The exploration of her life occurs through interaction with letters, dialogues and memorabilia that gradually clarify the tense relationships within the family. As Long As You’re Here is a sensitive reflection on the topic of living with dementia, telling a story of regret and difficult family ties. The atmosphere of what is happening is enhanced by immersive sound and original music.
This title offers a short but action-packed personal experience based on true stories. The developers from Autoscopia Interactive set out to place the gamer in a role that is rarely covered in the media space, allowing one to look at the world from an unusual perspective. The whole process of unpacking things in a new place turns into a metaphorical trip down memory lane, where fragments of memories from the past seep into the present, forcing us to relive key moments in the life of Annie and her loved ones.

Mastering three different biomes: from sterile scientific compartments to surreal Forests and Backstage. Opening access to eight unique species of rats, differing not only in appearance, but also in potential capabilities. Overcoming five successive phases of the experiment, where the complexity of the labyrinths and the deadly traps increase with each stage.

Game Description Death By Scrolling sends you on a continuous vertical sprint through the bureaucratic expanses of Purgatory. The gamer chooses a hero to fight with the creatures of the underworld and collect gold against the backdrop of an inexorably moving upward screen. The main task is to collect 10,000 coins necessary for the Ferryman to cross to the afterlife. Fiery doom awaits at the bottom edge, and the Grim Reaper pursues relentlessly, remaining out of frame. This mechanic ensures that time is never on the player’s side.
Each hero in Death By Scrolling has a unique set of skills and perks, giving you access to a variety of survival strategies. During the climb, the collected gems and coins serve as currency for transactions with merchants who appear mid-run. These merchants offer power-ups and special improvements to make your journey easier. The Reaper, who is always nearby, cannot be defeated in open battle; this entity must be temporarily stunned or actively avoided in order to continue moving upward towards the final goal.
Once you reach the top of a level, you can gain access to bonus runs and side quests that promise additional rewards. The path to the top is blocked by hellish pests and demonic bosses, making it difficult to constantly move towards the goal. To record your gaming progress in Purgatory, there is a leaderboard that documents the achievements of all trapped souls and ranks them for comparison. The final measure of success is paying the required tribute and crossing the river before the character is overtaken by the pursuer.

Game Description Master of Command is a project in which command of the armies of the Seven Years' War is presented as a harsh struggle for survival. Resource management is becoming as important as tactical superiority on the battlefield. A commander on a procedurally generated map hidden in the fog of war is constantly faced with a dilemma: make a rapid forced march, risking running out of supplies, or make a stop to replenish supplies, giving the enemy precious time to regroup. Every decision made directly affects the morale and combat effectiveness of soldiers.
More than 150 historically recreated units belonging to five leading European powers: Prussia, Austria, Russia, Great Britain and France are available to form a powerful military force. Both elite units, such as the Prussian Death’s Head Hussars or the British Highland Grenadiers, as well as less expensive but numerous troops, such as Russian recruits, can be called up under the banners. In Master of Command, the army is created in accordance with the military doctrine of the chosen faction, which allows you to rely either on discipline and training, or on numerical superiority.
The ultimate goal of each unpredictable campaign is to locate and then destroy the main enemy camp. The path to victory runs through tactical battles, where any loss is felt. On the map there are villages, convoys and fields of past battles, promising the opportunity to replenish the treasury and recruit new soldiers, but these same locations can turn out to be deadly traps. The combination of roguelike elements and classic strategy provides high replay value, forcing gamers to constantly adapt their approach to warfare with each new playthrough.

In the cramped corridors of underwater research stations, a desperate struggle for survival unfolds. Ammunition is running low, and you have to confront not only the ruthless mercenaries of the Omnium corporation, but also the nightmarish Lovecraftian creatures that have awakened in the Arctic abyss. Every shadow lurks a threat, and the hero’s sanity is constantly tested by supernatural visions and attacks on his mind.
The driving force for Noah in this hell is not just the instinct of self-preservation, but a desperate race against time to save the life of his own daughter. This personal mission forces him to make his way deeper into the flooded complexes, where every step could be his last. Project Beneath forces you to carefully manage scarce resources, using not only an arsenal of upgradeable weapons, but also elements of the environment to eliminate opponents. Combat in confined spaces requires tactical thinking as enemies, be they humans or monsters, act with maximum aggression.
Unraveling the dark secret of the Omnium corporation occurs gradually, through the study of evidence scattered throughout the stations: emails, PDA entries and testimonies of other survivors. By piecing together pieces of information, the protagonist comes closer to understanding the true scale of the conspiracy that threatens all of humanity. He will have to find out what ancient evil was disturbed at the bottom of the ocean and stop it before the abyss swallows everything.

Each battle becomes a test not only of strategic thinking, but also of moral principles, because to gain strength you have to experiment with living beings.
Events take place in a mysterious location known as the Abyss - a gigantic crater that promises untold riches to those who dare to reach its bottom. Descending deeper, adventurers encounter increasingly strange and dangerous inhabitants. The world of Decktamer is procedurally generated, making each new dive into the Abyss different from the last, offering fresh challenges and opportunities. In turn-based battles, each creature in the squad acts independently, which requires the gamer to carefully plan their moves.
The art of survival in the Abyss:
Capture hostile creatures to replenish your deck. Permanent death of allies killed in battle. Transferring unique skills to create powerful hybrids. Exploring procedurally generated levels.
The main dilemma becomes the choice between destroying the enemy and taming him. The decision to tame a monster turns it into a loyal ally, but the cost of a mistake is high. The loss of any creature in battle is irreversible - the card disappears from the deck forever, which forces you to weigh every step and take care of the safety of key fighters on your team.

Collaboration and communication via built-in chat help you find solutions faster and open locked doors. This powerful tool allows gamers to create their own unique challenges by constructing multi-level rooms and filling them with complex mechanisms.
At launch, the title offers three unique sets of rooms, each of which includes four levels. Adventurers will have to uncover the secrets of Dracula’s castle, try to save the Starship EOS research ship and find ancient treasures on the pirate island. Although the atmosphere of the project has become darker and more mysterious, it is not horror and does not contain frightening elements. Each location is filled with hidden secrets and additional tasks, encouraging careful exploration of every corner.
