Game Description MotionRec follows the journey of a robot named Rec as he explores a destroyed world. The main task of this mechanical protagonist is to restore records of a lost civilization. Moving through the levels is carried out using a unique ability that allows you to record the trajectory of your own movements, and then play them back to overcome obstacles. This mechanic opens up space for creative puzzle solving, because you can record both a regular walk or jump, and more complex sequences of actions using environmental elements.
The gameplay is based on solving spatial problems. To reach inaccessible platforms or cross wide chasms, you must first record the desired trajectory in a safe area, and then activate it in the right place. Reproducing movements allows the hero to literally float through the air, defying gravity. However, the number of replays in flight is limited and is only replenished after landing on a solid surface, which adds an element of strategic planning to MotionRec’s gameplay.
The world that Rek explores is filled not only with secrets, but also with dangers. After the disappearance of organic life, the planet was taken over by other machines, and now they pose a threat to the little robot archivist. Overcoming levels, gamers will have to be smart to avoid traps and hostile mechanisms. Visually, the project is made in the style of pixel graphics, emphasizing the atmosphere of desolation and retrofuturism.

Game Description İblis3:Phenomena is a first-person psychological horror that follows the investigation of a journalist who arrives in an abandoned Turkish village. His goal is to explore a mysterious house that has become the epicenter of paranormal activity. The events of the project are inspired by a real incident that occurred in 1994, and focus on slowly building horror. There are no complex puzzles or fast-paced battles here, as the focus is on creating an oppressive and realistic environment that keeps you in constant suspense. Every detail of the setting and sound enhances the feeling of anxiety.
At the center of the story is the tragic story of a young woman named Suna. Forced into marriage against her will at the insistence of her father, she comes to the grave of her late mother in despair. In a fit of grief, Suna unknowingly wishes for her mother to attend the wedding. It is this fatal desire that sets off a chain of terrifying consequences that are to be explored in İblis3:Phenomena. The project methodically reveals the details of this drama, making you feel the hopelessness and fear that the heroine faced many years ago.
The gameplay is based on exploring locations, where the frightening realism of the environment is combined with sudden sounds and light anomalies. Traveling around the house and its surroundings becomes a real test for the psyche. All elements are aimed at making you doubt the reality of what is happening and gradually reveal the truth about what happened after Suna’s careless wish. The challenge is to piece together the pieces of the tragedy and discover whether supernatural forces really exist or are just a figment of the imagination provoked by an old story of grief and loss.

Game Description 9 Souls takes you on an atmospheric journey on the edge between madness and reality, where every step requires utmost care. The gameplay is based on constant choice: in each section, three paths open to the protagonist, but only one of them is free from anomalies. The slightest details in the environment, barely noticeable distortions of familiar objects, become the key to advancement. The right decision saves the lost soul, bringing it closer to the solution, but the price of a mistake is immersion in even greater chaos and uncertainty, forcing you to doubt your own perception.
The story begins with an awakening after a car accident, which itself raises doubts about its reality. The world around you seems familiar, but this is a deceptive feeling, as the rooms begin to repeat themselves, creating the feeling of an endless labyrinth. The narrative in 9 Souls is built on fragments received from saved souls. Their whispers gradually form a single picture of what happened, causing the shadows of the protagonist’s own guilt to appear more and more clearly. With each correct choice, the feeling of the fundamental wrongness of what is happening only intensifies, and reality is distorted more and more.
Ultimately, he will have to face the faces of those whom the hero considered long lost. This psychological horror film offers no definitive answers, leaving the ending open to interpretation. Pieces of the puzzle put together may never form a complete picture, leaving one to wonder whether the truth was ever achievable. The oppressive atmosphere and constant tension force you to explore not only distorted locations, but also the depths of your own subconscious, where the frightening truth is hidden.

Game Description Death Frame is a psychological horror game in which the protagonist, the estranged child of a notorious serial killer, returns to the mansion he inherited. Inside the dilapidated walls of this estate are hidden paintings that can draw the hero into surreal worlds, woven from fragments of memories and nightmares. Each dive reveals new details about the father’s madness, shedding light on the fate of his victims and, perhaps, on the protagonist’s own bloody legacy.
Exploring an abandoned mansion reveals its dark secrets. During the passage, three diaries are discovered: one contains a cold-blooded list of victims, another contains the suicide notes of the prisoner, and the third contains the confused thoughts of a mind consumed by madness. Each document found becomes a piece of the puzzle, bringing us closer to the solution. In the Death Frame project, reality is distorted with every step, and behind the walls of the house something lurks, watching and waiting in the wings.
Edges of the Mad Mind:
Journey through six vast abstract worlds that are the visual embodiment of the killer’s mind. Collect clues and pieces of history from diaries hidden in the secret rooms of the mansion. Solve environmental puzzles in each surreal dimension. Uncovering secret passages and shortcuts to navigate the labyrinthine estate.
Each level offers unique mechanics: some worlds focus on platforming, others force you to solve puzzles, and others feature segments where you need to make quick decisions. Moving deeper, the hero is faced with a growing madness that permeates both the surreal worlds inside the paintings and the mansion itself.

Game Description MISERY throws up to 15 players into a cooperative survival scenario in a nuclear disaster zone. The characters take on the roles of PMCs guarding a research institute in the Republic of Zaslavie before the conflict escalated into nuclear war. A siren sounds, signaling an incoming bomb and providing a 60-second window to grab supplies before retreating to the bunker. After the strike, the daily routine consists of forays into the procedurally generated Exclusion Zone to collect resources from ruined cities and abandoned military bases.
The world of MISERY poses many threats beyond radiation exposure. Players will encounter other survivors fighting for scarce supplies, mutated creatures with specific behaviors, and various anomalies. The origin of these phenomena is unknown; some can give an advantage while others will tear a person apart. Anomalous fields often hide artifacts—objects endowed with special properties. High levels of stress cause the character to hear whispers and experience visual distortions that affect the perception of the surroundings.
The bunker functions as a central base of operations and shelter. It can be expanded by building new rooms, installing generators, creating workbenches for crafting and growing food. It is necessary to monitor vital signs: characters can die from hunger, thirst, radiation sickness, or go crazy and attack their comrades. The bar in the institute’s basement serves as a hub for exchanging loot with the merchant after a raid. The established gameplay cycle involves foraying for prey during the day and returning to the hideout before nightfall.

Defeating opponents like Guardian Seraphina or Empress Elisera will require not only perfect knowledge of attack patterns, but also impeccable coordination. Each successful foray into the Valley of Elisera is rewarded, allowing you to unlock permanent upgrades, legendary gear with semi-random stats, and even new characters for future runs. Progress between sessions is the foundation for conquering increasingly difficult peaks.
The project is based on the concept of a high-speed cooperative action game with roguelite elements, designed for a group of up to 4 people. Every playthrough in OLAPU becomes a race for survival, where you need to strengthen yourself as quickly as possible to withstand the growing waves of enemies. The gameplay forces the squad to constantly adapt in order to defeat the powerful entities that inhabit this world.
There is a wide roster of heroes to choose from, including melee fighters, marksmen and support characters such as Chii, Yuvi, Tavi and Kana. By destroying opponents, the team collects stars, which are then exchanged for constellation fragments, which open access to summoning allies or powerful chain reactions. As you progress, the heroes evolve, receiving exclusive upgrades that change their fighting style and tactical capabilities.

Game Description Once Upon A KATAMARI is a journey through the ages as a katamari ball rolls through the past and present, collecting a variety of items to restore the destroyed sky. The prince will have to visit a variety of time periods, from the Jurassic period to feudal Japan, performing bizarre tasks. The mission to restore the star field takes place in the backdrop of the Ice Age and the American frontier, where everything from prehistoric creatures to tumbleweeds must be collected to create new planets. The outcome of this space odyssey depends on the ability to gain enough mass to eventually devour even dinosaurs.
The culprit of the universal disorder was the King of All Space, who carelessly handled the mysterious scroll of history, which led to the destruction of the Earth and other celestial bodies. Now his son, the Prince, is tasked with correcting the mistake by traveling through time on a special ship, the S.S. Prince. Progress through the plot is complicated by the need to find crowns hidden in the levels, without which further time travel is impossible. As you progress through Once Upon A KATAMARI, the gameplay is enriched with new auxiliary tools, such as a magnet for attracting nearby objects or a rocket for temporary acceleration.
In addition to the main protagonist, 68 of his cousins ​​and relatives are available to control, whose appearance can be changed by adjusting colors and facial expressions. The project also features a competitive multiplayer mode called KatamariBall, where up to four players can compete online or against computer opponents. The goal in this galactic sport is to roll the biggest ball, proving your superiority in the chaos of space.

Game Description Onirism features a young girl named Carol as the main character. She is full of energy, but at the same time absolutely disciplined. One day, a strange portal materializes next to her bed, from which creatures of unknown origin appear. They take the plush toy, hiding on the other side of the portal. Without the slightest hesitation, the heroine follows them, intending to return what was taken from her. Thus, she finds herself in Crearia - an amazing world inhabited by a wide variety of life forms.
The entire story in Onirism consists of 10 consecutive sections, showing users different parts of the local world (there are more than 20 in total). Fields, waterfalls, forests, mountain ranges and other places have their own special architecture, which creates unique conditions for passing a particular segment. As for the passage itself, here the heroine will have her own set of weapons, with the help of which she will be able to neutralize the enemies advancing on her. This can be either a long-range weapon (a water pistol or a rifle) or a short-range weapon (an umbrella). To replenish your ammunition, as well as keep your health at the same level, you need to collect the corresponding fragments scattered throughout the locations or hidden in chests. In addition to those things that are in a visible place, there are also hidden places in the locations. There, the user will discover particularly valuable items, but to find them, he will have to try hard.

Game Description Slots and Daggers is a retro fantasy adventure wrapped in slot machine mechanics, where each spin determines the fate of the hero in dangerous lands. The gameplay is based on the rotation of reels, the symbols on which correspond to actions in battle: attacks, the use of potions or spells. Defeating eccentric opponents that include Kul Knights and Hammer-wielding Goblins will require not only quick reflexes and luck, but also strategic thinking. By winning battles, the gamer receives powerful modifiers that open access to additional reels, new weapons and abilities.
The journey takes place in a whimsical fantasy world, the visual style of which is made in retro aesthetics with deliberately rough character sketches. The soundtrack, consisting of sounds typical of arcade machines and hip-hop beats, creates a unique atmosphere. The Slots & Daggers project offers ten levels to complete, each of which ends with a meeting with a unique boss. As you progress, new equipment is unlocked, allowing you to flexibly customize your combat tactics.
Strategy and randomness in every spin:
Combat system. The outcome of battles is decided by combinations of symbols appearing on the reels, which requires the player to adapt to an ever-changing situation. Progression and customization. Coins earned in battles can be spent on unlocking new symbols for the machine or on permanent improvements, creating an individual playing style. Tactical depth. Despite the element of chance, success depends on the ability to correctly manage available resources and apply the received modifiers in a timely manner. Arena mode. For the most determined, there is the Egg arena mode, where you can compete for the maximum number of points.

Game Description Super Fantasy Kingdom is an exciting and addictive game where gamers will experience an exciting adventure filled with strategic gameplay and endless possibilities. With a randomly generated map and a hero at your disposal, you embark on each journey with the goal of protecting your kingdom from the relentless hordes of monsters. This survival roguelike offers a huge amount of options, allowing you to recruit over 100 different units, each with unique abilities and synergies. With careful upgrading, these units can evolve into even more powerful forms, increasing your chances of success.
However, protecting your kingdom is only one aspect of the project. Managing resources and cities also plays a crucial role in your success. From harvesting and building to mining, cooking, cooking, feeding and growing various elements, you have the opportunity to improve and perfect your kingdom. Achieving a balance between production and consumption is key, especially when night falls and your troops head to the tavern to feast. The quality of the food they are served directly affects their experience gains, so it is important to choose wisely.
One of the defining features of Super Fantasy Kingdom is its expansive open world. In this exciting world, gamers can explore and find hidden resources, items, units, monsters, quests, challenges, shops, and even helpful people that help them progress and unlock upgrades. The plot unfolds over the course of a playthrough, presented through brief and engaging dialogue. There are also numerous formidable bosses that will test your skills and strategic prowess.

Game Description Tattoo Tycoon is a management simulator in which you will revive the tattoo culture in the city of Tattooga Bay, which was once its center. The protagonist, whose appearance and backstory can be created independently, gets the last remaining salon. The main task is to turn a modest studio into a thriving chain of establishments, returning the city to its former glory. This will require not only skillfully applying designs to the skin, but also building relationships with a variety of residents, among whom there are eccentric clients and problematic artists, as well as an influential businessman known as the Tycoon.
Business development will require an integrated approach. Attracting visitors is achieved not only by the quality of work, but also by furnishing the premises with furniture from INKEA, as well as by creating a comfortable atmosphere. It is important to communicate with clients to understand their preferences and offer a design that they cannot refuse. In addition to tattoos themselves, the range of the salon at Tattoo Tycoon can be expanded with related products: skin care products, T-shirts and posters. Time and energy management becomes key as it is necessary to decide when to open and close the salon to complete daily tasks.
As popularity grows, it becomes possible to hire staff, from other tattoo artists to administrators, which helps cope with the growing flow of clients. Personal connections and word of mouth play just as important a role as marketing campaigns. Having gained the trust of the townspeople and earned a reputation, the most famous artists earn the right to participate in the prestigious Ink-Vasion competition, proving their skills.
Aspects of becoming a tattoo artist:
Unlock over 100 unique tattoo designs. Select and arrange one of the many salons in a busy city. Careful study of the preferences of each group of clients to create the perfect design. Create your own character and live a unique story. Management of all aspects of activity: from creativity to entrepreneurship.

Game Description The Bench is the story of an elderly retiree who, tired of the rules of a nursing home, decides to run away. Armed with a cane and an endless supply of bread, he sets out on a journey through a colorful world, moving from one bench to another. An ever-growing flock of pigeons becomes his faithful companions and assistants in this adventure. Feathered friends not only accompany the protagonist, but also carry out his instructions, helping to solve puzzles and obtain useful items necessary for advancement.
Escape from surveillance turns into a fascinating exploration of a world full of life and unexpected discoveries. As he progresses through The Bench, memories of his past life appear before the hero, hinting that he was not just an ordinary pensioner. The gameplay offers not only the search for hidden objects, but also many mini-games: from solving puzzles in the newspaper and drawing in a notebook to playing chess or fishing. Each location is designed with humor and offers unique challenges, allowing park visitors to interact with their surroundings and play harmless pranks.
Outside a nursing home:
Control a flock of customizable pigeons to perform various tasks. Explore stylized and colorful levels, each with their own characteristics. Interact with the world through solving puzzles and finding hidden objects. Participation in a variety of mini-games that support the hero’s mental activity. Revealing the protagonist’s past through memories that emerge during the adventure.

Game Description UltraGirl Alters is a tactical project in which the gamer controls a group of virtual idols, Alters, fighting the creations of corporate algorithms. Five girls, dressed in tokusatsu-style battle suits, confront monsters on live-streamed battlefields. The outcome of each clash is determined not only by the competent use of the heroines’ unique abilities, but also by the reaction of the audience to the actions of the commander. Accumulating SP points gives you access to ultimate attacks that can destroy entire squads of enemies or deal devastating damage to bosses.
Outside the virtual arena, the lives of heroines are filled with the challenges inherent in the entertainment industry. As a manager, you will have to solve the problems of girls related to cyberbullying, information leaks and conflicts within the fan club. Developing relationships with each of the group members, including the icy Nanase and the clumsy Mitsuki, opens up access to personal tasks. Successfully completing them not only strengthens bonds of trust, but also provides combat bonuses. In the UltraGirl Alters title, exploring the city allows you to find side missions that reveal the stories of minor characters.
Two sides of the life of idols:
In the virtual world, girls become heroines opposing monsters created by the megacorporation INFI-X. In reality, they are young artists whose careers and personal well-being depend on the wise decisions of their mentor. Progress in battles is directly linked to solving personal problems, which creates an inextricable link between the two aspects of gameplay. The ultimate goal is to achieve the perfect ending, where a team of six becomes the ultimate group of Alters.
The narrative gradually reveals the dark secrets of the INFI-X corporation, which uses entertainment content and complex algorithms to control society. By helping idols overcome difficulties, the manager, together with them, challenges the system, where everything is subordinated to the thirst for profit. Each decision affects the development of the plot and relationships within the team, leading to one of several possible endings to the story.

Game Description Unbound Eternity is a turn-based card roguelike in which players take on the role of a powerful monster. The protagonist will have to invade the mysterious lands controlled by the mysterious cult of the Eye and challenge its orders. The basis of the combat system is runes, which allow you to play cards and create powerful combinations. With their help, you can multiply damage, poison opponents, or sacrifice your own health for the sake of devastating attacks. This is the only way to resist the army of the empress and defeat the hero chosen by the cult to maintain the eternal cycle.
The main task of the villain is to break this endless chain of battles and establish undivided power over the world. To achieve this goal, Unbound Eternity will have to constantly improve your deck by creating and improving cards. The gameplay invites you to navigate your own route through hostile territories, choosing battles and avoiding unnecessary risks. Each decision affects the final result, opening up access to new opportunities to expand your sinister domain and obtain permanent improvements.
Tools for establishing dominance:
Collect powerful artifacts that provide unique advantages in battle. Combine tiles on the global map to strategically plan your route. Receive a variety of rewards, including permanent combat enhancements or even immortality. Overcoming a series of unpredictable events, each of which affects the further passage.

Game Description VEIN is a journey into a world that has experienced the collapse of civilization, where survival depends on the ability to adapt to constantly changing conditions. The change of seasons and random global events continuously transform the landscape and influence tactics. Here, every sound matters, as opponents controlled by artificial intelligence are able to track down survivors, relying on sight, hearing and smell. This forces you to be constantly on alert, because even abandoned buildings can harbor a mortal threat in the form of mutated zombies.
The basis of existence becomes the creation and protection of one’s own shelter. By erecting fortified bases on the ruins of civilization, the hero ensures his safety from attacks by marauders and aggressive creatures. The VEIN project implements a deep survival system that forces over time to move from searching for canned food to complete autonomy. To provide yourself with food, you need to master hunting, fishing and farming, because the resources of the old world are not endless. The gameplay offers both solo confrontation with dangers and cooperative restoration of society together with other participants.
Almost every object in the environment is interactive, which opens up scope for tactical maneuvers: from using a can of beans as a projectile to controlling water taps. Traveling over large areas is facilitated by the use of vehicles that require regular maintenance, refueling and repairs. Creating a unique character with customizable appearance and characteristics allows everyone to live their own unique story in this harsh but detailed world.

Game Description Battle On! Hero Academy is a strategic simulator with elements of idle mechanics, the main goal of which is to create a self-sufficient educational institution for heroes. The fundamental concept of the project is built on the principle of iteration and legacy, where the release of characters at the maximum level is not a loss, but a strategic investment in the future. Each graduate leaves behind valuable relics that are used to unlock permanent global improvements in the academy’s technology tree. The construction of the Hall of Fame allows such legendary warriors to constantly generate income. Thus, each training completed contributes to the strengthening of the institution, providing the next generation of fighters with a better starting point for development.
The process of creating a thriving academy begins with detailed planning of its infrastructure on an initially empty plot of land. The efficiency of the wards directly depends on the proper location of buildings. In Battle On! Hero Academy has implemented a completely autonomous ecosystem, freeing the manager from routine micromanagement. Heroes train independently, eat food to gain boosts, and rest. This allows you to focus on macro management and preparation for battles with powerful bosses that periodically appear at the training grounds.
Construction of academic infrastructure:
Hero huts - designed to restore characters' stamina after activities. Training grounds - provide a constant flow of combat experience for all students. Canteen - Provides fighters with powerful temporary buffing effects. Library - used to significantly accelerate the overall progress and growth of warriors.

Game Description Crown and Adventure is a project in which managing cities, appointing ministers, and issuing edicts form the basis for building a powerful dynasty. The path to dominance lies through the competent management of taxes, the development of technology and the strengthening of one’s faction, which allows one to turn captured territories into prosperous centers of power. Large-scale battles unfolding from a top-down side view make it possible to control armies numbering up to 1000 units on the screen at the same time.
To achieve your ambitious goals, you will have to gather an elite legion under your banner. Becoming a legendary lord is impossible without loyal companions, so more than 50 unique heroes are available for hire around the world, each of whom has their own history and abilities. Crown and Adventure’s troop arsenal includes nearly 100 different types of soldiers with unique tactical roles. The formation of the army occurs by attracting representatives of different cultures, be it warriors from the lands of Chen-Yuan, inspired by the ancient East, or fighters from the desert regions of Sasin.
The action takes place in the vastness of the continent of Eulogis, whose history was overshadowed by the ancient Cataclysm. This 2D pixel art world is made up of 17 unique regions that you can freely explore on horseback. As you travel across a huge, seamless map, you’ll discover hidden resources, dungeons, and the mysterious Mysterious Realm. Every decision made directly affects the further development of events, allowing players to create their own unique story in this fantasy world.

Game Description Echoes in the Storm is a psychological horror game in which you will dive into the investigation of a series of brutal incidents in a remote Arctic settlement. The main character is detective James Northland, for whom professional duty turns into a clash with his own inner demons. The oppressive atmosphere of an isolated town, engulfed in a storm, gradually erases the boundaries between the real world and nightmares. The storyline, filled with dark humor and disturbing moments, is revealed through the found diaries and documents. The story touches on themes of memory and the fragility of the human mind, offering 3 possible endings.
The process of investigating the circumstances requires meticulous collection of evidence in various locations, including the police station, the morgue and the city lighthouse. In Echoes in the Storm, to restore the full picture of events, you need to carefully interact with the environment.
Process of collecting evidence and information:
Listen to encrypted radio transmissions that contain snippets of witness testimony and hidden warnings. A collection of old photographs and amateur photographs that capture key moments in the life of the settlement and may indicate previously overlooked details in the behavior of the victims. Examine police reports, morgue medical records, and residents' personal diaries to reconstruct the chronology of events and understand the ulterior motives of the perpetrator. Activation of an old beacon, the light of which not only disperses the darkness, but also reveals hidden symbols and inscriptions on the walls of buildings, visible only in certain lighting. Solving puzzles based on James' memories, where distorted fragments of his past become the key to unraveling the real nightmare. An exploration of abandoned buildings and snow-covered paths, where every item found - from a forgotten toy to an icy tool - tells its own part of the tragic story.

Game Description Elemental Reforged is a reimagining of the epic fantasy saga, combining the best elements from War of Magic, Fallen Enchantress and Sorcerer King into a single project. This title offers you to lead a civilization in a world where each playthrough is unique thanks to procedurally generated maps filled with tasks and dynamically changing environments. Gamers will create their own character to lead an entire faction to dominance, using magic to terraform the land and capture mystical Shards of Power.
The process of managing an empire is closely intertwined with role-playing mechanics. Each unit, from the common warrior to the mighty hero, has a unique history, characteristics and equipment, and their strength increases with experience. Elemental: Reforged features a deep customization system that allows you to not only create armies, but also design cities, research technologies, and form dynastic alliances. Battles can be resolved either in turn-based tactical mode or using advanced artificial intelligence to automatically calculate the outcome of the battle.
The narrative unfolds through three massive campaigns set in The War of Magic, The Fallen Enchantress, and The Sorcerer King, delving into the rich history of the Elemental world. The developers completely redesigned the engine for 64-bit architecture, which made it possible to implement the original plan without the technical limitations of the past. The project also includes an updated user interface, improved graphics, and built-in modding tools with Steam Workshop support.

Game Description FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL is a satirical depiction of the future, where two cybernetically enhanced schoolgirls must storm the hundred-story skyscraper of a giant corporation. Inside a building whose structure changes with each new entry, the heroines Akemi and Ryoko are confronted by legions of corporate slaves turned into cyborgs. These weak-willed fighters, known as the Working Dead, defend their employer’s interests to the last spark of life, attacking in waves and relying on numerical superiority.
Traversing floor after floor, the childhood friends use a combination of guns and blades to break through to their main target - the ruthless CEO at the very top. The driving force for the brave girls is revenge for their fathers, whose fates were tragically connected with the activities of the megacorporation Meternal Jobz. Akemi, who has a cheerful and fair disposition, along with her cold-blooded friend Ryoko, breaks into the office premises, causing chaos and destruction.
Their daring foray is broadcast live, and the support of the audience becomes a real force, helping the heroines become more powerful through donations. The FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL project offers mechanics with roguelike elements: in case of failure, the entire arsenal and modifications found will be lost, with the exception of money and materials, and the ascent will have to start from the first floor. The story is set in an alternate year 2089 in the United Federation of Japan, where a 24/7 work culture is rampant and employee exploitation is at its peak.

Game Description GODBREAKERS is a project in which an artificial intelligence called Monad has destroyed humanity and now threatens the sun itself, successively consuming planets. To save a dying star, the mysterious sisterhood of the Coven creates vessels from the void, endowed with human consciousness. These warriors must journey through six surreal biomes to challenge the crazed AI and his minions. Each mission becomes a unique challenge, forcing you to adapt to constantly changing conditions and enemies.
The combat system requires sharp reflexes and tactical thinking. Heroes can interrupt their own attacks to dodge, giving them complete control in the most intense fights. A key mechanic in GODBREAKERS is Godbreak, which allows you to weaken an enemy before absorbing their power and unleashing it on other enemies in the form of a devastating attack. Battles with multi-phase bosses with unique attack patterns test both individual skill and teamwork of up to four members.
Advancing deeper into enemy territory opens up access to new character archetypes, each with their own weapons and set of traits. This allows you to experiment with different fighting styles, creating powerful combinations of skills and items. Constant improvements, unlocked between runs, gradually strengthen the heroes, preparing them for new, even more difficult challenges in worlds where every corner is fraught with mortal danger.

However, as she moves through the bleak, but in its own way beautiful lands, the heroine begins to realize that the true nature of salvation and the truth about this world are much more distorted than she could have imagined.
The Maid of Salvation project offers not just action, but a gothic story full of mysticism and unexpected discoveries, revealed through dialogues and hidden events. Character development is carried out through a detailed skill board, which allows you to fine-tune your fighting style to your own preferences. Journeying between life and death, Shizuka must not only battle monsters, but also confront the deception at the heart of her sacred mission.

The main goal is to uncover the story of its three creators and find out the circumstances that destroyed their working relationship. Gamers reconstruct the narrative by exploring the remains of an abandoned project, tormented by virtual decay and fragmented memories.

The gamer moves through a three-dimensional world that reflects different Internet eras and the horror genres that have grown with them. Each location contains clues and mechanisms, the solution of which links together disparate pieces of information. This process of discovery helps to piece together the tragedy that befell the development team, whose story unites these dissimilar virtual worlds.
The structure of the narrative is designed for repeated playthrough: actions taken entail consequences leading to several endings. Fully voiced dialogue and stop-motion animation in cut scenes reveal the confused memories of the three developers. The atmosphere of the title is built on the disturbing themes of Internet culture and the idea of ​​abandoned digital artifacts. To survive, it is necessary to directly interact with the environment - for example, forward letters or evade emerging entities, which determines the final result.

Game Description Painted In Blood is a dive into the depths of a distorted consciousness, where reality is deformed under the influence of the actions and mental state of the protagonist. In this surreal first-person shooter, the world is a mad artist’s nightmare, constantly changing and reacting to every action. Gameplay is directly dependent on a unique sanity system that forces the player to balance on the brink of madness, as visual effects and even the opponents themselves transform in real time.
This psychological terror forces you not just to shoot accurately, but to constantly adapt to unpredictable events generated by a fevered imagination. Survival in this nightmare requires non-stop movement and lightning-fast reactions. Combat in Painted In Blood is relentlessly brutal, reminiscent of the classic shooters of the past, but with the addition of modern mechanics. You will have to confront hordes of grotesque creatures, from hooded fanatics to creatures woven from flesh and fear. The arsenal for exterminating evil spirits includes both hellish shotguns and cursed bone saws, but the shortage of ammunition makes every shot count.
The maze-like levels, reminiscent of a desecrated cathedral, are full of hidden passages and breakable walls, making exploration a dangerous but necessary endeavor to find resources. The story is deliberately shrouded in mystery, inviting you to piece together the pieces of the narrative yourself. The protagonist is not a hero, but a victim who wakes up in a surreal world of rituals and indescribable entities without understanding what is happening. The only way to get out of this nightmare is not just to destroy monsters, but also to carefully study the environment, finding encrypted clues and fragments of memories that gradually reveal the secrets of the mad creator.

Game Description Pizza Deathlivery is a risky food delivery mission in a city shrouded in ominous fog. The streets of the metropolis, where almost all the inhabitants have turned into monsters, have become a deadly labyrinth. The only hope for survivors suffering from hunger is a brave courier, whose task is to deliver all orders before midnight. Failure means not only the boss’s displeasure, but also certain death in the foggy darkness.
Each outing presents a unique challenge as the city is randomly generated for a new run. Moving through fog-shrouded neighborhoods, you need to be constantly on alert, because monsters with unpredictable behavior await around every corner. Successfully completing orders at Pizza Deathlivery brings you not only money to buy equipment, but also reputation points. The accumulated authority allows you to open access to previously inaccessible areas and new equipment, increasing your chances of survival in this nightmare.
You can confront dangers either alone or in a company of up to six people, joining forces to achieve a common goal. Teamwork and coordination are key to success when the streets are infested with hostile creatures. For communication between participants, voice chat is provided, working at close range, which adds realism to joint forays. Players will have to not just deliver pizza, but become real heroes for those who are locked in their homes, fighting for every order and their own lives.

Game Description Plants vs. Zombies Replanted is a tactical survival test where every defeat forces you to start all over again. In a special mode called Rest in Peace, players will have to face the consequences of their mistakes without the right to correct them, because the mechanics of permanent death return you to the very beginning of the journey. The conditions for completing each race are determined by the eccentric character Crazy Dave, who provides a limited and sometimes completely random set of plants for defense.
This approach shifts the focus from long-term planning to the need to quickly adapt and survive in constantly changing circumstances. In addition to single-player challenges, the project offers a variety of multiplayer formats. Organized interaction in cooperative mode allows you to join forces to repel attacks, but even in a cooperative game there is an element of competition for resources. The weather mechanics in the Cloudy Day mode also make significant changes to the usual process.
With the onset of cloudy weather, Sunflowers stop producing the Sun’s resource, falling asleep until clear weather returns, which forces a radical rethink of tactics and energy management. All of these innovations expand on the classic Plants vs. formula. Zombies: Replanted. At its core, this title remains true to the traditions of the original defensive strategy. Returning to the screens provides a meeting with such familiar plants as Peashooters and Cabbage Pulpers, which again become the main line of defense against the invasion of the living dead.

Game Description Roulette Hero is a project in which a squad of adorable animals confronts ruthless mechanical monsters, and the outcome of the battles is decided by the rotation of the roulette. Gamers will have to form a team of various animals, each of which has unique abilities. Some companions are distinguished by their attack speed, while others create impenetrable defense. The thoughtful placement of fighters on the cells of the roulette wheel and its subsequent launch activate their skills, creating powerful combinations and synergies that can turn the tide of even the most difficult fight.
Each round of confrontation with robots consists of eight moves, during which the difficulty steadily increases. To strengthen the squad, special cartridges are used that provide powerful improvements, and Augmentation Points. Roulette Hero features more than a hundred unique units belonging to 13 species of animals and over 100 different abilities, which opens up scope for tactical experimentation. The gameplay offers three modes, including fast runs, difficult challenges and endless waves of opponents, and the total number of levels at the start reaches 20.
Strategy in a whirlwind of chance:
Assembling a squad of animals, such as fast hares or hardy bears. Using more than 100 unique units and 90 enhancing items. The use of special mechanics, for example, bonus spins for collecting four or more animals of the same species. Confrontation with mechanical enemies, requiring constant adaptation of tactics. Choose from two starting characters with different playstyles.
Despite the element of chance introduced by roulette, success depends on proper planning and the ability to create effective combinations between fighters. The project offers not only a single-player campaign, but also an asynchronous multiplayer mode with global leaderboards, where you can compete with the results of other participants. Steam Workshop support and a creative mode allow the community to create their own content, expanding and enriching the original concept.

Game Description Species Unknown is a dark sci-fi adventure in which mercenaries must face horror aboard abandoned spaceships. An unpredictable threat lurks within the depths of these wrecked ships, forcing squads of up to four to work together to survive. Each task plunges you into an atmosphere of oppressive uncertainty, because the hunt is led by one of five deadly entities with unique habits and strengths.
Successful completion of the contract depends on the team’s ability to adapt and use the tools available to confront the nightmare that lurks in the darkness. Events take place at the end of the 21st century, where the battlefield is devastated interstellar wanderers. Before engaging in combat, fighters must carefully examine the environment, collecting evidence to identify a specific type of monster. Missions in Species: Unknown range from retrieving valuable data from a black box to direct confrontation to capture or eliminate a xenomorph.
Sometimes the only option is to completely destroy the ship to prevent the threat from spreading. The gameplay is built on close cooperation and strategic planning, although the ability to act alone is also provided. The first-person perspective enhances immersion in what is happening, forcing you to constantly be on your guard. Rewards earned during risky missions allow you to upgrade your equipment, which increases your chances of surviving subsequent missions of increasing difficulty. The choice of enemy for each mission is determined procedurally, which provides high replayability and forces you to look for new approaches to each outing.

Game Description SUFFOCATE is the story of a once happy Taiwanese Lin family whose lives turn into a nightmare after an encounter with a mysterious cult. Set in modern-day Taiwan, the series plunges participants into psychological disintegration, greed, and distorted faith. The story is told from the perspective of several characters, allowing you to look at the unfolding tragedy from different points of view. The main setting is the family’s luxurious mansion, the architectural style of which recreates the villas of celebrities of the 1980s, located on Yangmingshan Mountain.
To uncover dark secrets, you will have to explore not only the family home, but also the mysterious Lian Hua Temple. Moving through locations involves mortal danger posed by vengeful spirits that seem frighteningly familiar. SUFFOCATE’s gameplay requires you to constantly hide, solve puzzles, and use elements of parkour to avoid collisions with hostile supernatural forces. The project draws inspiration from real-life events in Taiwanese history, including the Shellless Snail movement and the high-profile murder case of Liu Pan-yu, giving it added depth.
At the center of this first-person horror story are complex family relationships destroyed by outside interference. Exploring the environment, the characters gradually approach the shocking truth about the reasons for their misfortune. In the process of passing they will have to face cruel scenes, rituals of a mysterious cult and manifestations of human greed. Each discovery in this story forces you to plunge deeper into an atmosphere of fear and despair, where the only goal is survival and uncovering the truth.

Game Description The Jackbox Party Pack 11 is a collection of five unique party experiences that offer a fresh take on familiar formats. For the first time in the history of the series, the collection consists entirely of original concepts, abandoning the continuations of popular hits like Quiplash or Fibbage. Players will be immersed in a variety of activities, from creating absurd sound effects in Hear Say to collaborating on slaying monsters using erudition in Legends of Trivia. Each activity accommodates a different number of participants and offers a unique gameplay experience.
Doominate mode challenges players to take harmless concepts and turn them into something terrifying with witty additions. Creative types will be able to express themselves in the Cookie Haus, where they need to decorate cookies, fulfilling whimsical orders from customers. For fans of deduction, a Suspectives mode has been prepared, in which you will have to figure out the criminal among your friends, based on answers from previously completed surveys. The Jackbox Party Pack 11 offers both competitive and cooperative formats, making it a versatile solution for any party.
One of the most unusual new products was Hear Say, where for the first time a telephone microphone was used to record sounds and remarks. Legends of Trivia, on the other hand, is a co-op quiz game set in a fantasy setting where correct answers deal damage to enemies. This mode supports one to six people and is one of the longest running activities in the history of the franchise.

Game Description The Lonesome Guild is a journey through the world of Etere, where switching between party members is the key to surviving fast-paced battles. Overcoming obstacles, the heroes solve puzzles and explore vibrant but fading locations, from snowy streets to ancient ruins. The main character, known as the Phantom, is a spirit devoid of memories who must confront a mysterious fog. This substance poisons the minds of its inhabitants and spreads a destructive loneliness across the land, forcing the protagonist to seek allies to save the world.
The central idea of ​​the project is the mechanics of friendship, which directly affects the development of characters. To save Etere, you will have to assemble a team of six colorful personalities, each of whom is experiencing isolation in their own way. Bonds between them are strengthened through joint completion of tasks and intimate conversations around the fire. Developing relationships in The Lonesome Guild unlocks new abilities and unique co-op attacks, turning emotional attachments into real power on the battlefield.
It is the cohesion of a motley team that becomes the main weapon against the impending threat. By immersing himself in the personal stories of his comrades, the Phantom not only helps them, but also gradually restores his own memories. Each party member’s progress depends on close interaction with the others, making learning about their personalities and motivations an integral part of the gameplay. As a result, the fate of the entire world lies in the hands of a group of unlikely friends who must unite to drive away the darkness.

Game Description This Isn’t Just Tower Defense is a complex system where the strategic placement of defensive structures is combined with the need to create automated production lines. To repel attacks, not only military power is required, but also a well-functioning economy. The basis of everything is the energy generated by solar fields and delivered to the towers using drones. Resources obtained from defeated enemies are processed at various factories, which is the key to constantly strengthening the defensive perimeter.
You will have to confront huge waves of enemies, numbering thousands of units at a time. To effectively contain the onslaught, you need to wisely combine melee and ranged towers, as well as weapons that deal damage over an area or to single targets. Each tower in This Isn’t Just Tower Defense can be upgraded countless times, increasing its firepower, range and attack speed. Adapting tactics to suit different types of enemies becomes the key to surviving under ever-increasing pressure.
Infinite Defense Mechanisms:
Defeating a wave of opponents does not lead to a final loss, but only returns you to the last control point for a new attempt. Each destroyed enemy becomes a source of valuable materials for further development. Continuous improvement of defensive structures opens up access to new tactical capabilities. Creating a balanced supply chain of resources and energy ensures the smooth operation of the entire defense network.

Game Description Tormented Souls 2 continues the story of Caroline Walker after the events at Wildberger Asylum. Her little sister, Anna, suffers from visions of violence and death, which she sketches, and these drawings become reality. To save her sister, the heroine travels to the remote town of Villa Hess and a secluded clinic in the mountains of southern Chile. The establishment’s employees hide behind a mask of calm, but soon the sisters find themselves in the center of a completely new nightmare. Behind the walls of the institution there is a cult that sees a special interest in Anna’s abilities.
In Tormented Souls 2, the player takes control of Caroline and explores the dark places of the town, including a monastery, a shopping center and a school. The heroine’s special ability allows her to move between realities, changing the past to transform the present and search for alternative paths. Progressing through the story requires exploring and combining items from your inventory. Solving the puzzles built into the environment requires finding connections between objects and the world. These clever puzzles will force the gamer to carefully study every detail and think outside the box.
In this game, encounters with unfamiliar creatures are a central element of the gameplay. Caroline builds and upgrades an arsenal of improvised tools, such as a nail gun and a chainsaw, to combat threats. The quick selection system helps you change weapons directly in battle. She faces new opponents, from agile creatures with blades to massive armored beasts and bosses. During the adventure, the heroine will meet other characters, each of whom pursues personal goals and harbors dark secrets. Uncovering a complex story full of unexpected twists becomes the main reward for survival.

The game uses an isometric camera standard for the genre, which allows you to see all controlled territories and instantly react to events both in peacetime and during military operations. The project has only a single-player mode with a built-in list of achievements, in which rewards are given to the gamer for certain successes during the passage.
The gameplay consists of building your own fortified castle with many different buildings that perform their vital functions for the further development of the shelter of a huge number of workers and warriors. The user’s task is to build a powerful defense to protect their territories from raids by enemies. The game’s universe is filled with magic and many fictional races, which adds variety to the gameplay due to different schools of witchcraft and the spells they have. The key to success is a properly balanced army that can withstand attacks of different types (physical and magical damage, damage, and so on).

Game Description Cut That Wire is a project in which four hostages have to find themselves in a confined space, where each of them has an explosive device attached to their chest. In this tense situation, they need to identify the traitor hiding under the guise of an ally, because any mistake could be the last. One of the participants, known as the Engineer, has critical information - he knows one of the safe wires.
However, his main task lies not so much in knowledge, but in the ability to convince others that he is right, while the bomb’s timer inexorably counts down the seconds until it explodes. Opposing him is a saboteur whose goal is to sow chaos and trick others into making a fatal mistake. The process of identifying a saboteur is based on a series of tests that test intuition and ability to deceive. Various mini-games, such as Big Bluff Drawing or Big Bluff Picture, require participants to complete tasks given different inputs, forcing the impostor to improvise to avoid giving himself away.
At the end of each round, Cut That Wire moves on to its climax: the general vote. The group decides which of them is the most suspicious and must cut the wire. The toss of a coin decides fate: the blue side will force the chosen one to try his luck on himself, and the red side will allow him to shift responsibility to another hostage. This first-person multiplayer title relies on psychological tension and social deduction. Here, bluffing and the ability to read opponents’ body language become no less important tools for survival than logic and cold calculation.

Game Description Dispatch takes the superhero genre and turns it on its head, placing it in the mundane yet unpredictable world of office life. Instead of fighting evil aliens or saving cities, the title follows Robert Robertson, a former superhero called Mecha Man, who is now forced to find his place in a superhero control center after his trusty mech suit is destroyed in a fight with his nemesis. So what? Now he controls a team of former supervillains.
That’s right, the very villains he once fought are now on his payroll, and Robert must juggle office politics, emergencies and personal drama while trying to keep the city from falling apart. At the heart of Dispatch is a strategy map that acts as a command center. This is where gamers can view active emergencies that require immediate attention. Heroes must be sent to solve these situations, but it’s not just about sending the strongest hero to complete the task.
Decisions made on this map affect how characters interact and develop over time. One wrong move could take Robert’s command, ruin relationships with other heroes, or worse, cause them to reconsider their allegiance. It’s like managing a small dysfunctional family, only the stakes are a little higher - we’re talking about life or death situations.

Game Description Double Dragon Revive is a revival of the classic series in modern 3D, where the combat system goes beyond just beating up your opponents. The outcome of the fight now depends on the ability to parry blows by performing the stunning technique Critical Assault, and on the competent use of the environment. The heroes will not only have to use their fists, but also use weapons scattered throughout the levels, from knives to hammers, and also use interactive elements of locations to gain a tactical advantage.
Collecting Dragon Ball meter unlocks a devastating Finishing Blow that can deal massive damage to all nearby enemies. The action takes place 15 years after a devastating nuclear war, in a world where the surviving remnants of humanity live in colonies. One of these settlements is controlled by a brutal gang called the Shadow Warriors, which has established its own rules and widened the gap between rich and poor. It is in this dark setting that the story of brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee, masters of the Sosetsuken fighting style, begins.
DOUBLE DRAGON REVIVE’s plot revolves around confronting a crime syndicate when the brothers' dojo comes under threat and their childhood friend Marian is kidnapped. In addition to the familiar protagonists, other characters will appear in the story. Players will face both returning enemies, including boss Willie, and new faces, such as a character named Marcus. The project offers not only a story campaign for single or co-op, but also additional modes. For example, in Survival mode you can fight endless waves of enemies, while in Arcade mode you can complete the entire game with a limited number of attempts, which is a tribute to the classic slot machines.

Game Description Goblin Lands invites you to become the ruler of the seas in a world created using colorful 2D graphics. The journey spans 80 unique levels, distributed across 4 expansive maps, where you will encounter 24 types of islands. The seas are not empty: they are patrolled by wandering transports, and along the way there are various obstacles that require adapting tactics. For the most persistent explorers, hidden locations are provided, and the epic orchestral accompaniment emphasizes the scale of the events taking place and gives each battle a special atmosphere.
The core gameplay is a real-time strategy game focused on conquering archipelagos. Victory at each stage is achieved through the defeat of enemy forces with the help of your own armies, consisting of ships and aircraft. The Goblin Lands project sets the commander the task of not only seizing lands, but also defeating powerful bosses who control entire regions. Each battle is a test of strategic thinking, where it is necessary to wisely manage resources and units to achieve superiority over the enemy.
The development system is closely linked to victories over key enemies. For each defeated boss, skill points are awarded, which can be invested in one of the 20 available upgrades. There are 8 types of transport at your disposal, and for each of them there are 10 unlockable appearances. The total number of achievements exceeds 200, encouraging exploration of all aspects of this tactical adventure and offering high replay value even after completing the main campaign.

Having chosen his path as a mighty warrior, a mysterious warlock, an undead necromancer lord or an agile hunter, the protagonist gains a unique talent tree. Each battle against hordes of twisted monsters and powerful bosses is a test of not only reflexes, but also strategic thinking. In this world, where darkness gradually devours the light, the only salvation from madness is the flame of a torch, illuminating the road in the forbidden darkness of the night.
The environment in GOD FORSAKEN is fraught with not only hordes of enemies, but also many secrets. Exploring the long-forgotten ruins of ancient civilizations and dangerous underground labyrinths reveals mysterious documents scattered throughout, shedding light on the root cause of the all-consuming corruption. The equipment system offers huge variety with randomly generated item stats and hundreds of legendary artifacts.
The Fateful Monument guides the brave, and the Mirror of Fate opens the way for them, but each step deeper into darkness requires unimaginable sacrifices. The mechanics are based on free character development, which allows you to combine any weapon with a variety of starting skills. The combat experience is constantly evolving with a variety of unique skills and skill enhancement effects, reminiscent of a rune system that can be freely inlaid to enhance abilities. The hero will have to find the source of ancient evil, using all his power and cunning to snatch from the abyss at least a glimmer of hope for his people.

Game Description House Builder 2 is a simulation game in which the building process begins with careful planning and preparation. Before laying the first stone in the foundation, you have to go to the warehouse to get the necessary tools and materials. After loading everything onto his truck, the player goes anywhere in the vast open world to begin fulfilling the order. Progression in this construction sandbox is based on completing a variety of missions and contracts that provide access to new tools and improvements. Each successfully completed task not only brings rewards, but also expands the arsenal of available tools, allowing you to take on ever larger and more complex buildings. Thus, the gameplay constantly motivates to master new skills and technologies, turning a novice builder into a true master of his craft, capable of making any architectural dream come true.

The main task comes down to passing the tracks to energetic compositions created specifically for this title. The character moves inside a dark tunnel space, where, against the backdrop of cheerful chiptune music, it is necessary to hit targets. This process requires extreme concentration from the gamer, since chaotic moments in the songs are accompanied by acceleration and an increasing stream of multi-colored notes flying directly at the hero.

This project combines elements of classic role-playing action games with mechanics that require the gamer to have endurance and strategic thinking. Interacting with non-player characters in the capital and other villages opens up access to new quests and reveals the secrets of this detailed pixel world.

Game Description Refate Echoes of Desire is a cinematic adventure where the protagonist’s consciousness returns to the neon streets of Tokyo, and the memory of the past is completely erased. Finding himself in the midst of a violent conflict between powerful Yakuza clans and police forces, the protagonist is forced to survive without any money or allies. The only way to restore his lost identity is to build relationships with eight completely different women, each of whom holds a piece of the puzzle of his past.
Interaction with them gradually lifts the veil of secrecy over who he really was: an ordinary clerk, a secret agent, an assassin or a crime boss. The gameplay is based on the mechanics of interactive cinema with a first-person view, immersing you in the atmosphere of criminal Japan. All scenes in Refate: Echoes of Desire were filmed with the participation of real actors against the backdrop of authentic Tokyo locations, which gives maximum authenticity to what is happening. The development of the plot directly depends on the decisions made in the dialogues and on the success of completing intense QTE scenes.
These episodes, organically woven into the narrative, determine not only the hero’s survival in dangerous situations, but also which of the dozens of possible endings awaits him. The key to unraveling the mystery of the protagonist’s identity is his connections with unique heroines. Among them are the cold and domineering head of the Yakuza clan, a principled policewoman, a mysterious ninja woman and a caring restaurant owner. You will also have to gain the trust of a naive foreign student, a lonely teacher, an eccentric heiress to a wealthy family and a popular fashion model.

Game Description Riddlewood Manor is an adventure where the walls of a gothic mansion hide dark secrets and eccentric inhabitants. In its quaint halls you can meet an unusual dragon or feed an eternally hungry chicken, but not all its inhabitants are friendly. The sinister laughter of a possessed doll named Susie echoes through the dark corridors, and ghosts and evil spirits are constantly trying to destroy anyone who dares to disturb their peace. Every step in this mysterious place is a mortal danger, where sudden creaks and slamming doors become harbingers of trouble.
The main task is to cleanse the cursed estate from evil, which requires unraveling the tragic history of the Riddlewood family. To do this, you have to solve many puzzles scattered throughout the rooms of the mansion. Challenges include preparing breakfast from highly questionable ingredients, such as pork parts, or assembling a Ouija board from found clues. Completing these quests gradually brings you closer to understanding the fate that befell the former owners of the house. The gameplay of Riddlewood Manor is based on point-and-click mechanics, where exploration of locations is combined with solving problems in the style of quest rooms.
Stylistically, the project balances between creepy moments and absurd humor, creating an atmosphere reminiscent of supernatural cartoons. This journey through a haunted house offers not only frightening scenes, but also comedic situations that arise when interacting with its strange characters. To survive and uncover all the secrets, you must show ingenuity and attention to detail, as the Riddlewood family nest is reluctant to part with its secrets.

The ability to freely switch between members of the Nugiz squad allows you to find innovative solutions and fully explore the environment, imbued with a nostalgic atmosphere and references to the pop culture of the past.

The main task is to build your own basketball dynasty, where every decision affects your rise to glory. The path to greatness begins not in the professional arena, but in school. In addition to the individual path, the project allows you to take control of an entire team and lead it to the championship. The opportunity is provided not only to directly participate in matches, but also to act as an observer or simulate the outcome of meetings, which opens up tactical depth. Hoop Land is unique in that it seamlessly integrates collegiate and professional leagues within each season, creating a unified basketball universe. Gamers will have to manage their roster, looking for talent in the student draft and forming a team capable of dominating the court.
The gameplay is made in the style of two-dimensional retro projects, inspired by the classics of the past. On the site, control is completely in the hands of the user, allowing you to perform a variety of maneuvers. You can dribble the ball down the court, use a crossover to deceive your opponent, and make accurate three-point shots. More complex combinations are also available, such as fast breaks and rushing your partner for a spectacular alley-oop or a powerful slam dunk, making every gaming session unpredictable.

Game Description ILA A Frosty Glide is the journey of a young witch named Ila, unfolding in the vastness of a mysterious snow-covered island. The search for the missing kitten Coco, the last reminder of her mother, forces the heroine to ride her skatebroom - an unusual means of transportation that combines the properties of a broom and a skateboard. Moving around the world with the help of this magical item, the girl explores snow-capped mountains and enchanted forests, discovering hidden corners and solving puzzles.

To do this, you need to collect special charges of stardust, allowing you to soar higher and longer. One of the unique techniques is the ability to thrust the skatebroom into ice walls, then push off and soar to new heights. The environment itself helps with movement: on the island you can find jumping mushrooms that throw the heroine to previously inaccessible ledges and secrets.
As you explore the world, new possibilities for personalization open up. Items found in chests or purchased from the store allow you to customize Eela’s appearance, giving her unique outfits such as the Ash Explorer’s Set or Winter’s Cold Robes. The collected coins are spent not only on clothes, but also on useful improvements, such as a magic shield. Each discovery enriches the journey, revealing new details of the story and allowing you to dive deeper into the atmosphere of this adventure with its voxel graphics and cozy mood.

Under the control of the gamer, one of the heroes, be it Ink, Void, Sol or Roch, must stop the invasion of Earth organized by the fallen angel Azazel. The journey will take them to Purgatory, where they will face hordes of demons and monstrous creatures of darkness known as the Nephilim. Using perks unique to each protagonist that affect strength and survivability, they must fight their way through the gothic landscapes of this eerie dimension.
Battles unfold at a fast pace, and to move across vast biomes, you use not only standard running, but also dashes with a grappling hook, which allows you to quickly close the distance to enemies. The Voice of the Creator has granted this unique opportunity to atone for past sins, and it can be used either alone, accompanied by bots, or in co-op mode, joining forces with two other players. The Painkiller project offers not just the extermination of monsters, but a full-fledged test, where every action brings you closer to salvation.
The arsenal for destroying opponents is represented by both weapons familiar from the original and completely new examples of infernal weapons. To enhance combat capabilities, a tarot card system has been introduced, which provides access to improved abilities and active skills. Increasing your rank also expands your available equipment, making each subsequent encounter with Azazel’s forces even more spectacular. By exploring various locations, you can discover many secrets that shed light on the events taking place in this world.

Game Description SWAPMEAT is a co-op roguelite shooter set on the strangest and most hostile planets in the galaxy. In this project, players will have to carry out raids on alien worlds inhabited by aggressive alien creatures in order to collect their flesh. A central mechanic is the ability to instantly replace your character’s body parts with organs borrowed from defeated enemies.
This approach allows you to constantly adapt to the combat situation, adopting the unique abilities of your opponents right during the battle. The process of survival on alien planets turns into a constant hunt for biomaterial. Each new body part, whether it’s legs for a triple jump or a torso that can deploy turrets, radically changes the tactical capabilities.
Opponents can rip off the hero’s limbs, but he is able to immediately respond in kind by appropriating enemy arms, legs, or even a head to use their power to his advantage. In SWAPMEAT, success depends on how quickly you can adapt to constantly changing conditions and enemies who seek to defeat intruders.
Key aspects of survival on alien worlds:
Foray into the depths of uncharted planets alone or in a squad of up to four members to complete missions together. Using a unique character modification system that allows you to replace body parts with captured organs and gain new abilities. Fight in third person with mutated aliens, each with their own unique body parts to capture. Collect valuable resources in the form of flesh to further strengthen and adapt your fighter to the growing threat from the local fauna.

Game Description Croc Legend of the Gobbos is a revival of the classic platformer in which a brave crocodile named Croc must save his adopted family. The insidious wizard Baron Dante, together with his minions Dantini, captured the Gobbo Archipelago, imprisoning its peace-loving furry inhabitants. Among the prisoners was their leader, King Rufus, who at the last moment managed to summon the magical bird Bini to protect the protagonist from danger. Now the main character must single-handedly confront the villain and free all his relatives from captivity.
The journey takes place across five unique worlds, including volcanic and icy islands, as well as underwater caves. The gameplay of Croc: Legend of the Gobbos involves overcoming a variety of obstacles using running, jumping and swimming. To neutralize enemies, use a tail attack and a ground strike. This updated 45-level adventure has been greatly improved. The developers not only redesigned the visual component in high resolution, but also introduced a modernized control scheme with an updated camera for a more comfortable experience.
The main goal in each stage is to find and release all the hidden Gobbos. Successful completion of this mission opens up access to new locations and brings the decisive battle with the powerful Baron Dante closer. As Croc moves through the levels, he collects colorful crystals that serve as keys to secret areas and additional challenges. Each zone of the archipelago is guarded by bosses, minions of the main antagonist, to defeat whom you need to use ingenuity and mastered skills, turning each battle into a tactical puzzle.

Bonuses from defeated enemies - destroying large enemies allows you to receive one of three bonuses: partial restoration of health, a small increase in speed, or additional points.

Game Description Keeper’s narrative begins with the awakening of a long-dormant lighthouse on an island. Moved by an unknown purpose and accompanied by a seabird, the structure sets off on an odyssey through the surrounding area. This trek takes the duo towards the center of the island and into unexplored areas. This third-person puzzle adventure tells the story without a single word, conveying the story through cinematic and atmospheric elements. Events take place on a secluded island in a lost sea, at the foot of a distant mountain peak.
Keeper’s gameplay focuses on world exploration and puzzle solving in a surreal environment. Players guide the lighthouse and its feathered companion through a series of challenges. Progress through the plot is marked by a series of mysterious transformations affecting the main character. The task is to penetrate deep into the island by navigating a linear path in a stylized fantasy world. This game is a single-player adventure that focuses on its story and mystery, driving the central characters from one location to another.
A key gameplay mechanic revolves around the partnership between a moving lighthouse and a seabird. Their combined efforts are necessary to overcome the obstacles created by the natural and surreal elements of the environment. As they move forward, the withering shoots visibly grow and intertwine around them. This is a philosophical journey, an expedition leading two heroes through strange territories. The final destination is a place beyond ordinary understanding, completing an odyssey of metamorphosis.

Mechanics are constantly evolving, offering fresh challenges and unexpected twists that change the usual rules. At its core, Lumo 2 is a modern reimagining of classic arcade adventures, inspired by British titles from the 80s and 90s.
The gameplay is designed to recreate the charm of the retro era, but with the use of modern technology to ensure smooth control. The developers have created an atmosphere of nostalgic adventure, where exploring the environment and discovering all its secrets is rewarded with vivid emotions. This isometric puzzle platformer challenges genre veterans and newcomers alike, offering a fun and varied challenge in a bizarre, ever-changing world.

During the investigation, Detective James will not only have to face his own illness, but also uncover the secret of the Red Order organization. This structure, known for centuries as a crime fighter, conducts sinister genetic experiments under the guise of producing health products. THIEF’S SHELTER gameplay modernizes the classic point-and-click mechanics, allowing you to freely move through 3D locations to search for clues. Game Description Cal and Bomba is an adventure game where you solve puzzles by programming a sequence of actions to destroy your enemies. Players will have to use logic and mathematics to defeat their opponents on the battlefield. Each mission offers a set of special tiles with actions that must be placed in a specific sequence to achieve the goal. A key mechanic is the use of percentage calculations to fine-tune the gun’s firing range, turning abstract mathematical concepts into a visual and interactive process.
The journey takes place in various worlds where a pyromaniac dwarf named Kal and his wife, the troll Bomb, travel on their cannon cart. Their main task is to blow up everything in their path and crush the evil Beholder. The Cal and Bomba project offers more than 170 unique levels, divided into three thematic worlds and a prologue. The developers have provided two difficulty levels, making the puzzles interesting to both beginners and experienced strategists. The title won awards for its innovative approach to learning, successfully combining gameplay with pedagogy.
Instead of directly controlling characters, gameplay focuses on planning ahead. It is necessary to build chains of commands in order not only to eliminate enemies, but also to pit them against each other, causing large-scale chain reactions. Some opponents are able to move around the arena between rounds, forcing you to constantly adapt your tactics. Successful completion depends on the ability to foresee the consequences of your mathematical and strategic decisions, watching how the compiled algorithm is brought to life, leading to chaos and explosions on the screen.

The Escape from Duckov project features a deep weapon customization system that allows you to turn found objects into effective means of defense and attack. Belle faces only one task: survive the bloody night of terror and find a way to escape from a ruthless pursuer who sees in her only material for his next monstrous creation.
