Game Description Zaccaria Pinball is the digital incarnation of pinball machines, offering an extensive collection of tables divided into several categories. Enthusiasts have access to both classic electro-mechanical (EM) devices, like Nautilus or Universe, and more modern solid-state (SS) versions, including Time Machine and Devil Riders.
In addition to authentic recreations, the project includes completely redesigned tables such as Space Shuttle 2016 and Farfalla 2017, as well as unique themed designs presented in the Award category, where you can find The Mummy and Aliens. Deep personalization allows gamers to change physical parameters, from the strength of the flippers to the elasticity of the ball, and customize visual effects, such as lighting intensity or motion blur.
The gameplay offers two main modes: arcade and simulation, each of which conveys the sensations of classic machines in its own way. For those looking for a special angle, there is a camera editor that allows you to customize the view of the playing field. Having learned from a certain deity about the death of his physical body, the protagonist finds himself locked in the past with no clear path to returning home or moving on to the afterlife. The script is riddled with many hidden details and foreshadowing, leading to a completely unexpected dramatic outcome. Additionally, the title contains a mode that explains in detail the life, customs and terminology of the Edo era.
Elements of a detective investigation in Yoshiwara:
Explore an authentically recreated neighborhood in search of important clues. Use the time loop ability to change the course of events. Inhabit the bodies of other characters to obtain inaccessible information.

The gameplay of Water of M forces you to constantly be in suspense, balancing between a direct confrontation with the threat and attempts to hide. The only way to salvation lies through understanding the mysterious rules of this place and solving puzzles, the complexity of which gradually increases. At first, the solutions may seem obvious, but soon to advance you will need to analyze all the previously found clues and symbols. Relentless persecution by an otherworldly entity, whose steps are not similar to human ones, forces you to carefully think through your every step on the school grounds.

Relentless Pursuit - The protagonist is pursued by something that cannot be escaped using conventional evasive tactics. Research in constant tension - searching for vital clues in distorted and dangerous locations beyond recognition.

Game Description Dice Legends presents a setting where a magical cataclysm has turned all the people into monsters. The player’s task is to uncover the mystery of this event and the magician known as the Last Man. At the beginning of the journey, you have to choose one of three characters: Paladin-Lion, Summoner of Demon-Ravens or Assassin-Toad. Each hero offers a unique playstyle to navigate four different worlds with their own unique challenges.
Four facets of a legendary adventure:
Heroes: Three unique characters, each using a different type of dice and offering a distinct playstyle. Tactics: Deep combat system built on the synergy of the deck and the results of rolls. Equipment: Extensive arsenal of 160 cards and 75 items to create powerful combinations. Plot: A well-developed world with an intriguing story about a mysterious cataclysm.
Turn-based combat in Dice Legends revolves around deck building and resource management. Each turn, the gamer draws cards and rolls a set of dice. These are then used to activate abilities that allow you to defend yourself, weaken the enemy, or deal damage. Development is about finding synergies between skills and roll results to create effective combinations. The system requires managing randomness through the strategic use of items and tactical combinations.
Locations are explored on the world map, where plot details will be revealed after each successful battle. Defeating 50 types of opponents rewards you with new cards from the common pool and various pieces of equipment. This equipment, which includes weapons and armor, is necessary to form a unique character build. Game Description Dreams of Another turns the key mechanics of third-person action games upside down, as the gamer’s projectiles materialize the environment rather than destroy it. The world is created through these actions, taking shape around the character as they explore. What is happening unfolds in an ephemeral, dream-like environment, directly linking each action with creation. Instead of depleting the landscape, any shot contributes to its appearance. Players independently pave the way forward, and the main gameplay is based on a complete rethinking of genre canons.
The plot of Dreams of Another focuses on two individuals: the Man in Pajamas and the Wandering Soldier. Gamers will have to immerse themselves in their imagination, revealing details of the past and life events. These individual narrative lines are intertwined, and the full picture of what is happening emerges when their destinies are compared. Progress through the story involves dialogue with unusual characters and sentient objects that offer a special perspective on human society and existence. Such interactions allow you to look at the events of the title from a different angle.
Exploring this abstract world requires assembling a fragmented story from the lives of the characters. The philosophical basis of the project is built into both the mechanics of creating space and the development of the plot. Dialogues with local residents contribute to the formation of a psychological and emotional atmosphere. Funny remarks from objects add a touch of humor while offering food for thought. The journey is an exploration of the protagonists' past within an ever-evolving environment born from their memory.

Take part in numerous activities, from sports like baseball to racing with homemade cars. Help the club solve a variety of cases: from searching for missing sports equipment to investigating the appearance of ghostly music. The wizard in the squad has teleportation magic, which opens up new paths and allows you to change position. The gamer will have to alternately control three heroes, because none of them alone will be able to solve the riddles. Their coordinated actions are needed to interact with the environment and collect unusual treasures.
The gameplay of Treasure ‘n Trio is based on turn-based puzzles unfolding on a cellular field. All actions are sequential: the gamer moves objects step by step to the desired points and activates various mechanisms. Progress through the stage depends on the correct order of using the characters’ unique abilities. Interaction with the environment is the key to overcoming the logical barriers of each level, which requires the player to be able to plan ahead.
The journey takes place through many worlds, each with its own theme and new puzzle elements. Locations vary from forests to dangerous, lava-filled zones, introducing unique enemies and mechanics in each new area. In addition to the main objective, the game has optional side quests for additional skill testing. These difficult modes return you to already completed levels, but with special conditions, which require completely different approaches and a high level of tactics.

Immersion in the dark atmosphere of the title is complemented by the presence of a comprehensive compendium. In addition, the system tracks statistics, allowing you to analyze your successes and failures. Successfully overcoming challenges and completing special conditions is rewarded by unlocking achievements, of which there are 62 in this adventure. Players will have to guide survivors through abandoned areas, building temporary fortifications to protect against mechanical threats. The main task is to organize an exodus from the dead wastelands. Each location offers a new challenge in the ongoing struggle for the future of the remaining people, forced to survive in a world under the rule of their former servants.
Beacon of Neyda’s gameplay combines side-scrolling action with strategic defense and construction elements. You have to create and improve your base to repel the merciless waves of enemies. The building construction system is flexible, it allows you to place defensive structures in the right places to cover the vulnerable core of the outpost. The ultimate goal in each zone is to repair the main tower, thereby expanding the safe space for survivors. Success depends on the ability to balance between gathering resources and the need to strengthen key positions.
An important part of the game is exploring procedurally generated locations with dangerous environments. By traveling through these places, you can learn the history of the world and the events that led it to its current state, as well as reveal past secrets and deceptions. The project allows us to study new technologies to expand construction capabilities and improve protective structures. This progression system opens up access to more sophisticated strategies to combat the ever-present mechanical threat.

Lana’s search for the truth in Bye Sweet Carole opens the way to Corolla - a surreal parallel dimension. The gameplay requires the player to constantly move between realities to solve problems and overcome dangers. The main game mechanic is the heroine’s ability to take on the form of a rabbit, which opens up access to various abilities to bypass traps and save herself from tar monsters.
Four Pillars of a Mysterious Adventure:
Moving between the gloomy asylum and the kingdom of Corolla. Use the ability to transform into a rabbit to solve puzzles. Overcome danger through stealth and platforming. Interact with characters to reveal the secrets of the plot.
Progress through the plot is built on dialogues with colorful characters that reveal the connection between worlds. The entire title is an experiment, combining the aesthetics of a classic animated film with elements of intense survival horror. In this unique structure, platforming segments and puzzles are woven into a narrative of the search for truth.

Game Description Dicealot follows Queen Guinevere as she strives to save the cursed King Arthur by leading knights through chaos-ridden Camelot. Gamers will face more than 30 types of opponents, from commoners to mythical creatures, in this unpredictable medieval world. Each run is a solo journey with permanent death, forcing you to start a new adventure from scratch. The decisions made directly affect the outcome of the mission to remove the spell that threatens the domain.
Turn-based battles in Dicealot are built around a luck-testing mechanic. The player rolls dice to create attack combinations, with the ability to continue rolling to increase the effect. This tactic carries significant danger, since a failed result leads to the loss of everything accumulated during the round. Success depends on careful management of this system, requiring you to decide when to lock in loot or take risks for a decisive victory, using available re-rolls to mitigate failure.
Progress is built on collecting your own collection of more than 100 unique cubes. The journey begins with a standard set, but in stores you can purchase items with properties that change the chances of success or increase points. Tactics are further determined by the choice of one of 10 types of weapons, which radically changes the gameplay. The loadout offers different options, such as stable attacks or betting on risky combinations, and 7 difficulty levels provide increasing challenges.

Game Description Night Jackal Blood Debt follows a masked vigilante whose sanity is on edge after a brutal attack on his estate shatters his way of life. Taking on the guise of the Night Jackal, this anti-hero, driven by the desire for retribution, begins his crusade on the streets of the city. Justice is restored to them using their own, often brutal, methods, and the story itself explores the development of a superhero who gradually loses control in attempts to take revenge for the past.
Initially, all the collected evidence points to the protagonist’s long-time enemy - the elusive Bert the Barbarian. However, as the investigation progresses, it becomes clear that behind this crime lies something larger than personal revenge on the part of one villain. The protagonist of Night Jackal: Blood Debt must uncover a complex conspiracy, constantly balancing between the role of the arbiter of justice and complete madness, in order to ultimately pay off his bloody debt.
The gameplay reflects the dual nature of the character, offering both furious shootouts and the ability to covertly eliminate opponents. The classic shooter formula is enriched by puzzles and unusual situations, including missions in underwater levels. The visual style of the project takes inspiration from the original comics, and some of the graphic materials were created by industry veteran Derek Donovan, who had a hand in creating the images of Superman and Spider-Man.

Game Description Runeborn offers turn-based combat, similar to a slot machine. Spells are activated by rotating runic columns to match symbols along five different lines. Successful combinations initiate attacks against demonic opponents. For increased control, gamers can lock up to 8 individual symbols in place while the rest of the reels spin, allowing them to build powerful streaks. This mechanic underlies all tactical encounters with Malakar’s forces.
Strategy in Runeborn is based on direct customization of runic columns. The rune book changes by adding, removing or modifying the symbols appearing on the reels. Signs can be enhanced with amulets and auras, giving them additional effects when activated. Over 150 different artifacts introduce new variables, creating combinations to multiply damage, retrigger symbols, or provide additional fixations for columns. These items allow you to assemble a wide range of synergistic builds.
Each race begins with the selection of starting opponents, which sets the balance between risk and reward from the very beginning. For defeating difficult enemies, the player receives more coins, which can be spent in five specialized stores on items and upgrades. Battles with elite units and formidable bosses promise significant rewards. A vast assortment of artifacts, scrolls, and enemy abilities ensures that the gameplay offers a new configuration of challenges and opportunities every time.

Game Description ACRES, a strategic simulation game centered on crop production and market needs, offers a unique and engaging farming experience. Here you set out on a journey to build a successful farm, one acre at a time, by responding to market orders, upgrading equipment, and optimizing yields under time pressure. The project challenges you to thrive in an ever-evolving agricultural market.
The key is to grow crops in a targeted manner. To be successful, you must carefully tend your crops and take care of the land to ensure a bountiful harvest. Orders at the market are lined up, specifying specific crops and their quantities, and it is your responsibility to grow and harvest the crops before the expiration date. The faster you complete them, the more money you will earn, but be careful as the value of orders decreases over time, which affects the reputation of your farm.
ACRES offers a detailed process for growing crops, starting with tilling the soil to make it fertile and precision planting different types of seeds. Weed control and tillage practices are key to the success of your crops, and maintaining soil vitality is key to consistent yields. The simulator also highlights the importance of moving from hand tools to automated tractors and implements for efficient farming.

Game Description Last Term is a plunge into an endless nightmare, where a mysterious deity imprisoned the protagonist within the walls of a school. The main task is to escape from this time loop, for which you need to go down to the ground floor of the building. The way out of the vicious circle of repeating locations lies through attention to detail and the ability to distinguish the norm from the terrible deviations embedded in the familiar environment. The path to freedom is determined by correct decisions based on observation.
While going down or up the floors, the hero is forced to constantly analyze the environment, which consists of three key areas: the corridor, the classroom and the restroom. If anomalies are noticed in the situation, the right path is down; otherwise, when everything seems ordinary, you should go upstairs. Progress in Last Term directly depends on the ability to remember the smallest details and notice subtle or, conversely, shocking changes in the interior. Some of these anomalies are interactive, leading to unintended consequences and deepening the climate of fear.
To systematize observations, a special journal is provided in which all detected oddities are recorded. Collecting records of anomalies becomes a separate goal, revealing the full range of terrifying metamorphoses occurring at the school. Which of the four possible endings awaits the captive at the end of this psychological test depends on actions and attentiveness. Every decision brings you inexorably closer to either long-awaited salvation or eternal imprisonment in this ghostly educational institution.

In this dystopian world filled with government conspiracies and unforgiving mechanisms, the main character must face the truth about his life. Moving through the remains of the city, where shadows flicker in unison with the metallic echo in the mind, the character must restore the lost essence.
Advancing deeper into this waking nightmare requires not only dexterity, but also strategic thinking to circumvent numerous threats. The search for his father’s legacy becomes the main goal for the young protagonist, forcing him to piece together his own story. This side-scroller combines exploration of murky depths with puzzle solving and classic platforming elements. As your adventure progresses in MOONY:Black_Lotus, you encounter mysterious strangers whose abilities can be used to overcome obstacles.
For example, one gains the ability to pass through strong steel bars or see in complete darkness, which opens up new ways to explore the environment. Each new memory brings us closer to the solution, but at the same time plunges us deeper into the secrets of the hidden corruption that destroyed this world. The gameplay is built on constant vigilance, because danger lurks around every corner. To survive and continue your quest, you must actively use stealth while avoiding ruthless enemies known as the Lotus. The protagonist will have to uncover forgotten stories and face the truth, no matter how difficult it may be.

Game Description Pocket Boss puts the player in the role of a remote employee whose main task is to manipulate business schedules. The central goal is to achieve a promotion in one week by adjusting data to meet the demands of superiors. These activities include inflating performance metrics, increasing shareholder value, and hiding financial losses in reports. Each task requires you to find a convincing solution to an information puzzle while taking into account the whims of your boss.
Pocket Boss gameplay revolves around direct interaction with a variety of graphs, from pie charts to bar charts to scatter charts. The gamer drags, squeezes and stretches screen elements, changing trends until they fully meet management’s expectations. The process of editing these visualizations forms the key mechanics of the puzzle, and the goal is to make each set of information work as instructed. The scope of responsibilities is wide: from changing customer confidence indicators to erasing competitors from market reports.
The narrative unfolds through a series of awkward exchanges with a demanding boss that frame each misrepresentation task. These dialogues create a dramatic and often humorous atmosphere, reflecting the pressures of a remote career subject to arbitrary orders. Decisions made during these conversations can affect your bottom line and whether you receive a promotion. The theme of this game is emphasized by special puzzles, one of which offers to reveal the secrets of equal pay.

Game Description Swamp Keeper is a tale about a little keeper who is destined to protect a sacred swamp from the encroachments of invaders. Armed only with a bow, this nimble lizard must repel the onslaught of the enemy army of Ho, seeking to seize the valuable resources of the swamps. The fate of the native lands depends on accuracy and tactical calculation, because the enemy, using iron and fire, has already approached the very heart of the swamp sanctuary.
Survival in this world requires mastery of a single weapon. Each shot must be timed, as the arrows have limited ammunition and must be magically returned, leaving you momentarily defenseless. Opponents, including armored soldiers and bosses like the Tiger, force you to constantly move and use the environment. In Swamp Keeper, the combat mechanics are based on chargeable attacks, where the strength of the shot directly affects its effectiveness. Successfully completing stages is rewarded with random items that provide useful boosts, such as arrows that explode when hit.
Preparing for battles takes place in the shelter, where you can fine-tune your bow. Five of its components are subject to modification, from the tip to the tail, which allows you to change the characteristics to suit your style. However, the risk system does not allow you to use only the best parts, forcing you to look for a balance between power and stability. In addition to the main campaign, there is a Challenge Cesspool mode for gamers looking for a challenge, as well as special modifiers known as disciplines that make the game more challenging and increase the enemy threat.

Game Description The Gretlow Tapes explores the secrets of the abandoned Gretlow mansion, where the only tool for interacting with the world is a camera. Through the lens, you will not only document the frightening findings, but also interact with echoes of the past in order to uncover the dark secret of this place. The atmosphere of oppressive horror is created thanks to the realistic style of the found film and the ominous soundtrack. Every step along the dark corridors and the creaking of the floorboards hints at the presence of some entity that lurks in the shadows and is in no hurry to show itself.
Everything that happens is recorded in a special photo album used to collect evidence. The action takes place in 2000 in the small town of Hatherby, located in the north of England near the North York Moors moors. The main character is a local university student who is interested in photography. The protagonist, intrigued by rumors from the Internet and local legends about an old estate on the outskirts, decides to personally check their veracity.
Local residents carefully avoid any talk about the Gretlow house, which has long been a dark stain on the reputation of their quiet settlement. In The Gretlow Tapes, the immersion into history occurs gradually, as records are examined and objects are discovered. To piece together the picture of the tragic events, you will have to carefully search the locations. The search leads to the discovery of various keys, for example from a barn or a children’s room, which provide access to previously inaccessible parts of the mansion. In addition, missing cassette tapes containing valuable pieces of information are scattered throughout the house.

Game Description The Legacy is a co-op survival horror game set in a dark tale of a family curse in a deserted town. Events unfold years after in 1990, Grandfather Molfar, a local sorcerer, refused to sacrifice one of his descendants to the dark forces of the forest. To save his grandchildren, he sent them from their hometown of Svetlograd to Kyiv, but this act doomed the entire area to death and desolation.
The grown-up brother and sisters return to their native land to face the horror that has consumed their home and try to stop the ancient evil. They will have to explore a large open world, collecting bits and pieces of information about the tragedy from the notes of former residents, and confront the dangers of the cursed land. Survival in harsh conditions requires coordinated actions and constant vigilance from the heroes. The project relies on high replayability due to the procedural generation of key elements with each new start.
This turns each playthrough of The Legacy into a unique adventure with an unpredictable ending. To uncover the secret of the curse, the characters will have to join forces, wisely distribute the resources found and fight the creatures of darkness hiding in the forests and abandoned buildings of Svetlograd. The atmosphere of mystery and constant tension is supported by mystical stories that reveal the lore of this world.
The unpredictability of each new trip to Svetlograd:
The location of all game items, including food, weapons and ammo, changes when starting a new session. The places where enemies, animals, as well as useful plants and mushrooms appear are generated randomly each time. Book pages and notes from local residents that are key to the plot are scattered across locations in a new order.

Game Description In Battle Suit Aces, the hunt begins for alien superweapons known as Relic Suits. Gamers take command of the USS Zephyr, leading the crew through a galactic expanse infested with monsters. The journey involves recruiting, developing relationships, and improving mech pilots to counter various threats. This quest is an emotional story that focuses on the bonds that form between the captain and his crew. Interactions and decisions made determine the course of the expedition, creating an atmosphere of an extended family among the staff.
The basis of the gameplay of Battle Suit Aces are turn-based card battles. Each turn, the player places pilots from his hand into a 5-man battle line, deciding who attacks advancing monsters or defends the ship. Characters' unique abilities create synergies, encouraging experimentation with different combinations against ever-changing enemies. The deck is formed from fighters from 5 specialized factions, offering a special fighting style. Cards can be further enhanced with powerful modifiers.
The personal adventure in this project is determined by the choice of factions for the alliance and lines of dialogue. The decisions made influence the development of events, opening access to a variety of missions: from starball competitions to infiltration of corporate facilities. In between sorties, the ship serves as a base for preparation. Here you can get to know the team of more than 50 voiced heroes, create items, test card combinations in the simulator and plot your future course. The entire journey reflects the relationships built and the tactics used.

Game Description Blood of Mehran takes the legendary warrior Mehran to Ancient Mesopotamia, where his desire for a peaceful life is destroyed by the ambitions of others. Inspired by the Arabian Nights, the story revolves around themes of love, loss and loyalty. The game world includes sprawling palaces, bustling bazaars, and endless sand dunes to explore. Gamers can travel on horseback, exploring locations in search of secrets and collectibles hidden in cities and in the wild.
Key features of the Blood of Mehran saga:
A deep story of love and fidelity, inspired by oriental tales. Flexible combat system: from slashing attacks to archery and stealth maneuvers. Exploring the colorful world of Ancient Mesopotamia on horseback and on foot. Develop your hero through the skill tree to enhance his legendary abilities.
The gameplay offers several approaches to battles. Direct combat is done in the hack-and-slash genre, and the arsenal includes a combination of a sword and a shield or paired blades. To hit distant targets, a bow and arrow is provided, allowing you to eliminate threats from a distance. The third-person combat mechanics also allow for combat on horseback while galloping across open terrain.
In situations that do not involve open confrontation, a well-thought-out stealth system is an alternative. The player can use cover to move unnoticed past enemies, remaining a real ghost in the location. All actions affect character development, helping Mehran become stronger. In a special skill tree, the player distributes points to unlock and improve the hero’s abilities, adapting his skills to the chosen playing style.

Game Description Deathground is a first-person survival horror game aimed at cooperative play. The story centers on people fighting for survival among bloodthirsty dinosaurs. There are different modes available in which you need to team up with three more players, trying to break through the jungle and military bases, fighting against powerful ancient lizards. The heroes will have to survive on the killing field, where every enemy poses a serious threat. It is necessary to act harmoniously and competently, constantly interacting with partners.
The single player mode in Deathground is a survival horror game where the hero alone survives against powerful monsters, hiding from them in the shadows and trying not to get noticed. You can’t get close, as they have a heightened sense of smell. There is a motion tracking device, similar to the one Ripley had in Alien Isolation. With its help, you can always find out where the enemy is approximately located.
There is a class system where each character has unique skills and character traits. When playing together, each hero has his own position in the team. There is randomization: the location and movement of dinosaurs, weather conditions, sequence of tasks and much more. The game stands out for its cruelty and incredible violence. There are elements of suspense and real horror. All dinosaurs have individual movement and attack patterns, and live in unique environments.

This mechanic allows you to quickly gain a foothold in the area before organizing attacks in several directions. Commanders can launch coordinated attacks from land, sea and air, or use underground networks for covert maneuvers. Interiors and caves serve as points for ambushes and secret troop movements, adding depth to strategic planning.
The gamer’s tasks include not only direct control in battle, but also exploration of the big world. On the new maps you will have to face different environmental conditions and types of opponents. Successfully completing missions gives you access to improved weapons and new unit abilities needed to counter more serious threats. Every decision, from the selection of units to their placement on the battlefield, directly affects the outcome of the battle and requires precise actions to survive in a protracted war.

Game Description In EMOTIONLESS: The Last Ticket, James Anderson returns to the abandoned amusement park built by his missing father. The hero’s search for answers leads him into a surreal world that turns familiar locations into alarming dead ends. The structure of the environment defies logic: every corridor and tunnel opens up a new layer of unreal reality. The main mystery lies in uncovering the frightening story of the strange transformation of the park and discovering what lurks in its empty spaces.
Gameplay in EMOTIONLESS: The Last Ticket focuses on first-person exploration without combat. The gamer will have to navigate the confusing layout, looking for clues and listening to scattered audio recordings that reveal plot details. Gameplay consists of wandering through the park’s illogical architecture, finding the right path, and encountering new navigational challenges. This approach allows the focus to be on psychological tension and atmospheric discovery rather than direct confrontation, creating a completely immersive experience.
The environments are a mix of the mundane and the bizarre, from empty technical tunnels to outlandish fairground attractions. These locations feel both familiar and fundamentally wrong, creating a constant sense of unease. The player can interact with the attractions, but these attractions often serve to deepen the mystery rather than provide entertainment. Traveling through this oppressive space leads to one of several possible endings, depending on the discoveries made along the way.

Game Description Little Rocket Lab tells the story of aspiring engineer Morgan, who returns to her home to complete her family dream of building a rocket. The girl discovers that the city of Saint-Ambroise has changed a lot, and now her experience is needed to help local residents and revive the region. Through research and creation of ingenious devices and factories, Morgan directs his efforts to solving the problems of the community.
Her engineering talents become the key to bringing industry back to the city. The central mechanic of Little Rocket Lab is to convert local resources into useful materials through automation. The gameplay involves building vast industrial complexes using drills, furnaces, assemblers and extensive conveyor networks. Such factories solve the difficulties of citizens by introducing electrical elements, water supply systems and cranes.
To extract the necessary components, you will have to explore the coasts, railway junctions, quarries and underground zones, because each location contains unique materials for inventions. In addition to industrial tasks, the game’s plot pays attention to interaction with the residents of Saint-Ambroise. Gamers will get to know local characters, make friends and become an important part of society. The process of revitalizing the town through engineering solutions and social connections gradually brings Morgan closer to her personal goal. The culmination of all efforts is the final assembly of the mother’s rocket - the main project of her entire family.

Game Description The main goal in My Card Is Better Than Your Card! — become the main duelist on the site, collecting unique decks. Gamers design cards using stickers from a catalog of over 200 options, each with its own effect. Combining multiple stickers unlocks multi-level tactics, but increases the cost of the card played. This collection of personal creations is used to challenge opponents in the neighborhood.
Turn-based battles in My Card Is Better Than Your Card! are played on the principle of tug of war, forcing players to fight for the initiative. Instead of depleting your health, the cards give you superiority over your opponent, and the FEVER multiplier allows you to turn the tide of the fight. Each playthrough features a sequence of 10 unique enemies and ends with a fight against one of 3 bosses. At the beginning of the race, the player chooses one of 10 starting decks, adapting tactics to find fresh combinations.
In between fights, various activities provide access to resources to improve your selection. Activities include a sticker treasure hunt, testing your luck at the vending machine with new items, or trying to get one of the 40 toys in the claw machine. Collected trophies combine perfectly with the created maps, adding a new layer for tactical decisions. Story events also allow you to interact with friends in your neighborhood through activities such as water battles or forest adventures.

Game Description Seafarer: The Ship Sim puts gamers at the helm of a variety of ships on a spacious open-world map. The environment, inspired by northern European landscapes, includes many harbors and towns to navigate. The career path is determined through interaction with factions that offer unique missions and goals. Activities range from transporting goods between ports and fighting fires on the high seas to rescuing lost cargo.
Gradually, it is necessary to expand the personal fleet, replenishing it with both small tugboats and huge dry cargo ships to carry out new tasks. Gameplay in Seafarer: The Ship Sim is built around two main modes. The storyline offers a story that links the available factions through a series of quests. As an alternative, a quick play mode is available, allowing you to immediately dive into free-swimming without being tied to the narrative.
The project makes it possible to directly interact with the ship’s systems: check engines, control cranes and use water cannons. The built-in character editor allows you to customize the captain’s appearance before going to sea. The marine environment is subject to dynamic changes due to weather simulation that changes the state of the sea. Flights operate with a full cycle of day and night, and conditions can range from calm to severe storms. An interactive wave system generates a unique movement of water that affects the handling of ships during passage. This approach creates a fluid environment, making each trip unique due to constantly changing factors.

Game Description In Shrine’s Legacy, two heroes, Rio and Reima, must confront a dark force that threatens the world of Ardemia. Their main task is to restore the Sword of the Holy, a powerful weapon necessary to save all things. To do this, they need to find and combine 8 elemental magic stones that store particles of the necessary power. The narrative focuses on the characters, developing bonds between the protagonists and the residents who receive help from them along the way.
Shrine’s Legacy gameplay features a top-down view and real-time combat. Gamers explore a vast world and descend into dungeons full of monsters and bosses. The title supports single play and local co-op, where in the first case the partner is controlled by AI. A sophisticated equipment system ensures stat development, and exploring hidden corners rewards with valuable finds, including crafting materials and currency.
Magic, secrets and battles of the world of Ardemia:
The search for eight stones to restore the legendary Sword of the Holy. Dynamic battles in real time alone or with a friend in co-op mode. Solve puzzles in dungeons using unique spells. Collect valuable resources and equipment to strengthen your heroes and learn new abilities.
In the dungeons, players will find both battles and puzzles solved with the help of magic. Defeating the bosses guarding these places will give you items to improve your stats and unlock new skills. The storyline confronts the protagonists with difficult choices against the backdrop of the possible destruction of Ardemia, raising the theme of self-sacrifice. The entire game explores how Rio, Reima, and the other inhabitants cope with loss while the main characters determine the price of their victory.

Game Description Tales of Grimace is a journey through a world torn apart by ideological contradictions, where a person named Yi Ping must confront both external and internal demons. In the lands of Terra, the sinister cult of Maluum is gaining strength, seeking to forcefully impose its beliefs on all residents. Any dissent is severely punished, and those who resist, known as obstainers, face certain death. The story delves into the emotional state of a young man whose struggle with anxiety and depression becomes a central theme.
A quiet life in the town of Cologne for teenager Yi Ping and his girlfriend Hera ends with a sudden attack by fanatics. This event becomes the starting point for a large-scale adventure, during which the protagonist will have to explore the vast landscapes of Terra. The Tales of Grimace project is made in the style of classic role-playing action games with a turn-based combat system and pixel graphics. The gameplay offers not only battles, but also an introduction to many characters whose stories are closely woven into the main plot.
The central mystery is the mysterious connection between Yi Ping himself and the Maluum cult, which he has to uncover. The hero must face traumatic memories and find his true place in a world engulfed in a war of beliefs. This role-playing title focuses on a deep plot, where the exploration of the protagonist’s past plays a key role in liberating the lands of Terra from the oppressive ideology.

The journey unfolds in gloomy but charming locations, among which there are foggy caves and ancient ruins. The visual design is stylized as retro classics, which is achieved through pixel graphics and a limited color palette, creating a nostalgic atmosphere.
The open structure of the world allows you to avoid impassable areas, suggesting that you look for alternative routes to advance. This approach encourages exploration and out-of-the-box thinking, allowing everyone to take the challenge at their own pace. Despite the high difficulty inherited from previous years' titles, Vampire’s Best Friend incorporates modern design elements such as a fair checkpoint system, making the challenge more balanced. Moving forward, the little hero will have to show remarkable dexterity to overcome all the obstacles placed by the vampire hunters.
The plot reveals the reason for the dangerous adventure. A mischievous vampire girl named Vampi has been captured by hunters hired by disgruntled townspeople. The reason for their anger was her pranks and forays into the city for tomato soup. Having defeated her with the help of garlic, the hunters imprisoned Vampi in a coffin, but her faithful winged friend immediately took flight to rescue her friend from trouble. This platformer offers an unusual take on the genre, focusing on aerial mastery.

Game Description Yomegami My Sweet Goddess is a story about the difficult fate of Hayato Narukawa, whose new life suddenly turns into a series of comical and awkward situations. A sudden kiss with Ichijiku Mikoto, the daughter of the head of a local crime syndicate, jeopardizes his deepest mission. Now the protagonist will have to find a common language not only with the mafia heiress, but also with the clumsy class leader, as well as with a naive girl with dog ears. Each of them brings even more confusion into his already complex everyday life, filled with supernatural events.
The reason for all the trials that befell the young man is his own past. Hayato is the reincarnation of a powerful demon, and to atone for past sins, he arrives in the city of Masayresin. This task was entrusted to him by a divine mother named Iris, who oversees his attempts to do good deeds. In the visual novel Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess, the plot development is directly dependent on the decisions made, directing the story along one of four unique routes, each of which focuses on one of the heroines and leads to its own ending.
Events take place in a peaceful human dimension, whose inhabitants are not even aware of the ongoing war in the divine kingdom. This hidden conflict becomes the backdrop for Hayato’s personal drama, as he is forced to balance redemption, romance, and maintaining the secret of his origins. The gameplay offers the ability to adjust the voice volume for each of the voiced heroines individually, which allows you to dive deeper into the atmosphere of this fantasy novel about love and divine intervention in earthly affairs.

Available for solo gamers or cooperative squads of up to 4 people, these raids are designed to contain daimonic forces. The central mission is to hunt down the Hermit, a mentor who betrayed the order. The player must descend into the depths of this world to find the arch-traitor and interrupt his ritual of devouring souls before completion.
The game includes character customization, resource gathering, and item crafting. Gameplay in DAIMON BLADES centers on daimon-possessed weapons inhabited by an entity with a unique set of attributes and abilities. These living weapons absorb the blood of slain enemies to strengthen and unlock new skills during a raid. Between campaigns, its power can be permanently increased at the forge, providing deeper development and increasing the chances of survival.
Blades are not just instruments of destruction, since they carry a harmful influence, which their owners should not underestimate. The narrative is a prelude to the events of E.Y.E: Divine Cybermancy, taking place two millennia before and detailing the origins of the Order of the Secret through sacrifice and bloodshed. Treks take place across 9 biomes with procedural generation, offering unique levels on each playthrough.
What awaits you in the depths of the daimonic world:
Dangerous forays alone or in the company of up to three friends. A living weapon that absorbs the blood of enemies to strengthen itself. Procedurally generated biomes full of unique threats and challenges. Dozens of enemy types and powerful bosses with different tactics. A deep system of character development through the creation of objects and damage.

Game Description House of Necrosis sends the main character to a mansion with halls that are rebuilt with each new attempt. Its structure is procedurally generated, creating an unpredictable environment for exploration from a top-down view. Survival is the primary goal, and permanent death gives each playthrough significant consequences. The player must navigate this changing maze while confronting its dead inhabitants. This single-player title is set in a 3D world that takes inspiration from 1990s horror.
The gameplay of House of Necrosis is split between two different control schemes. The central hub location uses fixed camera angles and tank controls against pre-rendered backdrops. When entering the main sections of the dungeons, the perspective changes to systematically move through the cells. Fights with opponents take place in a step-by-step format - this system requires proper distribution of resources. Gamers must strategically use their limited supplies to defeat zombies and move deeper into the sprawling structure.
Leveling up your character is a key element to overcoming the constant dangers of the mansion. Gaining experience allows you to level up the heroine, improving her ability to survive long-term. Weapon upgrades provide another way to gain a tactical advantage over the occupants of your home. This role-playing framework supports the core loop of a roguelike game: each dive into mysterious dungeons becomes a new challenge. The goal is to move deeper into the building, using the accumulated power to confront stronger opponents.

Game Description Castle of Heart Retold is a dark action platformer that immerses you in the world of Slavic mythology, where the brave warrior Swaran challenges the sinister Sorcerer. A powerful sorcerer, a servant of the dark god Chernobog, kidnapped the hero’s beloved, priestess Mira, and placed a terrible curse on Svaran himself and his village, turning everyone to stone. However, Mira’s tear, which fell on the warrior’s petrified body, partially weakened the spell, giving him a chance to save his beloved and take revenge. Now Swaran must fight his way through hordes of enemies before his body finally crumbles into dust.
The main mechanics of the project are tied to a curse that constantly takes away the hero’s health. To survive, you must constantly fight, because killing enemies and collecting special items is the only way to slow down petrification. If Swaran’s energy drops to a critical level, he will begin to lose limbs, which will limit his ability to use powerful weapons. The journey to Castle of Heart: Retold runs through four unique locations: from the petrified village to the Sorcerer’s Castle.
On the way, the warrior will meet mythological creatures, including devils, ghouls and watermen. The hero can use dozens of types of melee and ranged weapons, from axes and torches to spears and crossbows. This re-release of the original game has completely redesigned the combat system, improved graphics and controls, and re-recorded the soundtrack. The plot was expanded: dialogues were rewritten, and cutscenes were created anew. Adventurers can collect Mokosh Crystals to unlock alternate endings and discover the full story of Swaran and Mira.

The world of this project lives by its own laws: the change of seasons directly affects the environment, and autumn auctions become a place where the strongest adepts fight for legendary items. The path to the heights of power begins with choosing the origin of the character, be it a survivor of an attack by a beast or an alchemist’s apprentice, which determines his initial predispositions. The narrative of Ascend from Nine Mountains begins with an unusual event: the protagonist is struck by heavenly lightning intended for another.
This incident attracts the attention of a powerful warrior named Tdong, who forcefully brings the hero to the Nine Mountains Sect to balance the scales of karmic debt. From this moment begins a long ascent, in which each decision shapes the future destiny and determines which ancient techniques will respond to the call of the adept. The main goal is to overcome nine worlds of power, each of which requires complete dedication from the adept. To move to a new level, called a breakthrough, it is necessary to accumulate chi energy and find rare components that allow the body and soul to transform.

Each successful shipment directly affects customer satisfaction, contributing to the expansion of the logistics network. Efficient completion of tasks provides access to an improved fleet and makes it possible to enter into agreements with large distribution companies. This decision prompts a living candy golem named Gumdrop to escape from the workshop. In her search for the necessary magical ingredients, she joins forces with Butterscotch, Syrup’s longtime rival, complicating an already difficult situation for all parties involved.
The story takes place within the walls of the Atelier Sweets confectionery, which is run by the alchemist Syrup along with his assistant Pastille. The protagonist is firmly convinced of the superiority of science over magic, which is a rarity in her city. The story of Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet begins with the sudden and mysterious appearance of Gumdrop in the basement of the workshop. This event becomes the starting point for the entire plot, forcing the characters to interact, reveal their personalities and make decisions that affect the further development of events and the relationships between them.
The entire gameplay is built on dialogues and choices that form one of 10 unique endings. Each decision taken sends the narrative along a certain path, some of which lead to very unexpected and sometimes dark consequences for the characters, including their death. The non-linear structure encourages repeat playthroughs to explore all possible outcomes of this sweet but full of surprises story. The project also features characters such as Toffee, whose roles are revealed as they progress through various story paths.

Game Description In Backyard Digger, the search for treasure becomes the main goal. Advancement deeper into the earth directly depends on the constant improvement of equipment, for which it is necessary to sell all the valuables found through the computer in the barn. The profit received is invested in upgrading tools, increasing digging power, work speed and inventory capacity. Each such improvement is a vital step towards the final goal, opening access to deeper and more resource-rich layers.
The excavation process requires stamina, and the character’s strength is gradually depleted. You can restore energy using food supplies found in the mines, energy drinks or cake from the garage. At the same time, in Backyard Digger you don’t have to go on a search alone, because the project supports co-op for a company of up to four people. This allows you to organize a real team treasure hunt, which begins very modestly - on the surface, armed only with an old rusty shovel and a lot of enthusiasm.
As you descend and discover the secret shaft, it becomes possible to activate the fire. It functions as a control point, allowing rapid movement between the surface and explored depths. Thus, the entire gameplay is built around a cycle of excavations, selling resources and consistently improving equipment. This process allows you to dig more and more efficiently and go lower and lower to the main secret hidden underground. Each foray brings new finds and brings us closer to the solution to what is hidden in the very depths of the backyard.

This gift allows him to separate his mind from the physical body, turning into a ghostly essence to study the environment, collecting information and tactical planning.
The main plot rotates around the investigation of a series of mysterious events that force the hero to encounter not only external threats in the form of demonic creatures, but also with his own internal demons. Two facets of one reality in the gloomy future:
In physical uniform, Liam relies on firearms and reflexes in order to survive in cruel contractions with aggressive opponents who flooded the city ruins. In a spiritual state, the protagonist is able to pass through the walls, get into electronic devices and even master the bodies of enemies for a short time, using them for their own purposes. The investigation is a key element that requires a gamer of attentiveness to details and the use of astral ability to search for evidence in inaccessible places. The confrontation of demonic entities requires not only accuracy, but also an understanding of their nature, because many of them are the creatures of distorted human consciousness.
It is this interweaving that the mechanic makes Corporeal gameplay multifaceted, offering unique experience at the junction of the shooter, detective and horror. The narrative is revealed through cinematographic scenes, dialogs and a study of the environment, where each note or vision brings Liam closer to the unraveling of a large -scale conspiracy. The elaborate universe fraught with many secrets, and the atmosphere of oppressive and uncertainty makes you constantly be alert, because danger can be hidden not only in dark alleys, but also in the depths of its own mind.

A minimalistic visual style and light humor create a contrasting atmosphere, helping to follow the basic rule - do not panic. New locations constantly introduce fresh elements into the already familiar process, forcing you to adapt to changing conditions and find innovative solutions to save every panicker.
Components of a rescue operation:
More than 14 unique creatures, including a ninja, a robot and a magician, need help. Each alarmist has special talents that open up new ways to solve problems. The adventure spans 8 completely different worlds with their own challenges. Over 100 puzzle levels require strategic thinking and calm.

The two main characters, Rias and Slade, return to their homelands with different goals. The girl wants to reopen her grandfather’s shop, and the boy wants to find out more about the things his father left him. Together they try to uncover the mystery of what happened, while simultaneously working on the revival of the settlement.
The further development of the plot directly depends on the success in restoring Khalfain, which closely connects the personal motives of the characters with the overall task. The gameplay in Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist and the White Guardian is based on exploring the Lantarna continent in search of materials. Gamers will have to switch between two protagonists, using their unique abilities in a world with dynamic changes in weather and time of day. The title features procedurally generated dungeons called Dimensional Paths, where the layout and enemies change with each visit.
Battles take place in a turn-based timeline, and a squad of six fighters placed in the front and back rows can perform coordinated moves like Link Attacks and Item Mixing. Synthesis is a key mechanic of the game, allowing you to create things by adding ingredients to recipes. The characteristics of the created item depend on the Gift Colors of its components. New crafting patterns are unlocked through experimentation, and special slots make it possible to use additional materials to improve the effects. Manufactured goods are sold in the shop, and the profit received goes to the development of Halfain.

Game Description In Beatblock, the player controls a platform located in the center of a circular arena. As the character Cranky, you need to intercept blocks that appear in time with the melody. This action requires constant rotation to meet targets that appear around the perimeter. Gameplay is complicated by the introduction of four different types of blocks, each requiring a different approach to eliminate. Each track is a self-contained level with a unique visual style, in which the main goal is to score points.
Progression in the Beatblock game is structured by the Atom Map, starting with teaching basic mechanics. Players will have to go through 25 compositions, first mastering four types of blocks separately, and then encountering new combinations of them. For experienced gamers, test levels with complex rhythmic patterns combining previously learned elements have been prepared. A marathon mode is also available, offering a continuous selection of tracks to test your concentration and endurance over a long session.
The built-in level editor provides tools for creating custom content. It allows you to design maps for your own compositions, placing blocks and customizing effects to build unique stages. This tool is identical to that used to develop the main levels of the project. Further customization is available through unlockable costumes for the Cranky character, allowing you to visually personalize him. Gameplay can be customized using a range of accessibility features to suit your personal preferences.

Game Description Deadswitch Combat is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shooter that immerses fighters in fast-paced tactical battles across a variety of maps. The project offers many competitive modes, including classic team clashes such as Team Deathmatch and Capture the Flag. In addition to them, more specific scenarios are also available, for example, Demolition with the installation of a bomb or Headquarters, where it is necessary to capture and hold strategic points.
Gamers can also test their skills in the Free-for-All single player format, where everyone fights for themselves, or in the intense Infected mode, trying to survive against infected opponents. A key component of the project is deep personalization of equipment and operatives. There are over two hundred types of weapons available in the arsenal, each of which can be modified using optics, laser designators and various grips.
The class system in Deadswitch Combat allows you to create unique builds by combining primary and secondary weapons, equipment like grenades or Claymore mines, and special perks. The latter are divided into fighter perks, which improve his characteristics, and weapon perks, which increase the effectiveness of weapons in battle. Adding additional tactical depth are killstreaks that unlock powerful support, including airstrikes or calling in an attack helicopter.
Battlefields and Joint Operations:
Fight for supremacy in Domination mode by capturing and holding control flags on the map to score points. Team up with allies in co-op Survival missions to face endless waves of enemies. Fight off soldiers, helicopters and even zombies in unique survival scenarios such as Undead and Terrorist. Create your own maps and tasks using the built-in editor and share them with other community members.

Game Description HOTEL BARCELONA places the player inside a remote structure designed as a trap for American serial killers. The main character is Justine, a new federal marshal whose mind is shared with the maniac Dr. Carnival. Together, the two individuals must eliminate every criminal within the hotel’s walls. Their common goal is to survive this ordeal and get out of the building.
The action in HOTEL BARCELONA takes place in a 2.5D plane, where battles require tactical maneuvers and well-timed attacks. The environment is modeled after American horror films of the 1980s and is fraught with many dangers. Every time a character dies, a Slasher Phantom is created - an echo of a past life. These phantoms repeat the exact movements from the previous run, and their actions can cause damage to enemies, acting as bait or allies in subsequent attempts. Combat activity results in the hero becoming covered in blood, a substance that directly feeds the force mechanics. An aggressive fighting style fills the Skull Gauge, and once the meter reaches its maximum, Carnival Awakening can be activated.
Features of your stay at the Barcelona Hotel:
Control a dual protagonist, combining a marshal and an assassin. Using Slasher Phantoms - ghostly copies that help in battle after death. Gaining power through the blood to activate the destructive ability Carnival Awakening. Explore seven unique zones, each representing a different subgenre of horror. Participation in online modes, including co-op missions and invasions of other gamers.

Game Description Macabre plunges a squad of one to four into an unstable Rift with constantly changing maps and objectives. The key task is to find rare resources and stabilize the location before it is destroyed. The area is patrolled by a smart monster that adapts to the actions of gamers and forces them to constantly improvise. Survival depends on stealth and cunning, because outwitting this creature is the only chance, since open combat is impossible.
To succeed in Macabre, you will have to understand the intricacies of teamwork, choosing between cooperation and betrayal. A joint escape guarantees the salvation of the entire group, but the betrayal of partners promises more personal loot. Successful evacuation is a prerequisite for preserving the found items, because in the event of death, everything acquired during the sortie is lost. Help is provided by an eccentric survivor named Banjo, who offers equipment and upgrades in exchange for resources to increase the chances of success.
The enemy remembers repeated actions, making the usual tactics useless over time. This kind of gameplay forces you to resort to distractions, stunning, and even self-sacrifice as the only ways to escape. During your forays you can find powerful artifacts and unusual items from distorted timelines. Such equipment helps to reveal important information, distract the monster, or simply hold out long enough to find a way out in the unpredictable and randomly generated locations of the new Rift.

Game Description Hotel Magnate is a hotel manager simulator. You need to manage the whole process: from building a building and choosing the color of the walls - to the hire of workers and the fight against emergency situations. You can manage a luxurious hotel in the center of the metropolis, a small motel by the road or a sunny resort with a pool.
In the Hotel Magnate, everything will begin with the construction of the building: the foundation, walls, rooms and stairs. Then this should be given a unique style by gluing the wallpaper and putting the floor. They will follow furniture and other jewelry. To begin with, you will have to prepare residential rooms of several classes, a kitchen, a dining room, toilets and a reception. Additionally, a gym, a patio, a pool, a restaurant, a tennis court and much more will come out. All this will require a lot of money, but the profit from customers will rise accordingly.
The presence of some features, like a spa or bar, will affect future guests. Family couples, young travelers, business businessmen, rich snobs and generally anyone else can be settled in the hotel. Even the usual decrease in alcohol prices can fundamentally change the contingent of the inhabitants. Therefore, you should always be prepared to satisfy the needs of any guest. It is their happiness that will affect the rating of the institution, on which the flow of new customers will depend. In general, at least a casino, even a business center with conference rooms, will come out to create.
An important part will also be working staff. Each employee has an education, qualification level and salary need. Game Description TORSO TENNIS is about creating absurd but effective combinations of body parts and tattoos for total domination on the court. Players, controlling only one torso, will have to piece together a powerful tennis mechanism capable of independently generating chain reactions. The basis of everything is a synergy system inspired by auto-battlers, where some items act as triggers to activate the effects of others. This allows you to unleash spectacular combinations, turning each match into a unique event. The ultimate goal is to achieve Tennis God status by completely breaking the balance with endless trigger loops. To do this, it is necessary to acquire new limbs and apply passive improvements to the body in the form of tattoos.
Progress in matches is achieved by constantly improving your character on a grid-divided field. Limbs can be purchased from the store or taken from defeated opponents using the special Yoink mechanic. The variety of available body parts in TORSO TENNIS allows you to experiment with dozens of different builds, each offering a different approach to the match. Passive boosts from tattoos can radically change tactics, opening up new opportunities for attack and defense. You can focus on defense, aggressive attack, or weakening your opponent by, for example, littering his court with useless trash and depriving him of limbs.
Strategies for the future tennis god:
Bet on aggression by summoning creatures that will flood your opponent’s court with a hail of tennis balls. Focus on weakening by stripping the enemy of his limbs and filling his side of the field with useless trash. Choose a defensive style, fortifying your half of the field with shells to wait for the perfect moment for a devastating counterattack.

Game Description The Evelyn Game is a psychological adventure in which a young woman named Evelyn returns to her childhood house. This place, abandoned after the death of her mother, keeps not only dusty memories, but also gloomy secrets of the past. The atmosphere of an abandoned mansion is saturated with symbolism, and each object and corner can tell their history. Players have to plunge into the study of this fading family nest, where the echoes of the past sound in empty rooms, and something sinister is hidden behind the locked doors.
The central element of gameplay is the solving of puzzles closely related to the environment and history of the family. Moving in the plot, Evelyn will find subtle tips that will help her restore the picture of the long -past days and reveal the secret associated with the name that she tried so hard to forget. The Evelyn Game has no place for battles or cheap frightening techniques; Instead, the project relies on deep emotional involvement and narrative, revealing the themes of guilt, memory and forgiveness.
The gameplay is built on leisurely studying locations from a third person, where every detail is important for understanding what is happening. Visual and sound design create an oppressive and at the same time touching atmosphere, immersing in the personal drama of the heroine. Gradually revealing the secrets of the past, Evelyn is forced to face the fact that memories can be much more dangerous than any monsters, and open those doors that were sealed many years ago.

Game Description Witchy Business offers you to run your own witchcraft shop. The main task is to prepare potions for a continuous flow of customers. Daily activities include fulfilling special orders, crafting magical items, and growing your enterprise. You also need to deal with troubles, for example, casting spells on thieves trying to steal coins. The ultimate goal is to successfully manage the establishment and achieve its prosperity through high-quality service and streamlined production.
Key aspects of the witch’s craft:
Creating unique potions using recipes and experiments. Prompt customer service to maintain the establishment’s reputation. Collecting rare ingredients from your own garden and its surroundings. Protecting your store from thieves and constantly improving your business.
Preparing for a trading day at Witchy Business begins in a personal garden called the Sanctuary. There, the gamer collects flowers and herbs, and also explores the surrounding area in search of curiosities and minerals. The cooking process itself consists of combining these components in a certain sequence, following recipes or relying on experiments. The outcome of each game is determined by various mini-games. In addition, powerful wands and other magical artifacts can be made for sale.
Directly in the store, the gameplay requires speed and attention. Visitors come asking for potions and fortune telling, and their patience eventually runs out. Players must quickly fulfill orders, keep the counter clean, and feed their familiar to maintain a high reputation. This indicator influences the world around us, opening up access to new recipes. The local Bazaar features a rotating assortment of components, and shop upgrades allow you to customize the establishment and its operation.

Game Description In Wander Stars, martial artist Ringo and a scoundrel named Wolf work together to search for pieces of a legendary map across the universe. Their alliance becomes the basis for the search for Ringo’s brother and the discovery of the secrets of Wolfe’s past - a story told in 10 separate episodes. This space adventure involves forming alliances with a variety of characters, gradually creating a real family. The plot touches on themes of mystery, betrayal and redemption as the duo travels between worlds.
The basis of turn-based encounters in Wander Stars is the martial art of Kiai, which uses words to create attacks. Gamers combine vocabulary from three categories—actions like STRIKE, modifiers like SUPER, and elements like FIRE—to develop techniques. The character’s spirit level determines how many elements can be connected in one chain to perform complex techniques. Each word has a cooldown, and opponents have vulnerabilities that must be found and exploited. The vocabulary includes more than 200 items, allowing you to build strategies based on the available set.
The gameplay consists of expanding Ringo’s vocabulary and receiving Pep Ups - special battle bonuses. They are earned in fair fights, and this principle can turn former rivals into allies. Each of the ten episodes offers a location to explore with procedurally generated battles and unique events. This structure encourages re-exploration of areas to find new paths, hidden treasures and dialogues. Random elements and encounters make every adventure in this game feel different.

Game Description In A Gentlemen’s Dispute, up to 8 fighters fight in multiplaying competitions for the title of the last survivor. They use various weapons, including bits, bazuki, guns and placed traps to eliminate opponents. The action takes place on closed arenas for a simple purpose - to eliminate all other opponents. Each match is a dynamic battle with a third -person view, focusing on a direct collision and tactical placement for victory.
The strategic development between rounds is the key feature of the title a Gentlemen’s Dispute. After each battle, the players are given cards that endow them with special perks and change their abilities in the next duel. This choice allows you to make tactical adjustments and get noticeable advantages over time. Success depends on the ability of rivals to combine combat skills with accumulated bonuses from improvements, which adds an element of far -sighted planning to the gameplay.
The locations in the project are dynamic and subject to physical destruction during fights. Buildings and elements of the landscape are destroyed from explosions and blows, constantly changing the battlefield and creating new tactical possibilities. Players also need to take into account the dangers of the environment, for example, passing trains or sharks pose a threat to all rivals. These interactive elements make matches unpredictable, forcing players to adapt to a changeable landscape and at the same time reflect threats from opponents and environment.

Game Description Call to Arms: Panzer Elite puts a World War II era tank platoon under the player’s command. In the role of a German officer in 1944, you have to stop the advancing enemy forces on French territory. Players form their own armored units and lead them into battle. Control occurs from both a third and a first person to assess the situation and direct control. Gameplay focuses on platoon-level tactics during historical battles, requiring coordinated action to defeat the enemy.
The combat system in Call to Arms: Panzer Elite is based on realistic ballistics and a well-developed damage model. Battlefields are completely destructible, changing the tactical landscape as clashes progress. The 5-quest single-player campaign, available for co-op play, offers a cohesive story. As an alternative, a Skirmish mode with 9 missions is presented, allowing you to play on the German or American side. The goal is to capture key objectives using powerful weapons like the Tiger tank or StuH 42.
What awaits the commander on the battlefield:
Command an entire platoon with switchable 1st and 3rd person views. Well-developed ballistics physics and a completely destructible environment. Two modes: story and tactical missions in Skirmish. Recreation of real battles and personal fates of crew members.
The campaign recreates the pivotal events of World War II, focusing on major tank battles in the areas of Saint-Lo, Mortain and the Ardennes. A distinctive feature of the narrative is the personal crew, whose stories are revealed over time. The player will have to witness the victories and difficulties of his subordinates as they complete tasks. This project offers 20 controllable combat vehicles, and each faction has 10 historically accurate tanks and armored vehicles.

Game Description Eclipsium begins in a sunless, self-eating world. A desperate protagonist known as the Wanderer is forced to search for a mysterious figure called She. His first-person journey takes him through a series of surreal, ever-changing locations, including hellish tombs and cathedrals of flesh. The environment is unstable, and the hero must sacrifice everything to continue his search. Each place becomes a psychological test in an atmosphere of mystery and existential horror.
The central element of Eclipsium’s gameplay is exploration of the world, guided only by pale, diffuse light. There are no safe zones, and every space is designed to evoke feelings of discomfort and anxiety. The Wanderer has a unique ability - a transformative hand that can bend and change obstacles to clear the path. This power serves as the main tool for solving spatial puzzles blocking the road. Each area has its own path to the exit, requiring careful attention to discover.
What awaits the traveler in a painful eclipse:
Exploring hostile, constantly changing locations. Using a special ability to change the environment. Solving spatial puzzles to move forward. Constant psychological stress due to the lack of safe areas.
The plot is built on a faint memory of Her, whose dim light serves as a beacon in the oppressive darkness. This whisper of hope is the only motivation for a hero in a world consumed by a painful eclipse. As the game progresses, the Traveler’s senses become dulled and perceptions become unreliable, creating a psychedelic and unsettling atmosphere. The purpose of the journey remains unclear, because the guiding light may turn out to be a bait, which only deepens the main mystery of the project.

The main task is to stop the invasion of demons, passing through a series of procedurally created dungeons. Each race will require the use of unpredictable spells to destroy bizarre opponents and advance inland of chaotic locations. To survive, a quick reaction and a tactical mindset are necessary to overcome many dangers. Successful passage will save the world from the onslaught of demonic forces.
Gameplay in Folly of the Wizards is built on passing 5 levels accidentally selected from 9 available biomes. There are 4 characters-magicians to choose from, each of which has unique characteristics and vulnerabilities. The power of the hero increases with the help of objects: in the game there are 130 relics, volumes and scrolls. The relics give passive bonuses, volumes change the spontaneous damage of ordinary attacks, and scrolls open access to powerful abilities with the time of recovery. Each level ends with a battle with one of 22 unique bosses.
In addition to the battles, social interactions directly affect the course of adventure. Conversations with powerful magicians are confronted with a choice that allows you to gain strong allies or to incur their anger. The decisions made, as well as the choice of one of 4 inclinations, determine which bosses will meet in the way. Gamer’s actions are narrative to one of the 7 different endings, predetermining the result of the student’s wanderings and changing the world in accordance with the prevailing relationship.

Game Description Jump Space is a team-based first-person shooter game designed for teams of up to 4 people crewing one starship. The gameplay involves completing specific tasks in space. Gamers seamlessly switch between controlling the ship, exploring locations on foot, and moving outside the vehicle when entering airless space. Maintaining the operational condition and upgrading the overall starship is a key activity within the gameplay.
In Jump Ship, teams will take part in combat encounters that take place both on planetary surfaces and in the vacuum of space. Collecting materials by searching the area allows you to obtain components to repair the ship and upgrade its systems. The missions contain procedurally generated elements to provide variety between playthroughs. Although the project was created primarily for joint actions, its mechanics allow operations to be performed alone.
Coordination of gamers’ actions is a factor in overcoming difficulties and achieving the goals of tasks within the game. The team must work together to manage the starship’s systems during flights and battles. Adapting the equipment of the device using the found components makes it possible to customize its characteristics to specific needs or emerging threats. The continuous cycle includes moving to operational locations, performing reconnaissance or skirmish missions, monitoring the ship’s condition, and preparing for the next jump.
