Game Description Marisa of Liartop Mountain begins with Reimu’s search for her missing friend, a quest that leads the heroine to a mysterious book. This book serves as a portal into a literary world inhabited by strange inhabitants. Inside, Reimu encounters a devastated version of Marisa, openly questioning her own identity and purpose. The main task is to go through this symbolic landscape, a mountain of lies reflecting the friend’s internal conflict, in order to reveal the truth and help her return.
Journey through the pages of a book in Marisa of Liartop Mountain is built on choices and dice rolls, simulating a tabletop adventure. Important decisions and the outcome of random events guide the story along branching paths that converge on several different endings. The player will have to build an inventory of dice, collecting special items with unique properties to control the probability. This collection includes dice with high values, intentionally low values, or those with identical sides, providing strategic tools to influence the outcome of key plot points.
Throughout the adventure, four other characters offer their opinions in the form of available options, offering advice that can be helpful, pointless, or even harmful. Following their recommendations can unlock powerful dice as a reward. The gameplay allows you to spend OP on re-rolls to undo unsuccessful results. OP is earned as the level increases, but this complicates the leveling of other parameters, so the player is faced with a key choice: develop the heroine’s skills through increasing characteristics or rely on luck with re-rolls.

Game Description Sora no Kiseki the 1st follows Estelle and Joshua on their first journey through the Kingdom of Liberl. As junior Bracers, defenders of peace in the region, they travel between cities, carrying out assignments and resolving local conflicts. This activity serves as training for them, but their wanderings are also prompted by the disappearance of their father, Cassius. Along their journey, the heroes meet new allies and experience important partings, while a great destiny gradually unfolds before them.
Gameplay in Sora no Kiseki the 1st allows you to switch between two battle modes. The player can participate in direct clashes on location or engage in turn-based tactical battles. Fights take place in accordance with the order of moves of allies and opponents. Characters use a number of special skills, including unique Crafts attacks and Arts elemental magic. The adventure takes place in a 3D world, allowing you to move between cities and open fields without interruption.
The plot develops through Estelle and Joshua’s interactions with the inhabitants of the kingdom through numerous quests and a variety of additional content. Their path is shaped by the people they meet and the connections they make, creating a story that extends beyond their cruising duties. The main storyline follows the growth of two heroes, leading them to unravel the fate that awaits at the end of the journey. The characters' personal mission turns into something much more.

Game Description Dying Light: The Beast invites gamers to return to the chaotic world of Harran, but this time the story unfolds in the rural area of ​​the Castorsky forest. This new environment is a different kind. If Harran was an overgrown urban venue with high buildings and destroying infrastructure, then Castor Woods is more calm, with small towns and extensive natural spaces. This is the same dangerous world, but now with a more extensive space, in the open air, which offers new ways to combat the usual dangers.
In the center of all this is Kyle Crane, the main character of the Dying Light: The Beast series. After more than ten years of experimentation and suffering, Crane gained freedom, but with her a new battle for survival came. He has to navigate in the forest, to help those whom he meets, and to track down those who are guilty of his torment. Dying Light: The Beast is largely based on the day -night cycle - the main feature that was improved from the time of the first part.
In the afternoon, users can slowly explore the area, collect resources and plan their further actions. The environment is extensive and offers many opportunities for secrecy and strategies. However, with the onset of night, the atmosphere changes. The undead becomes more aggressive, so it is important either to escape from it or join the battle. This transition to gameplay maintains voltage, since players are never too far from danger, even in seemingly safe places.

Interaction with the local population acts as a central mechanism for the development of history.
In addition to delivery tasks, this game is revealed as an interactive adventure with a rich history. Conversations with the townspeople shed light on details about the local community, its past and unusual secrets. The atmospheric environment creates a contrast between the monotony of work and secrets awaiting their disclosure. The narrative is supplemented by the personal goal of the hero: his long -standing dream to escape from this position and leave the city.

Game Description Racers in Formula Legends have been competing in car races for several decades. The gameplay spans the period from the 1960s to the present day, offering 16 vehicle models based on historical prototypes. Races take place at 14 circuits based on famous racing locations. These tracks are not static, they change over the years and offer fresh challenges in each new era. This journey through time clearly shows the evolution of racing cars and track configurations.
Speed ​​alone is not enough to win on the track in Formula Legends. Players will have to manage strategic elements such as battery consumption, using the slipstream to overtake, and making timely pit stops. Weather conditions, such as asphalt wet from rain, affect the car’s handling and fighting tactics. The competitions feature fictional pilots based on real-life sports legends and possessing special skills.
Their abilities include careful handling of tires, mastery of driving in the rain or increased efficiency of pit stops, providing a tactical advantage. The story campaign allows players to relive key moments in racing history through a series of championships across different eras. In addition to the main narrative, in this game you can create your own races and entire seasons of competitions. The time trial mode offers you to compete for the best results in the global leaderboard. The project also supports modifications, allowing for detailed customization of the appearance of cars, helmets and even sponsor banners on the track for a personal touch.

Game Description Goblin Cleanup will turn over the idea of ​​the classic Dungeon Crawler genre. Forget about the extermination of dragons and the plunder of treasures - here you yourself put things in order. Take the role of a professional cleaner of the dungeons, who is instructed to restore order after a group of violent adventure seekers arranged a pogrom here. This is not an ordinary cleaning simulator. Time management is a key moment. You must have time to put the dungeon in order before the next group of heroes arrived. Each level poses unique tasks for you, checking your strategic planning skills and problems solving.
Be inventive - use all the tools available at your disposal to put things in order, organize and, in fact, turn the time back in the chaotic state of the dungeon. Want to go through the game alone? No problem. But it’s always more fun to clean with friends! Combine in cooperative mode and go through the dungeon together. Communication and coordinated efforts - this is the key to obtaining this sparkling stamp about cleanliness. Good news? The environment is constantly changing.
Each level offers a new experience, so you will not get stuck, wiping the same mucus from the same walls. Goblin Cleanup is a sip of fresh air for gamers who are looking for something more than ordinary trips to the dungeons. This is a bizarre turn that will make you experience strategic thinking and cleaning skills. In addition, she offers a laughing look at the consequences of epic quests. So throw a sword and a shield, take a mop and a bucket and get ready for an unforgettable unique experience in passing the dungeons.

Game Description In Hollowdeep, a trip to the world of dark fantasy with a first -person view begins. The gameplay is focused on the study of medieval dungeons inhabited by demons and undead. Battles require a quick reaction from the gamer and the exact calculation of time. The key element of the battles is the mechanics of the parry, which serves as the main protective and attacking tool. Survival often depends on the masterful possession of this technique in the fight against numerous threats that live in an ominous environment.
In the action of Hollowdeep, most opponents' attacks can be reflected: successful parrying discards enemies and makes them vulnerable for a reciprocal attack. This technique is also necessary to reflect flying shells - a key tactic for survival. The mechanics are closely related to witchcraft: each reflected blow restores part of mana, allowing you to use magic more often. Spells are also used outside the battles, helping in moving and interacting with the environment and offering alternative ways to solve riddles.
The game world is a large interconnected space with many secrets and secret moves. A careful study of locations is rewarded with valuable findings: new weapons, rings with unique properties and additional spells. Some discoveries directly expand the arsenal of character techniques. Such improvements not only increase the efficiency in battle, but also serve as keys that open the passage into previously inaccessible zones. Such a title structure motivates players to return to already familiar places with new skills for a deeper study.

Game Description Morgenstern throws players into a dark medieval world with frenetic third-person combat. Each foray takes you through hand-crafted locations and procedurally generated dungeons filled with dangerous enemies. The title is designed for both solo playthrough and chaotic joint sessions. Gamers will face constant slasher battles, where survival depends on the ability to act in dynamic skirmishes. The main task is to destroy enemies, find valuable treasures and adapt to the unpredictable conditions of each race.
A key feature of Morgenstern’s gameplay is the evacuation mechanic, which adds strategic depth to each foray. Players must decide when to move forward for better rewards and when to retreat to save their loot. The world of the project is completely destructible, allowing you to collect resources, set traps and create new routes through the environment. This system makes each playthrough unique, forming the dynamic basis of the rogue-lite structure. Together, these elements create a tactical experience that goes beyond conventional battles.
Character development occurs through completing contracts and increasing reputation, opening access to new weapons, spells and abilities. A well-developed crafting system allows you to create unique equipment for specific gaming styles, be it a tough warrior, an agile robber or a powerful mage. The multiplayer mode supports cooperative PvE, giving teams the opportunity to overcome challenges together. Alternatively, you can test your strength against other fighters in intense PvP battles, offering a different format of interaction in the same dark fantasy world.

Her past actions led to her being blackmailed into fulfilling contracts for the figures now controlling her life. Missions do not have a prescribed method of completion, allowing both rapid assaults and more tactical, slow progress. The only requirement is to complete the goal by any available means. The plot revolves around this forced service and the brutal work of Exit.
Your new responsibilities in the PIGFACE world:
Take on any dirty work. Choose your style of eliminating targets. Make money from blood to survive.
Combat scenarios are designed as sandbox missions, the completion of which earns money. This currency is the central element of progression, used to expand the heroine’s personal equipment for future operations. Resources are purchased on the Black Market, which offers access to new equipment and supplies. Each successful contract serves a dual purpose, also bringing the protagonist closer to identifying the puppeteers. Gameplay directly links performance to narrative progression and character capabilities through such an economic system.
An extensive arsenal is available for purchase, from hammers and pistols to rifles and grenade launchers. Tactical items include mines, grenades and protective equipment such as Kevlar vests. Players can also find and unlock a variety of masks throughout the world. Each mask enhances specific abilities, providing tangible combat advantages and changing the dynamics of first-person action. These elements support different approaches to the brutal and bloody encounters that define the entire gaming experience.

Battles require constant movement to evade heavy fire while using magical abilities against enemies. Survival depends on your ability to reach the final chamber, with each attempt starting over again.
The combat style in the LootMage action game is determined by the equipment found in the dungeon. The hero can find magic staves, heavy swords and magic spheres, as well as many passive artifacts. Each such artifact contains two different magical essences; Collecting a set of 2, 4 or 6 items with the same essence will activate a special synergy effect. This system allows you to create unique combinations depending on the luck and choice of the player. Different types of projectiles can be combined, further customizing the character’s attack potential.
Defeat in a dungeon results in the loss of all current equipment and forces you to start over. However, some of the achievements are retained between attempts. A special device, the Gauntlet, uses collected Mana Stones to activate Arcs that improve or change combat skills for future game sessions. Such a system of permanent development lays the foundation for power that grows over time. Ultimately, success in this game depends on a combination of random finds in the current run and constant power-ups unlocked in previous runs.

Three unique archetypes with their own deck building styles are available for playthrough: Pathfinder, Tactician and Druid.

There are over 400 different cards and a dozen artifacts available for discovery that can radically change the course of the battle. After defeating the final boss, you gain access to 20 difficulty levels, adding additional modifiers to the passage and increasing the replayability of this strategic adventure.

Game Description Jupiter Hell Classic follows the tradition of classic roguelikes with grid-based movement, turn-based combat and procedural generation. Users navigate a sci-fi environment filled with demons and use an arsenal of weapons to survive. Every action counts, as permadete ensures that mistakes are costly, forcing you to adapt to ever-changing conditions. Strategy plays a central role, and movement and positioning affect the chances of survival.
Jupiter Hell Classic builds on its predecessor while integrating elements from its modern counterpart, allowing it to update the mechanics while maintaining the essence of the original. The game was originally known as DRL, a text-based roguelike inspired by the 1993 FPS, and has gained a loyal following over the years. With the re-release, the title received an official commercial version, while the original remained free on the developer’s website.
This approach allows new users to appreciate the tactical depth of the game, and long-time fans to support further development. Gameplay focuses on smart tactical decision making, with each encounter requiring careful planning. The classic roguelike design remains intact: turn-based mechanics, randomized levels, and resource management. Weapon selection, movement, and enemy AI create dynamic scenarios that require constant adaptation. Despite its modernized presentation, the title retains the structured challenge and replay value that define its genre.

Players have to accept the command of one of the 9 factions, from the technological tau and the mysterious Eldar to the ruthless forces of Chaos, and lead them in cruel conflicts on more than 100 cards. This publication contains four full -fledged campaigns offering both linear plots and nonlinear conquests of entire planetary systems.
The gameplay is focused on the construction of bases and army management in large -scale battles for control over strategic points and powerful combat vehicles, where the defeat leads to complete destruction. Most of the innovations in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition is aimed at technical modernization. The game has been transferred to a 64-bit platform, providing stability and support for current systems. Each action must be performed with caution, since the maniac is at the top and reacts to sounds. The main task is to organize an escape from captivity before being discovered, navigating in a world recreated from an eyewitness account of real events.
SLACKJAW is based on a popular crime podcast set in 2024 and features interviews with the only known survivor. The game relies on public testimony, official crime scene photographs, and FBI materials to create its world. This connection to documented facts presents a scenario based on real circumstances. The narrative puts a person before the same test that the only victim managed to overcome within the framework of a self-contained story.
It is necessary to explore the environment to uncover the secrets buried in the kidnapper’s dungeon. Success depends on careful planning and the quiet execution of an escape attempt. The entire single-player gameplay takes an average of 1 hour to complete. During this time, the constant presence of the antagonist on the floor above creates continuous tension, because he reacts to any noise in the room below.
What you need to escape from the maniac’s basement:
Explore the gloomy environment in search of useful items. Solve clever puzzles to progress towards freedom. Maintain extreme silence so as not to attract the killer’s attention. Uncover creepy secrets hidden in the basement walls. Plan and carry out a daring escape to freedom.

Game Description This Grand Life 2 offers a unique take on the life simulation genre. Poking Water Games has gotten rid of the usual bells and whistles, focusing entirely on the financial side of existence. Gamers create characters with specific personality traits, including quirks like allergies or addiction. Adventure is not about building relationships or achieving life goals in the traditional sense. Instead, a cold, hard look at how money shapes your life.
You start from scratch or from a silver spoon, depending on your character’s background. Career choices, investments, and unexpected life events determine your financial trajectory. Every decision matters. Bankruptcy is a constant threat. The title doesn’t sugarcoat the struggle. This is a harsh reality check, an economic survival simulator. Unlike other life simulators, in This Grand Life 2 users do not hold hands. There is no clear path to success here. The world is indifferent to your aspirations.
You are left to fend for yourself, forced to navigate a complex financial ecosystem. It’s a game of risk and reward where every dollar counts. Minimalism is refreshing. Without being distracted by graphics and music, users can completely immerse themselves in the world of finance. This is a niche game that appeals to those who value a challenge and a deep dive into the mechanics of money. Whether you’re a financial geek or don’t know how to budget, the title offers a learning curve.

Game Description Is This Seat Taken? will tell the story of aspiring actor Nat, who saw a familiar silhouette on the silver screen and set off on a trip around the world. This adventure sets the stage for a series of logic challenges that focus on organizing groups of special people. The main goal is to find a suitable place for each individual according to his likes and dislikes.
Each character has unique requirements, turning simple seating charts into complex puzzles that require solutions to progress through the story and meet the hero. Locations in Is This Seat Taken? range from crowded buses and cinemas to formal wedding receptions and cramped taxis. Each new environment introduces you to bright personalities who have their own set of placement rules. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t sit next to a stranger wearing too much cologne.
The sleepy passenger needs distance from the person listening to loud music, forcing the player to read the situation and find the ideal arrangement for the entire group. Successfully organizing one company unlocks subsequent levels and advances Nat’s story from one city to another. Players can solve these fun puzzles at their own pace because there are no timers or competitive tables. The essence of the gameplay is to discover the traits of each character, from the completely recognizable to the completely outlandish, in order to overcome placement problems and continue the spiritual journey.

Game Description The Night Shift is a first-person psychological horror game that immerses you in a nightmarish work shift. Inside a department store locked down due to a storm, the only rule of survival is constant vigilance, as deadly mannequins change their position as soon as you look away from them. The hero, a newly hired employee, finds himself trapped on his first night. The storm outside activates the emergency shutters, cutting off his escape and leaving him alone with the animated dolls in the empty shopping malls.
The gameplay keeps you on the edge of your seat as you move through spacious trading floors, claustrophobic service tunnels and creepy staff rooms. To survive the night and get paid, you must complete a list of tasks given by the manager, using only a flashlight and your own wits. In The Night Shift, each shift is generated with random events, which forces you to find new paths and adapt to changing threats.
The surroundings are gradually transformed, and the once clean premises are covered with dirt and signs of decay, hinting at an ominous secret hidden within the walls of the store. The answer to what is happening lies in the details: to survive, you have to search the environment in search of keys and useful items that will help in the confrontation with an inexplicable evil. The narrative develops through notes and environmental elements, revealing the truth about the mannequins and the department store itself. The story has several possible endings, depending on the actions and decisions made during this terrible adventure, where the main goal is to survive until the morning when the store can open again.

Game Description Ascent of Ashes is an immersion in a post-apocalyptic colony where your task is to build and defend a base, survive and explore a world teeming with dangers. Here you will find real-time battles with raiders, aliens and other factions, where you need to use stealth tactics and outwit the enemy. But the base itself also requires attention: grow crops, tame alien creatures, introduce technologies and strengthen walls against enemies. Combat in this game is not easy: the detailed damage simulation and health system mean that even non-fatal wounds can render a survivor unable to continue fighting. And suppressive fire can pin the enemy in place, but the ammo spent on it can make you ineffective in the next fight.
In addition, before you is a vast world with various biomes and important objects, in which you cannot go far on foot. To survive, you will have to use vehicles, which also require constant repair and maintenance. There are also hirings of survivors who will help solve the problems of the colony. Each of them is a unique individual with his own motivation, and you, as a leader, must find an approach to each of them. The battles against various enemies in this game are also varied. Each faction has its own intelligence and tactics, so fighting with a squad of well-trained Underdog soldiers will be very different from fighting with a disorganized group of raiders.

Game Description Pip My Dice features a roguelike structure based on the Yahtzee mechanic. The main objective requires the player to accumulate a target score to progress through a series of levels. The currency earned in rounds is used to purchase new items in the store, including various dice, relics with special effects, and modifiers that change the properties of dice. Gameplay focuses on turn-based strategy and scoring principles, where decisions affect the final outcome of the session. Each game offers a unique gaming experience.
The core of Pip My Dice’s gameplay is to create synergy between a collection of dice and numerous artifacts. A key feature is the ability to individually change all 6 faces of each die, gaining control over random outcomes. The gamer can modify the numerical value of the sides of the dice, manipulating the probabilities to suit his strategy. This system requires tactical decisions about the timing and composition of purchases, forcing a balance between risk and reward.
A stock of consumables allows you to cope with adverse circumstances. Replay value is created through both set and random runs, allowing for cooperative challenges or unique playthroughs with leaderboard competition. The project contains 130 different relics, 15 starting dice cups and 50 different dice modifiers. Gamers will also have to face 20 bosses that act as key stages. As you progress through the game, slots for combinations can be upgraded to increase your points.

Each ice-cold dessert served determines the further development of the plot, opening new branches of dialogue and relationships. Objects and scattered notes left by guests serve as fragments of a large mosaic, by collecting which one can understand their past. Gradually, these details not only form a closer connection with each client, but also reveal the truth about this unusual world and its inhabitants.
The owner of the establishment, having lost his voice, embarks on a journey to restore his identity in a monochrome world under the guidance of the mysterious Raven. It is at Yume Kakigori that an icy treat becomes the only way to express oneself and a tool for building trusting bonds. Through the creation of desserts for guests, the protagonist confronts emotions that cannot be expressed in words. This quiet journey is aimed at regaining not only speech, but also the sense of self, lost along with the ability to speak.
The communication process is based on mixing three syrups, symbolizing Emotion, Desire and Thought, to create unique recipes that convey complex feelings. The gameplay suggests not just following the instructions, but interpreting the meaning of each combination, because the same taste can carry different shades of meaning depending on the client’s situation. Deciphering these nuances and choosing a treat that most accurately reflects inner feelings forms the basis of this narrative experience, where dessert becomes a real message from the heart.

It is he who decides where to place buildings, while each city independently manages the needs of residents and maintains its own budget. The central structure, the castle, can be improved over time, and it is also necessary to organize the protection of trade routes from robbers attracted by the generated income.
The economic model in Let Them Trade gives cities the ability to operate with a certain amount of independence. These settlements automatically trade resources among themselves, creating a flow of goods throughout the map. The gamer receives a percentage of the taxes collected from these business transactions. A settlement’s profit influences the amount of tax paid, with more affluent settlements contributing more. The happiness of citizens is another factor, because a satisfied population ensures high fees, increasing revenue.
The main task is to protect cities from robbers attracted by the accumulation of valuables. The central lock can be used to purchase items needed for all sorts of upgrades. Strategic decisions determine when to sell specific products for immediate profit and when to hold onto them for better times. The game offers a variety of scenarios, each of which introduces different starting conditions and challenges, creating unique situations to play through.

Game Description Slidemagi is a duel between the two magicians on the 10x10 board, where units move by shifting the entire grid lines. The main task is to defeat the enemy magician in battle or exterminate all enemy forces in a separate mode with waves, allowing the use of various approaches.

The dead creature leaves behind a grave that blocks its line in place, and the necromancer is able to use these points to resurrect the dead. Such mechanics allow you to launch chain reactions, for example, destroying the enemy and resurrecting the fallen ally in one move, which changes the situation on the board.

You have to create heroes, systematically improve their parameters and interact with mechanics based on the principles of role-playing projects and racing action games.
Each title in the collection poses unique challenges, ranging from turn-based tactical battles to navigation using in-game physics. In Swords and Souls Legacy Collection, one of the projects is an RPG hybrid, tasking the player with creating a Soul and then improving its abilities through a variety of mini-game training. After careful preparation, the hero tests his strength in duels with a series of opponents in the arena, gradually striving to rise in the overall ranking of fighters.
The other two titles are fast-paced runners, offering the role of an agile robber traversing urban landscapes, jumping between buildings, avoiding traps and facing off against guards while collecting loot. Their continuation introduces multi-level locations, new enemies and encounters with unique bosses. A different experience is an action racing game where the challenge is to outwit pursuing police forces during a 42-mile drive to the border. A customizable car is under control, breaking through road barriers and fighting off airborne attacks along the entire route.

Finding every fragment of the Heart of the Void is the main goal, because assembling it will reveal the secret. Strategic planning of actions in order to outsmart enemies and remain undetected.

Game Description Astro Prospector puts the player in command of a ship with a dual mission: resource extraction and direct confrontation with the corporation. Primary activities include forays into asteroid fields to obtain materials called cofferoids controlled by SpaceCorp. In addition to collecting valuables, the key goal of the mission is to capture AstroCoffee seeds from the structure’s storage facilities. This creates a conflict in which the gamer’s actions represent a campaign to free the product from monopoly for the benefit of humanity.
Astro Prospector’s gameplay is structured like an incremental bullet hell game where survival and progression are closely linked. You need to navigate through 25 different zones, each of which presents unique enemy vehicles and ends with a boss battle. Opposing forces actively impede progress by filling the screen with projectiles, requiring constant maneuvering to avoid destruction. The challenge is to dodge attacks while disabling vehicles deployed by SpaceCorp, combining flight mechanics with shooter elements.
Leveling up is controlled by an upgrade system focused on the starship, which is the only tool for mining and combat. An extensive skill tree opens the way to increasing the ship’s power and gaining special functions as you progress in the game. New abilities and skills are acquired not only by spending what has been accumulated, but also by completing specific tasks and systematically destroying automated divisions of the corporation. With over 100 individual upgrades to implement, the ship undergoes constant incremental improvements to enhance its combat effectiveness against a powerful enemy.

Game Description Kaizen: A Factory Story introduces David Sugimoto, a South Bend, Indiana native who moves to Japan in 1986 to pursue a career at Matsuzawa Manufacturing. He arrives with an eye on an executive position in international sales, an opportunity available during the country’s economic expansion. Those hopes are dashed when he is sent not to the corporate office, but to one of the company’s old factories on the outskirts of Tokyo.
Without further ado, he is assigned the role of assembly line designer, a position that requires special logical abilities. The project structure places the individual in the position of a beginner who must adapt to the specific requirements of factory process automation. The core gameplay of Kaizen: A Factory Story is a simulation of industrial processes on a hexagonal grid. Players construct automated systems by programming individual machines to weld, rivet, cut, and drill components in precise sequences.
The goal is to build a functional, streamlined assembly line for iconic 1980s products including calculators, camcorders and arcade machines. The title offers tools for documenting and sharing successful solutions with others by exporting animated GIFs showing pipelines in action. To take your mind off the main design tasks, the game includes an additional mode. It’s a pachinko-themed solitaire game called Pachi-Sol that offers its own logic puzzles. It serves as an in-game activity, providing the opportunity to face a different type of challenge while remaining in the world of this simulator.

Game Description Brickadia is a multiplayer casual sandbox where you can build and play however you want - either alone or with your friends. Thanks to an intuitive interface and an ever-expanding collection of bricks, you can build anything - from skyscrapers to spaceships, the only limit is your imagination! But this game is not only about construction. A flexible system of rules and a huge arsenal of weapons allow you to turn any structure into a battlefield. Have a duel with friends or create your own server with unique rules for anyone who wants to join.
But what if the construction is not yours? No problem! Brickadia has a lot of ready-made experiences from other players. Explore the world alone or with friends, and maybe even add something of your own to the ready-made designs. And that’s not all! You can create interactive designs with buttons, switches, doors, lights and much more using wire logic. You don’t need to be a programmer to create complex puzzles, scary traps, or exciting chains of actions. And if you need even more advanced systems, then Brickadia offers a powerful scripting language called Behaviors that will help bring any of your ideas to life.

Game Description Fever Meme is a journey into the mind where behind the façade of absurdity and parody lies a deep personal story. Surrounded by white walls and checkerboard floors, a path begins that leads far beyond the normal gaming experience. From time to time, fragments of phrases appear on the screen - emotional messages and requests for help, hinting at the author’s inner experiences. The initial guide in this strange world is a skeleton in a fedora named Salvador, whose actions immediately set the tone for the entire subsequent adventure, full of unexpected turns and metaphors.
The narrative is purposefully disrupted, throwing the user from one extreme to the other. A classic platformer that requires extreme concentration can suddenly give way to a surreal game show where the contestant has to face a giant spider. This constant change of genres is not just a satire on established canons, but an artistic device that reflects internal chaos. The Fever Meme project makes you constantly doubt what is happening, offering puzzles whose solutions are beyond the bounds of conventional logic.
The central mechanic is the complete breaking of the fourth wall, creating a unique connection between the gamer and the creator. The title tracks actions and remembers previous mistakes, using this information to further develop the metaplot. Interaction with the environment reaches a new level, where the very nature of the relationship between the author and his audience is explored. This approach puts the project on a par with such works as The Stanley Parable and Undertale, but with its own unique view of interactive art, filled with humor and at the same time tragedy.

Game Description Grocery Store Tycoon allows you to build and manage a retail business starting from scratch. The player can switch between a first-person view for direct interaction and a free camera view to guide the store from above. The gameplay makes it possible to independently work at the checkout or arrange products on shelves. You can carry boxes from the warehouse one at a time or use a cart to transport large quantities to replenish inventory and keep shelves from emptying.
The development of a retail outlet in Grocery Store Tycoon occurs through the purchase and installation of equipment. The gamer purchases shelving, refrigerators, freezers and cash registers to furnish the room. Experience gained by working, passively accumulating or completing tasks opens up access to new types of products, management tools and the chance to buy out other stores. Human resource management involves hiring workers, assigning them to positions and controlling their mood, which depends on the work assigned to them and the salary; employees may resign if these conditions are not met.
For a successful gaming experience, customer satisfaction is important - an indicator that depends on the availability of the goods they need and the time spent inside. Maintaining order in the establishment, including returning carts, general cleaning and equipment maintenance, impacts the operation of the establishment. The interactive interface provides data on visitor statistics, supply and demand for specific products, and prices. This system allows you to view the status of equipment and manage worker tasks, which is a key element of the entire game.

Organizing space begins with thoughtful placement of furniture and decor from inventory. The key is to place objects strategically without overlapping. A prestige system that opens up access to bonuses upon repeated playthroughs.
Arriving at an empty plot of land with just a few things in the van, you have to create your own space from scratch. CRUFT’s minimalistic 2D style offers an extensive catalog of crafting recipes, opening up ample opportunities for self-expression. The project encourages creative freedom, allowing you to shape the environment according to personal preferences. Game Description ACTION GAME MAKER is a set of tools for developing 2D action games. As part of a software series, it is structured for use by professionals with varying levels of game design experience. The system provides access to functions without the need for programming knowledge. This toolkit is built on the Godot Engine and includes a collection of samples and assets to lay the foundation for future projects. This opens up opportunities for creating both small experimental titles and more developed gameplay mechanics.
The toolkit runs on an enhanced node-based visual scripting system. This approach eliminates the need for programming experience, making it possible to assemble game logic in a visual format. Creators connect elements called Actions to form the operating rules for their creation. This system allows you to quickly prototype and test concepts, bringing ideas to life in an interactive manner without delay. In ACTION GAME MAKER, this visual process is the central method for building mechanics, although GDScript support is also provided for those who want to go beyond this.
Developers can structure their titles as side-scrolling or top-down projects. This core choice is suitable for a variety of genres, including platformers and adventures. The range of genres is expanding with support for horror, shooters and puzzles, which gives users greater creative freedom to realize their concepts. The software uses the 2D pipeline from Godot Engine 4.3, and its key features include an interface modeled after Godot’s UI. To design game levels, a tile map editor with an auto-tiling function is also available, which greatly simplifies the process of creating detailed locations.

Game Description The Alters is a science fiction adventure that immerses in the world of choice and consequences. Imagine yourself stuck on an unfriendly planet, where there is no one to rely on, except for your own ingenuity. This is the intriguing plan of this innovative game, which immerses in the world of parallel lives and alternative realities. Going on this journey, you take on the role of Jan Dolsky, a worker who made an emergency landing on a foreign world and is now facing the problem of survival and salvation.
To cope with this dangerous situation, Jan creates clones of himself, known as “alter”. They have individuality and history, which is influenced by decisions that he made or could make GG throughout their lives. It is necessary to manage relations between these doubles that have various skills, goals and emotions. Switching between alter allows you to use their unique abilities to solve puzzles, overcoming obstacles and fighting opponents. You can also interact with them, plunging into their individual stories and influencing decisions.
It is extremely important to approach each action with caution, since the choice will have far -reaching consequences for both you and the changed ones. The Alters goes beyond the traditional game experience, serving as a deep study of personality, choice and fate. She encourages players to think about what could happen, they make other decisions in their lives, and how they could affect their present. Self -analysis is also encouraged, offering players to identify similarities and differences among themselves and doubles, ultimately asking the question of what really determines their uniqueness.

Game Description Scope X provides the ability to zoom in real time to any selected area of ​​the computer screen, serving as a tool for improving visual access. This lightweight software is designed to improve image clarity for PC gamers and other users across the entire display area. Its central goal is to instantly zoom into specific areas, revealing important details in any active game, without interrupting the process.
The utility operates through an overlay, allowing it to work independently of the running software and enlarging the image directly from the monitor. Scope X functionality is controlled through an optimized overlay with all the necessary settings. Gamers can assign and customize keyboard and mouse combinations, allowing them to quickly activate zoom based on their personal preferences. A key feature is the adjustable focus ring - a graphic marker that can be personalized by changing its color, size and transparency.
In addition, the system contains subtle sensitivity controls for the zoom mechanism itself, offering detailed control over its behavior. The software is designed for universal compatibility, working together with other programs and without requiring direct integrations or dependencies. This is achieved using image rendering technology similar in principle to recording and accessibility software. Since scaling is based on working across all windows, it does not modify game files or interfere with the processes of other running software.

It’s like choosing tools for a job, only the job here is to exterminate nightmarish creatures and navigate a treacherous world.

Game Description Pieces of me begins with Grisha’s return to his hometown in 2009. He is going to visit his younger sister, but does not find her or any signs of his usual life on the spot. The streets look familiar, but there is no movement in them. There is silence all around and rare traces, as if someone left them on purpose, trying to convey something. The school building, in which the most difficult and memorable years passed, is greeted with the absence of sounds and a strange feeling, as if something was left unfinished here.
As soon as he crosses the threshold, memories begin to manifest and interfere with the present. Pieces of me turns into an inward journey - an experience in which the gamer has to not so much explore space as make his way through his own past. Every room, every turn resonates with something personal. The atmosphere is not based on dialogue, but on the feeling of an approaching collision with what has been repressed. Everything that happens seems to emerge from memory, coming to life as we move forward.
This project raises topics that are rarely talked about directly: loss, pain, worn-out experiences. Plot elements are not explained directly - they are gathered through actions and hints. Things fall into place not according to logic, but according to the internal state of the hero. This interactive thriller doesn’t separate the past from the present—it stitches them together. In order to move on, the player will have to not just remember, but go through again what was left behind long ago.

Game Description Rift Riff throws gamers into the cracks between worlds to battle monsters and collect valuables. Gameplay is built around tower defense, requiring careful placement and control of structures. Before the start of the mission, you will have to determine a set of defense structures and then build them on the map at the designated points.
A key aspect of Rift Riff is selecting defensive structures to counter enemy types and their attacks. The monsters come in waves, their target is either the main Extractor module or any fortifications nearby. A resource called “juice” is obtained during attacks; it is needed to build and upgrade defenses before and during battles. Reflecting attacks brings prisms that open passages to new worlds, access to other buildings, satellites and improvements. This title contains several mechanics to support it.
If there is not enough juice for immediate installation, construction can be planned. An incorrectly installed structure may be dismantled with a refund of all costs. A destroyed tower will reappear at no cost after the wave ends. Losing the Extractor will force you to replay only the last wave, and not the entire mission. If difficulties arise, you can collect some juice by interacting with objects like flowers in the location. The project offers 15 kingdoms, each with 2 or more missions. The arsenal consists of 14 types of towers with 6 upgrades for them.

The world is a mixture of charming and creepy, forcing you to be on your guard as you move between quaint cafes and monster-infested dungeons. The combat system is where it gets interesting. It is a cross between a classic turn-based strategy and a real-time action game. You choose your attacks, but when the fight heats up, be ready to dodge, parry and parry in real time.
It’s all about thinking several moves ahead while reacting on the fly - one wrong decision and your carefully laid plan will go to waste (literally, if the enemy has a fire spell). So if you’re looking for an RPG that throws out the rules and forces you to be on your toes, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 could be your next adventure. It’s a world full of secrets, dangers and maybe even a beret or two. Just remember: when the Painter raises her brush, be prepared for a bang.

Game Description Armored Brigade II features real-time 3D tactical combat focused on combined arms operations during the Cold War, spanning 1965–1991. The project uses an extensive database and large terrain maps recreated from real European locations. The control process allows for both real-time with pause and turn-based formats, combining strategic depth with accessibility for beginners. The title offers a detailed simulation environment suitable for gamers of varying skill levels looking for authentic period-era combat.
Armored Brigade II places a central focus on Command, Control and Communications (C3) systems. Their work determines how quickly orders reach the executors, introducing an element of realistic delay into the gameplay. The duration of this interval depends on the training of the crews and soldiers, the chosen military doctrine and the distance to the command post. This feature directly affects strategic planning and the speed of reaction of troops to a changing situation, creating a tense atmosphere during battles. Combat formations are controlled through a combination of general directives and standard operating procedures. In addition, dynamic changes in weather and lighting significantly affect the effectiveness of combat vehicles and the range of vision, which requires players to be flexible in tactics and able to adapt to battle conditions.
The game features extensive maps of Europe, created from satellite topographic data and historical materials, which opens up the possibility of large-scale maneuver combat scenarios. Battles can involve forces from individual platoons to several battalions operating simultaneously in these spaces. There are over 1,000 different ground and air vehicles available, each modeled with operational characteristics such as weapon guidance systems and turret rotation speed. Reworked mechanics improve coordination of fire support and interaction of infantry in the theater of operations. Gamers use these resources in single-player skirmishes, dynamic multi-stage operations, or story-driven linear campaigns.

Game Description A Merchant’s Promise places the player in a stylized medieval setting focused on commerce and transportation through the direct physical handling of objects. Game Description Warm Monkey is about a desperate struggle for survival in the heart of a concrete jungle, where a troop of small monkeys multiplies under the scorching sun. Instead of the traditional health scale, there is an inexorably decreasing thirst indicator, forcing you to constantly look for saving moisture. The behavior of their relatives, appearing every 10 seconds, is unpredictable: they can fall from a height or run out onto the roadway under the wheels of scooters. Any individual whose color has changed to red is on the verge of death, requiring immediate access to water.
The main task is to travel through the entire city to the south in order to ultimately reach the sea coast. The world of Warm Monkey is an isometric 3D labyrinth without pre-defined routes. You have complete freedom to move around the exotic metropolis: you can climb trees and buildings, jumping from one roof to another. Survival here depends entirely on intuition and the ability to navigate the complex urban terrain.
Success directly depends on the ability to find sources to quench your thirst, scattered throughout the territory. As the group size increases, the overall need for water also increases, making the search for large bodies of water a priority goal. The loss of the lead ape does not mean the end, as the closest surviving teammate immediately takes its place, continuing the mission. The passage ends if the entire flock dies before reaching the goal.
The project offers not only survival, but also an arcade scoring system that rewards acrobatic stunts and the duration of the race. Additional points are awarded for exploring locations, discovering monumental structures and reaching great heights. The passage is available in cooperative mode for up to 4 people, where well-coordinated teamwork and coordination of actions become the key to overall success.

Before the fighter’s progress, a gamer can choose an option for Rotation or Stay to control the detachment. The choice of Rotation shifts the location of all allies after the completion of the action, while Stay maintains their current construction. The priority of the moves is displayed on the screen, allowing strategic adjustments, for example, to put forward a character with high protection to the vanguard to intercept the attack or move a weak partner to a rearguard.
The offensive gameplay is focused on the Download team, which allows you to strike at one of 3 points on the enemy’s body. Having entered a vulnerable place causes critical damage and fills a special indicator. After three successful ones, the Download, the Ruin Gauge scale reaches the maximum, activating the crushing mode of the Ruin Mode. This condition allows you to call on characters with powerful skills, which makes it possible to cause tremendous damage and potentially complete the battle with one decisive onslaught, radically changing the gameplay.

With a price on your head, you find yourself on the run in the Starbelt, a collection of habitats built in the asteroid belt and relentlessly pursued by their creators. The world is full of difficult decisions, dubious contracts and the constant need to balance survival and moral choices.
Here you take over an old, battered ship and assemble a motley crew of unique characters. Each team member has their own skills and backstory, and it’s your job to keep them alive by completing various risky contracts. The work ahead is dangerous: from asteroid exploration to risky robberies, and each of them is fraught with its own difficulties. How you manage your crew, ship, and resources can mean the difference between success and failure.
The core mechanics of Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector revolve around rolling dice that determine the outcome of your actions. Every decision you make - whether it’s upgrading a ship, recruiting a new crew, or completing a mission - depends on your luck and available resources. There is a lot of freedom in the game; the gamer himself determines the direction of his journey through the Star Belt. Although things never go according to plan, it is part of the exciting process of exploring this ever-changing world.

Game Description The Stone of Madness is a real-time tactical stealth game that immerses gamers in the claustrophobic halls of an 18th century Spanish monastery. In the bleak setting of a Jesuit stronghold deep in the Pyrenees, five prisoners must combine their skills to overcome a web of fear, paranoia and supernatural threats. With their lives on the line, they must confront their own traumas and the madness that threatens to consume them. Target? Escape - if, of course, they manage to maintain their sanity long enough.
Here you control five different characters, each of which has unique abilities. Whether it’s sneaking around in the shadows, casting spells, or distracting enemies, characters offer a variety of tactics to overcome every obstacle. But it’s not just about physical strength - mental health plays an important role. Character phobias and traumas, such as fear of the dark or the sight of blood, can trigger mental breakdowns that affect gameplay.
Keep an eye on the sanity of each character as you travel through the monastery, otherwise they may succumb to paranoia or, worse, become cruel or irrational. The structure gives gamers the opportunity to experience two separate campaigns, each offering different stories and challenges. Time also plays an important role: during the day, actions are less risky, since the guards are distracted, and the night brings its own dangers, as paranormal forces roam the corridors.

Game Description Behind Glass: Aquarium Simulator, as the name suggests, is an aquarium simulator. The title allows you not only to admire underwater inhabitants, but also to engage in construction. Thanks to this game, owners of real aquariums from real life will be able to recreate them in a digital environment and share their creations with other users. Players are allowed to rotate objects and adjust their sizes. In addition, here you can set the lighting by installing lamps and adjusting the color, angle, radius and light intensity separately for each of them. Users also have access to a wide range of algae and other plants. There are also plenty of stones and other decorations here. There is also the ability to change the background of the room.
Behind the Glass: Aquarium Simulator can be used instead of a screensaver (like those found on older operating systems) on the first or second screen using windowed mode. This indie project features 87 creatures, including freshwater saltwater fish and crabs. They interact with the environment and each other, and do so realistically thanks to elaborate animation. In the built-in virtual crossbreeding laboratory, you can recolor these creatures and breed hybrid individuals. They are also allowed to feed them here. The gameplay is accompanied by realistic sound effects and relaxing background music.

Seventy percent of the continent is under water, and two young islanders named Rod and Axel find themselves in the center of the crisis. Their mission is to catch the mysterious Seaaz, which is an important part of the plan to prevent the return of a nightmare of biological weapons - a black dragon. Forget about idyllic fishing. Sea fantasy throws a fishing rod into a desperate struggle for survival. Noticing Seaaz is only the beginning.
Gamers need to build a marker, accurately abandon the fishing rod and fight to deplete the health of the creature. But the adventures do not end there. In the flooded remains are the islands abounding with hidden dungeons. They hide traps and treasures that only wait for them to be excavated. Of the seaaz caught, players can create even more advanced tools, as well as fight with formidable bosses, which adds another level of complexity.
Sea Fantasy challenges the fishing genre. This is not a peaceful day on the lake. This is a frantic struggle with a ticking clock. Each casting of fishing line is a gambling game, each Seaaz caught is a potential piece of puzzle for salvation of mankind. The fate of the world hangs in the balance, and the secret of how to stop the Black Dragon can be hidden in the flickering scales of these water creatures. Freenses of the genus and Axel turn into a weapon, and their catch from a simple dish turns into a potential tool for salvation.

Game Description Amenti will take gamers deep into the heart of Ancient Egypt. The journey begins with the protagonist, a historian and photographer, entering the newly discovered tomb of Pharaoh Rudamon, hidden 50 meters below the surface of the earth. According to the plot, if the tomb is disturbed, the spirit of the pharaoh and his royal family will move into it, which will mark the beginning of an unfolding disaster. Descending into dark labyrinthine corridors, users will encounter history and secrets while trying to decipher the secrets left behind.
The plot is based on research. The main character is not just an observer, but also an investigator tasked with uncovering the truth about an ancient tomb and its eerie connection with extraterrestrial forces. Amenti doesn’t hold back on the weird and unsettling, expertly relying on supernatural elements. Users are encouraged to delve into the past, but in doing so they are faced with the terrifying possibility that they may not be alone.
The tomb is alive, with secrets hidden in plain sight just waiting to be revealed - if the player dares to look closely. What sets the title apart from other adventure games is its unique use of photography. While the gamer wanders through the endless corridors of the tomb, he is given the opportunity to take pictures of various objects and symbols. At first, these pictures may seem like just creepy, incomprehensible shots, but they will get better as you go.

Game Description Tactics of World War I, as the name suggests, uses the setting of the First World War. The game covers the entire period of the large-scale conflict (from 1914 to 1918). It is a real-time tactical strategy game. The video game is dedicated to the Western Front. It has 2 campaigns. They allow you to fight on the side of Great Britain and Germany, respectively. This video game features historical battles that actually took place. For example: there is the Battle of Passchendaele. The mini-map helps you navigate situations on the battlefield. The player can change the camera angle and scale the image.
Since this is a real-time tactics game and not a classic RTS, there is no way to mine resources, build a base, or create troops. In Tactics of World War I, you have to take care of your equipment and fighters, because you won’t be able to endlessly make up for losses. To minimize losses, it is necessary to perform flanking maneuvers, cover the infantry, conduct suppressive fire, hide soldiers in trenches or behind other cover, and resort to various tricks. More than a dozen units are available in the indie strategy: the very first tanks, machine gunners, cavalry, mortars, and so on. Each faction has their own. The user receives 8 units before the start of the battle and distributes them. 6 of them can immediately enter battle, and the remaining 2 will be in reserve.

Game Description Make Good Choices puts gamers in the awkward position of having to solve an unnervingly simple task: getting home. What seems like a simple journey down a quiet street quickly turns into an intense task of survival. Each step along the way presents a new set of obstacles, often unexpected, forcing gamers to constantly evaluate their choices. Although the story is based on a walk down a single street, the tension that builds throughout the game is palpable as a seemingly mundane environment turns into something much more sinister.
The simplicity of the environment creates an atmosphere of anxiety, because users are never sure what is hiding around the corner. At Make Good Choices, every decision matters. The title is built as a walking simulator, which, at first glance, may seem frivolous. However, gamers soon discover that the lack of save points adds a layer of pressure that makes the stakes high. One wrong choice can send the user back to the beginning or, even worse, lead to a much more dangerous outcome.
This mechanic reinforces the idea that there is no room for mistakes, and every decision is of great importance to the user’s progress. Gamers must navigate locations carefully, thinking ahead, facing the unknown. The duration is variable, usually lasting from 15 to 60 minutes. However, the tension that reigns in the game can make the user feel much longer. Patience is key and you will easily find yourself second guessing every step.

Game Description Alice Mesmerizing Episodes of Neurosis (Amen) sends a gamer for the psychological horizon of events - a point of no return. The main character, Alice, is experiencing the decay of her own personality, presented as a necessary but painful process. This journey looks like an escape from the abyss, immersion in a deeply personal and abstract inner world. The key goal is to lead the girl through the anxious environment, help her cross the symbolic path and find the key personifying liberation.
Promotion at Alice Mesmerizing Episodes of Neurosis (Amen) depends on the ability to find objects hidden in locations. The gameplay is built on the mechanics of searching for hidden objects that requires carefully inspecting static scenes in search of the necessary things for further passage. Such a Point-And-Click interaction directly helps Alice overcome trials. Each successful find contributes to the destruction of the symbolic constructions of its neurosis, gradually moving forward an abstract plot and opening the next segment of its route.
The plot base is borrined by motives from the works of Lewis Carroll, rethinking familiar elements for the study of mental states. Heroes from the country of miracles, such as the Red Queen, a crazy hatchman, a white rabbit and a caterpillar, appear symbolic figures in Alice’s mind. These meetings are not a direct retelling of the original stories, but reflect the various facets of its internal conflict. Contacts with surrealistic inhabitants become the key to understanding and overcoming the difficulties in the world of this game, acting as a manifestation of its subconscious.

Game Description Lands of Mine is a story about survival after an unforeseen disaster that occurs as a result of a collision between a spaceship and an asteroid. The cause of the crash was a momentary inattention of the pilot, who was carried away by the passage of another entertainment project. Waking up in an unfamiliar place, the hero is forced to adapt to the harsh conditions of an alien planet. Now the main task is to return to space, for which we have to go through a long technological path, restoring lost knowledge and constructing a new starship almost from scratch. This adventure can be shared with a friend, exploring a mysterious world and fighting underground monsters together.
Deep below the surface there is life, but it is not always friendly. Battles with hostile dungeon dwellers, both small and large, force you to constantly improve your combat skills. To survive and successfully mine in the Lands of Mine, you need to create new weapons and durable armor from the materials you find. Making his way through various geological layers, the protagonist discovers not only valuable resources for crafting, but also unique abandoned structures that keep their secrets and offer new challenges for the gamer.
Progress is significantly accelerated by the construction of full-fledged bases and the creation of entire factories that automate routine processes such as smelting ore and crafting complex components. This approach allows you to avoid tedious work and leave your mark on this earth. Interaction with non-player characters opens up opportunities for establishing trade and making investments that contribute to the future development of the established settlement.

The project skillfully combines elements of a walking simulator with platforming, requiring the player not only to pay attention to detail, but also good spatial thinking to further move through strange worlds.

A visual style that emulates PSX-era graphics and found-footage aesthetics. A meditative exploration of surreal liminal spaces. An atmospheric soundtrack that enhances the feeling of unsettling unpredictability. Deep subtext dedicated to the problems of ecology and the future of humanity.

Game Description Tibor: The Tale of the Good Vampire is a bright platformer about a cute little vampire traveling through various locations and encountering numerous enemies, including otherworldly evil spirits from myths and fairy tales. The game is based on the fairy tale of the same name by Croatian writer Damir Čivrak. The story is characterized by morality and valor, placing at the center of the plot characters who have been considered evil for centuries.
The gameplay of Tibor: Tale of a Kind Vampire is inspired by classic arcade games, including Mario, The Lion King and others. Many mechanics are borrowed straight from old-school platform hits. Since the project is based on a children’s audience, there is no violence, cruelty or blood in the game. Tibor: The Tale of the Good Vampire is an instructive story about overcoming difficulties and how you need to be able to fight back against offenders, using not so much strength, but rather intelligence. Gameplay Features:
5 bright and rich locations; 25 main campaign levels; 10 types of enemies, including black cats, bats, spiders, frogs, thieves and others; staged cutscenes using the game engine; an original soundtrack featuring 25 minutes of upbeat tunes; Lots of collectibles: coins, gems, lotions, etc.

Game Description Glorious Companions immerses gamers in the vast and ever-changing world of Navaroth. The title is characterized by procedural generation, thanks to which there is something different to be found in each journey, be it collecting vault crystals or navigating complex political landscapes. You lead a team of experienced mercenaries and the stakes are high. The goal is to defeat the Wrath of Xandar by collecting Vault Crystals scattered throughout the world while engaging in combat, strategic planning, and resource management.
The combination of these elements gives the game a layered and dynamic feel from start to finish. At its core, Glorious Companions is a mixture of traditional RPG elements with tactical turn-based combat. Combat is far from simple: success depends on how well you manage your companions, balance their skills, and equip them with the right gear. The mercenaries you command belong to two different factions, each with unique powers and abilities.
Recruiting and training soldiers to fill the ranks of your squad is a central aspect. You can also visit merchants in towns to buy weapons and armor, or collect gear from fallen enemies, making every encounter an opportunity to improve your team. This flexibility is very important, because every decision about which character to level up or what equipment to buy can dramatically affect the outcome of the mission.

Game Description Poveglia The Island of Non Return is a psychological thriller that plunges into the atmosphere of the abandoned Italian island of Poveglia, where the protagonist will have to face the horrors of the past. Forced to explore the dark ruins of a former mental hospital and plague quarantine, the character must solve puzzles and avoid the dangers that lurk in the darkness. The environment is explored from a third-person perspective, and the gameplay requires the gamer not only to pay attention to detail to find clues, but also to manage limited resources to survive.
The storyline develops non-linearly, revealing the secrets of the island through found documents and sudden visions that blur the line between reality and madness. The atmosphere of oppressive loneliness in Poveglia: The Island of Non Return is enhanced by a dynamic soundtrack, where every rustle can foreshadow a mortal threat. The history of this place, known as Ghost Island, is closely intertwined with the personal drama of the main character - a journalist investigating the disappearance of his partner, who disappeared here under mysterious circumstances.
Moving deeper into the cursed territory, the hero discovers evidence of cruel experiments carried out by the hospital’s chief physician, and realizes that the island itself is a hostile entity. Every decision made affects the character’s mental state, and confronting supernatural forces will require not only the use of found weapons, but also ingenuity to solve complex mysteries left by the souls of hundreds of thousands of dead. This project makes you go through an unforgettable experience, balancing on the brink between investigation and the fight for your own life.

Game Description Talented is an arcade roguelite shoot ‘em up that throws gamers into a chaotic world where survival is key. The project revolves around the character Ed, who will spend 20 nights on the infamous Demon Conveyor Belt (D.C.B). Each night presents him with new challenges as waves of enemies come inexorably, and Ed can only adapt and use a combination of abilities and upgrades to stay alive.
The randomness-focused structure makes each session feel different, as no two playthroughs are the same. Once immersed, users quickly realize that survival depends not only on skills, but also on choosing the right combination of talents and strategies. What sets Talented apart from other games in the genre are the randomly generated skill trees that accompany each play. Due to the ever-changing nature of these skill trees, users never settle into a predictable rhythm.
Each time you start a new run, you’re presented with different abilities, talents, and upgrades, forcing you to think on your feet and adapt quickly. The title offers a wide choice: from spells that incinerate enemies in the blink of an eye, to abilities that allow you to manipulate time itself. The array of customization options is wide enough to suit a variety of styles, and the randomness keeps the game unpredictable, forcing you to be on your guard. With six different character classes, the title offers gamers an extra layer of challenge.

Game Description SGS Battle of the Bulge simulates WW2 fighting in the Ardennes that began on December 16, 1944. The project depicts the Nazi offensive known as Watch on the Rhine, later renamed Autumn Mist, which targeted Allied supply routes through Antwerp. These events led to the conflict known as the Battle of the Bulge, which lasted until January 1945, including retaliatory operations by the anti-Hitler coalition.
The simulation covers the period of both the German attack and the subsequent enemy reaction. Commanding German troops in SGS Battle of the Bulge, the gamer controls the 5th and 6th Tank Armies, as well as the 7th Army, which amounts to over twenty divisions assembled from the available resources of Germany. The objective is to carry out a surprise attack through American defensive formations to quickly capture positions along the Meuse River.
Success requires eliminating opposing units before allotted supplies are exhausted, which is a race against time. Achieving these objectives would disrupt Allied operational plans in the West, although this strategy does not include Hitler’s plan to capture Antwerp, concentrating only on the units historically involved in the Battle of the Bulge. The Allied command’s representation poses a different challenge, starting with the eighth corps' four divisions along a 120-kilometer front. Reinforcements, including elements of Patton’s 3rd Army and the British 30th Corps under Montgomery, arrive over time.

Game Description Chrysalis is a roguelike strategy game whose gameplay is divided into two contrasting phases. Initially, the protagonist, in the guise of a disembodied spirit, explores procedurally generated locations, inhabiting friendly creatures and collecting resources. After the timer expires, the calm garden atmosphere is replaced by an ominous one, and waves of aggressive monsters appear on the map. From this moment, the defense stage begins, requiring the use of all accumulated forces and tactical skills to repel attacks. The main task is to protect a valuable object from destruction.
Only one creature can be taken under direct control, but over time the protagonist is able to acquire followers who will help in battle. Before the start of each passage, Chrysalis offers to choose one of the available types of cocoon, which determines the starting conditions and style of passage. The death of a controlled creature does not lead to the end of the session, since the spirit can simply find a new host. However, the destruction of the central object means inevitable defeat and the need to start all over again, using the experience gained.
Ally development mechanics:
Metamorphosis - increasing the level of controlled creatures with their subsequent transformation into more powerful forms. Mutation is the combination of different species to create new hybrids with unique sets of abilities. Gifts are random bonuses received for reflecting enemy waves and providing passive or active skills.

Game Description The Thing: Remastered returns to Antarctica, continuing the story of the 1982 film. Nightdive Studios resurrects the 2002 horror third-person shooter with a sequel to Outpost 31. Players play as Captain J.F. Blake, commander of a US Special Forces rescue team sent to investigate the aftermath of a scientific expedition.
Gameplay centers on facing off against shape-shifting alien creatures in a challenging environment. Team management becomes one of the core mechanics in which players must navigate complex interpersonal dynamics and potential contagion among team members. Survival depends on making strategic decisions, choosing weapons and psychological manipulation of team members.
The level design spans 20 different environments, introducing players to multi-faceted challenges and encounters. Combat scenarios involve facing various types of enemies: spiders with heads, humanoid walkers, and multi-tentacled organisms. Weapons range from machine guns to flamethrowers, offering tactical approaches to the confrontation.
The remastered edition features technical improvements including increased resolution, frame rate and visual fidelity. Gameplay changes focus on the player experience, implementing achievements and quality of life improvements. The interaction system emphasizes team psychology, and the player’s actions directly affect the cohesion of the squad and the success of the mission.
Narrative progression allows for multiple approaches to problem solving, encouraging exploration and strategic thinking. Players must distinguish the humans on the team from the alien infiltrators, which adds tension to every interaction and decision-making process. Communication and trust become essential survival mechanisms in this unforgiving Antarctic landscape.

Buildings that have once been the bastions of human civilization become flimsy cells against the rough power of prehistoric predators.

Forget about the usual Tires and Brachiosaurs. Traviteam Games listens to the opinion of the community of dinosaur lovers and plans to include less known species in the game so that you can meet faces with creatures that you may not dream in nightmares … for now.

The Overlords will throw everything they have at you, from dangerous attacks to clever countermoves. Your ability to learn and adapt to their strategies will determine your success.

In addition, by collecting the cores of fallen Lords, you can not only transform your combat abilities, but also change your appearance, which allows you to create unique gaming styles.

Game Description ANTONBLAST may be of interest to connoisseurs of old eight-bit and sixteen-bit games. It is a retro side-scrolling platformer with 2D pixel graphics. Visually, it is stylized as video games from early portable consoles. This project has several modes: normal, difficult, Boss Rush and Time Attack. The gameplay is accompanied by a soundtrack that also emulates retro. The story campaign is divided into 9 worlds, which consist of different thematic stages. The locations themselves seem to be two-level. Special springs and trampolines allow the hero to jump into the background and wander around it. At the same time, the camera angle and image scale remain the same, so the hero moves across the background in a reduced size.
Each stage does not scroll to the end from left to right or, vice versa, but consists of small segments. You can return to previously visited segments. There are a lot of destructible objects on the maps. In the indie game Antonblast, you control a bearded guy with red skin named Anton Dynamite. He makes a living by demolishing and blowing up old buildings. One day, Satan steals his valuable collection of perfumes. After this, the hero sets off on a journey to get even with the lord of the underworld himself. Along the way, he collects these ghosts and picks up coins. The character can run left and right, jump, slide down slides, roll, ram objects and enemies, hit opponents and obstacles with a hammer, and also rotate it around himself while jumping.
