This is a chaotic journey when you are trying to jump over the abysses, evade ramps and avoid other dangers. But the matter is not only in motion - success is how quickly you can move, because the game encourages quick and accurate actions.
The game is voiced by Connor CDAWGVA Kolkhun, whose voice helps you overcome every obstacle, talking with humor about climbing the corporate ladder. In the course of the game you will listen to fragments from The Grindset - a podcast filled with self -help advice voiced by popular streamers. These podcasts serve as collection objects, adding a bizarre note to the gameplay.
In addition to the chaos of roller skating, Get To Work offers a unique movement system, called Shmoooovement. This system makes the players move quickly, providing a deep sense of satisfaction when you manage to perform complex maneuvers. The intra -game timer is built for accelerated passage, and if you need to rest, then there is a button to give up, which will allow you to retreat at any time.

Often a climber will find himself one step away from a breakdown, literally hanging by a thread and forcing him to rethink further actions.
The whole project is a kind of tribute to the painful power of will. Control of the character is carried out through a single, deliberately clunky mechanic that requires filigree precision in every movement. The process of climbing in Yet Another Climbing Game becomes a real test of endurance, where gamers will experience both dizzying highs and crushing lows. Only by showing incredible endurance can you find your way up.

Master a unique, but unpredictable way of movement. Be prepared to lose all your progress after just one mistake. Test the limits of your own patience and persistence. Uncover the great secrets hidden at the peak of the mountain.

Game Description Relic Dudes is an online multiplayer game that can be played alone or with up to four friends. It’s a survivor-style action RPG where you work together or fight against each other to defeat hordes of different types of enemies. Game Description Scourge of the Village takes gamers on an eerie journey through a mountain village shrouded in mystery and supernatural elements. Set against the backdrop of Chinese folk horror, the plot revolves around an investigation that goes wrong. Chen Xi, a trainee reporter, begins investigating a wastewater discharge incident at a factory, but soon finds himself in a much more alarming situation. As she navigates the twisted paths of reality and dreams, the boundaries between the two worlds blur, and what was once an investigation into environmental crimes turns into a struggle to understand the tragic history of the village. At its core, Scourge of the Village is a decoding game. This means that users are not just passive observers - they are actively solving puzzles that reveal parts of the plot.
The puzzles are deeply intertwined with traditional Chinese folklore, particularly concepts such as the Five Elements and Bagua, adding cultural depth to the gameplay. Gamers interact with the text in unique ways by dragging, combining, and rotating various entries to cause changes in the environment, thereby moving the story forward. Each riddle is part of a larger mystery, and as it is solved, the user learns more and more about the forgotten past of the village. The story itself is far from simple. The title combines elements of psychological horror and traditional folklore to create a dream-like world that feels both familiar and unsettling.

In a world filled with bizarre robots, gamers take on the role of a disembodied AI programmed to wreak havoc. Unlike typical shooters, the adventure game features new mechanics: you control and switch between eight different types of enemies, each with their own unique abilities. In RAM: Random Access Mayhem, you don’t just mow down enemies with the same character throughout the entire game. If you’re not careful, you’ll quickly find yourself trapped, spending too much time in a body you can’t handle.
The challenge is to plan your next move, get rid of your current host and take control of a new one, all while avoiding being overwhelmed by surrounding enemies. Real-time mechanics force you to think on your feet, turning every encounter into a fast-paced puzzler. Game Description Dungeon Inn is a turn-based strategy puzzle game set in a world where adventurers, guilds, and dungeons collide in a unique, sometimes confusing world. In the title, you will find yourself in the shoes of Sarah, the owner of an inn strategically located next to the dungeon. Your job is simple: keep the inn running smoothly, manage resources, and manage the uneasy relationship between the two rival guilds that send their members to the inn.
The challenge, however, is maintaining a balance between these two factions while still making sure everything looks normal on the outside. In other words, you have to manage the day-to-day operations of the inn while preventing explosive tensions that arise between your guests. From the very beginning, players will have to manage the rooms, premises and general atmosphere of the inn. The difficulty is that the inn is not just an inn, it is located next to the dungeon, and even located between two guilds interested in mining in the dungeon.
As a result, the inn must serve members of both guilds without showing that the two factions are staying in the same place. Balancing their needs and personalities is important because if you get caught up in their rivalry, it could spell disaster for your business. The basic mechanics of the Dungeon Inn are to advertise the inn to adventurers going into the dungeon and try to lure them there while keeping things running smoothly. To attract more adventurers, many rooms and amenities can be added, but with more bang for your buck.

The action takes place in the small, seemingly calm town of Merrilin Crater Camp, and at the center of events is a murder that disrupts the peace and quiet of the village. Players take on the role of a detective with an unusual ability: he can penetrate the minds of suspects. With only five days to solve the case, the game turns into a race against time, where every decision matters.
Time passes as users collect evidence, interrogate suspects and use their unique mental abilities to get to the bottom of the truth. At the heart of Mindcop is detective work that unfolds through a process of investigation and interaction. Gamers investigate crime scenes, engage in conversations and, most importantly, use a gameplay mechanic called mind surfing. It allows users to delve into the minds of suspects and navigate their subconscious to piece together hidden truths.
Mini-games in these journeys of consciousness serve to uncover crucial clues and motives that may lead the investigation further. Each suspect presents a different challenge, and no two minds are alike. However, time is of the essence. Every action, be it questioning a witness or mind surfing, takes up precious minutes. How users manage their time is becoming one of the most important issues.

In addition to the usual jumping and climbing, players collect materials to create tools such as grappling hooks, checkpoints, and temporary platforms. These tools not only open up new paths, but also add a strategic element to gameplay, allowing you to customize your approach to each track. Crafting becomes its own mechanic, providing an additional level of depth.
Multiplayer features further enrich the gaming experience. The project offers a cooperative game in which friends can team up and solve complex problems together. In addition, competitive modes allow players to compete against each other, pushing their skills to the limit. Whether you’re tackling challenging obstacles together or competing for the fastest time, Parkour Civilization turns movement into a cooperative adventure. The combination of individual skill and group dynamics makes the gameplay fresh and fun.

Users take on the role of adventurers, each with unique abilities and skills, and set off on a journey through dangerous lands with the ultimate goal of obtaining the Crown of Command. Along the way, they will have to go through many challenges - from fighting dragons to obtaining magical items - while navigating a map divided into three regions: Outer, Middle and Inner.
The structure of Talisman: Digital 5th Edition is simple, but still leaves room for strategy. Gamers start in the Outer Region, a dangerous area filled with creatures and events where they roll dice to determine movement and actions. This randomness adds an element of surprise, as each move can lead to new encounters or threats. Further, the journey moves deeper into the Middle and Inner regions, where the challenges become increasingly difficult and the stakes become increasingly higher.
Each region is filled with different opportunities, forcing users to adapt their strategies depending on where they are on the board. Adventure cards, spell cards, and leveling tokens add complexity to the game. Adventure cards present gamers with situations or battles that require quick thinking and sometimes a little luck to overcome. At the same time, spell cards offer powerful magic that can turn the tide of battle or help you get through tough spots on the board.

Game Description Tetris Forever marks a milestone in the history of one of the most famous puzzle games, celebrating the 40th anniversary of Tetris. The collection contains more than 15 different versions, from early versions for Electronika 60 in 1984 to more recent ones, such as Hatris and Super Bombliss DX1, which many users may not have encountered before. The inclusion of these lesser-known games is a treat for those who are passionate about the evolution of Tetris and want to explore its varied history.
The adventure also includes interactive timelines where users can watch documentary footage and archival footage that provides an in-depth look at the game’s journey over the decades. For Tetris fans, this collection offers an opportunity to delve into a legacy that spans multiple generations of gaming. A distinctive feature of Tetris Forever is the new Tetris Time Warp mode. In this mode, up to four players can travel through different eras of Tetris, seeing how the graphics and mechanics have changed over time.
Users can interact with different versions, switching between graphic styles, speed levels and controls in real time. It offers a new, dynamic way to interact with Tetris, giving gamers a tangible sense of its evolution. Whether it’s moving from pixel blocks to a more modern design or adapting to different game speeds, Time Warp provides a unique experience that blends nostalgia and innovation.

Take part in the naval conflicts of the 80s. Control a huge number of different ships, use all modern types of weapons and technologies. Your main task in Sea Power: Naval Combat in the Missile Age is to defeat the enemy army. Survive intense naval battles and lead your nation forward!
Military operations are taking place in several parts of the world at once: in the Persian Gulf, where the conflict broke out between Iran and Iraq, as well as in the Norwegian Sea, where Soviet forces are operating. Control Bogammor in surface combat. Repel underwater and air attacks. Hunt enemy submarines and control planes to search for the enemy fleet.
Try to hide your forces and track down enemy troops. A game of cat and mouse helps to gain a strategic advantage. Seize the initiative and try to outsmart the enemy. Strike first and don’t give the enemy a chance to win. Use a huge number of different weapons. Tactics and planning will help you emerge victorious from the battle!Game Features: Campaign and multiple single-player scenarios; Various locations: North Atlantic, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Tonkin and Mediterranean; Dynamic weather changes and real-time combat; Realistic physics, as well as weapon malfunctions, advanced sensor simulation and much more other; 50 vessels and 30 types of aircraft; the ability to create your own maps and scenarios.

Game Description Void Sols places gamers in a minimalistic, top-down world that redefines the essence of soulslike gaming. The world is a huge, abstract labyrinth in which users will have to explore its depths and survive in harsh conditions. From the very beginning, you find yourself in a dark and confusing maze, where there is no map, no directions - only an inexorable desire to move forward. All you control is a triangle-shaped character, and there are no words to explain why you are here and what your goal is. It all depends on you.
The heart of Void Sols is the combat, which is simple and yet challenging. Gamers rely on a stamina bar to determine their actions, and each swing, dodge, or block is based on the amount of stamina. This means that you can’t just mindlessly attack enemies, every move must be carefully thought out. The combat system is designed to keep you on your toes, and every encounter can result in death. You will quickly realize that patience is just as important as skill.
The weapon selection is varied enough to allow gamers to experiment with different playstyles, but the real challenge comes in knowing when to switch between them, balancing the need for offense and defense as you progress. Campfires scattered throughout the world serve as both safe zones and strategic control points. Bonfires aren’t just for relaxation - they also provide an opportunity to change equipment or adjust stats to make them better suited.

Game Description Elements and Build is an adventure game that combines strategy and creativity, asking gamers to design their own paths to victory. The idea is simple: survive waves of monsters by building a labyrinth that will keep them at bay. However, the mechanics and challenges that adventure games offer make the process of building and surviving something that requires skill and insight. Each level is randomly generated, meaning players are faced with new obstacles and opportunities each time they play through.
The goal remains clear - defeat the monsters, but how you complete it is up to you. At the heart of Elements and Build is the ability to use elemental skills to create defenses and manipulate the environment. Each element has its own set of abilities that gamers can use to their advantage. For example, fire can be useful for damaging monsters, and water can be useful for slowing down their movement. However, the tricky part is knowing when to use each skill and how to combine them.
Strategy plays a huge role here: the right combination of elements at the right time can mean the difference between surviving the wave and defeat. A distinctive feature of the adventure game is the procedural generation of levels. Each card is different from the other, which allows users not to be caught off guard by the usual. This randomness forces players to think on their feet, adjust their plans on the fly, and adapt to new scenarios every time they start a level.

Game Description Everholm, a delightful indie game, is an RPG that seamlessly blends farming, friendship, and mystery. The plot centers on a girl, Lilly, who finds herself on a magical island, where everyone recognizes her, but her own memories elude her. As she delves deeper into the story, she discovers a startling truth - her sister, Melanie, has gone missing, and the island holds the key to her whereabouts. One of the hallmarks of Everholm is its open-ended nature, allowing players to determine the pace of their adventure. While exploring the island, you can learn about its unusual inhabitants, their difficult life and mysterious secrets.
As you progress, you can build your own cozy home, grow crops, breed animals, fish and make many items. In addition, building relationships with locals can develop into romance and even lead to the creation of a family. Everholm is not without its darkness, however. The island is fraught with treacherous dungeons, teeming with scary monsters and valuable treasures. Arming yourself with an arsenal of weapons and using magic is what you need to survive these dangerous trials and uncover the island’s deepest secrets.
In addition, the decisions you make throughout the story will determine the outcome of the plot and significantly affect the fate of your sister. Thanks to a wide range of possibilities and multiple endings, the project has enormous game value. Customizing your character to suit your preferences, choosing your own path and different options for ending the story - all this makes the tale exciting. The minimalistic pixel art style, complemented by a soothing soundtrack and light dialogue, creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. The title easily evokes a feeling of involvement, while simultaneously keeping the user in suspense and attention.

Game Description HeistGeist immerses gamers in the cyberpunk universe, putting them in the shoes of Alexandra, a cunning thief who overcomes the consequences of a failed mission. The title revolves around the challenge of assembling a diverse team of specialists to carry out complex heists. Each heist presents tactical obstacles and opportunities, turning each mission into a unique puzzle. Users take part in battles based on a card-based battle system that brings an innovative twist to the traditional strategy genre.
The stakes are high as gamers are forced to think on their feet, reacting to unexpected challenges that arise during missions. In HeistGeist, users will spend time developing their strategies by creating decks - a central element of the gameplay. Instead of following a linear progression of skills, users create a custom deck of cards that suits their preferred style. This approach fosters creativity and encourages experimentation, allowing players to find effective combinations that suit their tactics.
As gamers encounter different challenges, they can adapt their decks, finding new ways to solve problems. This flexibility plays a crucial role in how players interact with the mechanics. The story takes place in a fictional version of Central Europe in the 2040s, where corporate intrigue and high-stakes crime reign. Alexandra’s journey centers on her attempts to restore her reputation while becoming entangled in a web of deceit and danger.

Game Description Take Me is a title that is a distinct fusion of stealth, horror and dark humor. The story centers on Maria, a young woman who finds herself in an unexpected and somewhat strange situation. After attending a masquerade, Maria loses consciousness and wakes up in a strange situation - in the house of a mysterious man named Vitaly. From the very beginning, the gamer finds himself in the role of Maria, trying to get out of a place that seems both mysterious and dangerous. The plot unfolds as Maria tries to piece together her surroundings and find a way out, while coping with the ominous presence of her captor.
The premise of the game leaves no room for boredom. As Maria, users find themselves in a variety of environments, each offering their own challenges. The main goal is simple: escape. However, the path to freedom is far from easy. Throughout the game, users are faced with various obstacles that require them to think critically and creatively. Whether it’s unlocking doors, getting past obstacles, or using sound to distract Vitaly, there’s always something that needs solving.
Puzzles are not only necessary to progress, but also serve to deepen immersion by forcing players to interact with the environment in different ways. Take Me also stands out due to its use of randomization. Each playthrough of the game can be completely different because items, puzzles, and escape routes are swapped. This design choice increases replayability.

Game Description Locuras en el Banaverso is a single-player platformer that takes gamers on a chaotic adventure through a bizarre multiverse. The game follows the eccentric YouTuber El Bananero, who not only plays the role of the main character, but also voices him. From the very beginning, El Bananero finds himself in an unexpected situation - he is kidnapped by none other than Santa Claus and his gang of henchmen. As fate would have it, the kidnapping turns into an escape through a portal that leads him into the depths of the multiverse.
What follows is a whirlwind of events, puzzles and humor as El Bananero tries to navigate his new reality. As El Bananero moves through the multiverse, he finds himself not alone. He teams up with Andres Di Bono, a companion who helps him navigate various strange and bizarre environments. The duo travel through many different levels, each offering their own challenges. Whether they’re diving into underwater kingdoms or trying to outwit a world filled with cakes, the gameplay is full of unpredictability.
Gamers face obstacles that require both quick reflexes and creative problem-solving. These levels are designed to not only challenge the player’s skill, but also to keep the player engaged with ever-changing scenarios. The enemies in Locuras en el Banaverso are as colorful as the worlds El Bananero encounters.

Game Description Slitterhead throws you headlong into the shadow world filled with Sassens. Forget about sunlight and rainbow, the Kowlun area in this game is inspired by the gloomy approaching Hong Kong of the 80s and 90s. Close lanes and huge neon signs create a dense labyrinth, which you have to navigate. But you are not just a tourist here. You take control of Hyki, a complete riddle. No memories, no body, only a burning goal. It turns out that in the Cowl there is an unpleasant problem with monsters - more precisely, with the Picky of Sick. These terrible creatures mix with local residents, so it becomes difficult to distinguish a friend from the enemy. We have to be on the alert, that’s for sure.
However, this is not only an atmosphere. This is a full-fledged action-adventure in which battles play an important role. To destroy the Sicks, you will have to show ingenuity and strategy. Each meeting is a puzzle that you need to solve: find the best way to use your skills and send the monsters to the next world. What really distinguishes Slitterhead is riddles. The more you explore the coloon, the more questions arise. Who is Hyoka? What is the Plutterheads? Why are they here? The narrative pulls you forward, desperately trying to find the answers hidden in the city chaos. If you are looking for a unique horror with an exciting gameplay and plot, then the Title can become your next obsessive idea.

Game Description Dawn of the Ashen Queen is an online dungeon crawler that invites gamers to journey through a world rich in history, secrets and conflict. The action takes place on the land of Eshavon, a continent still reeling from the effects of the Great War, where the effects of a thousand-year curse continue to manifest themselves. As an emissary of the Grand Marshal, the player is thrust into a tense political environment where the task of rebuilding a fragmented empire takes an unexpected and dangerous turn.
The plot of Dawn of the Ashen Queen takes place after a surprise attack on a border town leaves the protagonist cut off from the rest of the empire and surrounded by danger. With the help of several unlikely companions, the player must navigate this fractured world while uncovering dark secrets that threaten the very fabric of their society. Eshavon is a land still recovering, but the peace it maintains now is fragile.
The once powerful forces that destroyed the earth during the Great War left behind not only ruins, but also a continent on the verge of a new catastrophe. The uneasy truce between the Darok tribes in the north and the Imperial Kingdom in the south is constantly under threat. The player’s role as the Grand Marshal’s emissary is vital to maintaining this fragile peace, but his task is complicated by unforeseen circumstances.

Game Description Metro Awakening is a story-driven first-person adventure created specifically for VR, immersing players in a post-apocalyptic Moscow. The action takes place in 2028 in the shadowy tunnels of the Moscow metro, which serve as a refuge for the last remnants of civilization after a nuclear disaster. Gamers take on the role of Serdar, a doctor navigating a world filled with danger while searching for his wife and the medicine she needs. There is an atmosphere of isolation here, and the remnants of humanity coexist with the ghosts of the past.
As Serdar delves deeper into the Metro, he encounters various problems. The project balances exploration, stealth and combat, requiring the player to think strategically. As you move through the dark tunnels, you feel a sense of urgency as resources dwindle. With limited ammunition and gear, gamers have to prioritize. Every encounter with hostile elements - bandits, mutants or supernatural forces - requires careful planning. The atmosphere remains tense, forcing users to weigh every action.
Metro Awakening’s game mechanics emphasize a slower, more thoughtful approach to combat. Serdar is not depicted as an experienced warrior; instead, he relies on cunning and stealth to overcome obstacles. The title encourages gamers to use the environment to their advantage. Hiding in the shadows, avoiding confrontations whenever possible, and using distraction tactics are key strategies.

Game Description Mirthwood is a fun medieval fantasy sandbox game that combines the charm of a life simulation with the thrill of an RPG. It offers gamers the opportunity to create their own adventure in a new country, escaping their war-torn homeland. The game offers two main paths: settle down and build a farm, trade with other cities and start a family; or explore a huge open world and fight bandits, monsters and other dangers. One of the main features is the rich and detailed setting, which includes six different regions and three cities, each with its own unique culture, history and secrets.
A Sims-style interaction system has been implemented, allowing gamers to make friends, romance, or antagonize city residents and NPCs. Completing tasks, dynamic events and solving mysteries determine the plot and progress of the gamer. Mirthwood features real-time combat using a variety of weapons, armor, and skills. Players have the opportunity to customize their character and specialize in one of three combat classes: warrior, archer, or mage.
Survival challenges such as storm, winter and disease add an extra layer of challenge, testing the gamer’s mettle. The beautiful hand-drawn art style, immersive sound effects and original musical score contribute to the overall magical atmosphere of the world. While exploring the vast landscape, users can discover rare and epic items that improve gameplay and open up new opportunities.

Game Description Odd Remedy invites users into an action-packed multiplayer adventure where teamwork and survival go hand in hand. The story takes place on an isolated island overrun by mutated spider monsters, and your mission? Escape with your fellow prisoners. Although you start out as prisoners, the island’s wild dangers offer a strange freedom as you scavenge for supplies, pillage towns, and destroy enemy-infested caves. The island itself becomes your playground, filled with challenges, obstacles, and the constant threat of the Black Fang Corps lurking around every corner.
The key to navigating this chaos lies in close collaboration with other gamers. Whether it’s taking down waves of spiders or solving puzzles, having a cohesive team makes all the difference. Communication is critical, and your smartphone will come in handy for both coordinating with teammates and managing your inventory. However, be careful: your phone is not only a lifeline, it can also attract unwanted attention when notification sounds lead enemies to your door.
The island threats in Odd Remedy keep you on your toes, and knowing when to fight or hide with your group is essential to survival. Exploring the island isn’t just about escaping, it’s also about setting up your workspace and collecting items for future use. Users can create tools, manage inventory, and even take selfies while running. Thanks to the procedurally generated map, the game experience changes every time, and each escape attempt becomes more interesting.

Game Description Bunker Invaders throws you into the middle of a post-apocalyptic scenario. The surface world has been destroyed, and your only hope is a rickety bunker. This is not a luxurious fallout shelter, but a situation where leaving the lights on is already a victory. Welcome to the new life of a bunker manager, where creepy creatures from the outside world are constantly trying to destroy your shelter. Here you have to solve two problems: patch up the crumbling infrastructure and at the same time repel the attacks of the inexorable invaders. Think of it as a game of whack-a-mole with a dash of existential dread.
These annoying creatures are constantly looking for weak spots in your defenses, so you will have to urgently look for and fix everything that does not work this time. Is the flickering light threatening to plunge you into darkness? Air filtration system not working? Looks like you’ll have some work to do. But at least you won’t be stuck waiting for the apocalypse. Bunker Invaders takes you through several missions that test your ability to think and survive. Every challenge you overcome makes you a little tougher, a little more cunning.
You will grow, but so will threats, so don’t get complacent. Finding resources becomes second nature, adding another layer of stress to your already overflowing plate. It’s not just about patching leaks and exterminating creepy creatures. This is a story about hanging on by your fingernails in a world gone crazy. This is a story about the will to survive, ingenuity born out of desperation, and the flickering hope that maybe you can find a new normal in this wilderness. So if you’re looking for a challenge that will test your resourcefulness and make you question your sanity, then the title could be your cup of radioactive tea.

In the second, the title offers a variety of songs at your disposal, each of which has a customizable difficulty level - from an easy walk to an extreme challenge.

The accessibility of the title ensures that users of any skill level will be able to drum to their hearts' content. Online, you’ll find ranked matches where you can test your skills against opponents from around the world as you strive to climb the leaderboard. Game Description The Memory Thieves is a co-op adventure with horror elements that immerses 1 to 4 players in exploring the mysterious Ravenwood Cemetery. Portals open here leading to the memories of the deceased, where priceless treasures are hidden. The task of daredevils is to penetrate these ephemeral worlds in order to steal valuables, but each foray is fraught with mortal risk, because the past is jealously guarded by its ghostly inhabitants.
Each dive into someone else’s memory becomes a unique challenge thanks to the procedural generation of levels. This ensures that each raid is unique, forcing the team to constantly adapt to new threats and environments. In The Memory Thieves, success depends on teamwork and strategic planning. Progressing through the story opens up access to new equipment and cosmetic items, which are purchased with money and experience earned in sorties. Some items require a certain level to use, which adds elements of tactical development to the gameplay.
The gameplay is complicated by the presence of cursed rooms and artifacts that can impose negative effects on the characters. Despite the increased danger, it is in such places that the most valuable relics are kept. The oppressive atmosphere is supported by semi-realistic graphics and a soundtrack that enhances the feeling of constant threat. You will have to confront a variety of opponents, each of which has a unique behavior pattern and poses a serious threat to unprepared treasure hunters.

The factory is not just a background, it is a character in its own right, filled with secrets waiting in the wings. Entering the role of a factory worker, users quickly realize that there is more to this place than meets the eye. Strange occurrences become the norm, and the unsettling nature of the dolls hints at deeper secrets lurking in the shadows. The atmosphere deepens as players move through the factory, with each room introducing new puzzles and interactions that further the story.
Dollmare’s game mechanics are based on exploration and puzzle solving. Gamers will have to piece together the history of the factory and its creepy inhabitants. Clues are scattered throughout the environment, and attentiveness becomes a prerequisite. By interacting with various characters, players make decisions that ultimately determine the direction of events. The decision-making aspect adds depth to the gameplay, as users must carefully consider their choices, knowing that each action can lead to different consequences. The non-linear structure allows for varied results, encouraging users to return and explore alternative paths. Here the psychological tension increases as gamers delve deeper into the history of the factory. Every corner of the factory seems to tell its own story, and remnants of the past are just asking to come out.

The game features luscious gore effects and animated strikes that add a visceral thrill to the intense gameplay. Armed with a variety of weapons, players engage in fierce battles against Lovecraftian nightmares and their ever-evolving, evil forms. Unlocks and power-ups along the way strengthen the character, allowing gamers to destroy hordes of enemies with unbridled fury. The gameplay is accompanied by an original soundtrack with exciting electric guitar riffs and atmospheric sounds that fit seamlessly into the overall theme.

Game Description IDILI is a first-person survival horror game where the main goal is to uncover one of Sardinia’s darkest secrets. John and his companion Ellie’s initial journey, intended to be an immersion in the island’s vibrant culture, is suddenly interrupted. The main character finds himself completely alone on the territory of the ominous archaeological park Nurage Is Paras. Frightened and isolated, he is determined to find Ellie, which becomes the central plot objective. Confronting the oppressive atmosphere and ancient evil will require incredible stamina and ingenuity from him, because every step could be his last.
Ancient monuments of Sardinia:
Archaeological Park Nurage Is Paras is the starting location for research. Nurag Is Paras is one of the ancient complexes in the park. Nurag Asusa is the second key point on the route of Ellie’s search. The necropolis of Is Tanas de Mreksani is a recreated complex of tombs. Domus de Janas burials are authentic objects for study. Sardinian folklore is the basis for the atmosphere and level design.
The exploration process will force the protagonist to visit several meticulously recreated historical locations. The search route runs through the nuraghes of Is Paras and Asusa, as well as the complex of tombs of Domus de Janas Is Tanas de Mreksani. While these locations have been adapted to suit gameplay needs, their authenticity and cultural significance have been preserved with utmost precision. Thus, in IDILI, the study of ancient monuments becomes an inseparable part of the frightening narrative, where Sardinian folklore is closely intertwined with fiction to create a unique and memorable atmosphere of total horror.

Game Description Movies Tycoon is an exciting simulator. This ambitious project invites players to immerse themselves in the complex process of creating cinematic masterpieces. Set in the 1990s, you’ll be able to start your own film studio, gather and manage talent, and carefully orchestrate the production of blockbuster films.
At the heart of Movies Tycoon is a dual focus: the business side of running a studio and the creative side of filmmaking. You’ll manage budgets, schedules, and staff while immersing yourself in the art of storytelling. A unique feature is the built-in movie editor, which allows you to create short animated films within the gameplay itself. Whether it’s a heart-warming drama, a thrilling action thriller, or a quirky comedy, you’ll have to think through every aspect, from casting to writing and directing.
PixelCraze s.r.o. seeks to find a balance between the tycoon simulator and the filmmaking process. Will gamers be more drawn to the economics of running a studio, or will they enjoy the creative freedom to create memorable scenes? The studio’s decision to release full content as part of Early Access will allow them to gauge player preferences and tailor them accordingly. As the game progresses, we eagerly await the verdict: will the title be remembered for its shrewd business acumen or cinematic magic?

Game Description PRIM is a point-and-click adventure game made in a monochrome style. The game is inspired by the works of Tim Burton. Events take place in the Land of the Dead. At the center of the story is the Angel of Death, nicknamed Thanatos. He can’t get started with the job of collecting souls because he can’t deal with his teenage daughter, Prim.
The girl suffers from nightmares. Every night she sees the same dream. An unknown boy keeps calling for help. She is constantly trying to do something, but the Grim Reaper forbids her to even move, otherwise she will enter the kingdom of the living. If the girl can get there, she will receive incredible power.
PRIM’s story focuses on issues of fathers and sons. The main storyline is about the father learning to let go. The daughter is growing right before our eyes and is learning a lot about herself. The heroine reveals herself as a person. The game is full of supernatural abilities and mysticism. Prim is able to cross between two realms, facing demons, both figuratively and formally.
The heroine does not travel alone. In her company is an old friend - an arachnid boy. All animations are hand-drawn, referencing Burton’s classic cartoon works. The interface is very simple, and control is tied to finding objects and solving puzzles. The campaign is completed in 6-8 hours of real time. The ability to switch between heroes is available. There is a hint system and an exciting card mini-game.

The story is set in the Varennes Empire and progresses through generations of emperors, starting with Leon and ending with his son Gerard. Gamers inherit not only the throne, but also abilities and quests, passing the tests that the Seven Heroes throw at them. Each emperor faces distinct challenges that require strategic planning and character development. The pedigree aspect adds a unique twist to character development, which keeps users from getting bored.
Gameplay involves various activities such as exploring varied environments and completing quests in cities. Gamers often have to solve local problems or negotiate with townspeople, which affects their position in the empire. As users set out on their journey, they meet new characters who can be recruited into their party. These companions have unique skills that increase the party’s effectiveness in combat and exploration. The depth of character interactions can lead to unexpected alliances, enriching the gameplay experience. In this way, party management becomes a strategic element that influences how players approach problems. The defining feature of Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is its inheritance system. Skills and abilities are not static, but are passed down from generation to generation, allowing gamers to create a legacy of strength and tactics.

In this game, gamers take on the role of a ghost manager as they navigate levels filled with unforgiving ghosts. Armed simultaneously with four to six types of weapons, users fight off waves of enemies trying to hinder their progress. This requires not only quick reflexes, but also strategic thinking as gamers choose how to use their arsenal against various threats. The variety of character options is amazing: users can choose one of 21 characters, each of which has unique abilities.
In addition, there are 35 weapons, 84 items and 21 pets, allowing for extensive customization. This variety encourages experimentation, allowing users to mix and match elements to create a build that suits their style. While going through various tasks, users are faced with a number of difficulties that require both adaptation and skill. Each run in Soul Stalker lasts about 25 minutes, and the locations change with each session. This variety keeps the gameplay fresh and exciting, as gamers never know what to expect from each new journey. During the passage, survival in waves of enemies, each of which lasts from 30 to 60 seconds, becomes crucial.

Game Description Terror in the Corn is a first-person survival horror game that immerses you in the nightmarish atmosphere of an endless cornfield. The protagonist comes to his senses without memories of the past, surrounded by tall stems that form a living labyrinth and deprive him of any hope of orientation in space. A supernatural fog spreads across the land, and an ominous chant constantly hovers in the air, serving as a harbinger of trouble. The feeling of constant surveillance does not leave even for a second, because something is hiding in the thickets, which is well aware of the helplessness of its victim. The psychological pressure here prevails over the sudden frightening effects, causing the tension to increase by the minute.
Survival in this cursed place is based on the mechanics of an endless loop. Each death at the hands of one of the many pursuers does not mean the end, but only returns you to the starting point, forcing you to learn lessons from your mistakes. To break the vicious circle, the hero, in the role of a miner, will have to explore not only the fields, but also the abandoned buildings of the town of Vorony Ravine. The process of exploring locations in Terror in the Corn involves searching for artifacts and evidence that can shed light on the mystery of the local curse. Only patience and attention to the details of the environment will allow you to put all the pieces of the puzzle together and gain a chance of salvation.
Gallery of damned stalkers:
Dumitra is a witch whose presence is felt in every corner of this world, and her singing serves as a constant reminder of who is boss here. Jack is the embodiment of pure aggression, appearing at the most unpredictable moments to deliver a swift strike. Ted is a silent and patient hunter who prefers to stalk his targets from the shadows, using endurance as his main weapon. Chris the Creeper is a cold-blooded and unforgiving creature who personifies death itself at its most brutal. Dolly is a source of creepy childish terror, adding an extra layer of unsettling madness to the proceedings.

In addition to single player play, Windblown offers online co-op mode for up to three friends. Co-op adventure adds an atmosphere of camaraderie to the gameplay. Players can work together to develop strategies, share resources, and cover each other in battle.

Game Description Wild Planet is a survival game on the Wild Planet, where you have to build your own base, explore mystical lands, collect resources, complete various tasks and much more. The story begins with the ship being wrecked. The hero was forced to land on an unknown continent. Left alone and cut off from the rest of the world, he must find a way to survive among hostile flora and fauna while trying to find a way to leave these lands.
You need to build your own base by hunting and crafting. Exploring the wild lands, the history of this continent is gradually revealed. In Wild Planet you will have to overcome challenges, complete many assignments, etc. You can survive alone or in co-op. The planet consists of a huge number of low-poly biomes. The hero hunts giant beetles. Outposts will need to be built to protect against external threats. You can craft weapons, equipment, useful items, etc.
The environment is randomly generated. Co-op allows up to four players to team up. The worlds are synchronized and when one participant does something at home, it is instantly reflected in the protagonist’s universe. The planet has a three-month cycle. Over the course of 90 days, the planet disintegrates and changes shape. Dungeons, lakes, desert, etc. are randomly generated. A storyline is available, during which you need to uncover the secret of the Savage Planet.

Game Description Clank! throws players headlong into an exciting world of dungeons and daring theft. This board game marks their physical debut, offering a unique blend of deck building and push-your-luck mechanics. Main task? Infiltrate the legendary Dragon Vault, steal the most coveted artifacts, and escape with the loot before the dragon turns you into a crunchy beast. Sounds simple enough, right? But no.
Every false step, every clink of metal on stone echoes through the caves, serving as an uninvited call to the slumbering dragon. The deeper you go, the richer the rewards, but the higher the stakes. One wrong move and the legendary Clank! will echo through the tunnels, infuriating the dragon. It’s all about deck building. Players start with a basic deck of weak cards, allowing them to move cautiously and mine scarce loot.
But as players progress through the game, they can upgrade their decks with powerful movement cards that propel them deeper into the dungeon, powerful combat cards that allow them to fend off the dangers that lurk, and superior treasure cards that net them valuable loot. However, you have to pay for each card you receive. Many powerful cards also generate noise, represented by a scary symbol. If there is too much noise, the dragon will awaken and unleash his fiery wrath on all the unlucky ones lurking in the depths.

Game Description Geo-Political Simulator 5 immerses gamers in the world of international politics, economic strategy and global decision-making. In it, users are not just passive observers of events in the world, but active participants capable of influencing entire states and transnational corporations. The title is a complex and highly detailed simulation of the modern geopolitical landscape, where every choice, from political decisions to economic strategies, has far-reaching consequences.
Whether it’s the president of a country, the head of a corporation, or the leader of the political opposition, the title invites gamers to navigate the intricacies of global power. The basis of Geo-Political Simulator 5 is a macroeconomic engine that brings to life the economic systems of countries and corporations. This framework models the interconnectedness of economies, providing insight into the production, trade, and financial dynamics that shape the real world.
Users can manage industry, agriculture and services, balancing supply and demand and responding to economic fluctuations. The title also reflects how global markets react to changes in policy or market forces, allowing gamers to see how a small decision can impact the international economy. This level of detail in economic modeling sets the game apart from others, offering a rich experience for those interested in how the world’s financial mechanisms work.

The action of the game unfolds within the destructive underground object, offering an exciting journey through the dimly lit tunnels, replete obstacles and formidable opponents, which makes the players experience their skills for strength.
For the company “Quark”, security is of paramount importance, and our commitment is unshakable to it. At our mining, industrial and research facilities, highly qualified security officers armed with powerful arsenal, ready for any unforeseen circumstances, whether it be the suppression of riots provoked by imperialist scouts, or other secret threats, is on duty around the clock. At the same time, we take care that these powerful means never fall into the wrong hands. Safety in production is the cornerstone of our activities, which is confirmed by the impressive duration of the period from the moment of the last incident in production - evidence of thorough insulation of dangerous materials, including radioactive isotopes. Your vigilance also matters: if you find suspicious substances, immediately inform your leader about it. Do not try to cope with them yourself - this can lead to serious consequences.
Adaptability is a key factor in our dynamic working environment. Due to the possible lack of personnel, you may be asked to temporarily take on a role that goes beyond your usual duties. In this free-to-play online pirate game, you must guide a group of misfits through a kingdom in chaos. The fate of Queen Julia’s throne depends on your decisions, and dangerous enemies and unexpected allies await you online. One minute you can be the captain of a ship on the high seas, and the next you can be the manager of a mead factory. The game features 12 unique characters, each with their own skills and quirks. Assemble your dream team and see how they collide and mesh as you tackle the challenges ahead.
Reproducibility is the name of the game here. Don’t like how things turned out? Don’t worry! You can always try again, discovering hidden secrets and alternate endings along the way. Who knows? Game Description City 20 is not an ordinary survival game where you need to search for resources. Of course, there is the usual wasteland after a disaster, the constant struggle for survival, the excitement associated with finding decent scrap metal. But the title adds a twist to the story - your choices rewrite the rules. Every decision you make sends ripples through this broken society, pushing NPCs in new directions and changing the course of events. Think of the butterfly effect, but with more radiation and fewer butterflies. It’s not just about finding the next meal or building a glorified hut.
The project offers you a sandbox overflowing with possibilities. You can play the hero by collecting the remaining fragments of humanity. Or you can go into the shadows, becoming the king (or queen) of scavengers, who has a taste for the most exquisite things of the apocalypse - for example, clean water that does not glow green. The world reacts to what is happening in real time, adapting to your decisions. It’s like a choose-your-own-adventure story, only the stakes are a little higher than being locked in a creepy attic. But here’s the catch: there is no one right way to play City 20. Want to build a utopia powered by rainwater and communal gardens?
Forward. Fancy yourself a post-apocalyptic warlord with a flair for the dramatic? Kill yourself (just avoid irradiated pigeons - trust me). This level of freedom makes every playthrough feel unique, a fresh take on a familiar genre. So if you’re tired of the same old survival simulator routine, this title could be your oasis in the desert. Just remember that every action has a reaction, and in this twisted world, your choices can mean the difference between a prosperous community and… well, a slightly less prosperous community populated by feral pigeons. Just like that.

Game Description Rune Coliseum immerses you in the brutal world of gladiatorial combat. This deck-based roguelike features a unique semi-real-time combat system that departs from traditional turn-based mechanics. Players choose a gladiator, assemble a deck of cards that reflect his movements, and then engage in duels to the death. The basic concept is simple: survive and become a champion. But Rune Coliseum brings the challenge with its innovative queuing system. Both gladiators choose the number of cards they want to play at the same time, creating a fast-paced duel where strategy and reflexes reign supreme.
The choice of characters offers variety. With over seven fighters, each with their own attributes, body types and signature skills, players can find their ideal fighting style. In addition, gladiators can loot equipment and power-ups from defeated enemies or purchase them from stores, constantly adding to their arsenal. The game world is inhabited by numerous NPC gladiators. These opponents are not just punching bags - they develop and improve over time. Gamers must carefully assess threats, determining which enemies to destroy and which to leave for later. The gameplay promises a brutal fight. With a unique combat system, character customization and evolving rivals, the path to becoming a champion is fraught with danger and competition.

Game Description Scary Shadow Spot: Last Farewell is a first-person psychological horror game that explores themes of grief, guilt, and the paranormal. Players take on the role of Mark, a man coping with the recent loss of his wife Jane. The game begins with Mark returning to his and Jane’s old country house to prepare for her funeral. However, what is meant to be a grim homecoming quickly turns into a terrifying ordeal.
As Mark goes deeper into the house, he encounters a number of disturbing phenomena. Strange sounds echo through the corridors, doors creak open on their own, and shadowy figures lurk in the corners. The house, once filled with memories of happiness, now exudes an unsettling aura of horror. Game Description Slackers - Carts of Glory is a racing adventure game that is something out of the ordinary. Instead of racing along the highway in luxury cars, you’re pushing a shopping cart. Yes, you heard right. It’s like playing supermarket, but with more fun and chaos. The basic idea is simple: you are part of a group of friends and try to get to the store before it closes. But what is the difficulty? You must do this on a shopping cart. No engines, no brakes, just pure muscle power and a little luck. It’s a challenge that’s both hilarious and surprisingly addictive.
You can race solo or team up with friends to cause multiplayer mayhem. And believe me, when a bunch of people are trying to outrun each other in a cart race, it can get really crazy. There’s something undeniably satisfying about watching your friends go crazy around a corner or get stuck in a tight spot. One thing that sets Slackers - Carts of Glory apart is the unique way it controls the cart. It’s not at all like driving a car. You’ll have to push, pull and maneuver manually, which adds a new level of challenge and strategy.
There are no shortcuts or bonuses to help you. It all depends on your skill and a little luck. There are many tracks presented here, each of which has its own unique difficulties and obstacles. Some tracks are easy, while others are full of turns. There are also several hidden paths that can be discovered if you are careful. Overall, it’s a fun and fresh take on the racing genre. This is an adventure game that is easy to pick up, but difficult to master. If you’re a racing fan or just want to have a good laugh, this game is worth checking out.

Game Description TCG Card Shop Simulator puts players in the role of a trading card store (TCG) owner who is responsible for the day-to-day operations and long-term growth of their business. From the very beginning, users are immersed in the mechanics of arranging shelves, pricing goods, and interacting with customers. You’re not just haphazardly putting products on display; careful planning is required to ensure that the right products are available at the right time. One of the key parts of the job is deciding which booster packs will be featured in the store, balancing between popular options and more obscure ones that may appeal to collectors or a niche audience.
You need to keep an eye on trends because the market is constantly changing and what is popular one day may lose its appeal the next. The ability to set prices allows for some flexibility, encouraging gamers to test their business acumen by adjusting offerings based on demand, supply, and competition. Another element of TCG Card Shop Simulator is hiring and personnel management. Employees are an important part of keeping a store running smoothly, but they also have their own needs and quirks.
You will have to balance between personality, skills and expenses. It’s not enough to just hire a bunch of people and put them to work; players must ensure that employees work in places where they can play to their strengths. Someone who is great at organizing inventory may not be the best at recommending cards to shoppers, and vice versa. Find that middle ground that can be the deciding factor.

Game Description Edge of Sanity immerses you in a chilling narrative. It’s not just about surviving the rugged Alaskan wilderness, it’s about battling with your own sanity as the harsh conditions erode your sanity. Imagine: you are cold, hungry and lost. Night falls and the only thing keeping the encroaching darkness at bay is the flickering fire. But wait, is that a growl in the distance or just the wind playing with your already frayed nerves? Edge of Sanity is based on resource management. You’ll scavenge for food and supplies while desperately trying to stay one step ahead of the dangers that lurk in the shadows. Every decision has weight.
Will you waste your dwindling resources on a flimsy shelter or risk reaching the rumored hiding place before nightfall? The project thrives on this constant pressure, forcing you to make difficult choices that could mean the difference between life and death. The plot unfolds organically through your actions. Each choice you make shapes the narrative, leading you down a path of increasing tension. It’s not just about fighting wild animals—there’s something much more sinister lurking in the Alaskan wilderness. Adventure is not afraid to mess with your brain.
The line between reality and paranoia blurs, causing you to doubt everything around you. Can you trust your own feelings? Ultimately, this is a test of human resilience. The world is cruel, but the human spirit is a stubborn thing. With every obstacle overcome, with every close test experienced, you become closer to the solution. The title is slow to heat up, but the tension steadily builds to a climax that will leave you breathless. So, are you ready to meet The Edge of Sanity?

Game Description Elsie is a side-scrolling action platformer with simplified roguelike elements. Each subsequent playthrough is different from the previous one. With any new run, levels are created randomly from hand-crafted parts. The order of loot also always changes. The locations themselves are non-linear. Before starting, you can add or remove modifiers to increase or decrease the difficulty accordingly. In the indie game you can run, jump, dash, bounce off walls, and shoot at opponents. The protagonist moves between rooms. They contain treasures, challenges, regular enemies and bosses. There are different classes with their own skills and arsenal. There is the ability to create a variety of builds.
Elsie is not only the name of the game, but also the name of the android. Dr. Gray discovered magitek technology, built a cyborg girl, and named the creation after her lost daughter. A relative disappeared during their joint experiments, which turned out to be failures. In addition to her disappearance, work on the Arclight Core project suddenly turned into a series of cataclysms and the appearance of spiers on the planet Ekis. To study them, cyborgs called Guardians were built. The plot begins with a robot attack on the Sapir shipyard, where all the research was carried out. As a result of the attack, the woman dies, and the mechanical girl she created goes on a journey. She wants to find out what happened and punish those responsible. The heroine also has to find out what happened to other androids.

Game Description Arcane Blast throws players into a whirlwind of magical chaos, where they can play online with a friend as they help the cat mage Adrian make his way through the dungeon of time. This roguelike lets you fight hordes of enemies for free, using the seven elements to create powerful spell combinations. Each playthrough lasts 20-40 minutes, and thanks to the ability to play pirates online, each online game brings new experiences with each dive.

Do you want to have a magical duel with your friends? Team up and unravel the mysteries of ShadowVille together. But don’t be too confident - for large groups the game increases the intensity of passions. Will you specialize in pyromancy or mix and match elements for unpredictable results? The choice is yours, but remember: with great power comes great responsibility… and maybe a few singed mustaches.
Air, darkness, fire, frost, lightning, nature and water - these are the components of Adrian’s arsenal. But why stop there? Combine these elements to unleash attacks that will make your enemies regret staying in bed. Do you want to turn a huge beast into a small fluffy sheep? Or maybe summon a black hole to swallow your enemies? The possibilities are endless, as is your imagination.
Felix Lunnoson, Adrian’s former student, became a bandit. Armed with the Forsworn Orb, he lured his mentor into a trap that altered time. Now you have to guide Adrian through ShadowVille, restore his strength and unravel the secrets of this strange kingdom. Can you outsmart Felix and find your way back to reality? Only time will tell, and in this game time is definitely not on your side.

Game Description Zero Hour is a multiplayer tactical first-person shooter with realistic game mechanics that replicate the behavior of real special forces units in anti-terrorist operations. The setting for the action is criminal Bangladesh, where banditry is at a high level and is not going to give up ground to law enforcement officers. The locations where clashes between groups of terrorists and special forces occur are made using real scale, which greatly helps the atmosphere and involves gamers in the gameplay. The project collects data about each session, providing statistical summaries for each participant in the fight.
The tasks of the opposing teams are standard for the genre - bandits must protect a planted bomb from being cleared or prevent special forces from taking a hostage. Lawyers need to act quickly, because time is limited, the explosive package will soon detonate, and the prisoner could be killed. To storm enemy territory, the attacking side uses shields to protect themselves from bullets, a variety of weapons and a three-dimensional map to plan the operation. At this moment, the attackers are strengthening their possessions and setting traps.
Due to the emphasis on the tactical component, the project introduces many interesting mechanics into the gameplay, for example, switches that turn off the lights in a certain area. Special agents have night vision flashlights; they will be able to see the enemy in complete darkness at the cost of giving away their location. This can be used to good advantage by diverting attention to one team member while the rest sneak past enemies. Also, doors become a serious obstacle, because there is no understanding of what is behind it and whether an ambush awaits there.

Game Description Scourge of War - Remastered takes players into the heart of historical battles, where you can play online with a friend and feel like a real commander. This strategy, available for free on the pirate market, offers unique opportunities for those who want to fight online online. Developed by NorbSoftDev, the game builds on the legacy of Norb Timpko’s acclaimed Take Command series and allows you to immerse yourself in online gaming, controlling armies on detailed 3D battlefields.
The game traces its origins to Sid Meier’s Gettysburg, which revolutionized wargaming in 1997 by introducing real-time combat and 3D terrain. Subsequent games like Austerlitz and Waterloo further refined the formula, paving the way for Mad Minute Games' Civil War: Bull Run in 2005.
These games set new standards in AI enemy intelligence and historical accuracy, winning numerous awards for it. Now Scourge of War - Remastered picks up the torch, bringing improved graphics, smarter AI and Steam integration for multiplayer battles. Whether battling the computer or humans around the world, players must keep their wits sharp and their powder dry to prevail on these legendary battlefields.

You enter the world as an introvert, navigating an environment filled with extroverts who want to make small talk, invite you to a party, or just chat about their day. However, the introvert has his own mission, much more personal than just making new acquaintances. In Don’t Stare, the world is your playground, but at the same time it is a kind of labyrinth. There are grocery stores, gyms, and houses—all filled with obstacles to jump over, walls to climb, and floors to slide under. Each setting is like its own little puzzle, challenging you to find the best path without attracting too much attention. You don’t move just for the sake of moving. Every action has its own purpose. You’re constantly deciding whether to sneak past undetected or, if the situation calls for it, to parkour to get where you need to go. The physicality of all this is not just window dressing. This is a reflection of the introvert mentality - always looking for a way out, always looking for the path of least resistance.

Game Description In Maxwell’s puzzling demon, gamers control a mischievous action figure inspired by the famous thought experiment. The task seems simple - move blocks and manipulate temperature. But as you progress, the title reveals a multi-layered structure in which even the world itself functions as a puzzle. Every move requires thought, and every block presents a new obstacle or opportunity. Some are burned, others are cooled, and together they determine the future path. The trick is to balance them correctly, otherwise the situation can escalate to the limit.
Maxwell’s puzzling demon has ten worlds, each with more than 350 levels. These levels are not just static challenges, they become pieces of a larger puzzle. Once you solve them, you turn them into moving blocks, which are then used to open new sections. Progress is not linear, and users must think ahead to avoid getting blocked. Some levels are located right out in the open, while others are hidden in tricky corners, requiring deft maneuvering.
And for those looking for an extra challenge, there are additional levels hidden beyond the main path. It won’t be difficult to get to them, let alone solve them. A built-in hint system helps stuck gamers. She offers insight into the mechanics and explains various techniques. While it doesn’t provide a solution, it does nudge gamers in the right direction. With so many interconnected puzzles, understanding the mechanics is key.

Game Description Liminal Void is a psychedelic immersion into a surreal world where the ultimate goal is to confront the Gods of the Void. Their abode is located at the 444th level of the dungeon, and reaching this layer is inevitable for everyone. However, the outcome of the decisive battle directly depends on the accumulated resources, because to win you will need to unleash a barrage of powerful spells on your opponents. The key currency for this are Sigils, the collection of which becomes the main task throughout the descent into the abyss. Without a sufficient supply, even the most skilled spellcaster will be destroyed in the final clash.
Death in this world is not the end, but only one of the ways to move deeper. Each death randomly transfers the character to the next level, making it impossible to collect more valuable Sigils and souls. The Liminal Void project forces you to constantly balance on the brink of risk. Extracting souls from hostile entities not only replenishes your spell arsenal, but also extends the time until your next inevitable death, giving you a chance to better explore the current layer. This continuous cycle of resource management forms the basis of all gameplay.
The player takes on the role of one of four mages of the Liminal Layer Society, an organization that protects reality from invasions from the Void. Each of the available characters has a unique fighting style, a set of spells and its own story. The decisions and actions you take directly influence the development of events, leading to one of 16 different endings. The journey through dark and chaotic levels is accompanied by elements of psychological horror, diluted with dark humor and constantly changing visual effects, creating an oppressive but mesmerizing atmosphere.

Game Description SGS Battle For Shanghai is a recreation of the battles of the Second Sino-Japanese War, called Stalingrad on the Yangtze. The conflict is taking place in urban areas and on the outskirts of China’s largest port city. Each cell on the map becomes an arena for fierce clashes, where units of different sizes are under command, from regiments to individual battalions.
The fighting covers the period from August to November 1937, with each move in the project corresponding to two days of real time. Commanding troops requires careful planning, since not all units can be deployed at the same time. The opposing sides are pursuing diametrically opposed goals. Chinese troops are trying to recapture the captured areas and attract the attention of the world community to the ongoing conflict.
Japanese forces, in turn, need to hold their initial positions for a subsequent full-scale counteroffensive. In the tactical confrontation of SGS Battle For: Shanghai, not only ground forces, including infantry, armored vehicles and artillery, play an important role, but also auxiliary air and river units. The unique unit activation system introduces an element of uncertainty, forcing you to adapt your strategy to the constantly changing conditions on the battlefield.
The outcome of battles largely depends on the competent use of special cards that can change the balance of power at a decisive moment. Unit morale is a key factor, influenced by fatigue, panic or, conversely, strengthened by air dominance and armor support. Successful conduct of hostilities allows not only to destroy enemy formations, but also to force them to retreat, seizing control over strategically important territories of the destroyed city.

Game Description Sins of a Solar Empire 2 offers players the unique opportunity to play a massive 4X real-time strategy game online with a friend. In this game, which can be played for free even as a pirate, your ultimate goal will be galactic domination. Thanks to online play, you can easily fight online online, combining tactical combat with empire management. A dynamic universe with ever-changing battle lines and strategic options takes you from planetary systems to space battles of individual ships.
The game features three different factions: the industrial TEC, the nomadic Vasari and the psionic Advent. Each of them brings unique gameplay mechanics to the game. TECs, for example, can adjust their economy on the fly with a flexible trading system. Vasari use mysterious phasic energies, and Advent use collective consciousness to gain powerful abilities.
Sins of a Solar Empire 2 abandons traditional turn-based gameplay, making the action constant and unpredictable. One moment you’ll have to fend off a surprise attack from a fleet hidden on a rogue asteroid, and the next you’ll have to use your massive titanium to defend a starbase from missile bombardment. The game encourages tactical thinking, whether you’re covering your cruisers with anti-aircraft frigates or influencing minor factions to protect your borders.

This is a living, breathing organism, formed at your whim. This is not work under high pressure. There are no ticking hours, no angry citizens requiring the provision of services. He created a space where players can lose themselves in the process of construction. This is a digital escape, a place where you can relax and give free rein to your creative abilities. The community is a close -knit group that shares its creations and offers reviews. This is the hive of builders, constantly expanding the boundaries. If you are tired of an ordinary game routine, if you are eager to create your own digital canvas, the project can become your ticket.

The player will have to build a base, extract valuable flora and command troops in this futuristic setting.
Features of an all-out war for valuable resources in Shrot:
Construction of your own base for resource extraction. Choose from three unique warring factions. Participate in large-scale battles with hundreds of combat units. Command an army of tanks, tractors and horses. Each battle on randomly generated maps is unique.
The gameplay is a fast-paced interpretation of the real-time strategy game, inspired by the 1995 Czech game Paranoia, but with a faster pace. It is necessary to build a base and collect hops to form armies intended for large-scale clashes against one of the other two available clans. Battles are designed to scale and last, sometimes taking hours to complete with hundreds of units on the field and thousands of resulting casualties. Game Description POOLS offers an unconventional gaming experience. Forget about blowing up aliens or conquering kingdoms. This is where exploration and atmosphere come to the fore. Imagine yourself in a huge, eerily empty water center. Sunlight barely breaks through the humid air, casting long shadows on the deserted tiled floor. The only sounds are your steps, reflected from the damp walls, and rare drops of water. There are no monsters or puzzles to overcome, just unsettling silence and frightening architecture. The game world itself is a character experience that constantly changes as you delve deeper into it. One moment you can find yourself in a brightly lit billiard room, and the next you can find yourself in a dimly lit maze of corridors. Each area holds its own unique secret, challenging you to move forward.
No menus, no dialogue, no background music. Instead, the developers rely on environmental sounds to create a truly immersive experience. The echo of your steps changes depending on the room, and walking on water seems deliberately slow and cumbersome. Although there is no traditional narrative, the feeling of unease increases as the exploration progresses. Vast empty spaces evoke a primal fear of getting lost, and the lack of human interaction only increases isolation. The project is a journey consisting of six chapters, each of which takes from 10 to 30 minutes. If you’re looking for an atmospheric and thought-provoking experience, immerse yourself in the unsettling world of POOLS.

The title invites gamers into a vast desert landscape where a series of strange events unfold. Rival factions, once in constant conflict, have now united under mysterious circumstances. Their growing raids threaten human settlements, bringing them to the brink of destruction. Rumor has it that at the center of this turmoil is a powerful leader who is presiding over the chaos.
Users will take on the role of a lone investigator and assemble a team of adventurers to uncover the true nature of these attacks. Throughout their journey, they will encounter a variety of difficulties - from monstrous creatures to ancient, hidden ruins. Combat is methodical and requires careful strategy, using both healing and offensive magic to defeat increasingly powerful enemies. The grid-based movement system forces gamers to think ahead, positioning themselves wisely to maximize their chances of survival.
As the game progresses, users will delve deeper into the mysteries of the desert. Their goal is to uncover the identity of the mysterious leader behind the raids and end the growing threat. Each victory brings them valuable experience and equipment, which are necessary to solve increasingly complex problems. Although Crossing The Sands is a sequel to Into The Inferno, it stands on its own as a standalone experience. New users will not need any prior knowledge.

Game Description OUTMINER is a survival story where, after a spaceship crashes on a hostile and uncharted planet, all responsibility for the fate of the crew falls on the shoulders of the captain. In a harsh and ruthless environment, the protagonist will have to lead his team, fighting for each new day. The fate of all crew members rests entirely with his decisions and ability to adapt to the deadly threats of this lost world. The resources and morale of survivors must be managed to maintain hope of rescue.
This fatal incident interrupts a critical transport mission, which was derailed by an unexpected technical failure that led to disaster. Now the primary task is not delivering the cargo, but organizing an escape from the inhospitable planet before it finally absorbs the remnants of the team. In OUTMINER, the desperate struggle for life forces you to rethink all previous priorities, putting unity and the will to win over circumstances at the forefront.
The process of survival requires the captain not only to think strategically, but also to build trusting relationships with his subordinates. Interaction with crew members, some of whom are women, takes on a special character under conditions of constant stress and isolation. Gradually, work connections can develop into something more, opening up new storylines filled with romantic and explicit scenes. Managing a team becomes a complex task where leadership, personal sympathies and intimate moments are intertwined.

The further you progress, the more difficult the tasks become, requiring increasingly creative conveyor belt designs.
Grab a friend and get ready for crazy fun! Ready, Steady, Ship! It shines brightest in local co-op, where players communicate, strategize, and juggle tasks in a whirlwind of activity. While single-player play is possible, the real fun comes from the cooperative experience of building and navigating the assembly line labyrinth of the factory. So gather your mayhem buddy, put on your beanies, and get ready for a wild ride through the factory!
