Game Description No Rest for the Wicked immerses players in a world ravaged by death and despair. Developed by Moon Studios, the creators of Ori and the Blind Forest, this action RPG promises challenging combat and deep human storytelling. The kingdom mourns the death of King Harol, leaving his untested son Magnus on the throne. Meanwhile, an ancient plague known as the Blight returns, corrupting the land and its inhabitants. Amid the chaos, Madrigal Celine, hungry for power in the church, seeks to use the crisis for his own selfish purposes.
Players take on the role of Serim, a mystical warrior tasked with destroying the Blight. However, the fight against evil will not be easy. Serim becomes embroiled in the plight of suffering people and a complex political struggle for power. Every decision carries weight, determining the fate of the kingdom and the fate of Serim himself. The game features brutal strategic battles. Players battle monstrous creatures, soldiers, and challenging bosses while mastering a variety of weapons and skills. Crafting and customization allow you to create individual buildings suitable for each player.
The story takes place on the banks of the Isola Sacra and touches on themes of maturity and darkness. Cunning rulers and rebels vie for power as the plague transforms lives into twisted parodies of their former selves. The exploration takes place in a carefully crafted world - a living picture, replete with details. From sun-drenched meadows to the shady Nameless Pass, each location holds its own secrets, people and treasures. Looking for solace? The city of Sacramento offers you refuge. Players can buy and decorate properties, fish, farm, and interact with townspeople, gradually restoring the city to its former glory.
And for those who are looking for communication, up to three friends can join the campaign in online co-op, sharing with them the quests, challenges and open spaces of Isola Sacra. No Rest for the Wicked promises a journey through a world on the brink of destruction. Will the Serim cleanse the land of evil and pave a new path for the kingdom, or will darkness consume everyone?

The core gameplay combines elements of role-playing with exploration without loading screens. In the world of Next Jianghu 2, protagonists navigate using special movement skills, sliding through water, running through vegetation, and climbing buildings to discover hidden locations. Conflict plays a central role, allowing you to engage in large-scale wars to assert faction dominance, using combat mechanics reminiscent of the Mount & Blade series.

The online game throws players into the deep end, forcing them to juggle numerous orders at various culinary stations. Time is of the essence—if you wait too long, hungry customers will leave without paying. The game is available for free, and you can play it on the Internet online, even pirated.

Chefs Together isn’t just about following recipes. It is a balance between inventory management, fast service and customer satisfaction. You must ensure that the pantry is stocked, plates are flying out of the kitchen, and smiles are shining on the faces of diners. There’s also multiplayer mayhem - you can play pranks on your fellow chefs by stealing their ingredients or turning them into animals while serving.
There are 19 different cooking stations in the game, each with its own set of 19 recipes. There’s no shortage of culinary tasks, from flipping burgers to making ice cream. As you progress, you’ll unlock new abilities that will help you cope with the heat in the kitchen.

Game Description Lifecraft is a management and construction simulator. The video game can also be classified as a sandbox and strategy game. It has elements of survival. The indie project has two-dimensional pixel graphics. The camera is located at the top and at an angle. This title differs from other similar games in its concept. Instead of managing a factory, you need to control the life support of the cell. The player is asked to organize the work of all its vital functions. Under the control of the user, it gradually evolves and becomes a more advanced organism. The user also needs to deal with internal and external threats. For example: with viruses, wounds, bacteria. Instead of buildings, he installs veins, capillaries, microtubules, and so on, using frames and tissue materials for this.
In the indie title Lifecraft, the body consists of various subsystems. For their normal functioning it is necessary to generate and compress energy. This is done through mitochondrial respiration or through glycolysis. The more complex a cell becomes, the more different resources it needs for its continued existence. They are mined in the outer primordial broth. Therefore, the user’s number of supply-related tasks is gradually increasing. He will have to establish blood circulation, regulate the functioning of neurons and the brain, and so on. As he progresses, he not only faces new challenges, but also receives additional tools, and also expands his capabilities in the microworld.

Game Description InSchool Paranormal Laboratory the ability to play online with a friend is free, even on a pirated version. This online online game allows you to become a supernatural investigator without any prior experience. Your mission is to investigate the dark incidents at the school and collect evidence.
The task is to find objects associated with ghosts, place them in an ominous chest and deliver them to the base. Pay attention to the insult limit in each case, and be careful! You may encounter real paranormal events, so use your smart glasses to automatically collect information. And remember, night is the perfect time for ghost hunting, so get ready for some nighttime adventures.
The institute provides you with a helmet and smart glasses. Think of the helmet as your paranormal tool belt. You can insert IC chips into it, which enhance your investigative abilities - the higher the level, the better. Stacking chips with the same effect gives you additional benefits, but they are limited in number, so choose wisely.
The main thing is sanity. Keep your helmet on - the darkness drains your sanity faster than a wandering poltergeist. Breathe life into this abandoned monstrosity and transform it into a vibrant commercial mecca. The game is based on resource management and production autonomy. Beneath the dusty floors of the mall lies a vast underground laboratory - a blank canvas for your production endeavors. Here you will produce a variety of goods, from daily necessities to high-tech gadgets.
The laboratory can be expanded indefinitely. But remember that growth comes at a price. You will need to carefully manage resources, ensuring a steady supply of electricity, water, oil and other raw materials to keep the wheels of your enterprise turning. Building and managing a shopping center is a practical matter. You will need to plan stores, automate payment systems, and implement strategies to increase sales. The title encourages a sense of industrial independence by requiring you to produce the necessary resources yourself.
A well-functioning parking lot is also critical to attracting customers and maximizing revenue. Center Station Simulator offers a sandbox-style experience, allowing gamers to experiment and create their own unique shopping mall layouts. The game encourages creativity and strategic thinking as you balance production, sales, and resource management.

Game Description In Dice Kingdoms, you can play with a friend online for free on a pirate, taking part in turn-based battles based on dice rolls. It is necessary to build a base, develop a kingdom, train an army and defend against enemy attacks. On the Internet online you can fight against other players or play in co-op. Having accumulated enough resources, you can build a wonder of the world. A huge island consisting of different biomes and resources is available for exploration. The online game Dice Kingdoms is built on the principle of dice rolls. When a certain number is rolled, you are given a chance to make a winning move or receive a certain amount of resources.
An important mechanic is disasters. They can either help in battles or vice versa - destroy a city or destroy crops. Natural disasters are determined by rolling the dice. Some types of disasters attack only the enemy, but there are also those that cause harm to both sides of the conflict. To get as many resources as possible, you need to attack enemy cities. Free online play allows you to join forces with a partner to fight against a common enemy. A victory is counted if the opponent’s king is defeated. Buildings must be built in such a way as to provide maximum protection to the city. It is necessary to do everything possible to anticipate the opponent’s strategy and prevent him from breaking through the defense. By rerolling the dice, you can gain additional resources, but you can also expose yourself to one of many natural disasters.

Game Description Route8 puts you behind the wheel on a seemingly ordinary road. But something is wrong. You are lost. No matter how long you drive, the landscape repeats itself, like a loop from which there is no way out. Night falls and your phone is ringing from an unknown number. The situation takes a chilling turn when rain lashes the asphalt and disturbing events unfold around them.
This short walking simulator takes inspiration from Exit8, relying solely on atmosphere and visuals to build up the horror. The lack of dialogue forces you to interpret the story through the environment. Each playthrough offers a unique experience, and multiple endings hint at the deeper truth behind the disturbing secret.
Prepare for psychological horror. The deserted road and endless loop create a feeling of isolation and vulnerability. The game evokes a familiar fear - driving alone on a dark road. But Route 8 ramps up the horror with a relentless downpour and a series of strange incidents that will keep you guessing. The beginning of the game creates a tense atmosphere, and players are eager to unravel the secrets hidden in this suspenseful journey. Prepare for the cold. As night falls and the phone rings, you find yourself trapped in a cycle of cars driving endlessly along Route 8. The rain continues to fall, adding to the isolation and anxiety. With each loop, new secrets are revealed that require your full attention.

Game Description From Glory to Goo is a cosmic adventure. Forget about the conquest of the new worlds - here the survival depends on how to cling to the fragment of the rock among the inexorable stream of mucus. You play for the captain, the last hope of mankind, who is instructed to establish a fragile colony on a hostile foreign world. Your enemies are not rival empires and not robots with lasers, but the ubiquitous mucus, a reasonable, changing form, the threat that oozes, drips and crawls to your colony from all sides.
The construction of outpost is a desperate struggle for resources. Each inch of space suitable for life should be cut out of alien terrain, each unit of water and energy should be squeezed out of an inexorable environment. The clock is inexorably ticking, every moment closer to your flickering light of civilization closer. But among the panic there is a goal. You command the growing group of specialists, opening new combat units using research and adapting to the constantly changing GOO tactics. You expand, capturing valuable resources and revealing the secrets of the previous ones doomed to the death of expeditions. Each piece of knowledge, every ounce of metal, every glimpse of the union with the local life of the planet is a desperate attempt to survive.
But the real struggle takes place at the top. The linen -colonies tied to the planet is your lifebueting circle. The pointed piece of the saved material should be sent back into space to finance the construction of vital modules: factories for the production of weapons, laboratories to open new technologies and arsenal to contain the advancing wave. From Glory to Goo is a cruel dance of despair and adaptation. You will increase the level of your captain, opening skills and abilities in order to better control your motley army in the fight against the inevitable. Every victory, every piece of progress is bought later, with courage and gloomy realization that only one GOO wave remains before the defeat. This is not about becoming famous in the starry sky, but that the last light of mankind does not go out in mucus. This is not a story about glory. This is a story about the struggle for existence contrary to everything, the story of despair and stamina in the face of an unstoppable enemy. Get ready to stain your hands, captain.

Over the course of several rounds, each of which includes the Reveal, Agent, and Reveal phases, Dune: Imperium unfolds its strategic tapestry. During the Reveal phase, conflict cards contain information about rewards and punishments for the upcoming Battle of Arrakis. Then, during the Agents phase, players strategically place their agents in key locations such as a city, starport, High Council, or desert. Each location provides certain benefits - from resources and cards to influence and combat power. In the final card reveal phase, players reveal their cards, resolve conflicts, and use additional effects caused by selected cards or locations. The game ends either after a certain number of rounds or when one of the four paths of influence reaches the zenith, culminating in victory points to determine the final winner.

Game Description Barbotine is an experimental horror, the plot of which tells the story of the creepy seven-day transformation of the protagonist. After an unfortunate incident at a party, the hero falls ill and his body begins to undergo grotesque changes. In parallel with the physical mutations, the surrounding reality is also distorted: the familiar apartment becomes an increasingly strange and hostile place every day. Surreal visual images and a disturbing atmosphere plunge you into a state of increasing anxiety, making you feel alienated from your own body and the world around you. This short but intense experience explores themes of loneliness and obsession.
The project deeply explores the psychological aspects of anxiety and social isolation using a unique artistic style. The visuals, which harken back to the PSX-era aesthetic, only add to the depressing feel of the experience. In Barbotine, the player must face the consequences of growing self-hostility, which is reflected in distorted space and frightening animations. The atmospheric soundtrack and thoughtful level design work together to create a cohesive and memorable experience, reminiscent of Suda51’s work and classic Silent Hill titles, but with its own unique twist.
The gameplay is not limited to just exploring the deformed home. The protagonist is not a defenseless victim of circumstances and is able to fight back against the terrible creatures that come his way. In a tense combat system built on close combat, the main tool becomes an ordinary shovel. With its help, you will not only have to fight off bizarre enemies, but also satisfy the uncontrollable desire to dig a deep hole located in the basement of the house. Once you study the rhythm of the battles, you can discover a peculiar mechanical elegance in them that complements the overall picture of this unusual project.

Game Description Dawnsbury Days provides a turn-based tactical RPG experience based on the PF2E ruleset, a system derived from tabletop entertainment under the Open Game License. Gamers take control of four childhood friends as they embark on their first meaningful adventures in this strategic environment. The main goal requires protecting the characters' hometown from many dangers that threaten its stability.
Gameplay mechanics emphasize grid positioning and calculated combat, stemming directly from the established rules system. In Dawnsbury Days, you lead the actions of the Dawnsbury Four. Creating and developing heroes provides significant opportunities; There are 9 origins to choose from, such as elf or orc, and 16 specialized classes, including fighter, wizard or psionicist. As the team progresses, the player allocates points from a pool of approximately 300 traits and selects abilities from over 250 available spells, customizing each character’s functions.
Obtaining loot remains an integral part of strengthening your squad for subsequent encounters. The main adventure unfolds through 20 separate skirmishes, presenting a narrative focused on the protagonists' initial trials, and takes approximately 4 hours to complete. To extend the time, this tactic provides the possibility of replaying with different squad compositions and a separate free mode with 10 additional scenarios with strong opponents. Characters reach a maximum level of 4 as part of the included content.

The gameplay of this project is structured in two main modes. The plot is based on the concept of entropy, which is a measure of disorder and chaos in the world. The participant’s actions affect the level of entropy in the world, which in turn affects the events and outcomes of the plot. The action game features a mature and unique storytelling with voice acting and animated scenes. The game contains references and connections to the original BlazBlue story, as well as new characters and scenarios. BlazBlue Entropy Effect promises to provide an exciting and exciting experience for fans of adventure games and BlazBlue. The project combines fast-paced combat, strategic customization and branching storylines to create a varied and replayable adventure.

Game Description Combat Mission: Final Blitzkrieg is an online game in which you can recreate the historical battles between Nazi Germany and the Western Allies at the end of World War II. The game covers events from October 1944 to January 1945, with an emphasis on the Battle of Arc, the largest and bloodiest operation of the war.
The game gives you the opportunity to appreciate the difficulties and advantages of commanding troops in different situations and conditions. You can play online as the Americans who are trapped in the German counter-offensive in the Ardennes, or as the Germans who are trying to fight their way through the Allied defenses to Antwerp. You can also play online online as the British helping the Americans on the northern flank, or as the Canadians fighting on the southern flank. The game has the option of free online pirate play, so you can play with a friend for free.
The game offers two main campaigns, one for each side, as well as a tutorial campaign, 25 stand-alone scenarios and many maps for quick battles. Campaigns follow historical events and outcomes, but also allow for alternative paths and options. Scenarios range from small skirmishes to large battles, and the Quick Battle system allows you to customize your own battles with different options and settings.
You can immerse yourself in the game’s realistic and exciting 3D environment, where you can control various vehicles, teams and units and see how they are affected by the terrain, climate and lighting. The game also takes into account the “soft factors” that determine the morale, experience and leadership of your units, as well as the level of uncertainty, detection, field of view, command and control, and objectives. The game offers a unique hybrid system that allows you to play in real time or turn-based, depending on your inclinations and style. The game also has a full-fledged editor that allows you to create your own maps, scenarios and campaigns, as well as share them with other players.

Game Description Anomaly Agent is a fast-paced 2D action platformer that places players in the heart of a bustling cyberpunk metropolis. As the titular character, Anomaly, players take on the role of an agent on a mission to investigate and eliminate temporary anomalies wreaking havoc on the city. The narrative unfolds gradually, revealing a complex web of interconnected areas with their own unique challenges and mysteries.
At the core of Anomaly Agent’s appeal is its innovative combat system, which relies on Anomaly’s unique ability to manipulate time. This feature brings a strategic element to the gameplay, allowing players to deftly evade enemy attacks and pull off perfectly timed combos. Progression unlocks a repertoire of new abilities that allow the Anomaly to launch devastating attacks and develop strategies for each confrontation. There’s also an intriguing storyline that forces players to piece together pieces of the city’s history and decipher the motives behind the temporary disruptions. The depth of the story is given by the diverse and memorable characters that inhabit the cyberpunk landscape, each of whom contributes to the overall richness of the gaming experience. In the game’s immersive world, gamers don’t just move through a pixelated environment, but are drawn into a multi-faceted story that unfolds with every step, offering challenges, discoveries and a fascinating exploration of a cyberpunk dystopia.

Game Description The events of the Stargate: Timekeepers project take place within a separate universe called SG-1. It all begins with the Battle of Antarctica, where Commander Eve McKine leads the battle against Anubis' fleet. After this, the user will be able to take control of a squad subordinate to this very Eve in order to penetrate behind enemy lines and complete a number of dangerous tasks. The outcome of the war depends on this, so no one has the right to make a mistake.
The story campaign of Stargate: Timekeepers consists of 14 consecutive missions, during which you will have to fight several unique types of hostile creatures at once. Some people focus on close combat, while others, on the contrary, prefer to stay at a distance from the target. Some locations (for example, the starting one) can be passed in stealth mode, eliminating enemies one by one. Each unit has a scripted route and viewing radius. Detection does not occur immediately, and before a critical situation occurs, you can manage to neutralize the enemy. Moving, like other active actions, occurs using the mouse. But you shouldn’t think that during each subsequent sortie you will be able to concentrate exclusively on fighting. Sometimes, you will need to switch to healing allies, neutralizing enemy electronic devices, as well as a number of other tasks. Moreover, any sortie requires a clear understanding of the team’s capabilities. Each character belongs to a specific class, and this must be taken into account for successful combat. For example, Derek Harper has controlled drones with him, which provide remote neutralization of devices, as well as conduct reconnaissance of hard-to-reach areas.

Game Description A simulator of city construction, the development of an entire planet and a ward civilization -The Universim is a short sand strategy in which you have to try on the role of God. The game begins with the fact that you settle several people on one of the planets, give them food, indicate what needs to be done - set priorities. And then watch how people develop on their own, without your help. But who are you if not God? You still have control over everything they do. You can even change thoughts and intentions, punish pranksters and bandits, give people something or take it away, depending on their behavior.
The people you place on the planet are called Nuggets. These are unique creatures with their own characteristics, which are also personalized - each personality has its own characteristics, views, health and appearance. Quite beautiful and quite interesting graphics of the game show you the full control of the planet: punish, give, encourage, observe and influence, because you are God. You have time, natural disasters and disasters, changes in thoughts, punishment and more than 20 different abilities with which you can influence your Nuggets.
At the beginning of the game you choose a planet. So that real Nuggets, who over time become like real people - in behavior, way of thinking and movements - can exist peacefully, you need to give them the right direction in construction and thought. For example, food and water must be on the planet. They will get them themselves, but how will they come to this idea? To keep creatures' Happiness levels from decreasing, they need entertainment. Give them one!
The development of civilization also depends on resources. For example, if you tell them to kill one animal, it will become scarce and then completely disappear from the earth; if the Nuggets build factories and pollute the environment, then the elements will overtake them even without your intervention. If they work at night and sleep during the day, then a disruption of the biological rhythm will lead to the collapse of civilization!

Game Description Kebab Chefs! - Restaurant Simulator is an unusual online game. Of course, you will still be cooking kebabs, but this game allows you to play online with friends, even if they have a pirated version. It’s not just a cooking adventure, it’s a free-to-play online game with free online play. Culinary adventures around the world, online cooperation and relaxation at the pub after work await you. This is something unusual and possibly a lot of fun.
Up to four players can take part in the game to create their own kebab empire. It doesn’t matter if you play as a solo chef or in a grilling team, the main thing is to build your business step by step. In addition to the usual cooking, you can also become a restaurant owner by creating a menu with exotic dishes from around the world that sit side by side with the classic doner.
Moroccan lamb tagine, Japanese yakitori or even a juicy American cheesesteak. Each recipe you master will add another delicious string to your culinary bow and expand your restaurant’s repertoire. Happy customers mean happy pockets, so watch your kebab kingdom flourish and your menu turn into a mouth-watering passport to international flavors.
But working in a restaurant is not all hustle and bustle. Chef “Kebab!” understand how important it is to relax after a long day of grilling. So when the last kebab is eaten and the dishes are washed, it’s time to head to the local pub. Grab a cold drink, chat with fellow chefs, and maybe even relax with some casual games. It’s a chance to let loose, build camaraderie, and maybe even pick up a few recipe tips from your fellow barbecuers.
Whether you’re a seasoned restaurant simulation veteran or a cooking newbie, Kebab Chefs! Restaurant Simulator offers a fresh and flavorful take on the genre. With a varied menu, a spirit of collaboration and an after-work pub, this is a game that asks you to build more than just a restaurant - it asks you to build a community, one sizzling skewer at a time.

A powerful influx of mystical energy and dark forces fills the metropolis, giving power to countless monsters and demons, who again carry destruction. The Bureau of Investigations, a special organization, is forced to intervene in this anomaly and sends its agents that are most resistant to unbridled energy. These operatives are a group of intelligent demon-shifts, whose task is to stop the otherworldly invasion and pacify the riots.
The key gameplay in Snake Crush combines the survival elements and the three system in a row, where the players direct a hungry snake to absorb the elements on the map. Having collected 3 identical elements, the character activates special skills to clean up the territory from opponents. Gamers lead their demon-snake over the city, exterminating many small creatures and spirits attracted by the release of energy from the dragon veins. The main task is to effectively use this combat system tied to the absorption to resist the onslaught of opponents and distraught gigantic creatures that fill the human world.
Promotion under each race consists in accumulating experience with defeated enemies-this is the central system for Roguelite design of this project with mechanics of irreversible death. An increase in the level opens up access to improvements that change the capacity of the snake and make it possible to collect a unique combination of skills for each mission. This game requires competent management of resources and decision -making that determine the style of passing tasks. The successful gameplay depends on the strategic application of skills and improvements received for one attempt to hold out to the finale.

Game Description Fling to the Finish allows you to play pirate with a friend online. You can also do this online via the Internet. The title is designed for co-op. However, you are also allowed to go through it solo.
It’s a mixture of racing and platforming. The network game offers pairs to participate in competitions. In Fling to the Finish, all teams consist of two users. Each user controls a ball-like creature. The choice is given to a penguin, a snail, a bee, a goldfish, a sheep, a robot, a worm in an apple, a tumbleweed, a slug, a mushroom, a nut and a TV. They all know how to roll in different directions and jump. The main feature of the indie project is that these creatures are connected to each other with an elastic rope. If one character falls into the abyss, he will drag his partner tied to him along with him. However, the rope also helps in performing acrobatic feats. For example: you can throw a friend onto ledges or slide down the crossbars together.
There are different locations: an asteroid field, a park hanging in the air, a casino. At each level you need to get from start to finish as quickly as possible. Along the way you need to overcome obstacles. Lagging pairs can shoot plungers, weights and lasers at the leaders for a chance to get ahead. Free online play features include online and local multiplayer. They are allowed to be combined. And thanks to split screen, players can have fun together on one PC. You can even use one gamepad for two people (half a controller for each).

Game Description Palworld offers you to find and use friends as helpers in a huge and dangerous world. The multiplayer survival game has elements of crafting, and the creatures themselves, discovered by the user in the process, become his pet friends, which help him at all stages of the passage, including the ability to move on them, construct buildings, engage in farming, production, and explore dungeons.
The user finds himself in a virtual universe inhabited by bizarre animal creatures, which in this world are simply called Friends. Together with them, the gamer will have to engage in battles with poachers, fight, send them to work in factories, cultivate agricultural land, sell, reproduce and breed new generations. The dangers include not only poachers, but also a lack of food and bad weather, for which you will have to constantly be prepared. As the player progresses, using creature friends, he navigates them, flying, swimming, digging to extract minerals, allowing him to explore different areas in the air, ground and underground spaces. Friends can also engage in construction, building any buildings the user needs, emit electrical energy, and also extract minerals in mines.
Each of the presented creatures is distinguished by individual skills, for example, in the agricultural sector, some are able to sow, others - to water, and others - to harvest. The user also gets the opportunity to grow gardens, develop farms and build factories where workers are willing to work simply for food. The game also invites you to explore dungeons, penetrating dangerous zones with companions who enter into battle alongside the user. You can also breed your pets to inherit their parents' traits, or combine different species to create more unique pet abilities. Some creatures live in forbidden areas, and by penetrating into them, the player is able to obtain their most valuable and expensive species, but if caught, he will be punished.

Game Description Rising Lords presents a mixture of a strategy with a card game in medieval setting. Fights are implemented using step -by -step mechanics. The player collects slaves and uses them for his personal purposes. As in any economic strategy, the gameplay is based on the collection of resources and taxes. The player is free to set the amount of duties depending on the solvency of units. It is required to set tasks and work to the peasants for the whole day.
Having built a rich city containing a first -class fortification, a strong and large army is gathering, equipped with the most advanced weapons. Over time, many subjects grow to the knights and act as a significant combat unit on the battlefield. The success of the kingdom depends on the skills of diplomacy, competent production of goods, regulation of salaries and taxes. No less important is the need to monitor the number of army and the moral spirit of detachments. To collect an invincible army, the presence of free recruits and a supply of weapons in the warehouse is required. Soldiers are divided into 7 types: militias, archers, swordsmen, crossbowkers, knights, spearmen and horseback riding. There is another type of fighters - mercenaries. For their recruitment, it is only enough to have funds in the treasury. It is necessary to participate in tactical tense fights between rich feudal lords, each of which eagers to capture as many territories as possible on a global map. Be sure to monitor the budget, since the personal army lives on a salary. Only money will cease to be paid, units can begin to desert.
The most important element of the Rising Lords gameplay are raids on neighboring cities to prevent their army from attacking your base or cutting off the opponent from the most important resources. The mechanics of the game allows the peasants to freeze hunger. There is an opportunity to misinform the enemy or perform sabotage. The system is closely tied to the moral spirit of citizens, so the psychological battle is no less important than military policy. Additional features include a flexible editor of the protagonist, with which you can configure the appearance and assign the abilities, 50 unique events and collecting cards that give tactical advantages, as well as multiplayer up to 4 players.

Optimize their schedule so they are the right tool for the job and not a rusty anchor dragging you down. Contracts, the lifeblood of any shipping magnate, dangle like carrots on a stick. Make profitable deals, but watch out for hidden clauses and fickle customers. Unexpected storms, political unrest, or even an illegal container stuck in the Suez Canal can turn profit into danger in the blink of an eye. SeaOrama: World of Shipping is not a leisurely cruise. This is a journey through the stormiest waters of commerce, where only the cunning and adaptable survive. So polish your brass binoculars, strap on your metaphorical life jacket, and get ready to chart your course to shipping supremacy.

Game Description Polylithic takes players into the heart of the Paleolithic/Neolithic era, where survival depends on cunning, resourcefulness and ingenuity. As the newly minted leader of your tribe, you’ll face the daunting task of leading your people through a vibrant, low-poly wilderness teeming with both opportunity and danger. You will spend the first days in a frantic struggle for survival. Hunger gnaws at your belly, the elements threaten your fragile existence, and every rustle in the underbrush can attract a predator. Picking berries, making simple tools and finding shelter become your top priorities. And yet, amid this struggle, a glimmer of hope began to glimmer. Every garbage collected, every tool made unlocks a new level of technology, bringing your tribe closer to civilization.
With new knowledge and stronger tools in hand, the hunt begins. The rabbits scatter through the tall grass, their timid movements revealing their rich flesh. Mammoths, once revered giants of the prehistoric landscape, now pose a formidable challenge: their skins promise warmth and their meat a feast for the entire tribe. Each successful conquest will not only satisfy your hunger, but also strengthen your reputation, attracting more souls to your nascent settlement.
As your tribe expands, its needs grow. Rough shelters become huge communal huts requiring constant maintenance and expansion. You have the heavy responsibility of being a leader. You must distribute tasks, oversee the well-being of the tribe, and navigate the subtle social dynamics that bind your people together. Elders give wise counsel, children frolic in the huts, and experienced hunters bring home the spoils, and each life story is intertwined with the fate of the tribe. Beneath the immediate concerns of survival lies a deeper secret, a gnawing unease that permeates the very fabric of your existence. Whispers of a forgotten past, ancient technologies and mysterious structures pique your curiosity.
Driven by an insatiable thirst for knowledge, you venture deep into the wild, unearthing the remains of lost civilizations and piecing together the scattered history of your own tribe. Polylithic is not just a game of survival, it is a journey of discovery, a chance to rewrite forgotten chapters of humanity’s past. In this vibrant, low-poly world, every sunrise brings a new challenge, every moonlit night a new revelation. So strap on your loincloths, sharpen your spears, and get ready to lead your tribe into a bright dawn.

Game Description DON’T SCREAM is a thrilling indie horror game that plunges you into the heart of an eerie forest with a nerve-wracking twist: silence is the key to survival. The basic concept is simple, but fiendishly difficult: survive in a creepy forest for 18 minutes without letting out a single scream. An integral component of the game is a functional microphone, and any flash, scream or loud noise will result in the character’s untimely demise, causing an unfortunate restart.
DON’T SCREAM cleverly keeps the player on the edge of their seats with a variety of dynamic leaps and bounds, a relentless test of nerves and courage. A distinctive feature of the game is the time mechanics. The clock only ticks when the player moves, creating a palpable layer of tension and strategic gameplay. However, this is not just your average horror game. It aims to replicate the creepy atmosphere of shot-on-video films such as The Blair Witch Project. This is not only a personal horror, but also a communal experience where friends and family can watch and listen to the players' creepy reactions. This is a severe test of self-control, where any careless sound can lead to death. This project promises to be an unforgettable and adrenaline-pumping entertainment with an unambiguous but ominous slogan: “If you scream, you restart.”

Game Description AI Roguelite is a text role -playing game where artificial intelligence generates all content and controls all game mechanics. The system determines each location, a non -game character, an enemy and an object that a player faces. In addition, recipes for creating things and fundamental rules of interaction also come from the neural network. As a result, the gamer has to explore the Universe, 100 percent consisting of elements created by a large language model, which provides a procedural adventure as a procedurally generated.
The world of AI Roguelite is formed from the answers of the neural network to contextual requests, inhabiting the area with appropriate entities. The model determines the specific weapons or enemies discovered in locations like an underwater city, which facilitates the study. The creation of objects works according to the similar principle of AI-interpretation. The algorithm decides which object will come from a combination of ingredients, such as a wooden stick and stone, or even a computer chip with a zombie brain.
Artificial intelligence bases the final result on the names of the components provided. The gameplay of battles departs from the traditional statistics of objects. When a gamer attacks the robot terminator with a raw salmon, the outcome depends on several factors. The success of the action takes into account the names and descriptions of the involved things, an assessment of credibility on the part of AI and a throw of a cube on the attributes of the character. After action, the neural network creates a narrative describing what happened. In conclusion, the system analyzes its own generated story to conclude whether the opponent was killed, wounded or remained unharmed.

Game Description Mosa Lina challenges the established rules of the immersive sim genre, where the tools often directly correspond to the obstacles. This title uses deliberate randomization, meaning there is no predetermined way to progress through the hand-crafted stages. Gamers move through these locations with the task of collecting fruit, which opens a portal to the exit, but the means of achieving the goal are not predetermined. The gameplay forces improvisation, relying on unpredictable elements and physical interactions.
The core of Mosa Lina is built on the principles of complete randomness regarding the equipment given out and the order in which levels appear. It is possible to obtain the same items several times in a row, or end a session without encountering a particular item, as there are no mechanisms to guarantee variety or balance. This unpredictable distribution also applies to manually prepared challenges, so races cover only a portion of the overall content. The mechanics of the project encourage you to find solutions by using available, randomly issued resources in locations that may not have been encountered before.
The interactions in this puzzle platformer rely entirely on a single engine that controls the character, environmental elements, usable items and dangers. Any object reacts to all other elements, giving rise to unexpected gameplay situations that arise directly from these laws of physics. While the task remains the same - collect the designated fruits to activate the exit - the specific method for completing it remains open. Success depends on mastering the physics and current set of gadgets to cope with randomly generated platforming puzzles.

Game Description Subpar Pool combines golf and billiard elements on a table of tables. The player will have to remove all balls for a limited number of blows at each procedured level, consisting of a sequence of connected surfaces. Gameplay based on physics requires strategic planning to roll objects. Classing and scattering balls often require adjusting the original plans, forcing to adapt the next move to complete the stage.
As you pass, gamers build a course, choosing cards from the deck to change experience. This system allows you to create individual tests, for example, the FAST RUN option, which adds aiming time restriction, or other portals. Modifiers can also change the properties of balls, for example, turning them into glass. Subpar Pools available 18 different cards that create more than 14,000 combinations with a unique set of rules for each call.
This game is divided into 4 different worlds, each with its own set of restrictions and trials. The project is designed for short sessions, but also supports a longer involvement. Such a structure, combined with a modifier system, guarantees a constant change in the sequence of tables and their inherent difficulties. The control scheme is configured for the game with one hand, adapting to different styles of interaction.

Game Description Athos is an immersion into the harsh realities of survival in a wild and dangerous world. Finding themselves in an unpredictable environment, migrants are forced to create living conditions from scratch. The construction of a fortified outpost from available materials, such as stone and wood, becomes a priority task for protection from aggressive fauna. To counter threats, you must constantly learn new skills and collect blueprints that allow you to create more advanced weapons and armor. Exploring vast territories opens up access to rare resources that are vital for further development.
The history of this world begins with a tragedy: the remnants of humanity, fleeing the devastated Earth, go to seek refuge on the distant planet Athos. However, due to the peculiarities of the atmosphere, the technology only allows people to teleport to the surface without the possibility of returning, dooming them to isolation among prehistoric predators. The environment is populated by various species of dinosaurs, from speedy velociraptors to giant tyrannosaurs.
The protagonists will not only have to hunt these creatures, but also master the art of taming them, turning mortal enemies into loyal allies and defenders of their shelter. The survival process offers a unique development path for each character. As you gain experience, new abilities are unlocked that help both in combat and in exploring the wild. Gameplay allows you to go it alone, honing your skills away from everyone, or team up with other survivors to face more serious threats.

Game Description Space Wreck is a turn-based adventure set in space. You play as colonists who have left Earth in search of a new home. But something unpleasant happened along the way. A shuttle carrying passengers was attacked by space corsairs. The ship was badly damaged and now you need to get to an abandoned station nearby to find working parts.
The gameplay of Space Wreck is made in an isometric style and borrows mechanics from games such as Fallout 2 and Arcanum. The gameplay, just like classic games, is incredibly hardcore and offers many challenging tasks to solve. In addition, the role-playing system and freedom of action were borrowed. You can play as absolutely any character, leveling up different skills: agility, talkativeness, cunning, hacking, hooliganism, etc. Depending on your choice of skills, the gameplay changes.
Quests are non-linear. There are always several ways to pass, largely depending on abilities. For example, if you can’t get the desired belief, you can always hack the terminal and find out information that will force the NPC to cooperate. And this is one example. Usually there are 3-8 ways to solve problems.
Your choices have a direct impact on the world around you. Depending on the decisions you make, a unique ending awaits you. The combat, like in the cult RPGs of the past, is made in a turn-based style. Move along the grid and roll the dice. Fight a huge number of unique enemies, each of which fights using individual tactics.

Game Description Midnight Girl is a point-and-click adventure. The game takes place in France in the mid-1960s. Its history, atmosphere and stylistic decisions originate in the city of Paris, and are also influenced by Belgian comics and cinema of the sixties. Gamers are immersed in this narrative primarily through investigation and exploration of the environment within a 2D side-scrolling perspective.
Midnight Girl is available for single player playthrough on mobile platforms, computers and console systems. The narrative follows Monique, characterized as a tomboyish teenager, operating as a housewife thief in Paris. After a robbery gone wrong, she ends up in prison. In prison, Monique meets another inmate, described as mysterious, leading to their escape from captivity together. They subsequently enter into an agreement to attempt a grand theft targeting a valuable diamond. This decision initiates the main quest in the title.
Their pursuit takes the protagonists through a variety of locations, including a Catholic monastery, underground in a Paris metro station, and into the Catacombs. The gameplay integrates mechanics associated with stealth operations that require careful movement. Players will also make discoveries through exploration of the detailed environments presented. Puzzle solving represents another major component needed to progress through the obstacles and story points of this adventure.

Game Description Virtual Circuit Board is a logic simulator that uses a drawing interface within the sandbox. Here, gamers construct, program and activate creations, from individual circuits to full -scale computers. The entire gameplay is concentrated in this sandbox, since it does not have training, levels or pre -prepared tasks. Players set their own goals, working with a system designed for people with a basic understanding of logical elements and their functions. This title does not provide instructions on such topics.
The Virtual Circuit Board engine is a clock system that distributes the signals between the components one interval at a time and processing millions of updates per second. The integrated assembler editor makes it possible to set his own instructions and write programs collected in accessible virtual memory. The whole game is divided into two modes. The editing stage is used for construction and coding, while the simulation stage allows you to observe the functioning of the system and interact with its active elements.
The construction of the schemes occurs through the interface based on drawing with color marking for logical elements and conductors. Specialized tools optimize the process, for example, an array function for simultaneously drawing many tracks. Electronic parts and lines connecting them support multiple entrances and outputs. To configure the appearance on top of the components, decorative layers can be applied. Thus, elements are created, such as buttons or inscriptions that change their appearance depending on the state of the part and providing visual feedback during the simulation.

Game Description Stop Dead takes you to a future where urban landscapes are spreading across the planet and artificial intelligence is becoming ubiquitous. In this world, you will find yourself embroiled in the dark plots of a rogue AI bent on destroying its creators. Your job as a player is to become a disruptive and powerful force against the AI, with a unique set of abilities to help you counter it.
You are encouraged to use supernatural abilities to run, jump, slide and throw hundreds of objects as weapons. In this merciless first-person telekinetic battle, your goal is to destroy everything in your path. However, remember that constant movement is the key to success. If you stop, you will fail. You can sneak through the urban landscape to complete missions in frantic, bloody combat, adding a layer of skill and strategy to the chaos.
The game takes inspiration from classics like Doom, Portal and Mirror’s Edge and weaves a story of speed, action and bloodshed into a kaleidoscope of chaos and fun that’s inspired by the comics. However, it is not limited to conventional weapons and projectiles. With over 160 unique throwable items, you can cause hell by using your telekinetic powers to pull and throw objects, wander randomly through levels and destroy everything in your path.
The game invites you to run, jump and slide through 40 levels in four different biomes, each created with a vibrant, comic-book-like atmosphere. From rooftops to tunnels, plenty of new paths, challenges, and even a few hidden secrets await you to discover. Apart from its addictive gameplay, Stop Dead also offers a unique feature for streamers on the Twitch platform. A fully integrated Twitch system takes streaming and global challenges to the next level. By watching the leaderboard change online, you can react to new challenges, create items and enemies directly in the stream you’re watching, and compete with your ghost against other players.

Game Description Rayz Arcade Chronology is a collection that invites you to immerse yourself in the digital space, where the Waverider manned fighter is presented as a virus, whose main task is to penetrate deep into the system. The mission, known as Operation RayCrisis, is to fight against the self-aware neurocomputer Con-Human who has rebelled against humanity.
Advancement through levels is associated with a unique Encroachment mechanic: if you do not destroy enemies quickly enough, a special meter is filled, and when 100% is reached, you are forced to move to the final clash, which directly affects the outcome of the entire operation. The basis of the combat system of the entire trilogy is the division of the playing field into two planes. Standard weapons are used to engage targets on the same level as the ship, while a homing laser is used for enemies in the background or on the ground.
This concept was laid down in the very first part of the series, RayForce, which was made in two-dimensional sprite graphics. Subsequent projects, including RayStorm, took this idea into 3D polygonal environments, developing and improving it. The Ray’z Arcade Chronology collection features both the original arcade versions and updated HD remasters of later releases. Modern re-releases of RayStorm NEO-HD and RayCrisis HD feature increased resolution, which gives ship models and environments greater clarity.

Game Description The Matchless KungFu immerses users in a world where martial arts are at the forefront. The gamer can choose the path of any warrior he likes and go on a journey through these lands. Be a loner or join a group of like-minded people - you can choose any convenient way. Only the decisions made will shape the character’s story, throwing him into different circumstances, giving him complete freedom of action in certain aspects.
The gameplay in The Matchless KungFu is formally divided into two parts - travel and combat. In the first case, the hero travels through locations, moving from one biome to another. Mountain temples, snow-capped valleys, settlements near water bodies and other places have many differences both in scale and in design. As for the combat, when switching to this mode the camera changes its location. You can watch the action as in a regular fighting game, but in addition to this, the camera rotates around the opponents, showing different perspectives of the battle. Each battle is unique, because all characters are randomly generated. Their life history, habits and fighting style are different. Game Description Napoleon’s Eagles: Game of the Napoleonic Wars is a strategic simulation of the Napoleonic Wars, adapted from the classic board game War and Peace. Gamers can lead Napoleon’s troops or oppose him, participating in key military campaigns in Europe, Egypt and Russia. There are both short historical scenarios and a large-scale multiplayer campaign covering the entire Napoleonic conflict. The multiplayer mode allows gamers to experience grand strategy warfare in a competitive setting, focusing on key historical battles and diplomatic decisions.
The gameplay is turn-based, each turn is a month of real time. The title uses hex maps to simulate military movements and decisions, where users can control different nations and their unique military units. The generals are presented with individual strengths, and each unit is designed based on the historical features of the period, such as infantry, cavalry and artillery. Gamers can engage in battles on land and sea, using navies to form global strategies.
Napoleon’s Eagles: Game of the Napoleonic Wars also includes a production system that allows gamers to strengthen their armies with supplies and new units, adding another layer of strategy to the game. Weather zones, major cities, and supply lines all play a role in the outcome of a campaign, requiring careful planning. The title strives for an authentic experience of the Napoleonic Wars with historical accuracy and an exciting turn-based strategy system.

Game Description Eon Fighter is an action game with a top view with Roguelite systems where the player pilots the fighter through the hostile sectors of the cosmos. The gameplay is focused on a collision with continuous waves of opponents and collecting resources for promotion. In the role of the last representative of mankind, it is necessary to carry out tasks, confronts the constant enemy. The structure of the Shoot ‘Em Up genre requires continuous movement and tactical ingenuity to survive in the conditions of the onslaught. The key goal is to complete the assigned tasks and contain the assault.
Eon Fighter gameplay pushes a lonely ship with hundreds of simultaneous opponents, creating a real Bullet Hell on the screen. Gamers have to act in closed areas, maneuvering to choose a position and collect key resources for a mission. The attacks of the enemy do not stop, representing a constant test of the pilot’s reflexes and tactical skills. Survival depends on the player’s ability to control the tasks under fire from several vectors. The complete destruction of all enemies is a condition for further advancement.
8 fighters with various characteristics are available to choose from, which serve as the basis for creating assemblies. These combat vehicles can be improved through 12 separate upgrading systems, as well as dozens of types of weapons and special equipment. This project offers an infinite number of combinations for customization of its vessel. This development path leads pilots to the most remote corners of the cosmos. There they will find a clash with an enemy boss, requiring a flurry of shells to break through to destroy the target and fulfill the final task.

Game Description Standbox, a bizarre single -user physical sandbox, invites players to indulge their children’s impulses to expand borders and experiments. Imagine a virtual world in which the central place is occupied by an elastic doll, which, on your order, passes all kinds of tests and hardships.
In this interactive digital site, you can interact with ragongollah in a variety of ways. It doesn’t matter what you choose - to lightly push it or throw out your most daring whims on it - you can observe the reaction and stability of Ragdollah. In the process of manipulation, he demonstrates amazing behavior: stands, balances, falls and inevitably tries to rise, even if his physical condition leaves much to be desired. These movements are controlled by complex approximation of the medical system with organs that react to what is happening in their own way.
Standbox returns us in the era of technical demonstrations of video games, when the attractiveness of the game was not so much in the gameplay itself as in technical perfection. This is a modest but intriguing experiment in the genre of “sandbox”, in which special attention is paid to the behavior of a doll named Stanley. Able to maintain balance, tolerate damage, fight a traumatic brain injury, experience fractures and show a stubborn desire to get to your feet, despite the injury, Stanley really becomes a star of this non-standard show. The landscape of the game consists of three separate cards that provide enough space for the implementation of your Ragdoll undead. As this world is studying, various tools become your companions, each of which offers unique ways to interact with Stanley and manipulating his reactions.

Game Description Sengoku Dynasty tells the story of difficult life in feudal Japan. To convey everything with maximum accuracy, the developers consulted with a historical group, which provided valuable advice and confirmed records with information about the life of that period. The player will have to become the leader of one of the villages and lead it to prosperity and expansion in one of the ways.
The player will have one, almost abandoned settlement at his disposal, which he will have to restore and provide the inhabitants with everything they need. The lands of Japan are a bit sparse in terms of fertility, so resources are often limited and one must rely on hunting and rice to survive. But at the same time, it is important to monitor the condition of the forest and the animals in it in order to prevent species from becoming extinct. At first, being a wise and strong leader will be very difficult, but you should always listen to your heart and do what is most optimal and reasonable. The paths of the ruler of the Sengoku Dynasty: Leader - creating alliances, strengthening relations with neighboring cities, trade, creating families and touching stories, such a head makes the settlement one big family and always listens to the wishes of the people Master - the leader of the technical process, makes life easier for the population with with the help of unique buildings and tools, mainly focuses on collecting various resources and directing them in the right direction. Warrior - achieves everything with the help of his weapons, masterfully masters a variety of techniques, easily repels the attacks of opponents Monk - is in complete harmony with the environment, builds various temples, worships the gods and may be heard by them
Each direction has its own characteristics and advantages in some industries, allowing you to keep everything in complete balance. The player will be able to choose the style that is most comfortable for him and move in his direction, so as not to disrupt the way of life and attract interested settlers to the village. In any of the ways, you can make enemies and start a war, but it is better to avoid this.

Game Description BOKURA is a two-player online adventure game where you can play online with a friend. Experience the exciting adventures of two runaway boys whose steps will lead them down a rabbit hole of changing realities. However, you don’t have to go on this adventure alone. This co-op odyssey gives you free online play. Find a partner who can navigate the perplexing discrepancies between your screens and take on your online adventure. Best of all, you can enjoy this adventure absolutely free, even if you play as a pirate.
Imagine you’re looking at pixelated animals and your partner is looking at metallic landscapes and robotic creatures. The same character, rendered differently, becomes a furry friend on one screen and a buzzing machine gun on another. Yes, it’s confusing, but the key to progress lies in open communication. Speak, describe, develop strategies - your contrasting perceptions will become a bridge across the abyss of distorted reality.
Forget about single-player walks or AI companions. BOKURA thrives on the dynamic duo. This is a game made of shared experiences, where cooperation is not just encouraged, it is required. Choosing a partner becomes the first puzzle, a prelude to the difficult tasks that await you.
The adventure unfolds in a side-scrolling canvas that features key decisions that shape your path. Three to four hours of solving puzzles await you, each step requires cohesion. Unravel the mystery of twisted worlds, decipher cryptic clues and overcome obstacles - these are the battles that you will fight side by side, pixel by pixel.
The journey begins with a grim encounter - a dead deer, a collective sigh, and then darkness. After awakening, the familiar world cracks, falling apart into two inconsistent realities. One boy walks among talking animals, another among whirring gears and metal behemoths. Will they be able to bridge the gap, find the source of this disorder, and return to their shared reality?

Game Description Greedland invites players to play online, throwing them into an unforgiving vortex of alien mutants. This is a high-octane shooter that you can play with a friend on a pirate for free. Combining roguelike and survivalist elements, the online game requires you to destroy hordes of alien baddies faster than you can say “They’re coming!” Starting with a basic Peashooter, in multiplayer you’ll quickly gain enough firepower to make even the toughest alien think twice.

Each weapon has its own unique charge - from explosions that destroy the air to laser beams that will make you feel like a fantasy superhero. Mix and match them as you please - the battlefield is your oyster! And if you’re feeling down, why not call a friend? Local co-op mode lets you share the fun of alien explosions. After all, misery loves company, right?

Game Description Sclash is an online game that allows you to play intense one-hit-to-kill samurai matches online. Over the Internet, you can fight a friend online, immersing yourself in a unique tension thanks to a minimalist approach to combat mechanics. Every move can be decisive for victory or defeat. You can also try playing pirate or free, but it is important to manage your stamina and timing to stay ahead of your opponents. The game’s hand-drawn art style brings combat to life, creating a beautifully rendered setting for epic showdowns.
Thanks to its simplicity, the game is accessible to beginners, and experienced fighters will be able to appreciate its depth. With just three buttons and no complicated combos to learn by heart, anyone can jump into the game and start throwing punches. However, mastering the subtle relationship between stamina management, positioning, and reading an opponent takes time and skill. This balance keeps matches fresh and unpredictable, whether you’re up against AI or a human.
Sclash’s story mode is a short but fun single-player game. It serves as both an introduction to the game’s mechanics and a showcase of its artistic vision. Some players may find it short, but others will appreciate its focused storytelling and how it eases them into the more competitive aspects of the game. However, the real meat of Sclash lies in the multiplayer duels, where players can test their mettle against others in fast-paced, exciting matches.

Game Description Baldur’s Gate 3 is a continuation of the cult turn-based RPG in which you take control of a small squad consisting of unique characters. Each party member is of great importance to tactics and represents an individual with his own character, history and abilities. Baldur’s Gate 3 invites you to explore the large open world of the Forgotten Realm.
The plot does not act as a direct continuation of the previous part, however, illithids appear in the narrative - they are also mind flayers. The story begins with the hero being imprisoned by these evil creatures. The game is based on the fifth edition of Dungeons & Dragons, and events develop in the Forgotten Realms universe. Before the start of the campaign, you can create a playable character. There are 15 races to choose from, each of which has its own characteristics. However, you can choose from ready-made heroes who have a written biography and certain skills at the start. The main character’s squad consists of four people. As you progress through the campaign, you will meet new heroes who can be taken into the party.
The difference from its predecessor is that the battles in Baldur’s Gate III are completely turn-based, while previous games in the series were based on a tactical pause. The player can control each hero of the party and interact with the environment and partners. You can enhance weapons and attacks with fire or poison. The use of auxiliary items is allowed. For example, after spilling oil across the battlefield or pouring it onto your opponents, shoot a fire arrow to make them burst into flames. By using the stealth skill, there is a chance to avoid battle. Extinguish torches and candles to darken the area. By moving through dark areas of the location, you can bypass patrols unnoticed. By using the special spell “Blackout”, you can plunge the area into darkness, depriving the enemy of visibility. Make a quiet kill or go unnoticed - the gameplay is varied and encourages any tactical decisions.

Game Description Cornucopia is a 2.5D farm life RPG that uniquely combines pet combat, animal breeding, and lush cropping. With over 49 NPCs to interact with and 200+ recipes to master, there’s never a dull moment. You’ll be able to form lasting relationships, master exciting mini-games, and enjoy holiday celebrations as you uncover the fascinating secrets of this dynamic world. By focusing on love, family, and agriculture, you can find true love, create a thriving family, and grow a variety of vegetables, fruit trees, and berry bushes.
But that’s not all: unlock the ability to collect and fight with pets to overcome challenges with loyal companions, grow and sell a variety of crops to increase your wealth, and hone your skills in mining, logging, farming, watering, mowing, fishing, and mushroom picking. Try over 200 recipes to impress your friends and family, catch 150+ types of fish, play exciting mini-games and attend colorful festivals. With a deck of 326 unique cards and scratch cards, you’ll be able to collect and strategize forever. His pleas for help, left in letters, serve as the only guide in this distorted space.
The protagonist begins his journey, not remembering anything about himself and how he got to this place, feeling only the strangeness of what is happening. Immersion in the psychological thriller GLASS forces you to piece together information about the writer, whose fate becomes the central mystery. Moving from one surreal picture to another, for example from the Crystal Spire to an ancient mansion, the hero is forced to confront the oppressive atmosphere and solve non-obvious mysteries. This process of investigation becomes not just a search for answers about another person, but a way to understand how this author’s past relates to the character’s own amnesia and what exactly brought him here.
The gameplay is based on first-person exploration of the world, where the focus is on exploring the environment and solving puzzles built into the narrative. Interaction with objects and reading the notes found form a holistic picture of the tragedy that happened to the writer T.N. The gradually revealed details of his past have an irreversible impact on the protagonist’s worldview. The ending of the story promises to forever change those who dare to follow this path to the end and find out the truth hidden behind a series of disturbing and bizarre images.

Game Description Life Not Supported is a survival simulator for the brave and courageous! You are the only survivor, stuck in vast empty space orbiting a mysterious planet that could become your new home. However, things don’t go as planned, and you’re tied to what’s left of your ship. With limited resources and time running out, you must scavenge nearby debris and assemble a makeshift vessel to escape the dangers of space and uncover the truth behind the ship’s malfunction.
You’ll have to use your wits and quick reflexes to maneuver your ship and collect precious resources as they sail by. But this is just the beginning! You will have to assemble platforms and walls to improve the size and functionality of your new home. It may not seem like much, but a strong design is the key to survival in this inhospitable vacuum. To survive, you must fill your Spacesuit Ingestion Pipe (SIP) container, melt ice to quench your thirst, and try your hand at space botany. Monitor your oxygen supply and collect spare cylinders to survive. Explore the various belts orbiting the planet and try to piece together what happened to the ship and crew.

Game Description Tale of Immortal, an open-world sandbox deeply rooted in Chinese mythology and cultivation, invites players into an immersive experience where the path to immortality is paved through strategic choices and the conquest of mythical monsters from the Classic of Mountains and Seasons. Your journey as a novice Qi Refinement Stage cultivator begins in Yukong Village. A world filled with unpredictable monsters, mystical kingdoms and treasures waiting in the wings will open before you. The path of cultivation is not just a solitary journey; it requires a deep understanding of the craft and the ability to overcome danger and adversity.
The NPC world in Tale of Immortal is fully realized, with each character leading their own independent lives. However, your choices may intersect with theirs, offering a dynamic and unpredictable narrative. Whether you cooperate with others, take revenge alone, or become everyone’s enemy, the power of the game is in your hands. Mastering martial arts, teaching NPCs the Taoist mind, participating in auctions, and running a cult, Tale of Immortal offers a variety of activities. The possibilities are vast: from exciting adventures to fulfilling promises, inciting jealousy or discovering long-forgotten treasures.
As you progress in the game, sect management gameplay appears, allowing you to experience the full spectrum of sect life. As you rise from a humble disciple to a powerful sect master, you can return a fallen sect to the pinnacle of glory, or join a huge sect to rise through the ranks. To succeed in this world, you need to hone your skills and become a real warrior. Cultivate a powerful mindset, delve into martial and spiritual skills, and study unique guides to improve your abilities. The world is filled with treasures, rare monsters, and challenges like the Tournament of Immortals and the Master Ranking that will put your school to the ultimate test.

Game Description The Dark Tower is a dark roguelike, the gameplay of which is based on the exploration of procedurally generated levels of an ominous tower. The protagonist, in the role of a brave warrior, will have to fight his way to the top to defeat the demon king and free the princess, but it soon becomes clear that the true purpose of the mission is hidden. The combat system is based on the concept of instant death: any enemy here dies from a single precise blow, which requires maximum concentration and dexterity from the gamer. Each new entry generates a unique structure of locations, devoid of clear routes. Moving through the floors is carried out using a special tank, and the path to the top is full of hidden treasures and secrets.
The main tool for eliminating obstacles and enemies are bombs that can be planted along the route. The collected gold allows you to endow them with special properties, including changing the mechanics of the explosion. In addition, the protagonist is armed with a ghostly pistol for shooting otherworldly creatures, the destruction of which gradually restores lost health. The 3D top-down camera follows the hero, dynamically rotating and allowing you to focus on what is happening. Successful completion of The Dark Tower depends on a combination of several actions:
overcome puzzles at levels. collecting useful items to strengthen your character. participation in unexpected events and fights in closed arenas. the constant evolution of bombs and other weapons.

Game Description Dead Monarchy is an addictive gameplay that puts you in the role of captain of a mercenary company, taking command and navigating a dangerous open world sandbox. This game offers a huge number of opportunities and dangers lurking around every corner. From fields to camps, caves to ruins, cemeteries to fortresses, the varied locations provide exciting environments for you to explore.
The combat system in Dead Monarchy is where the game really shines. With the ability to command up to 18 mercenaries, you must strategize and take into account various factors such as elevation, counterattacks, ranged combat, flanking and attack of opportunity. However, it’s not just about the tactical aspects; you also need to manage the morale of your soldiers. Witnessing the death of comrades or critical blows can break their resolve, so it is necessary to maintain their spirit.
Equipping your mercenaries with a wide selection of weapons and armor adds depth to the gameplay. Each item has its own unique models and characteristics, allowing you to customize your team to suit your preferred style. Plus, you can customize their benefits and characteristics, further increasing their versatility and strategic options. Advancing further means surviving increasingly challenging arenas that test your skills and resilience. Permanent death for your mercenaries and the risk of ending if your captain falls adds an intense level of consequence. The level of bravery is up to you: you can choose between manual saving and iron man mode.

Game Description Colonizing a planet in Occupy Mars is a challenging but fun task. Here the player will have to build his own base, explore the expanses of the red desert, extract water, grow food and find new ways to obtain oxygen. An open world with great sandbox potential will allow you to seriously immerse yourself in the role of a pioneer on Mars.
Using advanced technologies, Occupy Mars will create a developed network of buildings. A greenhouse, oxygen tanks, generators - all this will help you obtain vital resources and survive independently on a distant planet. The buildings are connected to each other by sealed tunnels, and solar panels can be built around them. It is also necessary to lay pipes and cables between them, and in case of breakdown, repair them using special repair kits. Soldering, hot air control, instrument measurement of indicators - all these skills will become indispensable in case of any breakdown. And in some tasks, a technologically advanced robotic dog will serve as an assistant.
The main goal will be to study the surface of Mars, search for valuable minerals and choose a place to build a future city. An eight-wheeled all-terrain vehicle or ATV will help you navigate steep terrain. Over time, the transport will be improved in the workshop. But you should be careful, because with the change of day and night the temperature drops significantly. After dark, it’s better not to leave the base; besides, it’s important to stock up on energy in advance, because the solar panels don’t work at night. The main thing in colonization is the ability to quickly respond to any disasters, because anything can happen.

Game Description Darkest Dungeon II, an exciting and intense roguelike game, immerses players in a nightmarish world on the brink of the apocalypse. In the game you have to become a brave leader, assemble a squad, equip your trusty stagecoach and go on a difficult journey through a crumbling landscape. As you plunge into the depths, you’ll soon discover that the biggest threat may come from your squad.
The combat system, renowned for its innovation in the original Darkest Dungeon, makes a triumphant return in the sequel. It’s been refined and improved this time around, and the innovative token system adds depth to strategic decisions, making every choice meaningful. Every hero on your team has a tragic origin story waiting to happen. Unleash their true potential with a variety of new skills, paths, items and more, turning them into unforgettable characters.
Darkest Dungeon II offers role-playing games, each with its own exciting story. Even if your journey ends in untimely death, you will receive valuable resources that will be useful to you on your next expedition. “Altar of Hope” is an extensive system of improvements and bonuses that allows you to customize your strategy and develop unique ways to attack the Mountain. However, these are not only external challenges. The affinity system forces you to manage the interaction and stress level of the heroes, because their connections can lead to both powerful combat synergy and catastrophic discord in the team.
The game’s nightmarish environments, including the burning Sprawl and the sick Foetor, offer a variety of challenges that will test your strategy and endurance across five different regions. In moments of respite, you can take refuge in a hotel to relieve the tension of the characters and strengthen their relationships through various entertainment and pleasures. Ultimately, by going to the Mountain and facing five terrifying manifestations of your weaknesses, you must face your own failures.
