Game Description Dungeon Drafters is a top-down, turn-based roguelike with an emphasis on tactical combat. The project uses anime style and card game mechanics. An adventurer with red hair is given control. It moves through cells. The indie product has mini-games. For example: fishing. In the title you can unlock new characters.
When confronted with opponents, the combat phase begins, and immediately, without switching to another screen, as in a JRPG. There are also no random encounters. All enemies are immediately visible on the map. In Dungeon Drafters, the heroine receives 5 random cards (200 varieties in total) from her deck each time she enters a duel.

During the fight, you can simply move around. In one turn, you are allowed to perform up to 3 actions, then it’s your opponent’s turn. Cards remain in the place of killed enemies. They can be picked up after the end of the brawl. Cards are also obtained from chests, but if there are adversaries next to them, you will first have to defeat them all, otherwise the lock will not open. Game Description Resident Evil 4 Remake is a full-fledged remake of the cult fourth part, which is rightfully considered one of the best in the series. The developers took into account the criticism of fans after the release of the remake of the third game and did not stray far from their roots, adhering to the course taken with Resident Evil 2. The plot has not undergone drastic changes, however, some storylines have been added that were not in the original, the arcs of minor characters have expanded and, Of course, the controls have been improved and the graphics have been significantly updated.
The story centers on Leon Kennedy, who arrives in the Spanish village of Pueblo to save the president’s daughter named Ashley. Here he encounters the religious cult Los Illuminados and their leader Lord Saddler. The latter controls the villagers with the help of the parasite Las Plagas, which is why they unquestioningly obey their leader. Resident Ivl 4 Remake moves away from the usual plot about the living dead, becoming closer to the original concept of “zombies” that appeared on the islands of Haiti. As legends say, Haitian shamans used Voodoo magic to control people like puppets.
During the passage of Resident Evil 4 Remake you will visit three vast locations: a village, a castle and an island. Each of the three chapters features unique monsters and bosses. In the village you will have to fight with the residents of the village and their leader, Bitorez Mendez. The castle is the family estate of the short lord Ramon Salazar, under whose leadership there are cult fanatics. The island offers to engage in battle with real military personnel and Leon’s former partner Jack Krauser, who injected himself with a strain of the Plaga virus. Some characters from past games have returned, such as Albert Wesker and Ada Wong. But they pursue their own personal goals…

Building elements in Masterplan Tycoon:
Nodes are structures that differ in the level of production and secondary parameters displayed on the interface. Game Description Dark Prospect allows players to play online in a battle between human soldiers and hellish monsters. Available for free on pirates, this asymmetrical multiplayer game pits FPS players against a friend against an RTS overlord in a fight for humanity’s survival. Soldiers mine resources, strengthen their positions and create weapons to resist the demonic horde. Meanwhile, the overlord controls legions of creatures with unique abilities, casting spells and enhancing his minions to crush human resistance. Online network play on the Internet adds an additional element of tension to this confrontation.
The essence of the game comes down to protecting or destroying a plasma cannon - humanity’s last hope for sealing infernal portals. FPS players must work together, balancing resource gathering, base defense, and offense. The RTS player, whether human or artificial intelligence, orchestrates waves of attacks by strategically placing units and exploiting weaknesses in human defenses. This creates a dynamic battlefield where tactics and reflexes collide.
Dark Prospect offers plenty of content to keep players busy. Five different maps serve as the battlefield, each with their own characteristics and strategic considerations. Custom Game Options allow you to tailor the game to suit you, adjusting settings for both FPS and RTS. It doesn’t matter if you want a quick shootout or an all-out war, the game has it all covered. Don’t forget about bots - they will fill up your FPS team if you don’t have enough human comrades.
Communication is key in Dark Prospect, and the game doesn’t skimp on features. Voice chat lets you coordinate on the fly, while quick chat and text options ensure you’re never left without words. With support for up to 32 players via Steam, you can stage epic battles or take on someone else’s nightmare. It’s a hectic dance of bullets and brimstone, where every decision can tip the scales between victory and damnation.

Game Description Meg’s Monster is a fun indie RPG adventure where you take on the role of a grumpy ghoul from the underworld tasked with helping a lost little girl find her way home. But don’t be fooled by her creepy-cute aesthetic, because if this girl cries, your whole world will collapse before your eyes. Entering a twisted dungeon world where humans are just breakfast for the monsters and mutants that roam its lands, you will meet Roy, a huge ogre who has no interest in feeding on people. One day he stumbles upon Meg, a lost girl whose tears could bring about the end of the world. Thus begins your journey to help her find her mother and keep her out of harm’s way.
Meg’s Monster is a short but story-driven JRPG where you control Roy, a virtually indestructible character with 99,999 HP. But don’t let that fool you, because keeping Meg safe is the real challenge. You’ll have to use all your wits and skill to master the unique mechanics and mini-games that accompany each battle, while comforting Meg with her favorite toys so she won’t cry. Along the way, you’ll meet a variety of quirky and colorful characters, all rendered in Odencat’s signature pixel art style that makes even the scariest monsters look cute. As the story progresses, you will find yourself drawn into a world full of drama and intrigue, where even previously defeated enemies can become your allies thanks to additional events.

Game Description The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak immerses players in the bustling world of the Kalvard Republic. Van Arkrid, a spriggan ready to take on any job, finds himself embroiled in a story that will shake the entire country to its core. This latest installment in the Trails series goes beyond expectations with an updated AT combat system that seamlessly blends field skirmishes and turn-based combat. Xipha, the sixth generation tactical orbital pistol, revolutionizes gameplay, offering a new twist on the franchise’s signature style.
But that’s not all, friends. The new topic system adds strategy by allowing players to use conversation fragments to gain an advantage on the battlefield. Do you consider yourself a talker? Talk to the locals and you might tip the scales in your favor when push comes to shove. Don’t forget about the Alignment system, which allows you to change Van’s attributes, affecting everything from his statistics to the alliance and even the plot itself. Let’s talk about player independence!
The game takes place in 1208 and begins with Van’s chance meeting with a prim academy student. From this point on, the game becomes a rollercoaster ride through the grimy back alleys and glitzy high society of Calvard. The Republic may be experiencing an economic boom, but tensions simmer beneath the surface. Immigration is on the rise, political reform is in full swing, and Van is about to stumble upon a job that will be much more difficult than he bargained for.
As you navigate this powder keg, you’ll wear many hats. One minute you’re playing detective, the next you’re negotiating a dodgy deal, and before you know it, you’ll be hot on the trail of bounty hunters. For a spriggan in Calvard, this is all just a day’s work. Just remember that in this game the line between good and evil is not always crystal clear. So, are you ready to dive into the dawn and shape the future of a nation on the brink?

Game Description Phantom Brigade is a turn-based science fiction strategy game. The action takes place in a country that has become the victim of a large-scale invasion by a foreign power. Enemy forces defeated the army and began the occupation. You will have to act as a resistance commander trying to reclaim his homeland from the invaders.
The player spends most of his time commanding units of small mechs and completing dangerous missions in a turn-based system. Each of the combat vehicles can be significantly modified, from weapons, armor to mechanical parts and camouflage models. All of these aspects are important for combat effectiveness. However, even the most powerful mech is completely useless without a remote control. Therefore, protecting subordinates from injury is key. The same rule applies to enemy units. Forcing the enemy to leave the cockpit and run is a great way to capture his mech and thereby strengthen your own strength. The campaign is very dynamic, and players can decide which targets and areas to attack on the strategic map. The resources obtained in this way and the losses suffered by the enemy influence the further development of the conflict. The authors took care of the variety of tasks. Among other things, you will need to sabotage enemy targets using the best equipment, infiltrate other people’s bases and attack. In most skirmishes, the player’s force is weaker and less numerous, so mission objectives must be completed quickly to complete the attack before enemy reinforcements arrive.

Game Description The Pale Beyond is a survival visual novel where every choice has a solution. The Arctic is harsh and cruel to anyone who decides to enter its territory, and explorers must always be prepared for unforeseen circumstances. But even they can be broken by some kind of misfortune and being on the verge of death from lack of food and terrible cold.
Several years ago, the ship Viscount set out in search of the absolute South, but failed and never returned. No one has ever managed to go this far, but the captain of the ship, Temperance, is not going to give up. He recruits a team of the same desperate adventurers and sets off with them along the same route as their predecessors. One night, the leader of the study mysteriously disappears, and until the circumstances are clarified, the protagonist is appointed leader. Now he has to not only complete the mission, but also ensure the safety of each crew member. The main parameters of the The Palais Beyond team:
The number of dogs - most of the survival of the squad depends on these animals, since with their help you can move forward and look for valuable resources, the animals must be provided with food and everything they need for health Crew member - the more of them, the greater the need for all resources, but the chances of life are higher Food - it can be saved, but nevertheless it will constantly be wasted and starvation can lead to illness and other unpleasant consequences Warmth is equally important, especially on winter evenings, because cold is the most effective slow killer.
All indicators must be kept normal and their quantity strictly monitored, since the ending and the number of survivors who will reach the end depend on this. The game has many plot branches that are activated by decisions made and relationships with the team. Try to return home or try to fulfill a dangerous dream? Only the player decides.

Game Description Company of Heroes 3 continues the turn-based strategy series, which unfolds in real time. The theater of military operations is the Mediterranean, where it is also important to make strategically correct decisions, planning every step. It features thoughtful gameplay, a new battle front, many units and factions, and the opportunity to take part in cinematically evolving battles. In TBS, the user fights with different factions using battle groups and units, controlling air, sea and ground types of troops, operating in a realistically destructible environment, taking part in a military conflict during the Second World War. It embodies classic combat mechanics that are combined with tactical gameplay, for example, the player can outflank the enemy, send infantrymen to break through, explore high ground to obtain additional information about the enemy’s location, and separate the enemy’s army from the garrison.
The player goes to battles that take place on a dynamic world map. There are mountain passes, coastal areas, deserts. For each location, it is important to select different tactics to obtain maximum benefit; for example, on the plains it is worth resorting to reconnaissance, strengthening defenses and stealth. This part offers the largest single-player Campaign with Sandbox features, where the user acts as a general who manages the overall process, as well as as a strategist who tries to defeat the enemy with his mind. To do this, it is worth establishing important supply lines and resorting not only to ground battles, but also to striking from the sea and from the air. During the battle, you can take a tactical pause, which allows you to think through further developments and plan your actions. The game also offers the largest number of alliances; it is possible to request reinforcements from powerful units, fighting, for example, as part of the special forces of America and Canada or the Gurkhas from India and the entire British Commonwealth. During the battle, a variety of equipment is also used, which includes fighters, tanks, reconnaissance vehicles, German Wiesel combat vehicles, Nashorn tank destroyers and Chaffee light armored vehicles, M3 half-track armored personnel carriers, which are used to repair equipment. Here, the maximum destructibility of environmental objects is realized, where any destroyed objects and buildings can be used as shelters, and the process itself is accompanied by special visual effects.

Game Description A completely rebuilt version of the iconic sci-fi horror title from the ground up, Dead Space Remake offers a radically reimagined approach to survival. The central mechanics of confronting necromorphs is tactical dismemberment, where an improved damage system allows you to literally rip off layers of flesh from opponents, exposing bones. Movement in zero-gravity conditions has gained complete freedom in three dimensions thanks to jet accelerators, and the ship itself is now a single, seamless space available for exploration with virtually no restrictions. In addition, the protagonist gained a voice, which allowed for deeper revelation of narrative elements through dialogue.
The plot of Dead Space Remake introduces engineer Isaac Clarke, who arrived as part of a repair team aboard the giant mining vessel USG Ishimura. What starts out as a routine troubleshooting task quickly turns into a fight for life. The ship’s crew was destroyed in a terrible disaster, and the protagonist’s beloved, Nicole, disappeared somewhere in its dark and deserted corridors. Armed only with his engineering tools, Isaac is forced to improvise to fight off the hostile creatures.
Exploring Ishimura’s compartments is a constant tension created by ambient lighting and three-dimensional atmospheric sound. The meticulously detailed work spaces and living decks, which became the scene of brutal massacres, create an oppressive feeling of claustrophobia. In addition to the physical threat from the monsters, Isaac must face his own crumbling sanity. The line between reality and nightmare visions is gradually blurring, turning survival into a real test for the psyche.

Game Description Helicopter Gunship DEX offers the experience of piloting combat helicopters. Players take control of rotorcraft, navigating and using weapons during combat encounters. This project contains elements of simulation games from the nineties, adapted for modern platforms. A key feature is the direct control of guidance systems, including containers and radar, while piloting the aircraft during mission execution.
A special algorithm procedurally creates missions, offering different goals and tactical conditions. The built-in random mission generator in Helicopter Gunship DEX generates missions including Strike, Suppression of Enemy Air Defense (SEAD), Search and Destroy, Recon, and Transport. These missions pose unique operational challenges for the player. The Deployment Points mechanic determines departure parameters, influencing equipment selection and maintaining balance in different scenarios.
This approach assigns cost points to the sides and weapons, which affects the choice of equipment for the specific conditions of the operation. You can pilot the car either with a first-person view from the cockpit or with a third-person camera. The interaction scheme is adapted for gamepads and uses Sensor of Interest (SOI) selection with modifier buttons to increase the number of available commands without remembering an abundance of keys; however, the button assignments are completely changeable for HOTAS systems. The game uses a physics flight model for rotorcraft, and the arsenal is not automatically replenished as you complete missions.

Created by a solo developer, this indie gem throws racers into the dirt world of rally competition. Racers can race through 11 countries, taking on everything from traditional rallies to breathtaking hill climbs. Racers have over 20 cars at their disposal, and they can tinker with them endlessly, upgrading and customizing each car. Network play is available for free, even on pirate sites, which allows you to enjoy racing on the Internet online.
The game does not skimp on technical specifications, offering smooth and smooth graphics in various weather conditions. Rush Rally 3 features over 100 unique stages, from sun-drenched to rain-soaked tracks. The driving model, honed over 15 years, provides a rich and enjoyable experience. Consider yourself a purist? Connect the steering wheel with feedback and feel every bump and slide.
The career mode attracts the ambitious, and single races and rallycross are designed for fans of fast driving. The game remains relevant thanks to weekly live competitions in which players compete with the global community. A powerful livery editor awaits those who love to dress up their cars. Social leaderboards and ghost races add a competitive element, allowing drivers to compete against the best in the world. Whether you’re grinding gears online or offline, Rush Rally 3 is designed to scratch that racing itch.

Game Description Floodland is a city builder with survival, strategy and roguelike elements. With each new playthrough, the map is generated randomly. Events are also generated randomly. This increases replayability. The project uses a post-apocalyptic setting. The user can choose one of the clans. Each faction has its own unique perks. You can be friends or fight with other factions. The player is asked to build buildings, improve buildings, extract resources, find food, look for lost technologies, explore islands, take care of his charges and train them into specialists, help other survivors or deal with competitors.
Floodland takes place in a dystopian near future. A catastrophe has occurred on Earth due to climate problems. After her, the world changed forever. Most of the planet was flooded, and very few pieces of land remained suitable for life. In place of the continents, clusters of swamps and islands remained. Due to the natural crisis, many people have died. The player is given the role of leader of one of the groups of survivors. The user’s task is to establish a settlement on the ruins of human civilization and begin to develop it. The user is allowed to choose the form of government. For example, he can create a society where equality reigns, or establish a harsh dictatorship. There is also the opportunity to create unique legislation and upgrade it in the law tree.

Game Description Last Command is deceptively easy to learn. To control, the player will only need the arrows on the keyboard and the mouse, but this does not make the task easier at all. A huge number of obstacles on the way, bosses with a large area of ​​​​AoE damage and many additional small attacks will definitely not let you relax. The main character is a space caterpillar, which at first glance may seem quite ordinary and simple, because it consists of individual balls and can grow by absorbing other circles placed on the field. But in fact, this is a real fighting creature that challenges anyone who would encroach on the safety of her people and family. She sets out on a dangerous adventure across the world to exterminate evil once and for all. With the help of victories, she can gradually improve herself, gain unique skills, abilities and even weapons. But at the same time, she is very fragile, because she is constantly in motion and as soon as she collides with any wall, she will die.
Las Command’s mechanics are reminiscent of a classic snake, only the locations here are much larger and more complex and there are enemies stronger than their own tail. In total, the player will have to go through 17 unique levels, at each of which he will meet a boss with special attacks. It can be very difficult to dodge a whole fan of enemy objects, between which there are only small free spaces for dodging, and you will have to spend a lot of nerve cells.

Game Description Atmospheric horrorEscape the Backrooms offers cooperative gameplay for up to 4 gamers. A group of people find themselves in a huge and very strange room, from where it is not so easy to find a way out. Users are required to actively interact with each other via voice chat to coordinate actions. It is very important not to separate - you need to move in such a way that users can see each other. The environment changes regularly, and therefore, in a place where there was once an exit, there may be a solid wall.
There are only 8 levels in Escape the Backrooms and each of them is more difficult than the previous one. Locations are often decorated in oppressive yellow or gray tones. The narration is told from a first-person perspective and the protagonists film everything that happens on a video camera. The main character is a member of an ancient family who, after a long absence from his homeland, returns home. The reason for this was the suicide of the mother. The protagonist came to support his only relative - his sister Lyudmila. However, upon returning, the man found himself drawn into a dangerous story with supernatural overtones.
The plot of Last Days of Lazarus delves deeply into the origins of the Orthodox faith and the church, and also touches on the topic of how it was preserved on the territory of the Soviet Union in conditions where religion was prohibited. As for the specifics, the protagonist is forced to investigate a case related to a curse that was placed on his family decades ago. It is because of him that many family members leave this world before their time.
As for the gameplay, most of the time the user is offered to explore colorful locations with a post-Soviet environment. They require you to look for key plot items and interact with the environment. The dialogues here are written down to the smallest detail, and the story itself keeps you interested and suspenseful almost until the end of this adventure.

Your traveler will go into the open world, where he will have to monitor his own temperature, the availability of water, food and energy. Without the proper level of these factors, the character will die faster. For example, you may get a cold if you don’t find a cure in time, and bad food will give you an upset stomach, so choose what you eat carefully.
While you are on the territory of any city, the environment will be preparing to grab you and hide you behind bars, so if you do not have enough strength to resist, the character will simply be captured. The plot develops on the basis of a monetary debt, which the main character undertakes to repay for his family. If he does not do this, then all family savings will be spent to at least somehow pay the amount. He goes to the open world, where he can earn a certain amount of money in order to return and provide for his family for the rest of his days, but this trip turns into the most interesting, but difficult story of survival in such a world.

Game Description Kapital: Sparks of Revolution is a city planning simulator that allows you to deal with all economic issues in managing the capital. Events start at a time when European countries find themselves in a deep systemic crisis. There is a class struggle and it becomes difficult to avoid a social explosion. The player finds himself in such conditions. What price must be paid to save Europe from anarchy?
Game mechanics combine elements of a city builder and a social manager. As the mayor of a metropolis destroyed by a devastating war, his top priority is rebuilding the city after the bombing. With a limited number of resources on hand, it is necessary to resolve various social conflicts and provide solutions to crisis situations. Society is strictly divided into classes. There are 3 of them: nobles, bourgeois and workers.
Nobles are the most prosperous and educated people. The bourgeoisie is engaged in business and earns huge amounts of money, while the workers are in the lowest strata of society, having only pennies and not receiving any education. The only thing that unites them is the desire to live better. In Kapital: Sparks of Revolution you need to find a way out of such a difficult situation, satisfying the needs of different segments of the population.
Crisis management is one of the most difficult tests for any government. Too many responsibilities and tasks. Resources are always limited. A decision must be made as to who gets the food first. Protests, threats and riots in such a situation are simply inevitable. The future of the community is in the hands of the mayor. Depending on the decisions made, the political system and structure of the state are developed.

The gameplay is a third-person action RPG where you explore the expanses of a fantasy world, equip yourself with a variety of weapons and fight powerful enemies. The world is divided into areas, each with a unique layout, appearance, and enemies. Each area is represented by a powerful boss. By defeating the monster, you gain new abilities and access to previously closed locations. Unlike many RPGs, there are no peaceful NPCs or hub settlements to catch your breath or gear up. The world of Elden Ring is a place of pain and sadness. Here you will find only the ruins of ancient castles, many aggressive monsters and difficult trials that only the bravest traveler can pass. Game Description God of War 2022 is an action-adventure game with a third-person view. This project is both a sequel to the previous part and a restart of the entire universe of the famous, cult slasher about the adventures of Kratos – a Spartan warrior, the protagonist of all 8 games in the “God of War” series, fighting against various gods and mythical creatures in a fit of rage and revenge. This game is called a restart because of the transfer of the location of the action and the change of the main mythology, which is used as the primary source. If in previous series of the franchise Greek myths and legends were taken as a basis, now - Scandinavian ones. Some characters from previous parts appear in cameo roles as you progress. The story often mentions Ragnarok and features various deities in which the Vikings believed.
The gameplay starts with the beginning of the journey of Kratos and his son named Atreus. The purpose of their adventure is to scatter the ashes of the protagonist’s wife, who died recently. She wanted this to be done from the highest point of all worlds and dimensions. The antagonist of the single-player story campaign will be Balder, the god of spring and light. The slasher mechanics inherent in the series were changed and the entire gameplay began to resemble role-playing adventures. As his main weapon, Kratos uses the magical ax Leviathan, instead of the twin blades that were lost at the end of God of War 3. Atreus also takes part in battles with his own bow. Thanks to the leveling branch of both main characters, you can create various builds and create combinations of the abilities of the son and father.

Game Description SGS Operation Hawaii features a scenario covering the events following the attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941. This game explores the possible consequences of the situation if a Japanese air raid were followed by a ground invasion of Oahu. The focus is on a theoretical operation involving specially trained Marines and Army units secretly brought in with the main strike force.
The idea differs from the real story, where a similar landing, although discussed by the Imperial Japanese Navy, was rejected due to supply difficulties. In SGS Operation Hawaii, gamers will take command of an alternate history setting. The Japanese objective is to land troops and inflict maximum damage to military installations in a short time, approximately 3-4 days, reflecting the limited support capabilities of the invading force.
Leading the forces, the player must choose the best place for the landing and strive to destroy ground objects in order to enhance the effect of the air attack. The American commander, in turn, will have to organize protection against a surprise ground assault. The gameplay involves making strategic decisions before starting an operation, which affects the initial conditions. Each side chooses options worth victory points, with the opponent’s choice unknown, creating different situations each time the game is played. The Japanese commander faces an important choice of landing site: proximity to Pearl Harbor carries the risk of coming under fire from coastal batteries, the northern coast is far from defenses but also from targets, and the eastern coast offers a different balance of risk and benefit.

Game Description Ancient Dungeon VR, a roguelike adventure, invites you to unravel its labyrinthine mysteries. Now you can play this exciting dungeon for free online, playing online with a friend. Its depths conceal legendary riches and artifacts of great power, available to those willing to pay the price. This isn’t just a casual stroll, especially if you prefer to play as a pirate, as the Ancient Dungeon twists and turns with every step, mocking your hopes of retracing the path. Your survival depends on the ability to pave the way forward, and, of course, an excellent online game on the Internet. Remember that escaping is a one-way street.
Hordes of various monsters stand between you and your reward. Blades, throwing knives and crossbows become your survival tools, sharpened and enhanced by the many items scattered throughout the maze. Prepare for the unexpected as each dungeon is a unique tapestry woven through procedural generation. No two runs are the same, requiring constant adaptation and skill. The deeper you dive, the harsher the environment and the deadlier the inhabitants become. The lush gates are teeming with plant horrors, and the Forgotten Library is buzzing with arcane powers and mysterious creatures. Unlocking new dungeon features at the Acolyte’s base camp provides bonuses, as does forging powerful weapon upgrades at the Blacksmith. Completionists can attempt to complete the Item Compendium and discover the forgotten history of this ancient tomb through scattered records. By completing certain tasks in the depths of the dungeon, you will help the research of the Great Library.
There are over a hundred unlockable upgrades, from fly companions to explosive throwing knives. Masterful combos unlock unexpected synergies, turning the tide of battle in your favor. The environment itself becomes a weapon. Make your way through thick foliage, break urns and drink potions at the most crucial moment. Your opponents are as varied as the dungeons in which they hide. Sorcerers, Slytherins, skeleton warriors, disembodied flies and fire-breathing skulls are just a small part of the horrors that await you. Physics-based combat gives each encounter weight and satisfaction, turning each encounter into a viscous dance of blade and spell.

Game Description Prison Simulator is an action prison simulator. The main character comes out of this hole after 30 days, but the fewer days remain, the more it seems to him that the whole world is against him. The administration constantly imposes difficult cases and compromising responsibilities on you.
To begin with, it is necessary to maintain a balance between the convicts and the prison administration. Neutral relations will help to ensure agreement between the two parties, but helping only one of them may end badly and will not pay off the efforts at all. As a caretaker, you will have a lot of tasks. You will need to accept new criminals and look for free cells. Confiscate items from prisoners, participate in the treasury, solve their problems and complete other tasks.
You have a certain time to complete all the missions. But still, the gameplay is completely free, do whatever you want. Even the hero’s behavior will affect the relationship between workers and those behind bars. The more bad things you continually do to prisoners, the worse they treat you. Play a campaign with limited time and specific objectives, or explore all the gameplay possibilities in Free Mode. Here you will not have tasks or time, do all the things that you would not do in the story. Visit the most remote places of the prison, take a gun, throw cigarette butts inside the cells and do other things. Sometimes you can ignore the law and do a few prohibited things.

Game Description Steel Crew is a virtual reality game in which you can play online with a friend on a pirate. This gives you the opportunity to play online for free. In the game you will find yourself at the helm in the literal sense of the word. You’ll be able to take on the role of a tanker, gunner or commander, participating in intense tank battles where strategy and communication are your most powerful weapons. This is an ideal online game for those who want to play online with friends over the Internet.
Designed with VR in mind, Steel Crew delivers a level of immersion unlike any other. While the game is focused primarily on motion controllers, it also supports traditional input means such as a gamepad, mouse, and keyboard for those who prefer a different approach, both on VR and regular screens.
One of the features here is the careful attention to detail. Each tank has fully detailed interiors, allowing for accurate reproductions of these fighting vehicles. As a driver, you will experience the thrill of driving a combat vehicle equipped with a manual transmission that requires skillful shifting. Visibility is limited and therefore largely depends on the commander’s instructions. To improve visibility, you can open the hatch, but be careful - this makes you vulnerable to enemy fire. Your responsibilities also include monitoring the condition of the weapon.
The gunner, in turn, has at his disposal both the main gun and a co-axial machine gun. However, its visibility is limited and depends on the commander and driver. Aiming accuracy is very important, which is aided by motion controllers that allow you to fine-tune your aim. The commander does not directly control the tank, but provides critical control. Armed with a map showing allied positions and capture points, the commander plays a key role in coordinating the team’s actions. Using a monocular, he can detect enemy tanks and even call in aircraft to carry out assigned tasks.

Game Description Age of Empires 4 is a computer game in the Real Time Strategy genre. This is the third sequel to the original game and the first to be developed by a new development studio that was not involved in the work on the trilogy. The announcement, which took place back in 2017, became an excellent gift for fans of the series on the anniversary of the franchise’s appearance in 1997. Age of Empires 4 has modes for both single player and multiplayer. In it you can fight with your friends and random players or take part in battles against artificial intelligence in co-op.
The time period chosen for Age of Empires IV was the Middle Ages, with a much greater scope than in previous projects in the franchise. This important change allows us to cover a huge variety of improvements to various technologies for maximum variety of gameplay. Also, this made it possible to create a larger number of single-player scenarios for the campaign, where historical figures become the main characters, and known facts about them are diluted with artistic interpretation to create epic situations and unexpected twists of fate.
Each country has its own pros and cons, allowing players to use different tactics when waging war and developing the economy, infrastructure and technology. For example, the Mongols have an advantage at the start of the game due to the presence of strong cavalry, while the British rely on calmer gameplay at the beginning to collect enough resources.

Game Description The Dark Pictures Anthology House of Ashes is a survival horror game. You can play it on pirates with a friend online. Multiplayer is available on the Internet online and in local form. The gameplay is reminiscent of interactive films. Here you need to watch cinematic screensavers, listen to dialogues (they contain obscene language), participate in scenes with QTEs (their difficulty can be adjusted), and make moral choices. The decisions you make influence the course of the story. From time to time you are allowed to wander around the locations and search for objects. There are also moments where you need to shoot. You can also read the diaries if you wish to better understand the background.
The Dark Pictures Anthology House of Ashes is the third installment in the series. The non-linear story takes users to an alternative “zero”. During the Iraq War, the US military went to the point, thinking that a warehouse with chemical weapons was hidden there. Instead, the soldiers found a Sumerian temple infested with monsters. Along with the Americans, local residents also entered the ancient catacombs and ambushed them. This collection not only preserves the original game mechanics, but also complements it with a gallery of illustrations and memorable music. The soundtrack, composed by composers such as Nobuo Uematsu and Kenji Ito, enhances the classic adventure feel. The ability to switch between English and Japanese versions allows you to dive deeper into the world conceived by the authors. Game Description Train Crew offers to take on the role of the driver on the fictional railway Tatehama Electric Railway. The gamer will have to drive the compositions on the route between the stations of Akaamacho and Tatehama, carefully observing the schedule and speed restrictions. The length of the available length of the track is 28 kilometers in both directions recreated within the framework of this project. The key task is to control the movement of the locomotive using special controls that imitate the real workplace.
It is necessary to monitor the signals of traffic lights and the condition of the paths to ensure safe movement. The Train Crew gameplay is built around the use of a special lever - the main controller, which serves as the main tool for interacting with the composition. For a set of speed, the handle is pulled on itself, and for braking - from itself; The development of this mechanism requires attention and accuracy. This method of interaction is the basis for navigation along the simulator railway tracks.
Additionally, the drivers of the compositions can use other functions: give a sound signal for warning, contact the conductor through a zummer to coordinate actions, as well as switch the types of camera for a better review of the environment and instruments in the cab. At the end of the flight, the system issues a detailed assessment of the driver’s actions, analyzing the accuracy of compliance with the schedule and smoothness. In addition to direct control of the locomotive, this title includes the tasks of the conductor, adding another layer to interaction.

The story begins with the fact that Elijah, a simple person working in a local grocery store, is attacked by an alien creature after the end of his shift. Waking up, he sees that his hometown in chaos. The military blocked the territory, and to explain the situation they come up with a bizarre legend about the spill of chemicals. Everyone who is trying to escape is shot on the spot, leaving people in the city.
When Elijah is guided by this dangerous new reality, he discovers a terrible transformation of the population. Mutants - once ordinary citizens - now roam the streets, attacking everyone who crosses their path. Elijah has a personal loss when he finds out that his brother has already become a victim of a flash of mutants. Having decided to survive, Elijah goes to explore the altered city, determined to reveal the truth behind the attacks of the aliens and sinister events unfolding in Cleveland.
Elijah and the out of this world adventure invites users to a unique combination of an open world study and gameplay of role -playing game. Game Description Yamafuda! 2nd station presents gamers with a unique roguelike game that simulates a mountain trek through card gameplay. Users go on a virtual hike along ten different rocks, choosing cards at each station to navigate their way to the top. During expeditions, players acquire equipment cards that expand their capabilities, creating a progression system that rewards strategic planning.
Weather mechanics provide dynamic difficulty changes, changing the steepness and difficulty of the mountain route depending on the conditions. Yamafuda! 2nd station is accessible without sacrificing depth, allowing you to find a middle ground between casual pastime and tactical decision-making. Each mountain trek offers new card combinations from forty unique cards, so no two runs are the same.
The user gradually assembles his collection of fifty different pieces of equipment, each of which provides certain advantages in specific conditions or scenarios. The anime-inspired visuals complement the light-hearted tone of the gameplay, creating an atmosphere that remains fun without overwhelming newcomers to the roguelite genre. The appeal of the project lies in its simple idea, executed with surprising nuances - the satisfaction of creating an effective deck that can handle any mountain. The single-player game focuses on mastery through repetition, with each failed climb providing insight into future attempts.

Game Description Aragami 2 may appeal to fans of ninja projects inspired by Eastern culture. This hybrid of action and stealth with a third-person view contains not only a single player, but also multiplayer, which is available online online. On Pirate you can play online with one friend or a couple of friends. The title takes users to an alternative Japan. It uses a medieval fantasy setting.
The plot of Aragami 2 begins 100 years after the end of the first part. The main character, hoping to protect the village from invaders, joins the Aragami clan and becomes a skilled killer. Members of this organization receive mystical shadow skills, but in return their minds and bodies begin to gradually be eroded by a supernatural disease. The warrior must free his relatives and find a way to defeat the curse. The sequel is noticeably different from the original. It featured a full-fledged combat game based on fencing and reminiscent of slasher films. It has auto-guidance, timing, and various strikes. Due to this, the gameplay also became more varied. Gamers can choose whether to go through locations quietly, eliminating individual enemies one by one if necessary, or create a loud massacre on the map. A hub and other changes have appeared. If the previous hero was afraid of the light and was limited in movement, then the new protagonist is able to go wherever he wants. The developers took away the ability to teleport to any point, but instead added a double jump.
The creators also introduced RPG elements. Here you are allowed to customize your ward and improve him. You can create your own armor and weapons. The possibility of free online play allows you to play through the campaign with friends or random users. The network game is designed specifically for co-op. This mode supports up to 3 participants.

Game Description Erannorth Chronicles combines an RPG and a card game. It’s also a sandbox. There is no complete single plot here. The indie title invites users to entertain themselves: explore the open world, fight monsters, upgrade their character, and participate in random events. You can also go treasure hunting or take tests. This CCG has a high barrier to entry due to the large number of deep mechanics that gamers have to figure out for themselves. However, here they allow you to flexibly adjust the difficulty. There are 200 types of enemies, and they can be strengthened or weakened if desired.
Erannorth Chronicles allows you to create a protagonist. There are 9 heroes in 35 variations and nine classes with 47 specializations. Each option has its own starting bonuses and different battle tactics. Due to this, the product has replayability. There are more than 2630 cards in the game. You can create and change decks (there are hundreds of their varieties), find and select equipment, decide which area to explore, collect and spend consumables, and create builds to suit your gameplay style.
The project can be called a modified version of Erannorth Reborn. The developer’s previous title used a roguelike approach, unlocking content over time as you complete multiple runs. In the sequel, everything is available immediately. The sequel has improved graphics, an updated interface and new content. The title supports fan modifications.

Game Description Cauldrons of War – Stalingrad is the second part of a small series of wargames. Like its predecessor, the title is set in the setting of World War II. This part is dedicated to the battles between Germany and the USSR. You can fight for both factions. Moreover, it is easier to play for the Germans than for the Soviet Union. The action takes place only on the Eastern Front. The video game covers the period from May 1942 to November of the same year. This turn-based strategy has a clear interface and simple mechanics. All this greatly lowers the barrier to entry for beginners. Players are presented with a set of scenarios of varying difficulty. Some of them last only one or two hours, while others take much longer.
Unlike other turn-based strategies, the map in this project is not divided into hexagons. The gamer is shown the front at a strategic level. It consists of different regions. They change depending on the military situation. The user manages entire operations and commands all advanced forces at once. He assigns units and uses command points to control them. In the Russian translation, the game is called In the Cauldron of War - Stalingrad. The graphics have remained virtually unchanged compared to the original. She’s all so sketchy. All changes affected the gameplay. The developers changed the balance and made many minor improvements to the gameplay. In addition to battles with bots, you can play together with a friend on the same computer. The indie title also allows you to fight with live opponents by exchanging files with them via email.

Game Description Cookie Clicker lives up to its name. This is a clicker about earning cookies. The title is considered one of the first such games. The project developed and popularized an entire genre.
Initially it was a browser. Here is an improved version of Cookie Clicker. The re-release boasts an achievement system with 500 achievements, 600 improvements, the ability to exchange some goodies for others, and receiving constant upgrades. There are also mini-games here. There are various holiday events, collectibles and other content available.
The essence of the gameplay is to click with the left mouse button on a confectionery product. For each successful click, the user is awarded cookies. They are the local equivalent of currency. You can use them to buy various upgrades. For example: a new cursor, a mine, a farm, a bank, and so on. Buildings provide passive income, which makes gameplay easier by reducing the need to click too often. The idea is to save enough money to buy buildings and upgrades to further increase your cash flow, so you can then invest even more money. The gameplay lasts forever, but it can be saved. It is possible to abandon the progress made. The gamer will then have to start all over again, but in return he will receive some kind of permanent bonus.

Game Description Inked: A Tale of Love is an indie project, a puzzle platformer. The character you will play is a samurai, the Nameless Hero. From the start of the game you think you are playing as a painted ronin in a painted world. Later you realize that this story is created by the artist Adam. And you, in turn, can influence what he draws. As you play, you learn to solve puzzles using simple geometry. The game has six pieces: a ball, a square, a ramp, a bridge and several special devices. As you progress, you will find leaflets, notes, and much more from the real world. All the items will make you wonder how Adam ended up where he is today.
Having gone to the world of Adam in order to find Aiko, the hero’s beloved, who has disappeared, you find yourself in an “ink” world, where everything really looks like it was drawn with an ordinary pen, just by the hand of a master. The developers paid great attention to small details. When the hero steps on an ink stain, he will leave traces behind him. In this dimension, locations change from simple ones - in the form of a path and stones, to huge ones - in the form of a forest, swamp or village. The fates of Adam and the Nameless Hero are intertwined in a story that turns out to be much deeper than it seems at first glance. Ronin and our artist will go on an adventure full of dangers that will change both of them forever. The game is very beautifully drawn and made in a unique style of its own - storytelling on paper. All events unfold from the point of view of Adam, the creator of the Nameless Hero. Inked is an excellent representative of the genre, with an interesting plot and amazing music.

Game Description Sprocket will give gamers an unusual experience, because here they will create their own designs and models of tanks. Here you can not only manipulate the type of hull and guns, but also study the specifics of armor to make your model more practical. Variations from different periods are available here, from the early stages of the First World War to the last years of the Second World War.
The main feature of Sprocket tank design is that the gamer is able to customize and modify literally every fragment of the combat vehicle. All manipulations are carried out using the mouse. For example, it is enough to pull the table so that it stretches out, or “grab” a sheet of frontal armor, changing the angle of inclination appropriately. So, for example, even a not very thick layer located at the right angle can reflect large-caliber projectiles. And if, in addition to this, the hull is tightened, the armor rating will be significantly higher.
You can study in detail not only the body of the combat vehicle, but also the cannon. Size matters, and its effectiveness directly depends on well-chosen indicators. Accuracy, projectile range, caliber and other factors can be adjusted depending on what the player wants to achieve in the end. It is also important to have a great team, because the tank will not be able to function without the influence of people. Therefore, the gunner, loader, radio operator and commander should be trained so that their interaction is effective.
When the preparatory work is completed, the turn of tests comes. To do this, the combat vehicle is located in an open field, and targeted fire is fired at it. If the armor can withstand hits or does not allow full damage to be dealt, this can be considered a success. However, if the tank is destroyed, this means that it is necessary to carry out modifications and adjust the indicators again.

Particularly notable are the diary pages that can be found at locations. At the same time, you can only have one page in your inventory, so after reading it, you will have to throw it away in order to be able to take another one further along the path.

Game Description Carrier Command 2 is a modern continuation of the strategy that came out back in the eighties. Compared to other titles, the sequel stands out due to its gameplay features. This is not only an RTS, but also a simulator of an aircraft carrier commander. The gamer’s task: to liberate the Telos colony located on the archipelago from the terrorists who captured it.
In Carrier Command 2, the user controls a huge warship. It is capable of destroying opponents with torpedoes, cannons, turrets and missiles. On its deck you can place ground and air units (there are a total of 8 varieties of each type). Here you can construct military vehicles from modules. You can choose the chassis, weapons, additional equipment, etc. In this project you need to capture islands in order to receive supplies for the army. The equipment is controlled in a way unusual for the genre. Here you cannot highlight combat units with a frame and direct them with the mouse.
The user sits in the captain’s cabin and gives orders from there. The player runs between combat posts, presses buttons on panels, and receives information about the battlefield from radars and other devices. Here you need to manually switch map modes, turn on and off the engines of the main transport, increase and decrease speed, turn the steering wheel, inspect the battle site using a drone or periscope, and so on. The game has training, a story campaign, separate battles with bots and a bunch of settings, multiplayer with support for up to 16 participants. Online there is co-op and PvP.

Game Description PropHunter is a game that you can play online for free or pirated with a friend. In this online game, players can participate online in an exciting cat-and-mouse battle over the Internet. The teams are divided into hiders and seekers: one group turns into ordinary objects, and the other hunts them down. It’s a constant battle of wits and stealth.
The success of the hiders depends on how seamlessly they fit into the environment. They must choose their disguises wisely, turning into anything from a lamp to a trash can. Main? Look natural in public. Some people prefer immobility, while others risk moving in order to divert suspicion from themselves. It’s a delicate balance between caution and courage.
Meanwhile, searchers face the difficult task of identifying impostors. They search their surroundings, looking for anything that is out of place. Every item becomes suspicious. Is this chair really just a chair? Time is ticking. Each correct guess strengthens their ranks, as the captured lurkers join the team of seekers.
But those hiding are not defenseless. They can fight back, damaging seekers who get too close. It’s a risky move that could blow their cover, but sometimes it’s worth it to take down a stubborn hunter. Eliminated seekers switch sides, evening the odds.
Both teams have access to special abilities, adding another layer of strategy. Invisibility, reincarnation, bombs - these bonuses scattered across the map can turn the tide of battle. It’s a constant race to catch them before the enemy.

The research library will help us deal with many of the monsters discovered during exploration. The game is made in the form of a role-playing turn-based adventure game, which you can play using virtual reality glasses. The project combines the dungeon crawler genre and tactical strategy, allowing you to take turns on the field and clear locations from opponents. Gamers will extract loot from enemies and strengthen their characters with found artifacts and things. You can go through the story campaign alone or in multiplayer mode for up to 4 people.
By plunging into the world of Demeo, gamers get the opportunity to:
Choose the desired class for the protagonist, which determines the gameplay and character’s abilities. You can choose from: hunter, sorcerer, assassin, guard and bard. Take a stand against Rakarn and Alfar to put an end to the evil machinations and free civilians from the dangerous intentions of the enemy. Explore the “Fifth World”, where you will have to wander through contrasting locations of 8 provinces, visiting mountain, forest and cave biomes that are located on a continent with shores washing the ocean. Go explore the ruins of Hollowmark Castle, and also face many challenges, confronting robbers and evil monsters. Try out the system with dice rolls, selecting and building a deck with spells and hero abilities, and moving character miniatures behind the tabletop.

Game Description Resident Evil Village continues the adventures of Ethan from the Seven. The Roman numeral hidden in the title on the posters hints that this is not a spin-off, but the eighth part of the series. This is already the tenth project in the main line. Winters was able to escape from the cannibal mansion and save his wife Mia. They got away from the American outback and decided to live an ordinary life. However, a few years later, Ethan finds himself in the wilderness again, only this time in a snowy area. His arrival in the mystical village was facilitated by Chris Redfield himself, the legendary RE character.
After experimenting with remakes, the creators returned the first-person view to the series. Previously, locations served only as a backdrop, albeit a well-made one, for stories about confronting the monsters of the Umbrella corporation. In Resident Evil Village, the surroundings are so detailed that the village can be regarded as a full-fledged character. The protagonist of Resident Evil 8 will face the past, present and future of a mysterious settlement located near the castle. In addition to monsters, he will also meet normal people. The Duke, for example. You can ask rumors and buy items from this polite and courteous inhabitant of the Village.
Melee weapons now break during use. An exception was made only for the main character’s knife. Classic firearms include a pistol and a shotgun. Much emphasis is placed on exploring locations, finding useful things and keys, solving puzzles, and inventory management. Opponents here can use weapons and wear armor.

Game Description Hobo Tough Life is a first-person role-playing game with a focus on realism. It is necessary not only to survive, but also to try to get food for free. You can survive online online, teaming up with other players, or connect with a friend locally. Playing online, or more precisely, being homeless on a pirate ship in Hobo Tough Life is many times more interesting than wandering through garbage dumps in splendid isolation! Players take on the role of homeless people as they attempt to explore the open world represented by a metropolis.
The gameplay is a homeless simulator. You will have to wander through the streets of the city of Praslov. By collecting food from containers or garbage cans, stealing, begging and doing other obscenities, you can live another day. Events develop in the post-war era, when the city is trying to recover from the Cold War and the communist regime. Not everyone was able to adapt to the new system, so they ended up on the street, not knowing where to go.
It is necessary to monitor your stats and needs: look for a warm place, free from dampness, try to at least monitor the hygiene and cleanliness of your clothes so as not to catch an infection, etc. The opportunity to play for free allows you to exchange few resources with your partner and support each other in a difficult period of life. Network play also allows you to do criminal things together. For example, one may distract a police officer or an ordinary civilian while the other robs passers-by, or steals food and useful resources from shops and souvenir shops.
There is a dynamic change in weather conditions, time of day and seasons. Climate affects gameplay. Cold and rain increase the risk of getting sick. You need to find a secluded and warm place to wait out the bad weather. The storyline consists of dozens of tasks, and some events are inspired by real people and their stories. You will have to meet many charismatic characters, gain the trust of people, make enemies and allies, and also create entire homeless factions to operate in Praslov’s back alleys.

This multiplayer game immerses you in dynamic, ever-changing battles, where weapons and battle conditions are rearranged from round to round. You can play online online, and you never know what weapon you’ll end up with until the match starts. The bread and butter of the game is its unpredictability. One minute you’re shooting from a distance with a hunting rifle, and the next you’re shooting point-blank with a Mac10. Or maybe you prefer to rush around the arena at breakneck speed? The possibilities are endless, and that’s what keeps players coming back for more.
Whether you’re going head-to-head or diving into free-to-play four-player action, Combat Labs has you covered. Can’t find a playmate? No problem. With bot support, you can hone your skills alone before taking on real opponents. There are six different maps in the game, and there is always a new strategy or clever shortcut to be found. It’s a constant learning curve that will keep you on guard and your finger itchy.

Game Description NIMBY Rails is a game where you can play online with a friend on pirate for free. You can create your own railways online online and solve various transport problems in the real world. This is a fun and creative online game that gives you free online play anywhere in the world. You can connect cities and countries with your railway lines and manage them efficiently. Do you want to create a rail link between Lisbon and Shanghai or connect Anchorage with Buenos Aires? Or maybe connect Cape Town and Rabat? The possibilities are endless and only your imagination limits them.
However, there is a twist - your tracks must correspond to real, existing roads and streets. If you complicate things by creating too many intersections, your projects may not be viable. NIMBY Rails supports interesting circulation mechanics without getting bogged down in unnecessary details when building and operating a vast rail network. The game also offers flexibility. You can easily build stations with automatic double tracks and entry/exit signaling. You can connect them together with just a couple of mouse clicks. But if you’re the kind of player who likes to delve into the intricacies of signal systems and detailed station design, NIMBY Rails will give you that freedom. Turn off the automatic assistants in the path editor and take individual control of each path, signal and building if you want.
NIMBY Rails covers a wide range of rail transport - from trams and subways to commuter, regional and high-speed trains. You’ll also have to choose between tunnels, viaducts, or surface routes, each of which has its own set of tradeoffs that affect the environment, train speeds, and your company’s financial health. One of the coolest features is the modeling of demand for trains and stations, down to individual passengers. Passengers are no longer just statistics: they board multiple trains and wait at interchange stations. Demand fluctuates depending on the time of day and week, and for those who want it to be more interesting, time zone support is provided. Passengers evaluate their experience based on travel time and fare, and this feedback influences demand at stations.

Game Description THE CORRIDOR is an experimental adventure exploring the relationship between humans and interactive entertainment. The main action takes place in a closed space, where the only visible goal is to press the orange button. However, every interaction with this object causes the application to immediately close, forcing you to start all over again. The process is punctuated by fourth-wall-breaking meta-commentary and encounters with surreal characters, such as a cardboard therapist who acts as an inspirational companion. This approach creates tension and forces you to rethink familiar mechanics.
It’s all based on a simple concept: one corridor, a door and a button. Despite the apparent primitiveness, each new launch of THE CORRIDOR brings surprises, transforming the familiar environment and rules. What starts out as a walking simulator can suddenly turn into a completely different genre. Simple elements of setting are used to create absurd and comical situations that subvert expectations. The gameplay is constantly changing, offering little secrets to discover or developer code mode to activate, further blurring the boundaries between the work and its audience.
Behind the satirical cover are reflections on the bias and inflated demands of modern society. The project touches on serious topics in a fun way, inviting you to think about your own established opinions. The narrative may abruptly change tone, becoming a first-person shooter segment or a sequence that deliberately degrades performance for comedic effect. This short but intense title is packaged in a concise form, offering an intriguing experience with a memorable ending.

Gather a huge crowd of people, break through the blockade and take the Royal Castle by storm. There are 5 main factions in the world of Mesmer: Nobility, Merchants, Craftsmen, Workers and Underworld. You can race with friends online or play together via split-screen mode, sitting at the same computer. The game allows you to do this even with four people. The title supports keyboards and gamepads.
This is a third person runner. The Vecter is stylized as an old arcade racing game with a rear view. It has schematic graphics. It is possible to customize the color palette for yourself. The gameplay is as follows. The user controls a car hovering above the ground. He moves along the highway at a very high speed. The route always has a straight shape. As you move along it, the scenery in the background changes. The desert landscape gives way to a city landscape, then mountains become visible in the distance and stuff like that.
On the ship’s path there are obstacles, enemies and bonuses. The first must be avoided, the second must be shot, and the third must be picked up. The pace of the game is constantly increasing. The essence of the process is to try not to crash into anything for as long as possible. Game Description Squad is a military tactical first person shooter game. This is a multiplayer game with an emphasis on realism. An important role is assigned to team interaction between users. This project does not have a story campaign or single player modes. Instead, players in it capture points, destroy weapons depots, or hold the defense.
The title was originally called Project Reality. This was a modification for the second “Battle”. Later the game grew into a full-fledged separate product and was called Squad. The gameplay here is hardcore. A character can die from one hit. The interface does not display the number of cartridges remaining in the clip. However, the creators made some simplifications to make the game more interesting. For example, here you can revive fallen comrades using first aid kits and you cannot pick up enemy weapons of a different class. There are quite a few specializations in the project. Gamers can become squad leaders, snipers, simple shooters without optics, medics, grenade launchers, and light anti-tanks.
This FPS has large locations, as matches support up to 80 participants. There is military equipment that you can ride on. In large-scale battles, two sides always take part (usually the Americans-British and rebel militias), which are divided into small detachments. Allied groups need to coordinate actions among themselves. Commanders can communicate with colleagues through separate radio channels and place markers on the map for everyone else. They are also capable of marking places for the construction of command posts and spawn points. If the remaining soldiers obey their orders and arm themselves with sapper blades, they will be able to erect defensive structures in the specified area. Both opposing forces have a reserve of points, which decreases with the death of fighters, loss of fortifications and combat vehicles. If a team loses all points, it will lose. Matches last about 2 hours. If time is up, the side with the higher score wins.

Crusader Kings 3 includes the Northern Lords expansion, allowing you to explore the countries of Scandinavia. Events cover the period from 867 to 1453. You can turn off the counter in the settings so that the story develops until the moment when the hero’s dynasty becomes extinct. The map covers the lands of Spain, Mongolia, Central Africa, etc.
The territory of Crusader Kings III has increased 4 times compared to the previous part. The lands include counties and 3 baronial possessions for each of them. The free multiplayer option includes playable classes such as Muslims, Pagans, and other non-Christian units, but theocracies, nomads, and merchant republics have been removed. The main characters of Crusader Kings 3 are represented by 3D models. Multiplayer allows you to set 5 lifestyles, including 3 skill trees for each. New stress mechanics have been introduced. It is activated at the moment when the protagonist makes decisions contrary to his character.
A dynamic system of religions is presented: heresy, cannibalism, ordination of women, etc. You can create side branches within dynasties. For example, the Yorks and Lancasters as an offshoot of the Plantagenets. Every dynasty has its own head. The army includes militias that can be recruited from the vassals' house. It is also possible to hire professional warriors: crossbowmen, infantry, cavalry, etc. Heroes with high scores can be knighted. Their strength is 10 times greater than ordinary soldiers. A love line is available, allowing you to give birth to descendants and connect noble houses.

Game Description Crusader Kings 3 is a global strategy that significantly expands the capabilities of the previous part. Crusader Kings 3 covers the time period from 1066 to 1453. Unlike the second part, you won’t be able to start the game at any time. The new map stretches from Spain to Burma and Mongolia, and from Scandinavia to Central Africa. The scale of the game is quadrupled. The points on the map represent not only counties, but also baronial possessions.
The game got rid of many types of troops: Muslims, pagans, nomads and many others. However, now all available heroes and fighter classes have much greater detail and have many additional abilities. Models of heroes are now represented by full-fledged three-dimensional models, instead of portraits. There are 5 lifestyles available for each character, each of which has 3 development branches. New stress mechanics have been introduced. When you have to choose an action that contradicts the hero’s beliefs, he may begin to stress, which significantly reduces his concentration. The religion system in Crusader Kings III is represented by heresy mechanics, including cannibalism or the ordination of women.
Side branches of dynasties are available. This means that multiple family houses can exist within dynasties. For example, the Yorks and Lancasters have side branches of the Plantagenets. Armies consist of recruits and professional warriors, which may include crossbowmen, cavalry, etc. You decide which fighters to hire. Heroes who have high performance and characteristics will be able to become knights. They join the main army as powerful infantry, increasing the strength of the army by 10 units. 20 experienced knights will be equal to 200 ordinary soldiers. A system of love connections has been introduced, which will greatly affect the gameplay. All the player’s achievements will be displayed in a separate table, which will allow you to track the correctness of your decisions.

Game Description Microsoft Flight Simulator offers you to play online and with a friend, even pirated and for free. This network game is available online online and includes many innovations. The game update also includes four historic airports, including Meigs Field, which was not only a popular departure point in early versions of Microsoft Flight Simulator, but also a significant part of the Chicago cityscape until its closure in 2003.
A recent update to Microsoft’s iconic flight simulator included a massive content slate, including the recreation of four iconic commercial airports, the creation of ten dedicated glider airfields, the addition of twelve modern aircraft, the integration of fourteen helicopter pads, and the inclusion of twenty legendary missions from past versions of Microsoft Flight Simulator. This update is part of a celebration of the 40th anniversary of the franchise, which is known for its realism and detail, including the use of real weather data and support for VR technology. Players are given the opportunity to fly both wide-body jets and light aircraft, experiencing night flights in unstable conditions.

Game Description Factorio is a construction simulator that you can play as a pirate with a friend online, competing with each other online for free. To protect yourself from them, you need to build stone walls, install turrets, mines and much more. It is important to find their lairs and destroy them with artillery or tanks. Game Description Horizon Zero Dawn is an action game in the world of a post-apocalyptic future, in which the world is inhabited by robotic dinosaurs that destroyed modern civilization. The few surviving people formed into small primitive tribes and resist mechanical monsters using primitive weapons combined with high technology.
The main character of Horizon Zero Dawn is a girl named Aloy. She was raised by a man named Rast, who is an Outcast. One day, while hunting, Aloy ends up in an abandoned laboratory, where she finds the Visar device, with which she can see augmented reality. To get into the Nora tribe, a girl needs to undergo the Initiation Rite. However, the tribe is raided by the cultist Helis and the settlement is destroyed. The heroine goes in pursuit of the killer. During her journey, she learns many secrets related to her origin and the formation of the world as she knows it now.
In the protagonist’s arsenal there is a bow with various types of arrows, including explosive and incendiary projectiles, bombs, a slingshot, etc. Aloy uses a unique device - a thread gun, which allows her to slow down the enemy’s movement using cables. Destroying robotic creatures, the heroine collects parts and mechanisms from their bodies, allowing her to craft various items and improvements. By hunting common animals, Aloy can create medicines, traps, quivers and bags from skins and bones.
A large open world consisting of various biomes is available for exploration. Each new location is inhabited by different types of dinosaurs: Rider, Scavenger, Lentorog, Thunderclap, Fireskin, etc. While tracking a robot called Longnose, you can mark all minor activities and points of interest on the map. The game includes a full set of add-ons, including the Frozen Wilds story addon, where a new storyline and several additional types of enemies and weapons are available.

Game Description Detroit: Become Human is a rather interesting game in the interactive cinema genre. It is based on the Quantic Dream graphics core, so the excellent graphics component immediately catches your eye. It is impossible not to note the titanic work of the animators, who created truly gorgeous animations and scenes that were plausible from the point of view of anatomy and physics.
The game takes place in the future, in an era of highly developed technology, where androids have already firmly taken their place next to people as loyal and multifunctional humanoid servants. The game’s plot tells the stories of three androids. Kara escapes her owner, slowly gains self-awareness, and protects the little girl. Connor is a hunter of fugitive androids. And Marcus is a fugitive who has chosen the goal of his life to save the rest of the androids from slavery.
Gameplay is a third-person adventure game with a choice of perspective. Various game characters can die during the story and events continue without them, so after death there will no longer be a Game Over sign, but the flow of the plot and the possible ending also change.
Special mention should be made of the features of Connor and Marcus. The first of them is a detective who is hunting for escaped androids. He is able to detect evidence and analyze the environment, reconstructing events that unfolded before his arrival. The more information he collects in the allotted time, the greater the likelihood of a correct analysis of events. And Marcus has the ability to give androids freedom of choice and calculates certain events in advance.
Depending on the player’s choice, the course of the plot changes, new conditions arise and other possibilities are cut off, so the game has enormous variability and replayability. And the interesting, dramatic and sometimes philosophical plot keeps you in suspense until the very end. Game Features: Sci-fi setting of the distant future. Eternal philosophical questions about self-awareness, artificial intelligence, robotization and androids in the spirit of cyberpunk classics and the works of Isaac Asimov. A variable story that takes into account every action and decision of the player. Three different characters with their own characters, destinies and inclinations. Great animation and superb graphics.

The events take place in the small Japanese town of Inaba. The children in Persona 4 are teenagers going through puberty. The heroes are investigating a mysterious series of murders.
The gameplay of Persona 4 Golden contains elements of a visual novel. During the passage, the protagonist and allies will meet different characters who will tell individual stories or ask you to carry out simple tasks.
