Heroes attack with light and enhanced attacks, and also use additional items. Allies summon one person at a time, while the protagonist uses more than two. Attacks are divided into several types: fire, wind, physical and almighty. Some characters have weaknesses to various attacks or, conversely, resistance to blows or elements. The “Decisive Offensive” attack will require energy expenditure, but can cause colossal damage to all opponents.
Monsters are unlocked as you progress through the story and after defeating opponents. Persons are pumped up and their characteristics increase. The gameplay allows you to live the life of an ordinary schoolchild: during the daytime, the protagonist studies or plays truant, communicates with friends, goes fishing, plays sports and many other activities. When interacting with friends, the Social links skill increases, providing bonuses for both the hero and party members.

Communication is carried out exclusively through singing. Each character has their own unique symbols on their scarves. You can complete levels together to move on to new stages at the same time. Game Description Wooden Ocean presents a narrative that begins when a teenager named Simon is transported to another world, and 42 years later, Violet goes in search of her brother Marcus. The setting is a simulation inside a structure called the Infinite Hotel, which serves as a kind of afterlife and contains many other virtual realities. It is inhabited by both local residents unaware of the nature of their existence and knowledgeable individuals, as well as entities such as demons, poets, angels and gods.

The hero’s effectiveness in battle decreases with a low health reserve, which primarily affects accuracy. The mechanics of combat psychology affect performance depending on the fighter’s confidence, and its level is tracked by portraits during clashes.
Heroes controlled by the gamer have a set of attributes, from attack and defense to luck and weight, which affects agility. Character development includes several levels of customization. At the beginning of this role-playing game, each hero chooses 2 of the 15 available elements, such as Fire, Ice or Gravity, each of which gives certain effects and allows you to interact with the environment. The project’s arsenal includes swords, bows and magic rifles, where each type of weapon offers a unique set of skills depending on specific parameters. Every 10 levels, fighters receive talents, of which there are 48 main and 12 additional talents in the title. They give an increase to attributes and increase resistance to the elements.

Game Description Space Simulation Toolkit is a physics sandbox that offers a unique approach to simulating worlds using your graphics card as a supercomputer. This game goes beyond the traditional experience, allowing users to manipulate the laws of physics and create complex worlds with living creatures. This is a platform for experiments - from the development of artificial intelligence to the design of mechanisms and simulation of various physical environments.
With the right hardware, the title turns your system into a powerhouse, making gameplay more dynamic and challenging as the graphics card’s power increases. The title relies on a fundamental building block - atoms. These atoms can form bonds, creating spatial structures that determine the physical properties of the world. Thanks to the flexibility of material properties, you can model everything from gases and liquids to soft and solid bodies.
This wide range of physical behavior opens up endless possibilities for creating realistic or completely fantastical environments. As a result, the Space Simulation Toolkit offers plenty of room to experiment with chemistry, states of matter, and more. One of the intriguing features is the Protobiome simulator, which allows users to create a living virtual world from scratch. It is a system based on evolutionary principles, where players manipulate elements such as light, water and earth to shape the development of life.

Game Description Carrier Battles 4 Guadalcanal - Pacific War Naval Warfare dives into the air conflicts that unfolded in the Pacific during World War II. This strategy game puts you in the middle of the historical battles between the US and Japan in 1942-1943. Using a system of hexes and counters, the title tasks you with outflanking your opponent while defending critical areas or attacking key enemy positions. It’s all about decision making: when to strike, when to retreat, how to preserve your carriers and prevent the enemy from gaining a foothold.
Carrier Battles 4 Guadalcanal - Pacific War Naval Warfare features 11 historically significant scenarios such as the battles of the Coral Sea and Midway, each offering a unique setting and challenge. Users can go through single missions against artificial intelligence or team up with other gamers in cross-platform multiplayer battles. For those who love deep, tactical gameplay, there’s plenty to manage here. Every action matters, from naval aircraft searches to radar scans and intelligence gathering.
You will need to monitor your forces, organize air strikes and make the most of your available resources. With a turn-based system and a focus on naval and air operations, the title allows you to feel like a real guardian of strategic planning and decision-making during the naval campaigns of World War II. Whether you’re planning amphibious invasions or launching air strikes, every move counts. It’s not just about winning the battle, but also about outwitting your opponent at every turn.

Game Description Supreme Mechanics - Challenges out-of-the-box thinking and explores different genres and perspectives. It is a first-person puzzle game that combines elements of dystopian fantasy, crime-solving, and horror with deep philosophical questions. You’ll have to solve some dark and twisted cases as you explore the world around you, uncover your character’s hidden identity, overcome the boundaries of danger and logic, and create your own version of time and history.
A true detective relies on his intuition and observation skills. They don’t let uncertainty stop them from discovering the truth, because they are able to pick up connections and clues that others miss. This is a complex web of secrets, mysteries and motives that connect people and events… You just need to find the right trail that will lead you to the solution. Become a detective who uses your intellect and heart as your main tools.
The main feature of Supreme Mechanics is its unique combination of science fiction, dystopia, crime solving and horror. Each genre offers its own story; you are free to mix and match information from all of these genres to create your own interpretation of this world, its history and major events. Your character’s identity is a mystery in itself, and you’ll have to treat the story like a puzzle to solve it.
Everyone who visited this world before you had their own view of what was happening. Everyone left their traces. The information you collect may sometimes be contradictory or conflicting, but there may also be similar or even identical pieces of valuable information. Trying to make sense of it all is difficult, but the process will take you closer to the truth.

Game Description [s][/s]Resident Evil 3: Remake is positioned as a remake of the original Resident Evil 3: Nemesis, released back in 1999. The time gap between the reissue and the original is 20 years. During this time, Capcom managed to radically rethink the series and enrich it with various innovations both in plot and gameplay, since progress does not stand still.
If Resident Evil 2 in 2019 offered the player a slower and more intense gameplay, steeped in horror, then the new product in 2020 looks a little different. The game is focused more on action, shooting and battles with Nemesis, rather than on puzzles, thoughtful exploration of locations and horror. Horror in Resident Evil 3: Remake became not the basis of the game, but its secondary component. Plot-wise, the 2020 Resident Evil 3 demo remake is as close as possible to the original 30 years ago. The main role, as before, is played by the famous Jill Valentine, a former employee of the special forces S.T.A.R.S. The protagonist finds herself in Raccoon City during a pandemic of a virus that turns people into the walking living dead - into zombies, among which there are dangerous mutants, unlike anything else, and aggressive infected dogs.
However, all opponents are not as scary and dangerous as Nemesis (aka Nemesis) is a particularly tenacious mutant capable of using weapons and obeying commands. The order given to him was simple - to destroy everyone who managed to leave that damned mansion from the first part, in which it all began. In addition to Jill Valentine and Nemesis, in Resident Evil 3: Remake 2020 the player will meet other well-known characters: the seasoned warrior Mikhail, the cynical and self-centered Nikolai, as well as the kind-hearted and simply sincere guy Carlos. By the way, the player will control Carlos for a good third of the entire passage.

Game Description People have always been attracted to space. And Avorion is one of the embodiments of human desires. This game doesn’t have much of a story or great graphics. Like many indie games, Avoiron is built on a specific idea for which the creators consciously sacrificed everything else. The backstory is this: several hundred years ago, a cataclysm almost destroyed the entire galaxy. Since then, no one has been able to break into the central regions of the galaxy. There are rumors of a strange race of aliens that have appeared in this most isolated center. And they know how to break through an unexplored barrier. But no one has yet established contact with them. There are also legends about the mysterious metal “Avorion”, which also appeared in the center of the galaxy. And the aliens clearly have something to do with this.
First of all, this is a sandbox. You start with a small ship and travel between different galaxies. At your discretion, you can engage in trade between different stations and create your own galactic trading empire - each ship can be given to AI control and given some simple task. You can hunt for various pirates, take on tasks to eliminate those objectionable to the law and receive a good reward. If you survive. Or you can become a pirate yourself. Rob merchant ships, raid stations, and so on. You can engage in peaceful mining. Crack apart asteroids and meteorites, extract valuable ore, process it and sell it, improve tools and further search for precious resources. But what you will definitely do in any of these cases is to create a ship. And here the developers gave it their all. Avorion offers a very advanced ship designer where you start with just the basics of a ship. You create everything else yourself. You yourself place living quarters, energy cells, loopholes and points for turrets, missile launchers, oxygen generators, armor elements and solar panels. And each block has its own characteristics, depending on what material you use. Your ship has a well-developed physical model. If you add extra armor plates, the weight and balance of the structure will change. The ship will take longer to accelerate and decelerate, which can be compensated for by additional engines. Which also weigh something and consume additional energy. You will have to think through the design of your ship yourself and create its appearance using a three-dimensional designer block by block. At first, such ships look unprepossessing and simple. But over time, you can create a whole fleet of small and nimble fighters at your discretion. Or, on the contrary, you can create a huge and invincible star cruiser. Game Features:
Space sandbox with an advanced physics model. A variety of activities for the space adventurer. A very well-developed three-dimensional ship designer with the ability to independently customize the type, materials and dimensions of each block. Complete freedom of action and a mysterious Universe with its mysteries and secrets.

Game Description Black Mesa is a remake of the cult shooter Half-Life, which at one time turned out to be a breakthrough in the world of video games and made the name of Valve. They worked on this project for eight whole years, during which the creators tried to transfer the old game to the new Source engine with varying success. As a result, they managed to achieve the desired effect and in May 2015 the game was released. Work on the remake was led by a team of developers from Crowbar Collective.
The plot, types of weapons, enemies, setting and the like - all this was lovingly transferred by the developers to the platform of the new engine, which made the visual component of a traditional shooter many times better: the graphics began to look quite at the level of the second part of this series (or even better) , the physics acquired features typical of Source, such as the realistic fall of opponents after they are incapacitated.
All this has improved the perception of the game and now, young fans of gamers have the opportunity to walk through the research station corridors long abandoned by everyone (except fans), fight with alien creatures and enjoy the gameplay for the second time. The game consists of 19 chapters. In general, the plot completely repeats that present in the original 1998 version. Some points were borrowed from the second part. Now everyone has the opportunity to touch the cult classics in a new modern shell!

Game Description The Longing can immediately be called a unique game. The main character is the servant of the king who ruled the underworld. The king hibernated for 400 days to recuperate, and you need to wait for him to awaken in an empty palace. The timer starts the moment you turn on the game for the first time and does not stop even when you close the game or turn off the computer. The only thing that depends on you is how you spend these 400 days. You can explore the caves in search of new trinkets with which to decorate your room, or simply kill a lot of time exploring the albeit modestly furnished, but quite extensive passages.
Don’t look for the sprint button. The main character has nowhere to rush, so he moves rather slowly. The whole game is built on the ability to wait. If you don’t know what else to do, you can go to the game library and start reading classic books from Nietzsche to Moby Dick. The books are only available in English for now, please note. The game also has several different endings, but rumor has it that it would be impossible to play through the game multiple times just to see them all. Not only because it’s very long, but also because of the tricky save system that makes it difficult to just pick it up and start again. Maybe on another computer? Or give it to a friend and watch his ending? Features of the game:
A hybrid of the adventure and idle genres, in which you just need to wait 400 days. Do you want to waste time artificially? The game will see through your attempt and throw you into prison, where you will have to click on the table 400 times. The slow and leisurely movement of the character can be automated by giving him a specific route. Then go about your business and come back when the time comes. Explore a network of underground tunnels and passages. Even in this empty palace, there are still many trinkets left that will be useful to you. Everything takes time. Can’t get to a certain location? Just wait. Something will definitely happen that will unlock your access. A stone will fall or moss will grow. You’ll see, this will help. Decorate your home. With each new piece of decor and with each improvement, the speed of time increases. Choose to your taste not only what you will do and how exactly you will play this game, but also how it will end. Choose wisely, you may not have the opportunity to replay it.

Game Description Disco Elysium is an RPG in which a detective must use his skills to conduct a unique investigation. The player will have to interrogate well-developed characters, investigate murders, and, if desired, take bribes. You can become either the savior of the city or the worst disaster for all humanity. Game Features: Unique branched dialogue system. Wide freedom of choice both in the story narrative and in additional tasks. Well-developed characters with their own stories and personalities. Wide range of clothes, equipment and skills. It is up to the player to decide whether to go through the game in the way that is considered correct or to immerse themselves in role-playing.
The game provides unprecedented freedom of choice. The detective can either use his own eloquence - intimidate and persuade, or resort to more effective and visual methods. But this is not limited to violence alone, because you can sing karaoke, write poetry, tear the dance floor to shreds, or you can even learn the meaning of life. All 24 skills are completely different, allowing you to create different combinations to suit your own playstyle. Or you can work out in detail the image for role-playing. Fortunately, an extensive wardrobe of 80 pieces of clothing also helps with this. And let’s not forget about the tools - pistols, flashlights, a tape recorder and even several different psychoactive drugs. And the cherry on the cake - 60 thoughts to ponder in the Thoughts Cabinet.
The dialogue system is very well designed and makes you believe that real people live in the game world, and not static bots. The characters can be helped, or they can be pitted against each other. You can even fall in love with them if you have the desire - the game’s dialogue system allows you to do whatever your heart desires. The same wide freedom of action is given in the gameplay itself. Game Description The player’s task inOxygen Not Included is to obtain food, water, oxygen, valuable resources and happiness for the duplicates - the inhabitants of his colony. The world settled into different parts, because of this, half of the people went to other planets, and the second part called themselves duplicates and decided to travel through space, flying between asteroids.
The idea of ​​the most hardcore survival simulator in a strategic shell - Oxygen Not Included - shows that maintaining your own base and several people on it is incredibly difficult. The lower the happiness of our settlers, the more they protest, the worse they work and cope with their tasks. It is important that most settlers have individual character. Fortunately, the developers made not several hundred players, but only a dozen.
The reality of the simulator is off scale. For example, in order for your people to feel comfortable on the new asteroid that you choose at the beginning, they need a full-fledged base. To upgrade it, you need to get out of the building and climb into the gorges to get fossils. After this, the settlers will want a sufficient amount of food with a “spare”, and then they will demand a car for recreation. Once they start consuming everything in their path, you have waste that leads to a series of diseases. Thus, in the game we will cope with one problem, which immediately gives rise to another.
Colonists will have their own skill, which is determined while performing work. For example, some will find it easy to learn and make plans; someone finds it easy to dig because the use of a tool is not new to him; some will be great at creating creative solutions to problems. Everyone does their job, but you must carefully monitor the bladder fullness, stress, and “busyness” of your settlers.

Game Description Quake II RTX offers a new look at the classic project. This became possible thanks to the introduction of RTX technology. So, now the usual corridors and battle arenas look completely new, the hero models have a more acceptable appearance, and the shot animations have become more spectacular.
As for the gameplay component, Quake II RTX is no different from the original in this component. Users are transported to arenas where they fight each other in a certain number of rounds. As they move through locations, they can use amplifiers, jump on trampolines installed at certain points, or pick up new weapons. But in addition to the multiplayer mode, the game contains a story campaign. Here, the focus is on the conflict between humans and the Strogg race. Intent on protecting Earth from invasion, the army decides to launch a counter-offensive on the creatures' home planet of Stroggos. But due to problems during the landing, the main character is separated from the main group, and he is thrown to the outskirts of the enemy base. There, he will have to make his way through the complex and military base, destroying key objects (air defense system, plant for the production of new soldiers, etc.).
At the same time, in the story campaign the user will not have additional landmarks or a map to rely on. Game Description Total War: THREE KINGDOMS is the first game in the series that recreates epic conflicts in Ancient China. The game combines a turn-based campaign of empire building and conquest with epic real-time battles. 190 AD. A beautiful but fragmented country awaits a new emperor and a new life. The player will have to unify China, create the next great dynasty and leave a legacy that will endure for millennia.
There are 12 legendary commanders to choose from, and help will come in the form of heroic characters. With their help, it will be necessary to destroy all enemies on the economic, technological, political and economic fronts. What kind of commander will you become - one who values ​​the bonds of lasting friendship, forms fraternal alliances and commands respect even from his enemies? Or those who are known for their treachery, terrible betrayal and masterful political intrigue? It’s up to you to decide.
The game recreates the Three Kingdoms of Ancient China in all their natural beauty. Battles will take place in lush subtropics, parched deserts and snow-capped mountains. The player will have plenty of time to admire legendary sights like the Great Wall of China and the Yangtze River. During the restoration of harmony in China, you will have the opportunity to visit all its nooks and crannies.
A new empire will be forged with the help of one of the 12 legendary commanders who came from the famous historical epic of China - the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Fearless commanders, mighty warriors and renowned businessmen - they all have a unique gaming style and their own tasks. They will be supported by a variety of heroes who take command of your armies, govern provinces and strengthen your empire in every possible way. Heroes are the heart of the game itself and China will be defined by these champions.
The game uses the Guanxi model, a Chinese concept of dynamic relationships. All relationships between the characters determine the course of the game. Each of the characters is endowed with his own character, motivation and what he loves and, on the contrary, does not accept. They also form their own relationships, both positive and negative. Gorgeous graphics and spectacular wushu style turn the game into the art of war. The colorful interface, breathtaking views and Chinese-inspired artwork make traveling through this world a feast for the eyes.
The turn-based campaign and real-time battles are even more interconnected than before. Each action in battle now has much more significant consequences, influencing the attitude of the heroes towards you as a commander, as well as whether friendship or enmity arises between them. In a world where strong allies are one of the key components of success, the way to achieve victory is given new meaning. Game Features: An exciting journey through a detailed reconstruction of Ancient China. 12 different potential emperors and legendary heroes. A system of friendship and enmity between heroes. A dynamic system of relationships between the parties to the conflict. Almost complete freedom of choice in how exactly everyone will bow to you Ancient China.

Game Description Despite the average ratings for the 10th part of the franchise,Mortal Kombat 11 became a continuation of the story, and the developers tried to improve and add a lot of new things to players. The eleventh fighting game in the Mortal Kombat universe has new gameplay, plot, graphics, and character relationships that reveal the story as it progresses. We arrive in the world after the defeat of Shinnok, who was defeated by Cassie Cage. Before us is Dark Raiden in a single guise. He plans to defend Earthrealm by forcing all opponents to flee or die. However, Kronika appears on the horizon.
The Keeper of Time decides to restore order to the entire Universe, and to do this she will have to get rid of Raiden. The latter intervened in the past, thereby upsetting the balance of power between good and evil. The final footage of the 2011 game perfectly captures these events, while we continue to correct the consequences. Unlike the 10th part, we will not have to resolve conflicts between characters, destroying traitors along the way and everyone who cannot take the final side. The plot of Mortal Kombat 11 is simple and clear: to correct the situation in the world and come to final harmony, but it is incredibly difficult to do this. The fatal change in characters is especially noticeable in the face of Raiden. While he was purifying the energy source of Earthrealm, dark energy seeped into his being, and now we do not see his peacekeeping views, but only an aggressive policy regarding the purification of the earth.
The gameplay of Mortal Kombat 11 hasn’t changed much. This is a 2.5D fighting game, where fatalities and brutalities remained, but were transformed due to new graphics. Fatal Blow and Krushing Blow have also been added. Killing Strike is a special move that deals a lot of damage to an enemy, provided your opponent has less than 30% life left. This is the actual replacement for X-Ray. Krushing Blow is a cinematic blow that plays out a cutscene of the blow after performing several combinations. Equipment has been added to the project, but it only affects the appearance of the characters.
The developers went further and made specialized tournaments in the MK universe. Ratings for competitive matches have been introduced within championships. One tournament lasts 4 weeks, and in the end you receive one of 9 ranks, each of which gives a unique reward. The matchmaking system is designed to match you with a player of your level. In addition to this, a special editor has been developed in which you can customize the appearance of the character the way you like. This is added to the advanced graphics engine that imbues the game with reality.

Traveling along various paths, the character leaves traces; they must be constantly covered up so as not to be detected. Go on this fascinating journey soon and find out the reason for Zero’s strange therapy and who he was before the disruptions in his memory began.

The classic gameplay of Anno includes solving complex logistics problems, constantly maintaining a balance between the consumption of strategically important resources and the costs of developing its own production centers. The player’s possibilities are almost limitless: superiority over competitors can be earned both through equipping expeditions and exploring new territories (and their subsequent colonization), and through success on the diplomatic front or military victories.
In addition to expansion, it is necessary to pay attention to the development of our own settlements. Providing residents with necessary goods, installing infrastructure and constructing special buildings can increase the productivity of production chains, and therefore ensure leadership in the international arena. Game Description Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy is a re-release of three parts of lawyer simulators combined with adventure. Here the player will not only defend a person in court, but will also begin to investigate the circumstances of the crime, exploring the place, finding evidence, interrogating witnesses. At the trial, the user will listen to both sides, question, look for contradictions in their words, using found objects. The lawyer will be able to defend himself, even if there is only one piece of evidence proving the innocence of the accused, and will also delay time to collect more information.
At the beginning of the walkthrough there are training episodes where you can learn more about the principles of operation. First, the gamer, in the role of defender Phoenix Wright, studies the location where the crime occurred, talks with the detective, looks for evidence unnoticed by anyone, moving the cursor over a static screen. Here you can meet random passers-by who can answer questions and even show you the objects they found. Having finished with the research, the game automatically takes the user to the trial.
The judge needs to be convinced of the client’s innocence, meanwhile, the prosecutor will interfere with the character with all sorts of tricks: calling strange eyewitnesses, revealing unstudied evidence and manipulating incredible facts. You can respond to such statements and support your version with your own evidence. Witnesses and defendants will play a huge role in the trial. They will tell their versions of events, and then there will be cross-examination, where the main participants in the process will answer various questions, the answers to which the character can clarify. This is the most active part of the gameplay, where a real verbal skirmish will begin - the eyewitness speaks, the defense attorney clarifies, the prosecutor appeals to the judge with a statement that the question is not relevant to the case, Wright convinces that it is.
There are different cases in the lawyer simulator - some are simple and do not last long, others are more complex and tricky. There are many situations here and they are all very interesting, close to real events, there are even investigations related to spiritualism. In the process, Phoenix will be able to unravel even the most complex cases, where the amazing logic of the criminal will build an unpredictable chain of events.

The story begins in the 25th year of Hongwu’s reign and continues until the Battle of Jingnan. You have to explore the world of Ming Wushu, which is filled with numerous activities and interesting quests.
There are two dozen factions that you are free to join. Participate in Jinyiwei or take a completely different route - enter the palace to serve the emperor. Gain the loyalty of leaders such as Zhu Yunqi, Yang Wang Zhudi, Ning Zhuquan, Shu Zhu Chong, Zhou Zhu Xi and others.
The combat in Wushu Chronicles is made in a turn-based style. Perform both ground and air attacks. 23 factions have their own characteristics. Develop skills, upgrade, level up and hire students. Teach them all the knowledge that you have mastered yourself/ You have the opportunity to educate your successors.

One-Armed Wolf: Shadows Die takes you twice through numerous levels of ancient Japan, giving you the opportunity to visit forests, mountains, plains, temples and much more.
Each enemy, be it an ordinary enemy, a mini-boss or a leader, poses a serious threat and requires you to choose a unique tactic of action. A special innovation is that now the player does not die immediately. After defeat, the hero is resurrected and given another chance. However, all bosses have this ability. Game Description Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is an incredibly challenging action game that makes feudal Japan look dark, burning, and beautiful at the same time. The third-person stealth action game combines the features of RPGs and the themes of Souls games. Well-designed graphics of feudal Japan allow us to plunge into the difficult process of returning our master of the Ashina clan. The leader of the opposition - Genichiro - kidnapped a samurai from Shinobi, and now we must cope with a huge number of his followers in order to save the teacher, master, master and good friend who paid us well in a past life.
We have at our disposal a character named Wolf. He has been a warrior with a bone arm all his life, and his secondary weapons are a sword and a rope with a hook. The whole game is built on the idea of ​​attack, not defense, so every time we encounter enemies, we will have to sophisticatedly kill them with our sword, pull them with a rope with a hook, use unique abilities, and all this in a perfectly drawn world!
The plot of Sekiro is revealed to us in more detail after several cut scenes. The Sengoku period is over. One of the military leaders - Isshin Ashina - seizes the land of Ashina (another character) and makes a revolution in the history of Japan. During this period, our character is adopted by one of the representatives of the wandering shinobi - Owl, who gives us the name - Wolf. Next we see that the Ashina clan is weakening. Opponents from all sides are ready to take his place. Isshin loses his powers. Isshin’s grandson finds strength in himself and captures the only Divine Heir - Kuro. His blood contains the “Dragon Legacy”.
Trained in all aspects of combat, the Wolf is Kuro’s bodyguard, but he cannot cope with the huge army and its commander, Genichiro. This is where our journey begins, which will end either with the formation of the Deity in the person of Isshin, or with the return of Japan to its usual modernized system. We will be able to upgrade our character’s skills after each battle. Each fight allows us to upgrade our character, make his equipment more powerful, and also fully master the skill tree. Fights take place strictly with a katana. Opponents have no health, but can be weakened by reducing concentration, which decreases after we reflect blows. Without concentration, we kill the enemy with one blow.
Our concentration dries up after missing or landing blows. When the “concentration” scale is depleted, we can die from one blow from the most powerful opponent. Also in the game there are shurikens, a grappling hook and all the techniques of a real ninja. An additional feature is that we can kill enemies by quietly sneaking up on them from behind. There is always an “alertness” gauge above the enemy’s head, which, when filled, reveals your location.

Game Description A city planning simulator, civilization development and real-time strategy - Dawn of Man is one of the few games in the genre where human survival is presented in this form. For example, we start playing on behalf of the leader of a primitive tribe, and we need to get people to collect resources. Due to constant work, the brain begins to improve, and the first people appear in the world who think more or less intelligently.
The first period is the Stone Age. Going through all 10,000 years of evolutionary development of mankind, we will see how the emergence of a brain like ours took place. Yes, we will only reach the Iron Age, but this will not stop us from capturing such a history of development. The main activity in the game will be hunting. By killing mammoths, bison, deer, lions and rhinoceroses, we will take the bones to make new tools and weapons; collect meat to ensure our tribe survives as long as possible; cut skins to provide clothing for people.
The second direction of work is gathering. Berries, fruits, vegetables, wood, stone, iron ore - the earth gives all this free of charge. Over time, we will study planting technology so that people can begin to plant and grow entire crops. When constructing your first buildings, do not forget to build a warehouse to stock up on provisions for a rainy day. It is advisable to place some building resources here in case you want to move.
Expand your settlement by building houses, help people research new technologies, including the wheel, weapons and fortifications of that time. Don’t forget that our ancestors were greedy for huge structures, so put up huge statues so that they can at least pray to someone. Also, nature will be on your side if you start taking care of it from the early stages of the emergence of a rational person.

The maid’s fighting style involves time management. It can be slowed down to make it easier to dodge enemy attacks, or stopped altogether. Silver knives, which the heroine deftly throws at her opponents, became the weapon for destroying local evil spirits. In addition to enemies, there are other obstacles on the way in the form of moving platforms, spinning blades, and spikes.
As the game progresses, the character upgrades, increasing his health, mana, the duration of the time stop and the number of knives thrown. There are also cards at levels with special moves and items that provide additional abilities. For example, Sakuya gets a double jump and a roll.

The developers laid down one basic reason for human happiness: “only in motion will you be calm,” they say. The game is something meditative, requiring careful attention and thinking about every step of the project, where the main character will not be afraid of death, nervous breakdowns or atmosphere. We have to solve puzzles, think through our movement towards the truth in order to finally calm down the naive gris. A special achievement of the developers was the plot, revealed through signs and human emotions in a bouquet with psychological triggers. There is practically no text in the game.

Game Description DUSK is a canonical first-person shooter created in a retro style. The plot is quite simple and clear - there is a small town called DUSK, in its vicinity ruins were discovered that have mystical properties. Many scientists and soldiers came here, studying strange objects and everyone gradually went crazy. They became possessed, and the government surrounded the entire area with a wall. A brave hero was found who entered the forbidden territory in search of these unique artifacts, but was captured by occultists and hung on hooks.
The gamer will have to take control of a nameless person who finds himself in a small room, but with a huge number of enemies. A mystical voice orders the death of the uninvited guest. The protagonist is not unarmed, he has two hooks in his hands, they will help fight off a horde of enemies. You have a huge number of levels at your disposal, and each one has the same task - to get from point “a” to point “b” while staying alive. You need to go through small corridor locations and constantly fire at enemies. They all have incredible strength and breakneck speed, trying to destroy the main character in every possible way. The game has several modes: Story campaign - tells us about the mystical deeds of a dark cult, which is located throughout the city. Endless survival - allows you to enjoy a large-scale meat grinder. Here, enemies attack in waves, after one has been successfully passed, a second one comes, but there are more enemies and they are becoming stronger. Arena DUSKWORLD - allows you to join a team match with players around the world. The one who makes the most kills wins.
The player will have to move through small locations, killing numerous monsters, robots and humanoid creatures. You have complete freedom of action, wander through locations, study objects, learn something new about strange creatures. Various variations of all kinds of weapons are scattered throughout the locations and are already loaded, you can take them and immediately start firing at enemies. The gameplay is divided into two stages. The first is a day, while it lasts you can explore the world around you and find the items necessary for survival: food, weapons and ammunition and learn more about the magical properties of the ruins. The second is night; at the first twilight, the streets begin to fill with various creatures that instantly head towards you.

The hero rolls everything that gets in his way into a ball and then sends it into the sky. Thus, a replacement star appears in space. Then the cycle repeats. This original activity is offered at 20 levels. A limited amount of time is given to complete them. Non-linear stages are divided into zones. The user chooses the route himself. Game Description FIGHTING EX LAYER, as the name suggests, is a fighting game. The game has two types of controls - classic and progressive. The first is designed for fans of fighting, and the second is suitable for beginners. Battles take place in 2.5D in closed arenas.
The gameplay of the project is reminiscent of the second or third part of SF and other virtual battles of the 90s. The super canceling mechanic allows you to abruptly cancel a combo during the attack animation in order to quickly carry out another series of attacks. The Gugi system appeared. Game Description Battlefield 5 is a first-person shooter, the fifteenth game in the Battlefield series. Unlike previous games in the series, Battlefield 5 sacrifices historical accuracy for the sake of the player: weapon handling, for example, has been noticeably improved, making the game more like an arcade shooter. Most of the changes made to BFV are solid improvements over its predecessor.
War Stories is a series of single-player missions introduced in Battlefield V, where the player is invited to become an eyewitness to tragic events. You’ll be introduced to three stories set in lesser-known corners of World War II. Missions are open-ended, with multiple objectives that can be completed in any order.
Detailed changes not only bring excitement to the gameplay, but also add to the mix an appropriately brutal depiction of war. Depleting or limited resources to operate adds a new dynamic to the franchise. Each of the four available classes - Recon, Assault, Medic and Support - plays a different role to ensure squad members stay alive and ammo never runs out.
Sandbox mode surprises you with unexpected moments of player freedom: Battlefield is a series known for its destruction, but now you can build. Any class can build without you having to gather resources, but the process is slow and leaves you vulnerable to attack.

The character will be able to shoot at special points to move forward in the location; will be able to jump and get objects, as well as kill monsters encountered along the way. At one point, he even drops his hands and closes his eyes after one character’s phrase: “this world will die.” But he continues to move because he is… A man.
The gradually engrossing plot is revealed gradually, as stated above. From the very beginning we will solve puzzles in order to at least somehow get acquainted with the gameplay, then the game will become a little more difficult due to the artifacts found in the locations. When we learn to shoot, the game will throw in several monsters to test our abilities. This is where the increase in game difficulty ends.
Overall, Unknown Fate is a great story that doesn’t end too quickly. Only after such games do you want to think about the present, about the world, about humanity, about memory.

Game Description Moonfall Ultimate offers online play in a dark, 2D side-scrolling action RPG set in an industrial gothic universe. Play with a friend online or pirate for free, enjoying exciting strategic battles and making your way through a treacherous, hand-painted world. In addition to the single-player campaign, the game features couch co-op and multiplayer where you can dive into an endless arcade mode and upgrade your gear as you explore the world in metroidvania style.
The game’s narrative takes place in the Empire, a once small kingdom that is now threatened by the so-called Savages. These mysterious enemies are hunting for Lunarium, a coveted element that can be found within the Empire’s borders. You will step into the shoes of a brave recruit tasked with defending the kingdom on the front lines. It’s not an easy task, but someone has to do it, right?
Moonfall Ultimate doesn’t skimp on variety, offering three different character classes to suit different playstyles. Whether it’s Vanguard, Elementalis, or Shadow, each class offers unique active and passive abilities. As you progress, you’ll be immersed in a robust leveling system and in-game economy, giving you access to over 80 unique items. It’s a classic case of fight, collect, upgrade, and repeat.
The combat system in the game is also not bad, offering you many options for dealing damage. However, you’ll have to put on your thinking cap - strategy is the key to victory. With 13 open, fully explorable levels filled with quests, boss fights, and notes that expand the story, there’s a lot to dive into. Don’t forget the rogue’s gallery - over 60 multi-level enemies, each with their own quirks and tricks up their sleeves. The world is a dog-eat-dog atmosphere, and Moonfall Ultimate leaves no chance.

Game Description A stunning rogue-like platformer with metroidvania elements -Dead Cells - features a real fight between the hero and constantly changing levels on the territory of the castle. Our hero is a creature who is trying to get out of the castle’s maze. He will try over and over again to cope with constantly generated opponents. But in random places on the map you will find many weapons with random characteristics. The character is upgraded with each new death. You will have about 100 abilities and unique characteristics to help you cope with a series of changing monsters.
The protagonist’s weapons will constantly change, as will his appearance - he takes on the appearance of killed enemies. For example, you will be able to carry two weapons with you - a blade and a turret. And replace the auxiliary items with throwing knives and grenades. Each enemy drops cells. At the end of the level, you upgrade your skills to these “cells”. They seem insignificant, however, they greatly help during the game. One of them is the ability to drink a health potion more often. Second, for example, your poisoned blade will deal more damage by 3% of the poison.
As the developers say, most monsters can be simply avoided, and the really difficult battles are bosses, which are made according to the system from Dark Souls: the larger the boss, the more powerful its blow. Although you will still die from one blow. Constant improvements to weapons and character, leveling up abilities that carry over from level to level: this is what metroidvania is all about. Gradually, the explored locations will take on a familiar appearance - this means that the world is no longer randomly generated, and you are approaching the end of the stage.

Game Description As a dialogue-heavy role-playing game that explores a deep story,Yakuza 0 claims to be a game that combines friendship, self-love, and the search for true calling. The Yakuza is the largest mafia group in Japan, which controls everything that can be controlled. Events begin in 1988, when two Yakuza characters - Kazuma Kiryu and Goro Majima - take part in a battle for a small industrial plot in the center of Kamurocho. The empty land rightfully belongs to no one, so all the factions in Japan are coming to seize this place at any cost. However, our heroes are loyal to their clan, despite the fact that Goro was exiled and Kazuma is the lowest rank.
The first scene shows the “silent” war of the Japanese mafiosi. Kiryu beats up a man in a back alley, demanding repayment of his debts, and after that the nameless man is killed, leaving to rot on the “empty land.” Because of such matters, Kiryu leaves the Yakuza, knowing that the Tojo clan is preparing a major attack. After which we fight with one of the brightest representatives of the clan - the “lieutenant” - and begin our criminal activities with Akire Tachibane.
The role-playing game combines two modes. The first is adventure. You calmly wander around the city, explore the area, talk to people, buy things, play mini-games and call the phone sex service. The second mode is combat. In it you have to fight your opponents using special techniques that you need to buy with money (inside the game). There are 4 fighting styles available in Yakuza 0, which you can switch between at any time. When playing as any character, you can choose a style, but remember about the “Dragon Style”, which becomes available after a while. There are two cities in the game - an analogue of Tokyo’s Kabuki-Cho - Kamurocho, and Osaka’s Dotonbori - Sotenbori. In both cities we will play as Kazuma and Majima. The main part of the game consists of side quests that help the plot unfold.

The impressive combat system is rightfully considered one of the most advanced in general; only an analogue from the series of games about Geralt of Rivia can compete with it, but still, in “Dark Souls” it, although less dynamic and rhythmic, is much more thoughtful. Fights with opponents turn into a real chess tournament.

Game Description Conan Exiles is an amazing multiplayer survival game with RPG and action elements. Employees of the Norwegian company Funcom worked on the project. The project was released at the end of spring 2018. Stunning graphics are a rare quality that developers of various MMORPG games pay attention to. But this time everything happened exactly the opposite. Funcom, 10 years before Conan Exiles, had already released a similar game called Age Of Conan. Despite the fact that the game was warmly received by players and the press, over time, it stopped paying for itself and its main servers were closed.
Like its predecessor, this project is based on the work of the Texas science fiction writer Robert Irwin Howard and his immortal hero - Conan of Cimmeria. Conan is the greatest fantasy character. He alone weighs at least as much as the entire Lord of the Rings brethren combined. Therefore, the creators of the game tried to take a responsible approach to the virtual embodiment of the hero. However, players will not be able to fight on behalf of Conan. At the very beginning, we choose the gender and appearance of our hero. Next, a prologue begins, during which the legendary hero removes our character from the cross (on which he was crucified, in the middle of a lifeless desert). Next, we have to go through a little training. The main point of the game is to create your own fortified settlement, fight with other players, mine minerals and explore the area. We can say that Conan Exiles is a mixture of sandbox, role-playing game and action, where battles are fought on mounts, and you can also create an entire empire within the world of Conan the Barbarian.

Game Description Frostpunk is an economic strategy game, a simulator of city construction in extremely harsh climatic conditions, where there are no wars, but there is a main enemy in the form of global cooling. The employees of the main office of 11 bit studios worked on the creation of this project. The official release of the game took place in April 2018.
In technical terms, we have a three-dimensional strategy game, with a top-down view, a simulator of the leader of a surviving human population in the Arctic cold. We have to deal with the issues of arranging the settlement, and the main task assigned to the player by the developers can be called the condition - to hold out for 45 days without losing a critically large number of human lives. The plot tells how in the second half of the nineteenth century, during prolonged volcanic eruptions on planet Earth, the sky became clouded with clouds consisting of volcanic dust. The sun ceased to adequately heat the surface of the planet and global cooling occurred. British scientists created heat generators in the Arctic ice, underground, but Great Britain itself soon ceased to exist as a power, and now, our group of survivors, needs to go to these generators and build a new city around them called New London.

A first-person shooter with action elements brings us to a reality in which even the movements of dogs will be more than real. The modernization of the shooter took several years, so the development studio warns us in advance that the game is based on religious motives. Age limit: 18+.

The main character is a nameless deputy sheriff of the city, who, out of helplessness, turned to a hired killer, that is, to us. The head and ruler of the district is Joseph Sid, a religious fanatic who created a religious sect in the city. According to him, he is the only one who can save people from real devilish punishment. Having convinced a crowd of civilians, a pursuit of dissidents begins in the area.
Our hero will have to craft weapons, collect items and use the skill tree, which pumps up not only his health level, but also the ability to carry more weapons; we can make grenades and Molotov cocktails. Driving cars and auxiliary equipment is provided to you. As you progress through the story, you will find people who will join your mission. You can also play Far Cry 5 with a friend and go through the story on increased difficulty. An eye movement feature has been added to the game. You can help your team spot enemies faster, cooperate in stealth mode, and carry out stealth strikes. The project is designed for several endings, each of which carries a certain meaning and beginning, which you are completely guided by when creating a character.

Game Description Ostalgie: The Berlin Wall is a political simulator that allows you to feel like the ruler of one of the socialist countries, such as East Germany, Romania, Poland and Bulgaria. The player’s main task is to survive until 1992.
Each country has a set of problems and is driven by an individual goal. For example, the GDR wants to unite with West Germany, Romania wants to become a European version of North Korea, Bulgaria is determined to overthrow its ruler Zhivkov, and the Poles need to give a helping hand to General Jaruzelski. At the same time, nothing prevents you from going against the citizens of your country. The gameplay takes place in real time with the ability to use a tactical pause. This distinguishes it from its ancestor Crisis in the Kremlin, which was based solely on turn-based mechanics. Ostalgie: The Berlin Wall provides:
develop strategy and build domestic and foreign policy; introduce reforms and build new formations of socialism; conduct research and build buildings; fight in vestalgia and bring the state to a more capitalist way of life; manipulates elections, bribes officials, engages in propaganda; manage the budget, trade with other countries or do not entirely legal things to obtain more securities.
Upon the onset of 1992 and having successfully avoided party coups, popular uprisings, and not allowing NATO or USSR troops into their lands, the game will helpfully offer to continue the campaign further, or to see how the power has changed as a result of the player’s actions.

Game Description The world of sleeping gods in Ash of Gods: Redemption is revealed to its fullest extent as the plot of the three main characters begins to rid this world of priests who awakened too suddenly. The role-playing turn-based strategy tells the story of the legend of the game world, in which the reapers - the magicians of the dark side - were supposed to wake up no earlier than in a thousand years. They completely occupied a piece of land to awaken and call upon the gods; to weary the whole world in blood, and become rulers in it.
Within the game structure there are turn-based battles, the outcome of which can sometimes be decided by a single card drawn from the deck. As we progress through the story, we get new characters into the squad and upgrade old ones. As soon as we meet the enemies, the game takes us to the battlefield, where we play with our characters one turn at a time, in which we can hit, use a spell or draw a card from the deck.
According to the plot, the bloodiest and biggest battle took place on the territory of the world. The Defenders came out for the people, and against them were the reapers, who united the evil forces of the game. For some time, our army held the upper hand, but at one moment the leader, a demigod, came out and managed to chain our Defenders in stone. The game tells how we can return our comrades, liberate the earth and prevent the prophecy from coming true.
Each event in the game changes its further turn. Even if the main character died during the battle, the game will not stop going on as usual, you will just be given another character to use, which will quickly lead to the prophecy. The combat system of Ash of Gods: Redemption is a unique combination of a card game and unique character abilities that you need to know by heart. The more experience you have at the start of a battle, the easier it is for artificial intelligence to adapt to your playstyle.

The modernized first part is made on a new graphics engine, allowing us to see every severed limb; look at dead enemies and collect dropped loot around them, not paying attention to graphical inaccuracies.

The main reward comes to us from completed tasks. Armor, weapons, scrolls, recipes and resources for upgrading our profession - all this is distributed between 4 players. If there are only two or three of you in co-op mode, then the last place will be taken by artificial intelligence, which can reflect your skills and play on the same level.
Overall, the game turned out to be a worthy version of itself 3 years after the release of the first part. Redrawn graphics, improved crafting system and character upgrades. The plot tells us the story of a world of chaos in several missions, in which there is time for jokes, murders and a huge amount of meat!

Game Description The Scandinavian strategy of Northgard with a deepening into the ancient mythology of the Vikings, which found Nordgard - a city full of wealth, myths and ancient legends. The game combines the peaceful graphics and the gradual development of your settlement. However, the Vikings quickly cooled their ardor when they met with the first danger of Northgard - a brutal cold enveloping all the shores and heart of the island. The second danger is wild animals and a limited number of resources in the territory. And the third is the dead, who rebelled to protect their ancient kingdom.
In fact, the storyline was invented for the Vikings themselves, and the player tells the story of Jarl Riga. His father was killed by Jarl Hagen and abducted the ancient relic of the horn of Konung. He is serving from his kingdom of the Vikings, gathering a powerful fleet, but half of the troops die on the way to the island. As it turned out, the Yarl Hagen has well settled on this island, where everything completely obeys him: from skeletons to animals. Because of such a power, our hero will have to almost survive on the new island in order to avenge his father and return the family ancient relic.
Arriving on the island, the player will have the opportunity to dispose of a small number of resources. Among them are people who were not always warriors. Part can be made by forges, some should be sent to the extraction of food, from the remaining group to make real ferocious warriors who are ready to tear to shreds all for the Yarl and Odin. With the help of strategic capabilities, the player will be able to expand their boundaries, but know that the soldiers will have to protect them from constant raids. Your army will not be replenished so fast, but there are many misfortunes in the entire game - especially often people will die from the cold.
In addition to constant conquests, the player will have the opportunity to pump his units in the tree of skills. For example, you can easily make the main ability to be resistant to frost, but then in the war with the skeletons the Vikings will be fought cruelly, but sometimes to lose. The control of the settlement is simple. The construction of buildings is allowed after the construction of a special municipality. The more resources, the more structures themselves, but keep in mind that a lot spoils the landscape.

Game Description Puyo Puyo Tetris is an arcade puzzle game. You can play Pirate alone or online with a friend. There is both local multiplayer and online competitions on the Internet. The controls are designed for a keyboard. However, gamepads are also supported.
The project has a lot of content for single or online fans. Free online play is available for up to 4 users. Puyo Puyo Tetris is a crossover between two franchises. Namely “Tetris” and “Puyo-Puyo”. In the first puzzle you need to place the figures falling into the glass so that they fill a horizontal row. Then the line of blocks will disappear and make room for new objects. In the second game, the gameplay is similar, but with a couple of differences. The figures do not consist of cubes, but of colorful creatures. And you need to place creatures of the same color on the field. Moreover, this can be done not only horizontally, but also vertically and even on the sides. In a single, you can play each of these types of puzzles or have fun in games that mix both types. Network play also allows you to do all this. Many different modes are available: Adventure - a single-player campaign with a plot about the merging of worlds; Battle - a single-player duel with a bot; Endurance - here you are asked to hold out against bots for as long as possible; Challenge - a set of tests designed for one gamer; Duel - a fight two users, each of whom solves his own puzzle; Big Badabum - participants fight for the title of the fastest; Merger - here both types of rules from two universes are applied simultaneously on the field; Transition - users compete with each other, but participate in turns; Puzzle League - rating matches with live opponents; Party - competitions where you can help or hinder other participants; Free play - here you can customize sessions in detail.

Game Description The plot ofKingdom Come: Deliverance takes place in a simple European village. We play as the son of a blacksmith. Our name is Henry. The civil war affected not only the political upheaval, but also ordinary villages and people like yours. Friends, family and your entire lineage have been slaughtered by brutal mercenaries in a sinister plot. We miraculously managed to survive, so we take the last sword forged by our father and march against the army of godless people!
The open world of this RPG demonstrates the constant pumping of the hero, his improvement in terms of striking technology. The Roman Empire was filled with discord, chaos and disorder after the death of the ruler, Charles 6. In Bohemia, people found refuge for themselves, became culturally enriched, worked smartly and demanded the same from their cohabitants, but civil chaos, which brought about the destruction of government power, overthrew the idea of equality, leaving only the numerical superiority of the mercenaries, who were able to eliminate the ideal regime of life in a few days.
Our hero intends to stop the bacchanalia. Killing the new king, Sigismund, is your main task. Lord Radziga Kobyla is your new father, master and patron. He takes you under his wing, educates you, gives you skills and teaches you the craft of war. Willy-nilly, you step into the conflict between the Lord and Sigismund. The first repels the invaders, and the second tries to extinguish the last forces of resistance.
In a completely open world with magnificent graphics of the Middle Ages, we will go through story and non-linear quests that completely influence the continuation of the game. Medieval Bohemia is made in such detail that the characters and people in it, whom you seduce, kill, and bribe, look like real medieval representatives of Europe. Character leveling is an additional aspect that opens from the very beginning of the game.

Game Description Rust (Rust) An ideal first-person survival simulator is not a simple escape from a city or civilization, but a necessary measure based on the conditions of our player. In Rust we will have to kill people, animals, build houses, dwellings, try to make fire out of nothing and survive in a world where everything is trying to kill us. The gameplay begins with the fact that we find ourselves on an island. Someone immediately goes to kill a crayfish or a turtle, but it is more profitable to go into the rainforest and kill someone there. In the updated version of the game, the developers added large cities and raised ethical and moral questions about murder. Although the players don’t care about it.
In a first-person survival simulator, you can create almost anything, the main thing is not to show yourself in front of other players. Many people will like this project because you can live and loot like a sniper, and only go hunting at night. There is only one server in the game, but it is divided into a huge number of locations and time zones, so many players may not even meet. The graphics of Rust are also pleasantly surprising. At maximum settings, we get a game in which glare, real images of trees, water and even stones make us think that the game is a place where you can live in peace. You will have to craft everything: from weapons to boards for the house. Cut down trees, kill animals, fry meat over a fire. After a while you will be able to install an electric stove, but that’s a completely different story. There is no plot side to the game, so the entire process is based on survival and killing other players. By the way, with the most pleasant members of the game you can create a clan, unite and capture a city or settlement on the map.

Game Description Eco is a simulator with survival elements that gives you the opportunity to create your own civilization together with a friend, playing online. On the free pirate game you will have to join forces to resist the approaching meteorite. You can play online online or use a LAN connection. In the process of building peace, it is important not to destroy the ecosystem and develop it correctly. Eco’s universe is represented by thousands of plants and hundreds of animal species. You need to erect buildings, harvest crops, extract resources, etc. By exploring locations, you can obtain various resources that are needed for the construction of certain buildings.
Every action has an impact on the outside world. An inevitable collision with a meteorite is coming and there are two options: either it will be possible to build advanced technologies that will repel its attack, or it will destroy everything that has been built for so long. The online game allows you to build entire cities, take care of a farm, hunt animals, develop a transport system, sew clothes, build transmission lines, develop technologies, etc.
Each player himself determines the image of his planet. You can set a profession for the main character. Using the opportunity of a free online game, you need to trade with other players. Eco has a data table that tracks every aspect of this world: records legislation, regulates malicious systems, evaluates technologies, etc. Each individual organism forms a link in the chain. The emergence or destruction of a particular life form has a significant impact on the entire planet. For example, if rivers are polluted, fields will be poisoned, which will lead to the destruction of crops.
By studying the graphs, you can develop a further action plan. Laws begin to influence society, determining its development. All decrees should primarily concern the environment: reducing deforestation, developing environmentally friendly factories, etc. You can vote for this or that law. You can come up with your own currency, regulating its exchange rate on the market. There is no need to get carried away with all this, since the global goal does not change, because you cannot let the world perish.

Game Description AtmaSphere is a small arcade game about the adventures of a ball. There’s even a simple plot. We play for a ball named Ballard. He needs to get to the house of his beloved, whose name is Ballerina. He will not encounter any traditional enemies, but there will be plenty of obstacles.
The main goal here is to help the hero get from point A to B. They are presented here in the form of houses. The game’s gameplay is similar to Ballance and Marble Madness. We just roll the sphere and don’t let it fall. Physics built on inertia helped make this process more fun.
The ball does not always move only from left to right. Often he needs to roll up or down. On a plane, it can move and accelerate in any direction. The hero can also push boxes, barrels and jugs. These objects help slow down in especially dangerous moments. In AtmaSphere the view is made in 2.5D format. The camera here is always located on the side.
The indie project has 30 levels. You can use them to collect coins (there are always different numbers of them) and 5 multi-colored diamonds. According to the lore, the ball picks up gold for the sake of showing off, and jewelry - to impress his girlfriend. It is not necessary to do this. This is just an additional challenge. You cannot buy anything with foreign currency.
There are traps in the locations: spikes, blades, saws, boulders, etc. They all try to push our ball off the track. There are also moving platforms, elevators, and thin paths with sharp turns. If a character falls into an abyss, he automatically returns to the last checkpoint or to the very beginning of the map. The scenery here is the same for all stages - medieval architecture with a forest in the background and constant rain.

Game Description An entertaining puzzle quest, made in a non-standard genre for a computer game. While playingGorogoa, the player must match images on the screen in a 2x2 grid, where each image has some kind of animated meaning or message. Thus, you create a whole picture that moves you towards the development of the plot, but does not reveal the main message until the very end.
The plot reveals to us a certain boy who goes through his whole life in these pictures, so Gorogoa can be called a philosophical parable in which the protagonist will grow up, look at the world differently, and after that he will grow old and begin to reflect on the past. In the very first scenes, we are introduced to a monster who will lead the protagonist through a colorful landscape that gradually turns into the consequences of war - wasteland, ruins, death.
On our screen there will be several components of the picture that will help us move further through the plot. For example, we always know half of an animated image, and we must find a logical conclusion to it. If there is a tree with an apple on top, and we have a picture with a bowl for apples, then we can pick this apple by simply moving the picture.
The entire game is an interactive graphic novel, the essence of which the player must figure out on his own, which is extremely difficult. The development of the project lasted 6 years, and during this time it was condemned, accepted, criticized, but recognized.
• Puzzles that reveal life;
• Hand-drawn images;
• A plot in which everyone can find themselves.

All multiplayer functions are retained on the pirate version, and all online content is available for free. You can play online online or use a LAN connection. Alone or with partners, online play allows you to solve complex and inventive puzzles related to electricity, agriculture, gravity, medicine and spatial reasoning.
The gameplay is distinguished by an increased degree of complexity. By joining forces with your comrades, you need to optimize various complex systems in every possible way, using all kinds of knowledge and practices. The project includes scientifically based cause-and-effect relationships and proposes to find a way to truly survive in critical situations. The constant lack of resources and time forces participants to act as quickly as possible and make decisions on the fly that will help bring the critical situation back to normal. However, this is not so easy to do!Key features of Stationeers: possibility of free online play; complex construction system; many parameters of temperature, pressure, combustion, gas mixtures, water and fire; planets and asteroids available for exploration; deforming landscape; construction of factories, conveyors, computers and etc.; writing programs using integrated circuits and assembly code; growing plants and caring for livestock.
Events take place on space stations, far from human civilizations. You need to collect resources, improve your base, craft tools and much more. When mining ore, for example, it is necessary to process it using specialized machines, including smelters, sorters, centrifuges, stackers, conveyors, manufacturers, etc.

Network play will allow you, together with a friend or random players, to restore peace in the country and deal with the source of the disease called Blood Fever. At the center of the story is the charismatic military commander Rondar Lekain. He believes that only evil magicians are to blame for what happened. Therefore, only the second coming of Aonir, the most powerful of all gods, can return the kingdom of Eo to its greatness. Together with him you will explore a huge dark fantasy world with a variety of biomes and creatures. If you manage to find new heroes, you can add them to your party. Sky Force Reloaded has several upgrade branches that allow you to improve the aircraft’s armor, the power of its guns, and install additional weapons to fire from several guns at the same time.

As you understand, the game is quite difficult, but if you are a fan of real hardcore, then Sky Force Reloaded offers several difficulty levels that can reveal the gameplay from all sides.

Game Description The events of the new part of Call of Duty: Wwii unfold during the Second World War. The developers again returned to the origins, adding to the old plot campaigns the schedule of our time, the gameplay of the last parts and the voice acting from the professional studio within the company. The basis of the plot is a landing in Normandy. The narrative of the European Theater of Acts of the Second World War begins with it. All Call of Duty: Wwii will be deployed inside Europe: not a step towards the USSR or East. We will play for the French, English, Americans and rebels among the Poles. The game campaign is saturated not only with large -scale shooting, the sounds of real battle and a lot of blood, but by betrayal, killing friends, and the change of command.
The game also offers you to go through the whole plot in one player mode, a multi -user and joint game. If the “one player” must completely plunge into the events of the Second World War, then the cooperative part of the first -person shooter demonstrates separate missions, where artificial intelligence projects a task for two people. The weapon of the game is fully consistent with that time. It is a pity, but the developers have not yet added effects such as “weapons froze” or “jammed”. Take it, shoot, kill, hold a position and you will be happy. The joint regime and multi -user missions open before us open battlefields for the battles of 30x30 (and more), and the scenarios of some tasks go beyond the scope of the shooter, turning the game into the horror.

Game Description InCuphead we choose one of two heroes and set off to conquer a world that looks like very old cartoons, with tons of weapons, special moves and immortality. A classic, in the truest sense of the word, platformer, in which everything is set in the world of the 1930s. The music is jazz accompaniment, the graphics are standard Disney of the time, and the bosses are neither good nor evil. They are trying to kill us, but we can try to destroy them countless times. A true example of hardcore gameplay and an unusual setting, Cuphead’s surroundings seem to mock the gamer. Don’t be fooled: despite the cartoonish style of the image, this is pure hell for the casual player - a complex platformer with shooter elements, made in the style of the 1930s.
The user (and his friend, a joint passage is provided) embark on a journey full of unforgettable adventures, atmospheric locations and incredibly powerful, almost unkillable bosses. The protagonists are represented as mugs with arms and legs that shoot from their fingers, they and the rest look like classic Disney cartoons due to hand drawing. But despite the frivolous setting, each level is a real test. The game has a multiplayer mode. The platformer is a classic because of its controls, but not because of the story. If in other representatives of the genre the emphasis is on conquering the world, then in Cuphead the main task of the player is to cope with all the bosses that come along the way. They may be weaker than the previous ones, but they help you get a new weapon, learn techniques, see a new scene or listen to a jazz composition. Good old music.
The soundtrack, corresponding to the era of the thirties, also sets a special mood - mainly jazz and other similar compositions that fit perfectly into the general, crazy atmosphere of the game. This is many hours of difficult, incomparable combat, equally good at spoiling your nerves and delivering true pleasure. The hero can easily parry objects in the air and reflect them using learned combinations and techniques. But the basis of the game is still dealing maximum damage to the boss. By the way, the devil sends us bosses because Cuphead (the main character) must repay his debt to him. The faster the protagonist falls to the devil, the longer it will take to repay the debt - physical or spiritual. Therefore, our hero seeks to destroy the entire devilish army in order to pay off the minimum amount of debt.

Game Description The world ofARK: Survival Evolved is a setting full of dangers, in which not only dinosaurs, but also other creatures will try to kill you. People become especially dangerous. The game does not have any interesting plot, but there is a huge open world in which you have to build your base, hunt with a group of people (your friends), attack, defend, make weapons and explore the area. Survival is eternal hunger, need, thirst, the demand for a roof over your head and the desire to develop. Therefore, in the world you will be able to plant plants, harvest crops, go hunting, cut down trees, kill dinosaurs and other creatures - reptiles, amphibians and some mammals. Exploring the world doesn’t have to be done alone. You will be able to create a tribe that will be a whole group. She can have her own goals and intentions in the world, and common ideals will unite people. With innovations, players can declare war between tribes while playing in multiplayer mode. The game features coloring of substances, summoning mystical creatures using special ritual objects, and much more, which is not found in conventional simulators where you simply need to escape the weather (in ARK: Survival Evolved, time changes, as does the season).
