Game Description Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2, the second installment in the popular UNS series, allows you to play online and with a friend, providing free online play. Now fans can enjoy exciting battles online online without resorting to using pirated copies - because the game is available for free. Across 23 levels spanning nine chapters and one extra chapter, players can experience unique aspects of online play by activating powerful combos and jutsu in Awakening mode. Even guest character from Tekken 6, Lars Alexandersson, can join the fights in this exciting sequel.
As you progress through the story, jutsu and Ultimate Jutsu for specific characters become available. Support characters return with interesting upgrades. Players can choose between Guard, Attack, and Balanced support types, which affects their actions during the first level of Support Drive. This level starts automatically when support characters are summoned enough times. Depending on the type and actions of the player, support characters will appear on their own, without resetting the charge, even if it is not full. However, the player cannot manually summon a support character who has already done so automatically.
For example, a support character set to defend will automatically block enemy charges while the player charges chakra. Attack type support helps in combos and knocks opponents back. Balanced characters throw projectiles along with the player and block Ultimate Jutsus, temporarily canceling their support. The second level of Support Drive unlocks Team Ultimate Jutsu, a powerful technique activated by repeatedly pressing the chakra and attack buttons. It consumes a significant amount of chakra, but deals enormous damage to unprotected opponents.
Unlike the free-roaming nature of the original game, the sequel uses traditional JRPG screens and movement. Players go beyond the Leaf Village, traversing forests, deserts, and even the Hidden Sand Village. Boss battles return with added quick-time events and cutscenes. Online features include casual quick matches, ranked matches with leaderboards, match customization, and the ability to host matches.

The adventurer moves through the open world on a global map. While traveling between points of interest, he may encounter a random event. You are allowed to skip such events if you wish. In cities, the character communicates with NPCs. Sometimes its characteristics influence the further development of the conversation. All the dialogue here is comic and absurd. Game Description Lost Technology is a real-time strategy simulation involving over 100 characters from 12 factions fighting for control of territories. The player’s initial choice of faction determines the specific events and dialogue that unfold throughout the campaign. The world of this project is defined by eternal enmity - a state of conflict that does not allow any nation to survive for more than 50 years.
The true history of mankind, including advanced technology, has been erased or altered by the victors who rewrite events for their own purposes, be it in the name of justice, earth or greed. Lost Technology’s gameplay follows a structure of three alternating phases that advance conflict. The first phase provides a turn-based strategy map for recruiting standard units and powerful followers, gathering armies, and managing diplomacy with other powers.
After this preparation, the second phase initiates real-time battles, where the outcome of the conflict is decided by the command of the army, the formation of units and the use of terrain. The third phase introduces story events triggered by special game circumstances; decisions made in these scenarios directly affect strategic development and interaction between factions. The setting features a world reminiscent of the fantasy Middle Ages, but containing the remnants of a civilization that once had scientific advances beyond modern understanding. This technological regression is a direct consequence of the incessant battles that have consumed the lands for generations.

Game Description A funny open-world first-person shooter -Slime Rancher is a mixture of genres in one complex picture, which the developers called - Boundless Outland. We plunge into a special experimental environment. Our hero’s name is Beatrix LeBeau, and he is a farmer. Armed with courage, madness and a funny vacuum cleaner, he decides to stay on the planet of the Boundless Outlands, because a certain Hobson Twillgers left us his farm.
The Earth is several thousand light years away, so we have no way to go back. The hero decides to put the farm in order and start growing crops, but the game does not imply such simple development. For example, every day we will perform many tasks related to Slimes. These are small creatures that you will collect throughout the game. With this, the protagonist plans to make a fortune by stuffing his vacuum cleaner with a backpack attached.
In addition to collecting Slimes, we will explore the open world of the KB, collect resources, plant new crops and improve the farm around us. Also, other farmers will keep various pets near us, who will want to buy Slimes or a few other resources from you. The more you satisfy their needs, the more rewards you receive, for which you can buy many in-game items.
Get money and expand your farm. Upgrade your backpack vacuum cleaner to become a true farm lord in Slime Rancher! Resources obtained at the farm near the house can be used in different combinations in the Slime Science window: craft items, furnish the house, create decor; Treasures, secrets, an interesting open world, funny graphics, simple gameplay and a role-playing quest system - why not try all this in a new game about Slimes?
The game has three modes: adventure, carefree and race. The more slimes you cross, the more species you get. The slimes themselves are divided into 4 types:
Regular. Cross easily; Largo. These are hybrid slimes that produce 2 plorts of slimes, and if you feed them their favorite food, they produce 4 plorts; Proudly. Huge slimes that are absolutely motionless. Most often they consist of 10 regular slimes. To remove it from the place, you need to blow it up by feeding it with your favorite food. Inside there are many good items and a teleport; Varra. The only aggressive creatures in the game. They turn black and begin to take hostile actions against you immediately after Largo eats the alien plort.

Game Description SAELIG (stylized as SÆLIG) is an RPG with strategy and management elements. The game focuses on managing the lives of the Anglo-Saxons in the kingdom of Wessex, extracting resources, managing life, and defending against attacks from warring savages from the Scandinavian lands. Gameplay involves individual playthrough:
live the life of a typical family man: get married, have children and work on a farm; start your own business: hire workers, produce goods and engage in trade; lead a criminal gang of thieves, terrorizing the area and stealing valuables from residents; become a monopolist and sabotage competitors; buy houses, rent them out, or live like a hermit without a roof over your head.

each character in the game lives his own life and goes about his own business; You can leave behind a successor who will continue your lineage and family business; changing weather conditions and seasons; fires and diseases that are global in nature for urban and rural residents; a skill system that allows you to improve abilities in any industry that the character is involved in.
The setting of England in 880 allows you to fully experience the life of the era and plunge into the past, becoming not only an eyewitness, but also a participant in historical events.

Game Description TEKKEN 7 is a side-scrolling 3D fighting game that tells the true story of the Mishima clan’s feud. In the storyline we learn why Heitachi killed his wife, for what reasons Kazuya Mishima survived. The basis of the game’s action is a fighting game based on love, family relationships with friendly fights.
Each battle in Tekken 7 is a separate branch in the plot, so after the end of the battle (victory in it), we see a small interactive video of the creation of the entire universe, Kazuya growing up, and the formation of the Mishima clan. Also in this part the origin of the devil gene is revealed. The action of the game is reviewed by an unknown journalist who became interested in all the feuds between the clans and other TEKKEN fighters.
The fighting game has undergone major changes. In addition to the fact that the developers have installed the game on Unity Engine 4, we see a major upgrade in graphics and interactive films within the storyline. Thus, by watching full-fledged flashbacks, the plot and “hidden details” are fully told. 10 new characters were added to the game, some of which only existed in the past, like Heitachi’s wife, Kazumi. New game strikes such as :
Rage Art - allows you to “destroy” 2/3 of the enemy’s health if your life level is at a critical level; Rage Drive - a blocked blow that deals 60-80% of the total damage in proportion to the enemy’s life. The character turns white, and the enemy can repulse this super blow; Power Crush - you can strike even if you are attacked at the same moment. You only ignore two types of hits: mid and high.
Of the available modes, we were left with arcade, duel and practice, where we train techniques. A VR mode has been added with the ability to slow down time and view the battle from any angle. “Treasure Fight” is an old battle format where successive fights lead to new rules and opponents. In multiplayer games, fights between friends and other players are available. Achievement for a game can be a rating that affects championships within the created server. There is also a “customization mode” in which we change the appearance of the heroes.
The developers were the first to try to make the story progression of a fighting game cooperative. Whatever side you play for, the outcome of the battle will be decided by the further passage of the plot. Even if you fight between Heitachi and Kazuya, the winner of the match will show you his history of how events unfolded. The key features that the studio hinted at in the description for TEKKEN 7 are a family story told not without tears.

The main innovation is the Rage Art mechanic, which allows you to carry out strong blows that remove up to 80 percent of your health. Jack-7 is a new model of the Jack series; Master Raven is a ninja girl.
Several confrontation modes are presented: Arcade, Duel, Practice, Battle for Treasures and Customization. The jukebox allows you to select soundtracks from all previous titles. The roster includes 13 new fighters. Many old characters have returned, including Julia Chan, Brian Fury, Anna Williams and others. Four heroes from other franchises made guest appearances: Akuma, Geese Howard, Noctis Lucis Caelum and Negan.

Rivals can be avoided if you meet them in outer space, but if they themselves attack you, you will have to put the station or planet into combat mode.
At the beginning of the game you choose one of 8 races. Each of them influences certain characteristics of the people’s advancement. For example, rapid population growth, rapid resource extraction, increased improvement, rapid research. The resulting system contains several planets and one star. New ones appear according to the same principle: near a new or old star. Some of the planets are uninhabitable, so keep in mind that most planets will not be able to build a colony. In Endless Space 2 we will have to go to war with those with whom our ally from the Alliance is at enmity.

The universe has several significant differences from the real world: the Soviet Union did not collapse, the President of the United States of America John Kennedy did not die due to an assassination attempt, as well as a serious leap in technology in the field of space research, as a result of which humanity came into contact with an alien race - the Typhons.

The “Cage” station in the distant orbit of the Moon becomes an important object in space; its purpose is to obtain information from captured Typhons through experiments, to study the structure of the aliens and determine weak points. It will become the place where the gameplay takes place.
The plot is not linear, the player is responsible for all decisions made by the protagonist (at the beginning of the passage you will be asked to choose the gender of the main character). Game Description Rain World is a conceptually original indie video game created by just 4 people. Brings something new to the platformer genre, focusing on hardcore. You take control of an unusual creature - a slugcat. He had not yet grown up, and always lived under the supervision of adults. But an unfortunate incident occurs, and the protagonist ends up in the industrial areas of the city, where his race obtains provisions. Experience a complex journey for yourself as you control a tiny creature and explore a cruel world to find its parents.
This project contains many different mechanics. The main goal can be considered survival in unfamiliar territories. All locations are procedurally generated, which is why at each level there will be many unknown dangers waiting for you, to which you need to apply the trial and error method. But having understood the gameplay features, the project will reveal itself on the other side, offering real features of a “survival game”. The graphics feature a pixelated design reminiscent of old-school 16-bit video games.
The main enemy in all biomes will be deadly rain, from which you need to hide in special shelters. Also, numerous enemies will pose a threat; you need to have a unique approach to each, otherwise every mistake will cost you your life. But that’s not all, each location must be cleared for resources, otherwise the game will certainly show the death screen, and start from the checkpoint. From time to time, various puzzles will appear along the way, each of which requires logical involvement in order to successfully complete them.

Game Description Vikings - Wolves of Midgard is an isometric role-playing action game that allows you to play as a pirate online for free with a friend or compete with random players online online. The world is inspired by Scandinavian mythology. The action takes place on the shores of Midgard. The history of the Vikings is closely intertwined with phantasmagoria. Using the opportunity of a free online game, you will have to face huge jotuns, hordes of the living dead, and also engage in battle with the army of Ragnarok. A cold falls on the lands, as a result of which the powerful Jotuns return to take revenge on the gods from Asgard. The fate of the continent is at stake.
The warriors of the Ulfung clan, also known as the Wolves of Midgard, being outcasts, decide to stand up for all of humanity and take the situation into their own hands. You will play as the leader of the Wolves. The online game will take you through Nifilheim, Muspelheim, Fimbulwinter and other mythical locations, where you will have to fight with ferocious monsters and giants. Over the course of a three-year winter, the protagonist will need to overcome severe trials and traps of the gods. To gain the favor of the Almighty, it is required to make offerings at the altars in the form of the blood of fallen enemies. When the gifts are accepted, the hero receives new powers and abilities.
Having filled a special rage scale, the warrior temporarily goes into berserk mode. Increased strength allows you to arrange a real bloodbath. As you progress through Vikings - Wolves of Midgard, you can hone your weapon skills. Swords, bows or staves are represented. Each type of weapon changes the strategy and tactics of battle. By collecting the amulets of Thor and Loki, the hero receives divine powers. By passing the tests of the gods, rewards are earned to help you on your adventure. Co-op play is available, inviting you to team up with a friend to go through the storyline together. There are 4 difficulty levels to choose from, challenging even the most experienced warriors.

Game Description Tower 3D Pro is a simulator that immerses you in the intense work of an air traffic controller, managing air and ground traffic in a detailed 3D environment. To perform the assigned tasks, the specialist is provided with all the necessary tools, including flight strips, as well as radar screens that monitor the situation both in the air and at the airport. Real-time visualization allows you to monitor the movement of official vehicles and other vehicles, which creates the feeling of a living and functioning airfield.
The primary responsibility is to coordinate aircraft of various types and sizes. By issuing clear commands, taxi routes to terminals and runways are assigned. Aircraft traffic control requires constant attention: it is the controller who gives permission to cross lanes, stop and start, as well as the final permission to take off. The simulator implements complex scenarios, such as takeoffs from intersecting runways, and the control of the aircraft is entrusted to advanced artificial intelligence, which precisely follows the instructions received.
The technological basis of Tower!3D Pro is a speech recognition system that allows you to give commands by voice, which significantly enhances the effect of presence. The dynamic cycle of day and night, as well as changing weather conditions, directly affect work processes, requiring adaptation of the control strategy. In addition to the single-player mode, it is possible to work together with other users in multiplayer. This project is the ideological successor to Tower! 2011, deepening its mechanics and offering a more comprehensive experience away from arcade entertainment.

Game Description The Hunter’s Open World is now available intheHunter: Call of the Wild. This is not a simple hunter simulator, where we will have to climb trees and hide in the grass to kill the next deer, but a full-fledged world with smells, changing wind and weather; with the individual behavior of each animal that must be killed to complete the task. This is not a simple hunt, but a real one! The first-person shooter also features co-op and multiplayer modes. You can team up with 2-7 friends to bring order to your forest.
Of all the available tasks, not only exploration of 13 hectares of forest, swamps and rivers in the mountainous area will be open to you, but also the killing of some animals for villagers to either feast on their meat or get their skins. The game uses an action engine - Apex. Not only will you be able to explore open areas that were created by the same developers who created the leading action films, but you will also be able to trade the items you find, look for rare items in headquarters, abandoned huts and foresters' houses. Killing isn’t all there is to theHunter: CotW.
Its realism is primarily manifested in the amazing beauty of the locations. The forests are truly dense, filled with the sounds of nature and properly working effects. This encourages deep immersion into virtual space. The game is harsh on hunters - here you will not find any hints or infrared vision, the only helpers will be feces and traces left by animals. There is an increased likelihood of spotting game near water sources and notable forest edges. Just like its real counterpart, it takes a lot of patience to fire the single, decisive shot in this painstaking task.
The presence of some leveling options increases the playability of the product. In the store we can purchase additional equipment, and spend experience either on shooting skill or on the necessary dexterity. There are several types of armor and weapons for the player to choose from. For example, if you are tired of a rifle, then you can always change it to a more mobile revolver or bow in order to be less tired. If you’re not shooting accurately and the locals are complaining about the quality of the hide, then try a rifle with the new optical sight to ensure you always hit the eye! However, there is also a nuance here: ballistics, bullet behavior - physics, and the individual movement of all animals. Day and night alternate in the game just like in real life, so get ready for the fact that most of the time you will have to wait for those animals that are needed on the task. After completing some of them, the game character will receive experience and skill points, which can be used to upgrade their skills. If you’ve been looking for a hunting ground for a while with friends, then Call of the Wild is perfect for you.

Game Description A cooperative first-person shooter in which there are only two modes - survival and battle in the territory. Killing Floor 2 does not have a plot, but there is sharp FPS on several maps, where each player chooses the desired role for himself - a zombie or a department fighting an epidemic. In addition to the fact that the gameplay differs on both sides of the barricades, players can buy additional weapons, make skins and show who can stand up best on the map.
If we still talk about the game scenario, then it is short - 4 hours of gameplay - and quite monotonous. An experiment was conducted on the planet, during which several thousand clones scattered throughout the world, and after that they became zombies. We play as a representative of the organization that destroys these clones. In the second part, things are even worse than in the first. The government stopped fighting, closing itself in bunkers; ordinary people give up and allow themselves to be killed; The last fighters for the freedom of people on the planet lower their weapons and close themselves off from everyone. It’s good that all these weapons fall into our hands.
The developers have done a good job of making the game realistic within the gameplay. Blood and severed limbs will scatter across every location where the head of the organization sends us. We added a little more weapons than in the first part. If earlier we feasted on machine guns and assault rifles, now we have pistols, machetes, and homemade huge guns that blow opponents to pieces. The hand-to-hand system has also been improved, where we see how our opponents' bones break, which is why we hit hard.
The multiplayer mode has been improved just as much. The first mode for players is 6 vs 6. Half play as humans, half as mutants with the support of other mutants. The one who manages to kill all enemies wins. The second mode is 6 vs ALL. 6 people are distributed among themselves and appear on the map, where hordes of monsters (depending on the server settings) will gnaw at you.

content:
Game Description Travel on an intergalactic level has become too simple and ordinary. It’s becoming increasingly difficult to create a game that captivates with its graphics, but the developers ofNo Man’s Sky, an indie adventure game with an open world and a wonderful RPG base, were able to recreate the image of space. Distant, limitless, completely open and so human.
We play as a character, but then our gameplay switches to an entire space station or ship. The whole content of the new indie is a third-person multiplayer mode in which each player does exactly what he wants: destroys other ships, terrorizes planets, makes colonies, captures other players and forces them to pay a fee for being in outer space . No Man’s Sky is more of a life simulator in space than a story game.
Different temperature conditions, different terrain and creatures living on it - this is the process of automatic map generation in the game. To upgrade our ship, we will have to fly long distances from the initial point, but quests from “headhunters” will help us with this, pointing to the right planets and civilizations.
On each planet there are limited quantities of resources that can be mined, sold, distributed among other players, or crafted something of your own that will be more expensive in the future. Economic forecasts and building a sales funnel will also be needed in the game. Note that each planet initially has its own level of radiation and radiation. Its terrain is generated automatically based on game algorithms. You won’t be able to find something similar in one galaxy.

Game Description Starbound is a 2D side-scrolling indie RPG adventure with graphics that reference the classic 8-bit titles of the last century. The project has become widespread thanks to the ability to play with a friend in co-op mode on different platforms, as well as a well-developed system of achievements and rewards that motivate you to improve your own skills and collect all kinds of items for crafting and collecting. The surrounding world is presented in the form of open territories, where there are no prohibitions on colonizing unknown planets or performing secondary tasks; you can even not touch the story campaign at all. 7 races live in the vastness of space: Apexes are creatures similar to monkeys. They have the best technology at their disposal. Avians are birds that were deprived of their wings many centuries ago. The weapon was inherited from an ancient powerful civilization. Floranes are plants and are not averse to eating their own brothers. They have mastered the technologies of all races through reverse engineering. Hylotls are fish with unique diplomatic abilities. People look no different from real ones. A single government has been established on Earth, which has eliminated the need for division into countries. Glitches are robots that have remained in the Middle Ages in their technological development. But they have a tremendous speed of construction. Novakids are children of solar energy, have a rather short memory and do not like to write down references to themselves, which is why there is very little information.
The story starts with the creation of a protagonist. You can create a representative of any race, there is the possibility of slight customization. Then a huge universe opens up before the player, full of colorful characters, quests, assignments and dungeons to clear and gain experience for leveling up. In dangerous areas you can stumble upon monsters suitable for taming. They will make excellent companions and can help in battle.
Thanks to a crafting system of more than 2,000 items, gamers are given the chance to equip many planets and become an intergalactic owner of lands. The possibilities for creating your own nook are truly enormous. You can build an inconspicuous treehouse, or you can build a giant Gothic castle, as well as many other options. And everything is limited only by the amount of resources that can be replenished by completing procedurally generated tasks.

Game Description Death Road to Canada is a zombie apocalypse game. It differs from other projects on this topic in its gameplay and humor. It’s a mixture of beat ‘em up and roguelike. The premise here is simple: in the USA, the dead began to rise from their graves and eat living people. After which their victims were also resurrected. The remainder of the population decided to move to Canada because this country was not affected by the epidemic.
The gamer’s goal: to reach a neighboring state in 15 days. Preferably the whole team. The user starts with a squad of two people. As you progress, the team can be increased to a maximum of 3 creatures. The range of travelers is not limited to ordinary people. There are Mexican wrestlers, pop culture characters and even dogs.
Gameplay in Death Road to Canada is divided into a couple of phases. The first is a decision-making simulator. The camera here is located on the side. The user watches the car move along the highway and makes choices in text-based random events. When you have to explore a location, the game switches to the second mode.
In it, with a top-down view, the player, alone or accompanied by 1-2 partners, searches for loot and fights with the undead on randomly generated maps. In residential buildings, offices, supermarkets, shops, police stations and other buildings you can find weapons or resources: gasoline, food and first aid kits. Sometimes you can find a new car. To leave the level, you need to start the car. This is implemented as a QTE.
Battles take place in real time. You can beat the evil spirits with your fists, melee weapons (axes, bats, knives, swords, hammers, cutlery, chair legs) or shoot them with shotguns, pistols, rifles. When swinging a stick, the hero loses some of his strength. Endurance shows on their faces. A tired character will appear red and sweat will start dripping from their head. In such a situation, you need to stop fighting for a few seconds and take a breath.

Game Description Firefight is a real-time simulation game set during World War II. It throws gamers into the heart of intense military battles, where strategy and tactical decisions are the key to success. You will not just command units, but manage their strengths and weaknesses, monitor their movements and carefully orchestrate each action to tip the scales in your favor.
Infantry, tanks, artillery - they are all under your command, and each has their own set of attributes that determine their behavior on the battlefield. The goal is clear, but the path to victory is not always easy. Every detail matters, from managing soldier morale to keeping tanks in working order. What sets Firefight apart from other games in the genre is its commitment to realism. Tanks move according to detailed physics, and bullet trajectories simulate real-life behavior.
It’s not just a matter of lining up shots and charging forward; you need to understand how each unit reacts to the environment and enemy forces. For example, soldiers don’t just fight until they are told to stop. They get tired, they run out of ammunition, and they need medical attention for injuries. It is a delicate balance between control and management of limited forces. Strategy becomes more than just positioning, but an understanding of the very nature of the equipment and personnel you command.

Game Description A side-view platformer -INSIDE - tells the story of a small and unarmed boy who, through an unknown means, ended up in a closed, scary space. The physics of the game and the gameplay invite us to go through the platformer to the last level with a lot of deaths, puzzles, solving difficult problems and good visuals, combined with the atmosphere and the usual soundtrack.
The death of our hero is an endlessly scary animation. We advise you to die in the most favorable conditions, so as not to look at the last 10 minutes of the game. The main mechanic of INSIDE is the movement of the bodies and souls of monsters and players. This type of gameplay calls into question moral and ethical values, since only your hero can move objects at a telepathic distance. People constantly chasing the boy can only hunt and run after the character, while we can take them in a bunch and throw them into zombies.
Character control is too simple, which is why the developers focused on graphics and the plot side. The boy will move through all the locations, find objects, immerse himself in a plot where they want to capture and kill him. By the way, the developers explain in advance that the plot side is not revealed in any way. First you run and grab a helmet to control the zombies, move around locations and try not to get caught by people, and the whole inside story is built on this.

Game Description Dead by Daylight is an asymmetrical cooperative horror game inspired by youth slashers. The story centers on four survivors facing off against a fifth player who controls a bloodthirsty maniac. The defending team’s job is to do everything possible to ensure they aren’t dead by dawn. Finding yourself in the same location with the killer, you need to use the environment and interact with your partners, trying to resist the monster.
In order for the victory to be counted for the survivors, it is necessary to open the gate leading from the location. There are 5 generators available on the map that will need to be started. The maniac can catch people and hang them on special hooks for sacrifices to the Entity. By controlling the killer, you can not kill the victims, but leave them helpless, so that they suffer and bleed. People are much weaker than the monster, so they cannot engage in direct confrontation. In Dead by Daylight, you need to use the environment to fight the enemy or hide, out of sight of the maniac.
Controlling the maniac is presented from a first-person perspective. The survivors are controlled from the third. The maniac wins if he kills all the people. The closer it is, the faster the victim’s heart beats. The maps feature closets, narrow openings, bushes, beds and many other places to hide. The killer can see all actions performed by other players: broken hooks, a running generator, a triggered trap, a phantom trap, etc. Several monsters with their own unique abilities are presented: Hunter, Witch, Nemesis, Pyramid Head, Michael Myers, Freddy Krueger, Amanda Young, etc.
At the beginning of the match, you can set certain skills and perks that affect battle tactics: Knockout, Deer Hunter, Crusher, Your Own Doctor and others. People are pumped up using the bloody web. The main currency is blood points. They buy additional abilities. They are divided by degree of rarity: common, uncommon, rare, ultra-rare and trainable. You can summon the Essence starting from level 10. At level 30, trainable skills are unlocked. Most equipment and support items have a charge. If it is completely wasted, the weapon or equipment cannot be used for the rest of the match.

Game Description Despite the fact thatHearts of Iron 4 is famous for its realism, the new part has completely redesigned the focus tree for individual countries and nationalities. The strategy, dedicated to the Second World War, invites you to play in countries such as Italy, Ethiopia, Spain, Japan and China. Two scenarios that differ in their dates: 1936 and 1939. In one of them you will take part in the Second Italo-Ethiopian War and the Spanish Civil War, and in the second you will see how Japan invaded China, and the Second World War was fought.
As you progress through the Hearts of Iron IV story campaign, you will upgrade individual bonuses for countries - Great Britain, France, Germany, USA, USSR, Japan and Italy. Many bonuses will be mutually exclusive, so keep a close eye on their development. Poland and Hungary were also added to the game at an early stage, but they simply take part in wars. You can’t fight for them. At the beginning of each campaign, you choose a story side. It determines all subsequent actions of your leader and the country as a whole. You can choose neutrality, fascism, communism or democracy.
At the moments of your development, many countries will be able to declare war on you, but the reaction depends solely on ideology. A total strategic war is taking place not only on land, but also at sea and in the air. Remember this when a new ally suddenly turns into a member of a coalition created against you. You can lead any country, but remember that having taken Italy, your soldiers will drown in the mud in the spring and die from the heat in the summer; By choosing the USSR, you will have to overcome snow, mud, bad weather and superior enemy forces. The game also offers a truce between many countries, with the exception of Germany and all of Atlanta. The multiplayer mode supports gameplay on a server where there can be up to 32 battle participants.

Game Description DOOM 2016, unlike DOOM Ethernal, has less dynamics, but is more related to the horror genre. We can say that it began the evolution of the series towards speed and platforming, and it is considered closer in spirit to the series than its brother released in 2020. It was the first step towards a global rethinking of the franchise.
The game takes place inside the corridors of a giant research complex. During an unsuccessful experiment with a portal to Hell, the base of the United Aerospace Corporation found itself in the clutches of invaders - terrible creatures from the underworld. The first chapters show that changing weather can make you die. The second chapter is the same permafrost, but here there will be attacks by hounds, from which it is easy to protect yourself if you look at the ground - the more bones around, the closer the danger. The point of the game is to survive in a strange, mysterious, but interesting world. Each chapter tells a story about your character, and at the end - you must pull Maxwell out of all this madness, who has long gone crazy, but perfectly copes with imitating a healthy person.

Gaining DNA points does not end the entire game, and you must level up antibiotic resistance, disease skills, combo abilities, symptoms, and increased lethality. Remember that your time is limited. By studying combo symptoms, such as coughing and vomiting, people will immediately begin to recognize your disease and, accordingly, will invent a cure specifically for it, coming up with new preventative measures. Game Description Dying Light: The Following is an add-on to the survival horror game Dying Light, which was released in 2015. In this add-on you will find a new location, new weapons, new gameplay elements and a new difficulty level. You will also have the opportunity to play online for free with a friend over the Internet, even if you have a pirated version. This is a great way to play a fun and scary game online.
The expansion takes place in the countryside outside the city of Harran, where the zombie outbreak occurred. The area is ruled by a fanatical cult that believes zombies are divine punishment and a source of salvation. The character, Kyle Crane, infiltrates the cult to learn its secrets and find out how it is connected to the outbreak. The expansion features a controllable buggy that can be customized and upgraded with a variety of weapons and gadgets. You can use a buggy to move around a large map, which is twice the size of all the original maps combined, and fight enemies. The performance of the buggy depends on factors such as fuel, engine, suspension and brakes. The expansion also adds new weapons such as a crossbow and various types of firearms that can be used to fight zombies and cultists. During the day, zombies are slow and weak, and at night they become fast and aggressive. The user can use parkour moves to escape them, or use traps and explosives to destroy them. The expansion includes a new Bounty mode, which offers daily and public tasks that reward experience points. Missions vary in difficulty and objectives, such as killing a certain number of zombies, surviving for a certain time, or finding hidden objects. The expansion also introduces a new Nightmare mode, which makes the game more difficult by increasing the strength and health of enemies, increasing the length of the night, and reducing stamina with each action. The expansion is compatible with the base game, meaning you can switch between the two maps and save your character progress. The expansion also supports single-player and co-op multiplayer modes, allowing you to explore and complete the story campaign and side quests with up to three other players.

Game Description American Truck Simulator doesn’t have the typical pick-up-and-drop-off. This is a strategic and economic simulator rolled into one: we will upgrade our trucks, buy new ones, decide which contracts to take on and what to leave aside. An important component in the process is the driving itself, because it is done in the first person, from the driver’s cabin. Compliance with all traffic rules is the basis and responsibility of every driver. Do not forget that different states have their own rules, so compliance with individual rules that “pop up” on the screen is a mandatory measure, otherwise you will be fined. You will also have to look for a place to stay overnight, because the driver is pretty exhausted on the road.
The project divides cargo into valuable, dangerous, explosive, expensive, and industrial. For example, if you took a tank with gasoline, then it is a valuable, explosive and expensive cargo. If you are carrying valuable metals, they will simply be expensive and valuable. The importance of the contract is determined in advance, and the cost of the completed transportation is instantly transferred to the player’s account. You can buy 5 trucks: Kenworth T680, Kenworth W900, Volvo VNL, Peterbilt 389 and Peterbilt 579. Upgraded engines, tires, gearboxes, and separate power components are sold separately for them. If you want to start your own transport company, then this can be done in American Truck Simulator. Buy new trucks, equip them with all types of rights and licenses, and then buy special tanks so that drivers can transport hazardous and other substances.

Game Description A new installment in the first-person shooter,Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege is a game of multiplayer destruction. We will not just destroy the map to which we and our friends were sent, but we will build traps, plant a bomb, and all this at a distance of a bow shot. The technical equipment of the new part is made specifically so that you can blow up everything in the open location of each level. The developers declare in advance that everything will be different in the game: shooting, physics, weapons, depiction of players.
The game is divided into invaders and those who defend. The latter use reinforced blocks, set up a defense system, set up their own programs for hacking enemy robots, set up ambushes and strengthen the floor and walls. Opponents will be able to listen to their opponents, send robots, plant a bunch of explosives and suddenly detonate them when the entire enemy team has gone for a diversion. Strategic planning is the core of Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege. For more experienced players, game developers and representatives organize matches and tournaments in an intercontinental environment.
Become the best in the project by assembling your own team of professional killers; think over the best tactical plan to capture just one room and do not forget that victory sometimes lies after an explosion, which you should not be afraid to create. There are plenty of weapons in the game, but you need to unlock access to them. This is done for prestige points, rating points or game currency. We get all this at the end of each round. What matters is whether we won or lost.
Multiplayer competitive first-person shooter - Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege - is a lot of realism, juicy fights and repeated victories before a single defeat. There are several modes inside the project that you will definitely master if you learn to shoot straight! The art of destruction is for you. Intense battles over short and long distances that are over in a few minutes - that’s what Tom Clance is all about! You can assemble a small team to administer justice on game servers. Here, each player is equal to the other in terms of equipment and weapons.
The main thing that the developers gave in the new part of Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege is destruction. Aspects of a simple shooter, where every enemy could die from a bullet, are becoming a thing of the past; now an important factor in victory is the destruction of the enemy building or base. You will have to storm, use shields, barbed wire, and other items to improve the strength of your own base. Your team can take a variety of items to win. For example, one person will be able to set up fortifications, the second will be able to track enemies with the help of drones. The third will try to conduct targeted fire from distant points on the map. The main thing in this is skill, tactics and prudence!

A ten-year-old girl named Fran Bow-Dagenhart has been unhappy since childhood - her parents were killed. She was able to escape and later good people were able to find her in the forest. At the hospital, your girl was prescribed a huge number of pills. They don’t help, they don’t even drown out little Fran’s pain, but taking them gives access to another reality. All that remains is to figure out whether the second world is real or is it a hallucination due to the side effects of the drugs.
The atmosphere of horror is also created by the characters you meet in the world: a huge talking ant, living shadows, suspiciously carefree Siamese sisters, truly scary tribes of cones and skeletons. The unusual style of this game will definitely attract you.

Game Description Borderless Gaming forces programs into full-screen, borderless mode, combining the benefits of windowed and exclusive formats. This utility provides smooth switching between the running game and other processes active on the system. It’s designed for titles that don’t have modern display features, including older titles and some problematic PC ports. The tool prevents window minimization or crashes that often occur when using Alt-Tab from a full-screen session, creating a smooth multitasking experience.
With Borderless Gaming, the gamer gains control over multiple display and input options. Options are available to automatically hide the taskbar and force the project to be rendered at a specified size on the selected monitor. Granular controls also include locking the mouse cursor in the active window to prevent accidental clicks on third-party elements, or hiding it completely. Another useful feature allows you to mute the sound of any title running in the background.
Gameplay in borderless mode is often smoother. This configuration eliminates the need for V-Sync, which significantly reduces input lag. The program has a simple interface for adding the games you need, focusing on key features without unnecessary elements that can affect system resources. This makes the tool effective for launching classic titles, providing them with the convenience of working at the level of modern software.

Game Description BeamNG.drive is a car simulator that simulates the behavior of cars during collisions. Excellent physics, realistic controls and spectacular accidents are the main features of the game. The simulator allows you to find out what the consequences will be if, for example, the steering wheel of a Ferrari jams and the car flies into the oncoming lane, where it collides with a 40-ton truck. Or assess the damage to an army jeep whose brakes jammed when it was going down a hill at a speed of 90 km/h, flew off the road and crashed into a tree.
The huge fleet of vehicles will not leave car enthusiasts indifferent; with the help of mods it is possible to add even domestic cars. You can choose several locations for your crash tests: a training ground filled with various jumps and loops, a snow-covered forest, or a small town. There is also water and air transport, and long trains travel along the railways, capable of knocking down an unlucky driver.
Thanks to the excellent skidding physics, you can drive through the tracks, boldly using the drift technique on turns, while trying not to crash the car, or vice versa, depending on how the player wishes. Free mode allows you to do the craziest experiments. In this sandbox, you come up with your own tasks - a beautiful passage of a track, or a giant collision - the game will definitely not disappoint!

Plan everything from the first pedestrian crossing to turn times for trucks. Also in the game there is a time of day that changes like in real life: day and night. The time of day greatly affects the productivity of citizens, areas are empty, no one drives on the roads. Use this fact to quickly get closer to the desired position of mayor. Your squad and other civilians will always lack food, water and other household items, and your hero - the leader of the squad or a lone fighter - will make forays at night in order to “farm” the maximum amount of various goods.
Over time, new characters join our house, who calmly live in our house in the place of the previous residents - because each character is subject to death. People here are tired, hungry, thirsty. They can get sick at low temperatures, and at high temperatures they begin to take off their outer clothing. If a person in a shelter becomes sad, he can calmly leave home, taking some of the supplies, or he can even commit suicide.

Game Description The creators of BlazeRush were clearly inspired by Blizzard’s ride-alongs that came out on consoles back in the 90s. Since that project ultimately did not reach the PC, its spiritual successor appeared a couple of decades later. The game also successfully played with the idea of ​​another racing hit of those years - “Micromachines” - in the form of a single screen for all participants in the race. The arcade action game features co-op for four people. You can race across the network not only with live users, but also with bots. A campaign is available for the single. Tournaments take place on 3 planets with different scenery.
Unlike Rock and Roll Racing, there is no currency here, and therefore, you cannot buy cars and upgrade them along with weapons. Weapons (rocket, saw, sonic cannon, machine gun) and auxiliary items (slime and three types of nitro) simply lie on the levels. Health bars are also missing, so you can only slow down your opponents by pushing them off the track or forcing them to turn around and crash into barriers.
In BlashRush there are not only regular round trips in which you have to arrive at the finish line first, and standard time trials. There are also survival races here, where everyone runs away from a huge skating rink. In addition, there is a mode called “King of the Hill”. The winner is the one who can maintain the lead for 30-50 seconds.
The camera can become awkward for the racer who is ahead as it tries to keep everyone in perspective. In addition, those who are far behind are pushed forward by the game itself, making it impossible to break away from the competitor by half a lap. However, such mechanics add drive to the competition and maintain tension until the very end.

Screencheat only offers online play. Compared to other titles, the indie project stands out with its unusual concept. In it, the screen is always divided into several parts. The number of windows depends on the number of participants. Matches are designed for 4-8 people. All users are invisible. The point of the gameplay is to peek into other people’s windows and determine where everyone is. Based on the information received, you need to find your opponent and try to hit him. There is no health bar, since any successful explosion, blow or shot is fatal. And the ammunition here is endless.
The arsenal includes 10 atypical types of weapons. Among them are a candelabra, a blunderbuss, a piñata, a teddy bear with a bomb inside, and even a car engine that shoots ricocheting plasma balls. Each weapon not only has its own pros and cons, but also leaves a characteristic mark that reveals the fighter’s position. There are 9 modes available - from regular or team “Deathmatch” to “Mysterious Murder”, where you need to eliminate a specific target in a certain way. There is “King of the Hill” and other fun. The possibility of free online play extends to the Internet and local multiplayer. Both options can be combined. You can customize matches by changing victory conditions, enabling or disabling modifiers, and adjusting the availability of certain guns.

Game Description Damned is a first-person co-op horror game with stealth elements. Its gameplay is tailored for short online sessions on the Internet. On Pirate you can play online with a friend or with random users. Each match requires 5 participants. The gameplay here is asymmetrical.
The possibility of free online play allows gamers to experience an atypical experience. In Damned, users can take on one of two roles. There are several monster hunters to choose from. They have different behavior and fighting skills, which adds variety to the gameplay. An assortment of cards is also available. Game Description Metro 2033 Redux is a first-person shooter with a deep story and horror elements. The developers questioned not the simple existence of people underground, but the relationships between them. Has the main threat always been with us, in people? In the world of the post-apocalypse, we play as a character named Artem. He grew up underground, in the Moscow metro. In 2013, the world was hit by the terrible consequences of the latest epidemic. Until 2033, the powers that be raised a new generation that must cope with the danger threatening the entire planet, bring humanity to the surface and free large cities from mutants.
The new Metro is augmented reality physics, graphics, sound and dialogues. The more we dive into the intricacies of the plot, the more it becomes clear that Artyom is a real person, a survivor; a character trying to put a nation of people on top. He does not forget that enemies can become friends if everyone unites against one problem - quarrels, evil, mutants.
The pack includes two games: Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light. Both parts were supplemented with new weapons and graphics. The developers did not touch the plot, and the addition is rightfully considered the author’s work. If in the first part we got to know this world, looked for ways to resolve conflicts and killed a lot, mercilessly, with all types of weapons, then Last Light is rather a deep, story-driven saga about people who do not want to make contact, just to remain in a world where survival I became comfortable among the monsters.
A gas mask is still available in the game in case of a gas attack, you can take a rifle and completely upgrade it, because there will be enough quests where long-range killing is the goal. The atmosphere was supplemented with the old difficulty level - ranger. Playing in a low ammo environment where there is no game interface is a real challenge!
Metro 2033, one of the most popular survival-horror games of recent years, has received a global graphics update. The Redux version received support for 4K resolution, high-quality textures, animation and lighting. For gamers familiar with the franchise, this will be a new exciting journey into an already explored world, which has become much more reminiscent of the real one. For newcomers, the remaster is a great way to get acquainted with this epic FPS.
According to the plot, humanity did not reach 2013, and was almost completely destroyed. The survivors hid in the Moscow metro, and only a few colonies remained on the surface, constantly repelling attacks from unfriendly mutants. Artyom, the protagonist of the game, witnessed an unusual event that threatens the remnants of civilization, and went on a dangerous expedition to warn others.
The gamer will have many hours of survival in a post-apocalyptic environment. He will have to use stealth and shooting skills, as well as communicate with many colorful characters. Metro 2033 is a unique project created by domestic developers, showing the Russian version of the end of the world, with its own heroes and consequences.

Game Description One finger death punch is an arcade fighting game in the style of beat’em up, in which you can feel like a real martial arts master. In this game we have to fight off crowds of enemies that have surrounded the main character and are advancing from opposite sides. The game design is made in 2D, and all the characters are drawn people, which adds simplicity to the game, but at the same time makes it unusual.
Control in the game is carried out by clicking on the left and right mouse buttons when the enemy comes within the radius of your strikes. By gaining combos through continuous combat and avoiding damage, you gain more points and receive various bonuses, for example: switch to Jedi mode and start destroying enemies with a lightsaber until you miss a few blows and it is knocked out of your hands . Sooner or later he will undoubtedly be eliminated, as at this point the pace of the game begins to accelerate. Initially, the dynamics of the game are comfortable enough for the player to feel like a real kung fu master, fighting off weak and strong enemies, but with each new level it begins to grow.
The game has several game modes, namely: passing levels and survival. During the passage, a large map opens in front of the player, on which he will be able to overcome more than 230 levels, which differ in design, pace of play, and in some of them you will have battles with strong enemies and bosses. The battle with them is different from the battle with ordinary opponents, who die from single blows from the player. To win the battle against strong enemies, you need to use combos that the player will see on his screen. As you complete levels, you will unlock various skills that will help you in a difficult and unequal battle with your opponents.
Survival mode - in it the player is asked to carry out an endless battle with the advancing enemy until the last drop of blood in order to score the maximum number of points for combos and a series of kills. In each mode, you can choose a difficulty level, which will determine the speed of the game and the number of enemies, and at the survival difficulty level, something truly unexpected awaits you… During the battle, a huge black cat will crawl out to the left or right of the screen, which will block your view and simply interfere with the fight, so you need to drive it away with the mouse cursor, how do you like this turn?
If you want to let off steam after a hard day and relax, then one finger death punch is perfect for this. Spending hours in this fighting game will not let you get bored, as the changing dynamics of the game, musical accompaniment, combat skills and hundreds of different strikes will not allow your attention to wander.

Game Description Insurgency is a first-person shooter, in which the developers focused on playing in cooperative or multiplayer mode, about the Iraq War. The protagonist is a member of the US PMC, and he is fighting against Iraqi insurgents. The player chooses one side at the beginning of the match, and after that a brutal fight begins between the two factions. The basis of the game is a confrontation between two teams, which include 16 people. The fight takes place on one of the maps covered in the events of the Iraq War.
The game contains more than 20 weapon models, around which points are farmed in tasks or matches. The more battle points you accumulate, the better equipment or modification you buy. To kill an enemy with a regular assault rifle, you will need 3-4 shots. One hit to the head is fatal. There are a total of 12 cards in the game. These are zones in Iraq, Somalia and Afghanistan. 8 multiplayer modes, which perfectly demonstrate the graphics and audio component of the game, supporting 5.1 and 7.1 sound. In each battle, the player will be able to communicate with his team using voice chat, and also show the attack symbol on the map. Game Modes:
Push. Capture three control points; Battle from two fires. The enemy or you have captured 2 points out of 3. You must take 2 and prevent the 3rd from being captured; Cache. Each team, in addition to 3 neutral points, has a place into which the enemy cannot be allowed; Occupation. Simple capture of a point and holding it for a certain time; Escort. You, together with your team, must escort one person to a certain point. Task: do not let them die; Cache protection. You or the enemy will have access to the cache. It is important not to allow the enemy to destroy it or, conversely, to destroy it.
These and other multiplayer and co-op game modes bring the first-person shooter experience of Insurgency to life in the most realistic way possible. Weapons, graphics, sound, maps, events - all this was created by developers who prefer truth in games rather than fiction!

Game Description Project Zomboid is a cross-platform game in which we will have to find a house, equip it, and start surviving in a world where a zombie apocalypse has recently occurred. We are located in Knox County. The latest epidemic infected more than 90% of the district’s residents, and they all became zombies. Difficult conditions will force us to survive, stock up on food, water, weapons and all available supplies in order to simply survive.
We play as one of the survivors who is in the open area of ​​the city. There are thousands of zombies around us who want to eat us. First of all, we need to find a house, check the integrity of its structure, get more or less settled, and then go in search of survivors and supplies in the city. The game does not have a specific ending. The only time the game will end is your own death. If you can survive until the moment the military arrives in the area, then this means that you have practically won, because the military will “drag” a whole army of zombies with them.
At the beginning, you create a character whose gender, race, name, appearance, hairstyle, clothes, beard, etc. can be chosen. Next, you choose a story and place of work. Any factor will entail changes in gameplay. For example, if your character worked before the zombie apocalypse, then his previous job will help him in handling objects. A policeman can shoot better, a carpenter can build defensive structures faster and better, orderlies will be able to heal wounds for themselves and their allies faster, and a cook will be able to prepare a tasty, satisfying dish from a few ingredients.
Despite the fact that the people around you are mired in the fight against zombies, you will be able to kill, rob, and terrorize. But do not forget that you must choose one of the negative qualities. For example, it could be laziness, obesity, myopia, thirst, etc. The better you fight the disease, the more points you get, which can be spent on upgrading positive skills - agility, luck, disease resistance and others. Also, since we are in reality and not in a game, our character will want to eat, drink, go to the toilet, sleep, communicate and relax. Remember this when you are going on your next outing.

Over the course of 5 chapters, the heroes will find themselves in a series of intrigues and conspiracies that will reveal a terrible secret. Who to trust? Who is friend and who is enemy? Game Description Outlast (+Whistleblower) - DLC for the game of the same name, which added more content and a new storyline. The addition contains a backstory of the events that happened in the original, where Miles Upshur played the game. The journalist went to the Mount Massive mental hospital, where, for information received, there were many violations. Here he encountered a crowd of terrible psychos - monsters who had taken over the hospital.
The backstory of the horror comes from the name of the informant, for whom you will play. Waylon Park was an employee of the Murkoff Company. It was this corporation that secretly carried out terrible experiments on the human brain in a mental hospital. By telling Miles about what was happening, he set himself up, so they also experimented on him. Now the hero, in order to get out of the terrible place, must himself fight monsters - victims of non-human doctors.
At the beginning of the playthrough, the player will have to run away from a psycho cannibal who dismembers people. The authors perfectly conveyed madness, fear and the desire to hide from this madness, which will steadily haunt the player. In the process, the user needs to run away from enemies, hide, jump over various obstacles and climb ventilation shafts to escape. The location has many corridors and offices with fallen furniture, boxes, beds, under which you can hide and wait. Next, Waylon accidentally meets Frank Maner, a sexual maniac, and ends up in his lair, where real hell is going on.
In Outlast, screams are heard everywhere, body parts are scattered, and patients create complete chaos. Murder, dismemberment, rape, eating - this is just part of what is happening here. In this version, various deviations and perversions are brought to the fore. Park himself will also have a hard time - he will often receive fractures, get roasted in the oven and have a lot of cuts, wounds and bruises from blows. But this is not so scary compared to what brutal psychos are capable of.

Game Description Age of Empires 2 is a re-release of the classic real-time strategy game with many different improvements. Many years later, this game still remains unique and serves as an example for many strategy developers to follow. In the game, the player will have to take control of a small settlement of a certain faction and lead it to victory and prosperity. Events take place in the Middle Ages, roughly starting from the fall of the Roman Empire and up to the Renaissance. Game Features: Re-release of the classic game. Historical campaigns with stylized visual inserts that reveal certain events. Wide selection of different nations with unique units and bonuses. The ability to turn a miserable settlement into a prosperous empire. Improved AI, improved graphics, additional factions and campaigns .
It is proposed to start with a modest settlement with three workers and one scout. The key aspects of the game are the economic component (quite simple, but effective) and military affairs. There are 4 resources in the game - food, which is spent on most units; timber for most buildings; stone for more advanced and durable buildings; and gold, which is used extensively for both recruitment and research.
Research in the game is varied and is carried out not on a global technology map, but locally, in certain buildings. Often, they relate either to the units produced there, or to the buildings themselves. For example, in the city center you can open loopholes, which will allow settlers settled there during a period of alarm to fire at the enemy, and you can also research handcarts to speed up the collection of resources and increase the health of workers.
Combat units are represented by infantry, riflemen, cavalry, siege engines and special units. Moreover, when the player unlocks the next level of development through research, units are automatically upgraded to this level - a scout turns into a light cavalryman, and a militiaman puts on armor and exchanges a club for a sword. Conventionally, the development process is divided into several eras. Each new era not only opens up access to more advanced buildings and improvements, but also visually changes the style of existing buildings. So a boring stone wall becomes decorated with carvings, and primitive huts turn into full-fledged houses.
The player has several different nations to choose from, each of which has its own unique units (the French have ax throwers, and the British have special archers), as well as some gameplay changes, such as additional protection for buildings or accelerated resource extraction. All nations are balanced and each has both disadvantages and advantages. In addition, all unit lines are voiced in the language of the nation you are playing for. The game supports both a regular battle mode, where you choose your opponents, their number and strength, and a multiplayer mode. And for lovers of historical battles, there is a campaign mode in which you can follow the vivid battles of great commanders such as Joan of Arc, Attila, Genghis Khan, Richard the Lionheart, William Wallace and so on.

But one day it happens that a whole crowd of thugs comes after us, who were well paid to get our bodies. Behind all this is Vaas Montenegro - a sadist, drug addict, psychopath and owner of the largest crime syndicate on the entire coast. The new island becomes your home.

As we progress, we will upgrade our hero with tattoos, which will fill his entire body by the end of the game. They are needed for the character’s new passive and active abilities.
The gameplay of the game is divided into 3 possible ones: stealth, action and fast passage. The project includes main and secondary missions, and each of them requires you to kill enemies. Gradually, new connections will be established on the island, with whom you will eventually come to Vaas and kill him, but that’s another story.
In the game we will have to hack systems, climb towers, find and sell weapons, create our own economy and upgrade every piece of ammunition. Try to complete Far Cry 3 without killing a single person (except for animals that have valuable fur for crafting).

And he will puzzle you a little by purchasing vehicles for other players, paying for their repairs, diesel fuel, and so on. Truck Driving Simulator - ETS is a strategic and economic simulator about a real truck driver who spends the night at motels along the road, eats at roadside cafes, and then takes the money home.

Game Description Borderlands 2 is a shooter with a view from the perspective of the protagonist and leveling up abilities and passive improvements, as in the role-playing adventure genre. A direct continuation of the story of the original game. The main differences from the first part are a greater emphasis on the plot component and the addition of a more advanced weapon editor with many possible modifications that open up as you progress. Weapons are divided into several types according to the manufacturers: Dal - reduced recoil and the presence of a burst firing mode. Tedior - does not have additional horns, instead of reloading it must be thrown like a grenade at enemies to explode. Hyperion is the antagonist’s company. A special feature is the increase in accuracy as the shooting progresses. Malivan - has the ability to impose special elemental debuffs on the enemy, be it freezing or poisoning. Vladov - the fastest-firing weapon. Torrg - has a slow bullet speed, but they have explosive properties. Jacobs - huge damage, but small ammunition. Bandit - spacious magazines, but long reload time.
Before the start of the Borderlands 2 campaign, the gamer is given a choice of 6 characters with different backgrounds, a set of abilities, their own leveling branch and characteristics. They are not tied to a specific type of weapon, due to which everyone can choose their weapon without obstacles. The main character receives assignments during his travels from non-player characters controlled by artificial intelligence or from message boards. For completing quests, you receive a reward in the form of some kind of guns, experience points, or eridium - a rare metal that serves as currency in this world.
At the center of the plot, many characters from the first part of the series remained, for example, the robot Claptrap or the main antagonist of both games, Handsome Jack. The main goal of the protagonist is to destroy Jack’s dictatorial regime on the planet Pandora.

Game Description FTL: Faster Than Light - this project is a two-dimensional simulator of a space combat ship. The creation and publication of this media product was carried out by the Subset Games studio. The official release took place in the first half of autumn 2012. The gameplay is based on the interaction between the player and the crew of the combat starship.
The success of this space tactical strategy will depend on how successful this cooperation is. Don’t forget about the races, of which there are 8 in the game! These are people who excel in learning specialties; Angies, who quickly repair equipment, but are completely clumsy in hand-to-hand combat; Slugs that can see right through your ships; Crystallins - the oldest, most powerful race - practically do not lose health where there is no oxygen. You can get acquainted with other races during the game.
As you overcome the difficulties of the key story mission, you will more than once have to choose between saving your ship and all the people on board, or fearlessly engaging in battle with superior enemy forces on pain of death. Run, surrender or fight to the last - these are the three roads between which you will navigate your turn over and over again. If enemies shoot your engine, decide on the supply of energy to the affected area, send mechanics there, or immediately strike back: energy is always consumed unilaterally, which greatly complicates the process of passing. But at any moment you can stop time and assess your position, and then go to upgrade a separate part of the ship or base.
If you are a fan of games of this genre, then you definitely won’t be able to pass by the impressive scale of FTL: Faster Than Light. Set off to conquer outer space on your starship, at the head of the fearless crew of your interstellar combat vessel!

Game Description Touhou shinreibyou ~ ten desires begins when strange divine perfumes begin to come from people, Yokaev and fairies. In response to this event, female protagonists of the game go to the other world, suggesting that it is the key to unraveling the phenomenon. The gameplay offers to lead the chosen heroine through a series of levels filled with flitches of shells from opponents. The task is to survive these attacks and destroy the entire opposition, completing the passage of the stage with the boss.
In Touhou Shinreibyou ~ Ten Desires, survival depends on the management of several resources, including a limited number of lives and spells for defensive maneuvers. The capacity of the character’s shot is determined by the collection of special objects falling out of enemies. The central mechanics of this Shoot ‘em up is tied on a trance scale represented by the skull and soul icon in the lower part of the screen. This indicator is filled when the player defeats the enemies and collects the divine spirits remaining after them.
The trance scale provides a special reaction to damage. If a shell enters a gamer if there is at least one charge on the indicator, it enters the state of a trance instead of an immediate loss of life. This condition is served as a hallucination on the verge of death, which gives temporary invulnerability and maximum power of attack for a short period of time. The indicator is depleted during this period, and when it is devastated, the heroine dies, performing the final blow. Alternative activation of trance at maximum charge does not lead to a loss of life after the timer, offering a strategic offensive option.

Game Description Terraria is a simulator of construction, life, survival, an interesting storyline and everything that could be combined into a game with the Sand Box style. Simple 8-bit graphics take us into a randomly generated world generated by the game itself. The open map is almost endless if you dig deep into the world, but you will be stopped by armies of monsters or underground knights. Terraria is not as simple as it seems.
We start with a simple traveler who is looking for clues and wood to build his first home. Before starting the game, we create a character, completely changing his appearance. This is not so important for the future player, because after 2 hours you will put on armor, after 3 you will destroy underground monsters with the help of magic, which is learned in a special book, which also needs to be found or created. The game can be played by several people, so at the depths of the dug mine you can find money, jewelry and rare resources. You can create something from everything in the game, and the workbench will help you with this, which has a huge number of recipes for various items.
Go deep into the ground, into the very depths of your location, to find valuable items; build your hero with the best weapons to find and not lose with opponents who are not at all like the first zombies at the very top - these monsters will cast spells, summon a mass of black spiders, revive enemies, making them skeletons in armor. Gradually, while you are building a house, different people will come to you. They can come and ask for shelter, or they can sell you valuable items for gold that you find in the depths of the earth! Don’t miss the opportunity to explore ancient caves in Terraria - a platformer, sandbox and simulator of everything that is accessible to the common man.

Game Description The computer game “The Witcher 2 Assassins of Kings” is an expanded limited edition of the impressive continuation of the 2008 giant of the world of role-playing video games “The Witcher”. The development of this project was carried out by the famous studio CD PROJEKT RED. The announcement came in May 2011. Geralt of Rivia is the greatest of the line of witchers, wielding a sword better than others, almost the only one who can resist the forces of darkness, while being something between an ordinary person and a monster. He wanders the world and makes a living by exterminating monsters. But sometimes he has to solve other problems.
This time, our hero of The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings will have to find and deal with a guild of professional assassins. As the game progresses, Geralt will encounter his own kind more than once. Witchers are much stronger than any ordinary warrior, so fights with half-bloods will be very cruel and spectacular. Note that small obstacles in the form of fences and small fences are no longer something incomprehensible to Geralt. Along with the changed combat, the developers added the ability to overcome fences. Of course, it won’t be possible without crowning battles with all sorts of monsters, of which there are traditionally many here. Spectacular action scenes and a well-thought-out combat system, which is a mixture of active movement, fencing with a one-and-a-half-handed sword and inserts of combat magic spells, make the right impression. There are probably no better fights in the RPG world anywhere else.
In Arena mode, you will be able to fight with many enemies advancing from different corners and crevices. After this, you will go on an adventure where the developers will introduce you to Geralt’s worldview through the storyline. Don’t forget about the “Dark” mode. It is prepared for experienced players and includes many items that are only available in battle with the strongest opponents in the series. The second part of the famous series remained the most invisible, compared to the first and third parts. The thing is that in the same 2011, the more famous and popular TES: Skyrim was released. However, all the same, critics and gamers rated The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings very highly and it is rightfully considered one of the best games in this genre.

The gameplay of Portal 2 is based on physics. Fluid mechanics allows you to influence different objects upon contact. For example, a pushing gel increases speed. It is highlighted in orange. There is a blue gel that has a repulsive effect - it springs objects. A transformative gel is created on surfaces, creating the effect the player desires. Test chambers represent different tests. For example, a transport funnel contains a tunnel of energy lines, between which turrets and other objects must be transferred.
The cameras are called Whitley and contain a serial number. Cargo Cubes are represented by Refraction of Suppression, Aerial Faith Panel, Thermal Beam, Franken Turret, Rounded Security Cube, etc. Each has its own unique properties and is necessary to solve a particular puzzle.
